題目(英):
An application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a VPC. The application processes logs that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The EC2
instance needs to access the S3 bucket without connectivity to the internet.
Which solution will provide private network connectivity to Amazon S3?
選項(英):
A. Create a gateway VPC endpoint to the S3 bucket.
B. Stream the logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Export the logs to the S3 bucket.
C. Create an instance prole on Amazon EC2 to allow S3 access.
D. Create an Amazon API Gateway API with a private link to access the S3 endpoint.
解析(英):
The correct answer is A because establishing a gateway VPC endpoint to an S3 bucket provides private network connectivity to Amazon S3. This method allows EC2 instances to access S3 buckets without needing to be connected to the internet. A gateway VPC endpoint is an AWS service that allows resources in a VPC to access other AWS services without going over the Internet.

The other options are incorrect because:
- Option B requires streaming the logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs and then exporting to an S3 bucket. This method requires an Internet connection and therefore does not meet the requirements of the question.
- Option C: Creating an instance role allows the EC2 instance to access the S3 bucket, but this method requires an Internet connection and therefore does not meet the requirements of the question.
- Option D. Creating an Amazon API Gateway API does not directly provide a private network connection to the S3 bucket and requires a connection to the Internet, so it does not meet the requirements of the question.

Therefore, setting up a gateway VPC endpoint to an S3 bucket is the most suitable solution to provide private network connectivity to Amazon S3.

題目(英):
A company is hosting a web application on AWS using a single Amazon EC2 instance that stores user-uploaded documents in an Amazon EBS
volume. For better scalability and availability, the company duplicated the architecture and created a second EC2 instance and EBS volume in
another Availability Zone, placing both behind an Application Load Balancer. After completing this change, users reported that, each time they
refreshed the website, they could see one subset of their documents or the other, but never all of the documents at the same time.
What should a solutions architect propose to ensure users see all of their documents at once?
選項(英):
A. Copy the data so both EBS volumes contain all the documents
B. Congure the Application Load Balancer to direct a user to the server with the documents
C. Copy the data from both EBS volumes to Amazon EFS. Modify the application to save new documents to Amazon EFS
D. Congure the Application Load Balancer to send the request to both servers. Return each document from the correct server
解析(英):
The correct answer is: C

[Why is C correct? 】
This question tests the concepts of "Stateful vs Stateless" and "Shared Storage":

Limitations of EBS: Amazon EBS is a block storage service that is typically designed to only connect to a single execution instance within a single availability zone. In your current architecture, Server A reads EBS-A, and Server B reads EBS-B. When a user accesses through ALB, if he is directed to A, he will only be able to see the files in disk A; if he is directed to disk B after reorganization, he will only be able to see the files in disk B. This is why users never see a "complete" list of documents.

Advantages of EFS: Amazon EFS (Elastic File System) is a network file system (NFS) that supports Read-Write-Many (RWX) and can be mounted by hundreds of EC2 execution instances simultaneously and spans multiple availability zones.

Solution: After moving the data to EFS, Server A and Server B will mount the same EFS path. No matter which server the user is assigned to by ALB, both servers see the "Single Source of Truth" and therefore can see the complete file list.

[Why are the other options incorrect? 】
Option A is incorrect: Although "copying data" is theoretically possible, it is extremely difficult to achieve in practice. You must write programs to synchronize two EBS disks located in different AZs, which will cause serious latency and consistency issues. If a user uploads a file on Server A, Server B cannot get it immediately. This is not a cloud-native approach recommended by AWS.

Choice B is incorrect: these are so-called "sticky sessions." Although the same user can be permanently connected to the same server, this does not solve the fundamental problem - if the file is uploaded by "different users", everyone can still only see fragmented data, and if one of the servers crashes, the files stored on the disk will still be inaccessible, which does not comply with the principle of high availability.

Option D is incorrect: Application Load Balancer (ALB) is responsible for distributing traffic, but it does not have the function of "merging the contents of different server disks". It cannot grab some files from A and some files from B and then present them to the user.

🎓Expert summary
In the AWS architecture exam, whenever you see "multiple EC2s need to access the same file system at the same time" or "solve cross-AZ file synchronization problems", Amazon EFS is almost the standard answer.
題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS 上使用單一 Amazon EC2 實例來託管網頁應用程式，並將使用者上傳的文件儲存在 Amazon EBS 卷中。為了提高可擴展性和可用性，公司複製了架構，創建了第二個 EC2 實例和 EBS 卷在另一個可用區域，並將兩者都放在應用程式負載平衡器後面。在完成這個變更後，使用者報告說，每次他們刷新網站時，他們只能看到文件的其中一個子集，但永遠不能同時看到所有文件。解決方案架構師應該提出什麼建議，以確保使用者可以同時看到所有文件？
選項(中):
A. 複製數據，使兩個 EBS 卷都包含所有文件
B. 設定應用程式負載平衡器將使用者導向包含文件的伺服器
C. 將兩個 EBS 卷的數據複製到 Amazon EFS，修改應用程式將新文件儲存到 Amazon EFS
D. 設定應用程式負載平衡器將請求發送到兩個伺服器，從正確的伺服器返回每個文件
解析(中):
正確答案是：C

【為什麼 C 是正確的？】
這題考的是「狀態同步（Stateful vs Stateless）」與「共享儲存」的概念：

EBS 的局限性：Amazon EBS 是一種塊儲存服務（Block Storage），它通常被設計為只能連接到單一可用區域內的單一執行個體。在妳目前的架構中，Server A 讀取 EBS-A，Server B 讀取 EBS-B。當使用者透過 ALB 訪問時，如果被導向 A，就只看得到 A 磁碟裡的檔案；重新整理後如果被導向 B，就只看得到 B 磁碟裡的檔案。這就是為什麼使用者永遠看不到「完整」的文件清單。

EFS 的優勢：Amazon EFS（Elastic File System）是一種網路檔案系統（NFS），它支援 Read-Write-Many (RWX)，可以被數百個 EC2 執行個體同時掛載，且跨越多個可用區域。

解決方案：將資料移至 EFS 後，Server A 與 Server B 會掛載同一個 EFS 路徑。不論使用者被 ALB 分派到哪一台伺服器，兩台伺服器看到的都是「同一個資料來源（Single Source of Truth）」，因此能看到完整的文件清單。

【為什麼其他選項不正確？】
選項 A 不正確：雖然「複製資料」理論上可行，但在實務上極難達成。妳必須寫程式去同步兩顆位於不同 AZ 的 EBS 磁碟，這會產生嚴重的延遲與一致性問題。如果使用者在 A 上傳檔案，Server B 沒辦法即時拿到，這不是 AWS 推薦的雲端原生做法。

選項 B 不正確：這是所謂的「黏性會話（Sticky Sessions）」。雖然可以讓同一個使用者固定連到同一台伺服器，但這並沒有解決根本問題——如果檔案是由「不同使用者」上傳的，每個人依然只能看到碎片化的資料，且若其中一台伺服器當機，存在該磁碟的文件依然會無法存取，不符合高可用性原則。

選項 D 不正確：應用程式負載平衡器（ALB）負責分發流量，但它並不具備「合併不同伺服器磁碟內容」的功能。它無法從 A 抓一點檔案、從 B 抓一點檔案再呈現給使用者。

🎓 專家總結
在 AWS 架構考試中，只要看到 「多台 EC2 需要同時存取同一個檔案系統」 或 「解決跨 AZ 檔案同步問題」，Amazon EFS 幾乎就是標準答案。

題目(英):
A company has an application that ingests incoming messages. Dozens of other applications and microservices then quickly consume these
messages. The number of messages varies drastically and sometimes increases suddenly to 100,000 each second. The company wants to
decouple the solution and increase scalability.
Which solution meets these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Persist the messages to Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics. Congure the consumer applications to read and process the messages.
B. Deploy the ingestion application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to scale the number of EC2 instances based on
CPU metrics.
C. Write the messages to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with a single shard. Use an AWS Lambda function to preprocess messages and
store them in Amazon DynamoDB. Congure the consumer applications to read from DynamoDB to process the messages.
D. Publish the messages to an Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic with multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service
(Amazon SOS) subscriptions. Congure the consumer applications to process the messages from the queues.
解析(英):
The correct answer is D. This is because Amazon SNS and Amazon SQS provide a completely decoupled architecture that eliminates the need for direct communication between the receiving application and the consumer application. When a receiving application publishes a message to an Amazon SNS topic, Amazon SNS copies the message to queues in multiple Amazon SQS subscriptions, allowing the consumer application to pull the message from the queue for processing. This architecture can provide high scalability and fault tolerance. When the consumer application cannot process the message in time, the message will be saved in the queue, waiting for the consumer application to resume normal operation.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics is primarily intended for real-time data processing and analysis, not for decoupled applications.
B. Using Auto Scaling groups to expand the number of EC2 instances only increases the capacity of the receiving application, but does not decouple the receiving application from the consumer application.
C. Using Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and AWS Lambda functions can provide a certain degree of decoupling, but it still requires the consumer application to read information from DynamoDB, which cannot completely decouple it. In addition, Kinesis Data Streams of a single Shard will limit the message throughput and cannot meet the demand of 100,000 messages per second.

題目(英):
A company is migrating a distributed application to AWS. The application serves variable workloads. The legacy platform consists of a primary
server that coordinates jobs across multiple compute nodes. The company wants to modernize the application with a solution that maximizes
resiliency and scalability.
How should a solutions architect design the architecture to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Congure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a destination for the jobs. Implement the compute nodes with
Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Congure EC2 Auto Scaling to use scheduled scaling.
B. Congure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a destination for the jobs. Implement the compute nodes with
Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Congure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the size of the queue.
C. Implement the primary server and the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group.
Congure AWS CloudTrail as a destination for the jobs. Congure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the load on the primary server.
D. Implement the primary server and the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group.
Congure Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) as a destination for the jobs. Congure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the load
on the compute nodes.
解析(英):
To meet the company's needs, solutions architects need to design an architecture that maximizes resiliency and scalability. Option B is the correct answer because it uses an Amazon SQS queue as the destination for the job and sets up EC2 Auto Scaling based on the queue size. This ensures that the number of computing nodes is dynamically adjusted according to changes in workload, thereby improving the scalability and resilience of the system.

Option A is incorrect because it uses schedule scaling, which is not capable of dynamic adjustment as workload changes. Choice C is incorrect because it uses AWS CloudTrail as the destination for jobs, but CloudTrail is primarily used for logging and monitoring the activity of AWS services, not for job scheduling. Choice D is incorrect because it uses Amazon EventBridge as the destination for jobs, but EventBridge is primarily used for event-driven architectures, not for job scheduling.

Therefore, Option B is the most appropriate solution because it uses Amazon SQS queues and EC2 Auto Scaling to dynamically adjust based on the size of the queue, thereby increasing the scalability and resiliency of the system.
題目(中): 一家公司正在將一個分佈式應用程式遷移到 AWS。該應用程式服務於變化的工作負載。傳統平台由一個主要伺服器組成，該伺服器在多個計算節點之間協調工作。公司希望使用一種解決方案來現代化應用程式，以最大限度地提高韌性和可擴展性。解決方案架構師應如何設計架構以滿足這些需求？

B. 將 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列作為工作的目的地。使用 Amazon EC2 執行個體實現計算節點，並將其管理在 Auto Scaling 群組中。設定 EC2 Auto Scaling 根據佇列的大小。
C. 使用 Amazon EC2 執行個體實現主要伺服器和計算節點，並將其管理在 Auto Scaling 群組中。設定 AWS CloudTrail 作為工作的目的地。設定 EC2 Auto Scaling 根據主要伺服器的負載。

解析(中):
為了滿足公司的需求，解決方案架構師需要設計一個架構，以最大限度地提高韌性和可擴展性。選項 B 是正確答案，因為它使用 Amazon SQS 佇列作為工作的目的地，並根據佇列的大小設定 EC2 Auto Scaling。這樣可以確保計算節點的數量根據工作負載的變化進行動態調整，從而提高系統的可擴展性和韌性。

因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案，因為它使用 Amazon SQS 佇列和 EC2 Auto Scaling 根據佇列的大小進行動態調整，從而提高系統的可擴展性和韌性。

題目(英):

題目(英):
A company is building an ecommerce web application on AWS. The application sends information about new orders to an Amazon API
Gateway REST API to process. The company wants to ensure that orders are processed in the order that they are received.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use an API Gateway integration to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the
application receives an order. Subscribe an AWS Lambda function to the topic to perform processing.
B. Use an API Gateway integration to send a message to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue when the
application receives an order. Congure the SQS FIFO queue to invoke an AWS Lambda function for processing.
C. Use an API Gateway authorizer to block any requests while the application processes an order.
D. Use an API Gateway integration to send a message to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue when the
application receives an order. Congure the SQS standard queue to invoke an AWS Lambda function for processing.
解析(英): The correct answer is B. Amazon SQS FIFO queuing can ensure that messages are processed in the order they are received. This is because the design principle of FIFO queuing is first-in, first-out, ensuring that messages will not be skipped or changed in order. This ensures that orders are processed in the order they are received. The reasons why the other options are incorrect are: option A uses an Amazon SNS topic, which does not guarantee the order of messages; option C uses the API Gateway authorizer to block requests, which does not solve the problem of order processing order; option D uses Amazon SQS standard queuing, which can queue messages, but does not guarantee the order of messages. Therefore, option B is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司正在使用 AWS 建立電子商務網頁應用程式。該應用程式將新訂單的資訊傳送到 Amazon API Gateway REST API 進行處理。公司希望確保訂單按照接收的順序進行處理。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？

B. 使用 API Gateway 整合將訊息傳送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 排隊，當應用程式接收到訂單時。設定 SQS FIFO 排隊以呼叫 AWS Lambda 函數進行處理。
C. 使用 API Gateway 授權者來阻止任何請求，直到應用程式處理完訂單。
D. 使用 API Gateway 整合將訊息傳送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 標準排隊，當應用程式接收到訂單時。設定 SQS 標準排隊以呼叫 AWS Lambda 函數進行處理。
解析(中): 正確答案是 B。因為 Amazon SQS FIFO 排隊能夠保證訊息按照接收的順序進行處理，這是因為 FIFO 排隊的設計原理是先進先出，確保訊息不會被跳過或改變順序。這樣可以確保訂單按照接收的順序進行處理。其他選項不正確的原因是：A 選項使用 Amazon SNS 主題，SNS 主題不保證訊息的順序；C 選項使用 API Gateway 授權者來阻止請求，這不會解決訂單處理順序的問題；D 選項使用 Amazon SQS 標準排隊，雖然可以進行訊息排隊，但不保證訊息的順序。因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):

credential management.

解析(英): The answer is A because AWS Secrets Manager is a service designed to manage sensitive information such as usernames and passwords. 題目(中): 一家公司有一個應用程式運行在 Amazon EC2 實例上，並使用 Amazon Aurora 數據庫。EC2 實例通過使用儲存在本地檔案中的使用者名稱和密碼來連接數據庫。該公司希望最小化憑證管理的運營負擔。解決方案架構師應該做什麼來實現這個目標？

B. 使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store，啟用自動輪換。

題目(英):
A global company hosts its web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The web application has
static data and dynamic data. The company stores its static data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to improve performance and
reduce latency for the static data and dynamic data. The company is using its own domain name registered with Amazon Route 53.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the S3 bucket and the ALB as origins. Congure Route 53 to route trac to the
CloudFront distribution.
B. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the ALB as an origin. Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator that
has the S3 bucket as an endpoint Congure Route 53 to route trac to the CloudFront distribution.
C. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the S3 bucket as an origin. Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator
that has the ALB and the CloudFront distribution as endpoints. Create a custom domain name that points to the accelerator DNS name.
Use the custom domain name as an endpoint for the web application.
D. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the ALB as an origin. Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator that
has the S3 bucket as an endpoint. Create two domain names. Point one domain name to the CloudFront DNS name for dynamic content.
Point the other domain name to the accelerator DNS name for static content. Use the domain names as endpoints for the web application.
解析(英): The answer is A, because this is the most direct and effective method that can improve the performance and reduce latency of static and dynamic data. Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) that caches static and dynamic data to edge locations around the world, thereby reducing the distance and latency between users and origin servers. By using S3 buckets and ALB as the original source for CloudFront, you can ensure that both static and dynamic data can be cached and distributed to edge locations around the world. Then, setting Route 53 to route traffic to the CloudFront distribution ensures that user requests are routed to the closest edge location, thereby reducing latency and improving performance. Although other options can achieve similar functions, they are more complicated and unnecessary than option A. For example, options B and D require the establishment of multiple domain names and endpoints, increasing the complexity of management and maintenance. Option C requires establishing a custom domain name and accelerator endpoint, which also increases the complexity of management and maintenance. Therefore, option A is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家全球公司在Amazon EC2實例後面的應用程式負載平衡器（Application Load Balancer, ALB）上託管其網頁應用程式。網頁應用程式具有靜態資料和動態資料。公司將其靜態資料存儲在Amazon S3儲存桶中。公司希望改善靜態資料和動態資料的性能和降低延遲。公司使用其自己的域名，該域名已在Amazon Route 53中註冊。解決方案架構師應該做什麼才能滿足這些需求？

B. 建立一個Amazon CloudFront分發，將ALB作為原始來源。建立一個AWS Global Accelerator標準加速器，將S3儲存桶作為端點。設定Route 53將流量路由到CloudFront分發。
C. 建立一個Amazon CloudFront分發，將S3儲存桶作為原始來源。建立一個AWS Global Accelerator標準加速器，將ALB和CloudFront分發作為端點。建立一個自訂域名，指向加速器的DNS名稱。使用自訂域名作為網頁應用程式的端點。
D. 建立一個Amazon CloudFront分發，將ALB作為原始來源。建立一個AWS Global Accelerator標準加速器，將S3儲存桶作為端點。建立兩個域名。將一個域名指向CloudFront的DNS名稱，用于動態內容。將另一個域名指向加速器的DNS名稱，用于靜態內容。使用域名作為網頁應用程式的端點。
解析(中): 答案是A，因為這是最直接和有效的方法，可以改善靜態資料和動態資料的性能和降低延遲。Amazon CloudFront是一個內容分發網路（CDN），可以將靜態資料和動態資料緩存到全球各地的邊緣位置，從而降低用戶和原始伺服器之間的距離和延遲。通過將S3儲存桶和ALB作為CloudFront的原始來源，可以確保靜態資料和動態資料都可以被緩存和分發到全球各地的邊緣位置。然後，設定Route 53將流量路由到CloudFront分發，可以確保用戶的請求被路由到最接近的邊緣位置，從而降低延遲和改善性能。其他選項雖然也可以實現類似的功能，但都比選項A複雜和不必要。例如，選項B和D需要建立多個域名和端點，增加了管理和維護的複雜度。選項C需要建立一個自訂域名和加速器的端點，也增加了管理和維護的複雜度。因此，選項A是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company performs monthly maintenance on its AWS infrastructure. During these maintenance activities, the company needs to rotate the
credentials for its Amazon RDS for MySQL databases across multiple AWS Regions.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Store the credentials as secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Use multi-Region secret replication for the required Regions. Congure
Secrets Manager to rotate the secrets on a schedule.
B. Store the credentials as secrets in AWS Systems Manager by creating a secure string parameter. Use multi-Region secret replication for
the required Regions. Congure Systems Manager to rotate the secrets on a schedule.
C. Store the credentials in an Amazon S3 bucket that has server-side encryption (SSE) enabled. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon
CloudWatch Events) to invoke an AWS Lambda function to rotate the credentials.
D. Encrypt the credentials as secrets by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) multi-Region customer managed keys. Store the
secrets in an Amazon DynamoDB global table. Use an AWS Lambda function to retrieve the secrets from DynamoDB. Use the RDS API to
rotate the secrets.
解析(英):
Answer A is correct because AWS Secrets Manager provides a simple and secure way to store and rotate secrets, including credentials for Amazon RDS. Secrets can be easily synchronized across multiple AWS Regions using the multi-region secret replication feature. Configuring Secrets Manager to rotate secrets according to a schedule can automate maintenance activities and reduce operational burden.

Choice B is incorrect because although AWS Systems Manager can also store secrets, it is primarily used to store and manage settings parameters, not secrets. While it is possible to use Systems Manager to rotate secrets, this requires more setup and maintenance.

Choice C is incorrect because using Amazon S3 and AWS Lambda functions to rotate credentials requires more setup and maintenance work. Additionally, storing secrets in S3 may not be as secure as using Secrets Manager.

Choice D is incorrect because using AWS KMS and Amazon DynamoDB to store and rotate secrets requires more setup and maintenance. While this solution can provide a high level of security, its operational burden is much higher than using Secrets Manager.
題目(中): 一家公司每月對其 AWS 基礎設施進行維護。在這些維護活動期間，公司需要在多個 AWS 區域中旋轉其 Amazon RDS for MySQL 數據庫的憑證。哪種解決方案可以在最少的操作負擔下滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將憑證儲存為 AWS Secrets Manager 中的秘密。使用多區域秘密複製功能複製到所需區域。設定 Secrets Manager 根據時間表旋轉秘密。
B. 將憑證儲存為 AWS Systems Manager 中的安全字串參數。使用多區域秘密複製功能複製到所需區域。設定 Systems Manager 根據時間表旋轉秘密。
C. 將憑證儲存到啟用伺服器端加密 (SSE) 的 Amazon S3 儲存桶中。使用 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 呼叫 AWS Lambda 函式旋轉憑證。
D. 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 多區域客戶管理金鑰加密憑證。將秘密儲存到 Amazon DynamoDB 全域表格中。使用 AWS Lambda 函式從 DynamoDB 中擷取秘密。使用 RDS API 旋轉秘密。
解析(中):
答案 A 是正確的，因為 AWS Secrets Manager 提供了一種簡單且安全的方式來儲存和旋轉秘密，包括 Amazon RDS 的憑證。使用多區域秘密複製功能，可以輕鬆地在多個 AWS 區域中同步秘密。設定 Secrets Manager 根據時間表旋轉秘密，可以自動化維護活動，減少操作負擔。

選項 B 不正確，因為雖然 AWS Systems Manager 也可以儲存秘密，但它主要是用於儲存和管理設定參數，而不是秘密。雖然可以使用 Systems Manager 來旋轉秘密，但這需要更多的設定和維護工作。

選項 C 不正確，因為使用 Amazon S3 和 AWS Lambda 函式來旋轉憑證需要更多的設定和維護工作。另外，儲存秘密在 S3 中可能不如使用 Secrets Manager 那樣安全。

選項 D 不正確，因為使用 AWS KMS 和 Amazon DynamoDB 來儲存和旋轉秘密需要更多的設定和維護工作。雖然這個解決方案可以提供高級別的安全性，但它的操作負擔遠高於使用 Secrets Manager。

題目(英):
A company runs an ecommerce application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The instances run in an Amazon
EC2 Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The Auto Scaling group scales based on CPU utilization metrics. The ecommerce
application stores the transaction data in a MySQL 8.0 database that is hosted on a large EC2 instance.
The database's performance degrades quickly as application load increases. The application handles more read requests than write
transactions. The company wants a solution that will automatically scale the database to meet the demand of unpredictable read workloads
while maintaining high availability.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use Amazon Redshift with a single node for leader and compute functionality.
B. Use Amazon RDS with a Single-AZ deployment Congure Amazon RDS to add reader instances in a different Availability Zone.
C. Use Amazon Aurora with a Multi-AZ deployment. Congure Aurora Auto Scaling with Aurora Replicas.
D. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with EC2 Spot Instances.
解析(英): The correct answer is C. Because Amazon Aurora's multi-AZ deployments provide high availability, while Aurora Auto Scaling automatically scales the database based on the demands of your read workloads. Aurora's replication capabilities can improve read performance and accommodate large read requests from applications. Option A is incorrect because Amazon Redshift is primarily used for data warehousing and analytics and is not suitable for use with real-time transactional repositories. Option B is incorrect because Amazon RDS deployed in a single Availability Zone does not provide high availability, and the configuration of the reader instances does not scale automatically. Choice D is incorrect because Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached is primarily used for caching and is not suitable for transactional repositories, and the price and availability of EC2 Spot Instances do not meet the company's needs. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在Amazon EC2實例上運行電子商務應用程式，實例位於應用程式負載平衡器（Application Load Balancer）後面。這些實例運行在跨多個可用區域（Availability Zones）的Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling群組中。Auto Scaling群組根據CPU使用率指標進行擴展。電子商務應用程式將交易資料儲存在MySQL 8.0資料庫中，資料庫主機為大型EC2實例。當應用程式負載增加時，資料庫的效能迅速下降。應用程式處理的讀取請求多於寫入交易。公司希望找到一個解決方案，可以自動擴展資料庫以滿足不可預測的讀取工作負載的需求，同时維持高可用性。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用單節點的Amazon Redshift進行領導和計算功能。
B. 使用單可用區域部署的Amazon RDS，並在不同可用區域配置讀取器實例。
C. 使用多可用區域部署的Amazon Aurora，並配置Aurora Auto Scaling與Aurora複製。
D. 使用Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached與EC2 Spot Instances。
解析(中): 正確答案是 C。因為 Amazon Aurora 的多可用區域部署可以提供高可用性，同時 Aurora Auto Scaling 可以根據讀取工作負載的需求自動擴展資料庫。Aurora 的複製功能可以提高讀取性能，滿足應用程式的大量讀取請求。選項 A 不正確，因為 Amazon Redshift 主要用於數據倉儲和分析，不適合用於實時交易資料庫。選項 B 不正確，因為單可用區域部署的 Amazon RDS 不能提供高可用性，同時讀取器實例的配置也不能自動擴展。選項 D 不正確，因為 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 主要用於緩存，不適合用於交易資料庫，同時 EC2 Spot Instances 的價格和可用性也不能滿足公司的需求。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company recently migrated to AWS and wants to implement a solution to protect the trac that ows in and out of the production VPC. The
company had an inspection server in its on-premises data center. The inspection server performed specic operations such as trac ow
inspection and trac ltering. The company wants to have the same functionalities in the AWS Cloud.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use Amazon GuardDuty for trac inspection and trac ltering in the production VPC.
B. Use Trac Mirroring to mirror trac from the production VPC for trac inspection and ltering.
C. Use AWS Network Firewall to create the required rules for trac inspection and trac ltering for the production VPC.
D. Use AWS Firewall Manager to create the required rules for trac inspection and trac ltering for the production VPC.
解析(英): The answer is C, because AWS Network Firewall is a fully managed network firewall service that provides traffic inspection and filtering capabilities to meet the needs of the company. It can create custom rules to control traffic to and from the production VPC, including inspection and filtering. Option A's Amazon GuardDuty is a threat detection service designed primarily to detect and prevent malicious activity rather than traffic inspection and filtering. Option B's Trac Mirroring can be used to mirror traffic, but does not provide traffic inspection and filtering functions. Option D's AWS Firewall Manager is a management tool mainly used to manage the rules and settings of multiple firewalls, but does not provide traffic inspection and filtering functions. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司最近遷移到 AWS，並希望實施一個解決方案來保護生產 VPC 中進出流量。該公司在其本地資料中心有一個檢查伺服器。檢查伺服器執行特定的操作，例如流量檢查和過濾。該公司希望在 AWS 雲端具有相同的功能。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 Amazon GuardDuty 進行生產 VPC 的流量檢查和過濾。
B. 使用流量鏡像（Trac Mirroring）從生產 VPC 鏡像流量以進行流量檢查和過濾。
C. 使用 AWS 網路防火牆（AWS Network Firewall）為生產 VPC 創建所需的規則以進行流量檢查和過濾。
D. 使用 AWS 防火牆管理器（AWS Firewall Manager）為生產 VPC 創建所需的規則以進行流量檢查和過濾。
解析(中): 答案是 C，因為 AWS 網路防火牆（AWS Network Firewall）是一個完全管理的網路防火牆服務，能夠提供流量檢查和過濾功能，滿足公司的需求。它可以創建自訂規則以控制進出生產 VPC 的流量，包括檢查和過濾。選項 A 的 Amazon GuardDuty 是一個威脅偵測服務，主要用於偵測和防止惡意活動，而不是流量檢查和過濾。選項 B 的流量鏡像（Trac Mirroring）可以用於鏡像流量，但不提供流量檢查和過濾功能。選項 D 的 AWS 防火牆管理器（AWS Firewall Manager）是一個管理工具，主要用於管理多個防火牆的規則和設定，但不提供流量檢查和過濾功能。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company hosts a data lake on AWS. The data lake consists of data in Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company needs a
reporting solution that provides data visualization and includes all the data sources within the data lake. Only the company's management
team should have full access to all the visualizations. The rest of the company should have only limited access.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create an analysis in Amazon QuickSight. Connect all the data sources and create new datasets. Publish dashboards to visualize the
data. Share the dashboards with the appropriate IAM roles.
B. Create an analysis in Amazon QuickSight. Connect all the data sources and create new datasets. Publish dashboards to visualize the
data. Share the dashboards with the appropriate users and groups.
C. Create an AWS Glue table and crawler for the data in Amazon S3. Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to produce
reports. Publish the reports to Amazon S3. Use S3 bucket policies to limit access to the reports.
D. Create an AWS Glue table and crawler for the data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena Federated Query to access data within Amazon
RDS for PostgreSQL. Generate reports by using Amazon Athena. Publish the reports to Amazon S3. Use S3 bucket policies to limit access
to the reports.
解析(英):
Answer B is correct because Amazon QuickSight provides data visualization and access control capabilities that meet the company's needs. By building analyses, connecting data sources, creating data sets and publishing dashboards, companies can provide visual reports on data. At the same time, Amazon QuickSight supports sharing dashboards with users and groups, which allows companies to control who can access which visual data. This way, the management team has access to all visual data, while other employees have limited access.

The other options are incorrect because:
Option A shares the dashboard using IAM roles, which can make access control complex and difficult to manage.
Options C and D use AWS Glue and Amazon Athena to generate reports, but these services are primarily used for data transformation and querying, not data visualization and access control. At the same time, using S3 bucket policies to restrict access to reports can make access control less flexible and difficult to manage. Therefore, option B is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS 上託管了一個資料湖，資料湖包含了 Amazon S3 和 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 的資料。公司需要一個報表解決方案，可以提供資料視覺化，並包含資料湖中的所有資料來源。只有公司的管理團隊應該有權限存取所有視覺化資料，而其他員工應該只有有限的存取權。哪個解決方案可以滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在 Amazon QuickSight 中建立分析。連接所有資料來源並建立新的資料集。發布儀表板以視覺化資料。將儀表板與適當的 IAM 角色共享。
B. 在 Amazon QuickSight 中建立分析。連接所有資料來源並建立新的資料集。發布儀表板以視覺化資料。將儀表板與適當的使用者和群組共享。
C. 為 Amazon S3 中的資料建立 AWS Glue 表格和爬蟲。建立 AWS Glue 的抽取、轉換和載入 (ETL) 工作，以產生報表。將報表發布到 Amazon S3。使用 S3 儲存桶政策限制存取報表。
D. 為 Amazon S3 中的資料建立 AWS Glue 表格和爬蟲。使用 Amazon Athena Federated Query 存取 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 中的資料。使用 Amazon Athena 生成報表。將報表發布到 Amazon S3。使用 S3 儲存桶政策限制存取報表。
解析(中):
答案 B 是正確的，因為 Amazon QuickSight 提供了資料視覺化和存取控制的功能，可以滿足公司的需求。通過建立分析、連接資料來源、建立資料集和發布儀表板，公司可以提供資料視覺化的報表。同時，Amazon QuickSight 支持與使用者和群組共享儀表板，這使得公司可以控制誰可以存取哪些視覺化資料。這樣，管理團隊可以有權限存取所有視覺化資料，而其他員工只能存取有限的資料。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A 選項使用 IAM 角色共享儀表板，這可能會使存取控制變得複雜和難以管理。
C 和 D 選項使用 AWS Glue 和 Amazon Athena 生成報表，但這些服務主要用於資料轉換和查詢，而不是資料視覺化和存取控制。同時，使用 S3 儲存桶政策限制存取報表可能會使存取控制變得不夠靈活和難以管理。因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is implementing a new business application. The application runs on two Amazon EC2 instances and uses an Amazon S3 bucket
for document storage. A solutions architect needs to ensure that the EC2 instances can access the S3 bucket.
What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?
選項(英):
A. Create an IAM role that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the role to the EC2 instances.
B. Create an IAM policy that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the policy to the EC2 instances.
C. Create an IAM group that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the group to the EC2 instances.
D. Create an IAM user that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the user account to the EC2 instances.
解析(英): In order for the EC2 instance to access the S3 bucket, the solutions architect needs to grant the EC2 instance the appropriate permissions. The correct approach is to create an IAM role (Identity and Access Management role) that grants access to the S3 bucket. Then, attach this role to the EC2 instance. This allows EC2 instances to use additional roles to access S3 buckets without requiring a specific IAM user account or group. Choice A is correct because it correctly describes how to use an IAM role to grant an EC2 instance access to an S3 bucket. The other options are incorrect because: option B refers to an IAM policy, but the policy itself cannot be attached directly to an EC2 instance; option C refers to an IAM group, but a group cannot be attached directly to an EC2 instance; option D refers to an IAM user, but a user account cannot be attached directly to an EC2 instance and is not secure. Therefore, establishing an IAM role and attaching it to the EC2 instance is the most suitable solution.
題目(中): 一家公司正在實施新的商業應用程式。該應用程式在兩個 Amazon EC2 實例上運行，並使用 Amazon S3 儲存桶進行文件儲存。解決方案架構師需要確保 EC2 實例可以存取 S3 儲存桶。為了滿足此要求，解決方案架構師應該採取什麼行動？
選項(中):
A. 建立一個授予 S3 儲存桶存取權的 IAM 角色，並將該角色附加到 EC2 實例。
B. 建立一個授予 S3 儲存桶存取權的 IAM 政策，並將該政策附加到 EC2 實例。
C. 建立一個授予 S3 儲存桶存取權的 IAM 群組，並將該群組附加到 EC2 實例。
D. 建立一個授予 S3 儲存桶存取權的 IAM 使用者，並將該使用者帳戶附加到 EC2 實例。
解析(中): 為了讓 EC2 實例可以存取 S3 儲存桶，解決方案架構師需要授予 EC2 實例適當的權限。正確的做法是建立一個 IAM 角色（Identity and Access Management role），該角色授予存取 S3 儲存桶的權限。然後，將這個角色附加到 EC2 實例。這樣，EC2 實例就可以使用附加的角色來存取 S3 儲存桶，而不需要使用特定的 IAM 使用者帳戶或群組。選項 A 是正確的，因為它正確地描述了如何使用 IAM 角色授予 EC2 實例存取 S3 儲存桶的權限。其他選項不正確，因為：選項 B 提到的是 IAM 政策，但政策本身不能直接附加到 EC2 實例；選項 C 提到的是 IAM 群組，但群組不能直接附加到 EC2 實例；選項 D 提到的是 IAM 使用者，但使用者帳戶不能直接附加到 EC2 實例，而且這種做法也不安全。因此，建立一個 IAM 角色並將其附加到 EC2 實例是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
An application development team is designing a microservice that will convert large images to smaller, compressed images. When a user
uploads an image through the web interface, the microservice should store the image in an Amazon S3 bucket, process and compress the
image with an AWS Lambda function, and store the image in its compressed form in a different S3 bucket.
A solutions architect needs to design a solution that uses durable, stateless components to process the images automatically.
Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Congure the S3 bucket to send a notication to the SQS queue when
an image is uploaded to the S3 bucket.
B. Congure the Lambda function to use the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as the invocation source. When the SQS
message is successfully processed, delete the message in the queue.
C. Congure the Lambda function to monitor the S3 bucket for new uploads. When an uploaded image is detected, write the le name to a
text le in memory and use the text le to keep track of the images that were processed.
D. Launch an Amazon EC2 instance to monitor an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. When items are added to the
queue, log the le name in a text le on the EC2 instance and invoke the Lambda function.
E. Congure an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) event to monitor the S3 bucket. When an image is uploaded, send an
alert to an Amazon ample Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic with the application owner's email address for further processing.
解析(英):
In order to meet the requirements of the problem, it is necessary to use rugged, stateless components to automatically process images. Options A and B are correct because they use Amazon SQS queues and Lambda functions to automate the processing of images. When an image is uploaded to an S3 bucket, an SQS queue is triggered to send a notification, and a Lambda function is called to process and compress the image. The process is automatic, stateless, and uses rugged components.

Choice C is incorrect because it uses text files in memory to track processed images, which is not a robust method and may result in data loss. Choice D is incorrect because it uses an Amazon EC2 instance to monitor the SQS queue, which is not a stateless component and may result in wasted resources. Choice E is incorrect because it uses an Amazon SNS topic to send alerts, which is not a mechanism for automated image processing and may cause additional complexity. Therefore, options A and B are the correct answers.
題目(中): 一個應用程式開發團隊正在設計一個微服務，該微服務將大型圖像轉換為較小的壓縮圖像。當用戶通過網頁界面上傳圖像時，微服務應該將圖像存儲在 Amazon S3 儲存桶中，使用 AWS Lambda 函數處理和壓縮圖像，並將壓縮後的圖像存儲在不同的 S3 儲存桶中。一個解決方案架構師需要設計一個使用堅固、無狀態元件的解決方案，以自動處理圖像。
選項(中):
A. 創建一個 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列。設定 S3 儲存桶在上傳圖像到 S3 儲存桶時向 SQS 佇列發送通知。
B. 設定 Lambda 函數使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列作為呼叫來源。當 SQS 訊息成功處理後，刪除佇列中的訊息。
C. 設定 Lambda 函數監視 S3 儲存桶的新上傳。當偵測到上傳的圖像時，將檔案名稱寫入記憶體中的文字檔，並使用文字檔跟蹤已處理的圖像。
D. 啟動 Amazon EC2 實例監視 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列。當項目添加到佇列時，在 EC2 實例上的文字檔中記錄檔案名稱並呼叫 Lambda 函數。
E. 設定 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 事件監視 S3 儲存桶。當上傳圖像時，向具有應用程式擁有者電子郵件地址的 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題發送警報以進行進一步處理。
解析(中):
為了滿足題目中的需求，需要使用堅固、無狀態的元件來自動處理圖像。選項 A 和 B 是正確的，因為它們使用 Amazon SQS 佇列和 Lambda 函數來實現圖像的自動處理。當圖像上傳到 S3 儲存桶時，會觸發 SQS 佇列發送通知，然後 Lambda 函數會被呼叫來處理和壓縮圖像。這個過程是自動的、無狀態的，且使用堅固的元件。

選項 C 不正確，因為它使用記憶體中的文字檔來跟蹤已處理的圖像，這不是一個堅固的方法，且可能會導致資料丟失。選項 D 不正確，因為它使用 Amazon EC2 實例來監視 SQS 佇列，這不是一個無狀態的元件，且可能會導致資源浪費。選項 E 不正確，因為它使用 Amazon SNS 主題發送警報，這不是一個用於自動處理圖像的機制，且可能會導致額外的複雜性。因此，選項 A 和 B 是正確的答案。

題目(英):

application servers and database servers are deployed in private subnets in the same VPC. The company has deployed a third-party virtual
rewall appliance from AWS Marketplace in an inspection VPC. The appliance is congured with an IP interface that can accept IP packets.

reaches the web server.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

A. Create a Network Load Balancer in the public subnet of the application's VPC to route the trac to the appliance for packet inspection.

inspection.
C. Deploy a transit gateway in the inspection VPCongure route tables to route the incoming packets through the transit gateway.

解析(英): The answer is D because a Gateway Load Balancer is a service in AWS designed to route traffic to a third-party virtual firewall application for inspection. 題目(中): 一家公司有一個三層網頁應用程式，部署在 AWS 上。網頁伺服器部署在 VPC 的公用子網路中，應用程式伺服器和資料庫伺服器則部署在相同 VPC 的私用子網路中。公司已經從 AWS Marketplace 部署了一個第三方虛擬防火牆應用程式，在一個檢查 VPC 中
選項(中):

題目(英):
A company wants to improve its ability to clone large amounts of production data into a test environment in the same AWS Region. The data
is stored in Amazon EC2 instances on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Modications to the cloned data must not affect
the production environment. The software that accesses this data requires consistently high I/O performance.
A solutions architect needs to minimize the time that is required to clone the production data into the test environment.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Restore the snapshots onto EC2 instance store volumes in the test environment.
B. Congure the production EBS volumes to use the EBS Multi-Attach feature. Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Attach
the production EBS volumes to the EC2 instances in the test environment.
C. Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Create and initialize new EBS volumes. Attach the new EBS volumes to EC2
instances in the test environment before restoring the volumes from the production EBS snapshots.
D. Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Turn on the EBS fast snapshot restore feature on the EBS snapshots. Restore the
snapshots into new EBS volumes. Attach the new EBS volumes to EC2 instances in the test environment.
解析(英):
The answer is D because this option satisfies all requirements. First, taking snapshots of production EBS volumes ensures data consistency and integrity. Next, enabling the EBS Snapshot Fast Restore feature can significantly reduce the time required to restore a snapshot to a new EBS volume. Finally, attaching the new EBS volume to the EC2 instance in the test environment ensures that the software can access the data and achieve consistently high I/O performance. This solution also ensures that modifications to the replicated data will not affect the production environment because the new EBS volumes are restored from snapshots and are completely isolated from the production environment.

The other options are incorrect because:
Choice A is incorrect because restoring snapshots to EC2 instance storage volumes may result in poor I/O performance and does not support consistently high I/O performance.
Choice B is incorrect because using EBS multiple add-ons may cause data inconsistencies and integrity issues, and does not support consistently high I/O performance.
Option C is incorrect because creating and initializing a new EBS volume and then restoring the volume from a production EBS snapshot may result in long restore times and does not support consistently high I/O performance.
題目(中): 一家公司想要改善其在相同的 AWS 區域中將大量生產資料複製到測試環境的能力。這些資料儲存在 Amazon EC2 實例上的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷中。對複製資料的修改不得影響生產環境。存取這些資料的軟體需要一致的高 I/O 效能。一個解決方案架構師需要最小化將生產資料複製到測試環境所需的時間。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 對生產 EBS 卷進行快照。將快照還原到測試環境中的 EC2 實例儲存卷上。
B. 對生產 EBS 卷進行設定，以使用 EBS 多重附加功能。對生產 EBS 卷進行快照。將生產 EBS 卷附加到測試環境中的 EC2 實例上。
C. 對生產 EBS 卷進行快照。建立和初始化新的 EBS 卷。將新的 EBS 卷附加到測試環境中的 EC2 實例上，然後從生產 EBS 快照還原卷。
D. 對生產 EBS 卷進行快照。啟用 EBS 快照快速還原功能。將快照還原到新的 EBS 卷中。將新的 EBS 卷附加到測試環境中的 EC2 實例上。
解析(中):
答案是 D，因為這個選項能夠滿足所有的需求。首先，對生產 EBS 卷進行快照可以確保資料的一致性和完整性。接著，啟用 EBS 快照快速還原功能可以大大減少還原快照到新的 EBS 卷所需的時間。最後，將新的 EBS 卷附加到測試環境中的 EC2 實例上，可以確保軟體能夠存取資料並獲得一致的高 I/O 效能。這個解決方案也確保了修改複製資料不會影響生產環境，因為新的 EBS 卷是從快照還原而來的，與生產環境是完全隔離的。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A 選項不正確，因為將快照還原到 EC2 實例儲存卷上可能會導致 I/O 效能不佳，而且不支援一致的高 I/O 效能。
B 選項不正確，因為使用 EBS 多重附加功能可能會導致資料不一致和完整性問題，而且不支援一致的高 I/O 效能。
C 選項不正確，因為建立和初始化新的 EBS 卷，然後從生產 EBS 快照還原卷，可能會導致還原時間過長，而且不支援一致的高 I/O 效能。

The access cost of S3 standard-infrequently accessed storage is relatively high, especially for frequently accessed files; D. 題目(英):

題目(中): 一家公司觀察到其最近的 Amazon EC2 費用增加。會計團隊注意到幾個 EC2 實例的不想要的垂直擴展。一個解決方案架構師需要創建一個圖表，比較過去兩個月的 EC2 費用，並進行深入分析以找出垂直擴展的根本原因。解決方案架構師應該如何以最少的運營成本生成這些信息？

A. 使用 AWS Budgets 創建預算報告，並根據實例類型比較 EC2 費用。
B. 使用 Cost Explorer 的細緻篩選功能，根據實例類型對 EC2 費用進行深入分析。

解析(中): 正確答案是 B。因為 Cost Explorer 提供了細緻的篩選功能，允許解決方案架構師根據實例類型對 EC2 費用進行深入分析。這個選項具有最少的運營成本，因為它不需要創建預算報告、設定 AWS Cost and Usage Reports 或使用 Amazon QuickSight。Cost Explorer 是 AWS 提供的一個內建工具，允許用戶查看和分析其 AWS 費用，包括 EC2 費用。其他選項需要額外的設定和配置，從而增加運營成本。選項 A 需要創建預算報告，選項 C 的圖表可能不夠細緻，選項 D 需要設定 AWS Cost and Usage Reports 和 Amazon QuickSight。因此，選項 B 是最合適的選擇。

題目(英):
A company is designing an application. The application uses an AWS Lambda function to receive information through Amazon API Gateway
and to store the information in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database.
During the proof-of-concept stage, the company has to increase the Lambda quotas signicantly to handle the high volumes of data that the
company needs to load into the database. A solutions architect must recommend a new design to improve scalability and minimize the
conguration effort.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Refactor the Lambda function code to Apache Tomcat code that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Connect the database by using native
Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) drivers.
B. Change the platform from Aurora to Amazon DynamoDProvision a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Use the DAX client SDK to point
the existing DynamoDB API calls at the DAX cluster.
C. Set up two Lambda functions. Congure one function to receive the information. Congure the other function to load the information
into the database. Integrate the Lambda functions by using Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS).
D. Set up two Lambda functions. Congure one function to receive the information. Congure the other function to load the information
into the database. Integrate the Lambda functions by using an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.
解析(英):
The answer is D because using Amazon SQS queues effectively improves scalability and minimizes setup effort. When a Lambda function receives information, it can send the information to an SQS queue, and then another Lambda function can receive the information from the queue and load it into the database. This design allows the system to better handle high-volume data and automatically scale to meet demand.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Refactoring a Lambda function into Apache Tomcat code requires significant code modification and setup work and may not improve scalability.
B. Changing the platform from Aurora to DynamoDB requires significant data migration and setup work and may not meet the company's needs.
C. Integrating Lambda functions using Amazon SNS may cause delays and instability in messages because SNS is designed for sending notifications rather than handling high-volume data. In contrast, SQS queues are designed to handle high volumes of data and provide reliable messaging.
題目(中): 一家公司正在設計一個應用程式。該應用程式使用 AWS Lambda 函數通過 Amazon API Gateway 接收資訊，並將資訊儲存到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 數據庫中。在概念驗證階段，公司需要顯著增加 Lambda 配額以處理需要載入到數據庫的高容量資料。一個解決方案架構師必須推薦一個新的設計來提高可擴展性並最小化設定工作。
選項(中):
A. 將 Lambda 函數程式碼重構為 Apache Tomcat 代碼，該代碼在 Amazon EC2 實例上執行。使用原生 Java 數據庫連接 (JDBC) 驅動程式連接數據庫。
B. 將平台從 Aurora 變更為 Amazon DynamoDB。配置 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 叢集。使用 DAX 用戶端 SDK 將現有的 DynamoDB API 呼叫指向 DAX 叢集。
C. 設定兩個 Lambda 函數。配置一個函數來接收資訊。配置另一個函數來將資訊載入到數據庫中。使用 Amazon Simple 通知服務 (Amazon SNS) 整合 Lambda 函數。
D. 設定兩個 Lambda 函數。配置一個函數來接收資訊。配置另一個函數來將資訊載入到數據庫中。使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列整合 Lambda 函數。
解析(中):
答案是 D，因為使用 Amazon SQS 佇列可以有效地提高可擴展性並最小化設定工作。當 Lambda 函數接收到資訊時，它可以將資訊發送到 SQS 佇列中，然後另一個 Lambda 函數可以從佇列中接收資訊並將其載入到數據庫中。這種設計可以讓系統更好地處理高容量資料，並且可以自動擴展以滿足需求。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. 將 Lambda 函數重構為 Apache Tomcat 代碼需要進行大量的程式碼修改和設定工作，而且可能無法提高可擴展性。
B. 將平台從 Aurora 變更為 DynamoDB 需要進行大量的數據遷移和設定工作，而且可能無法滿足公司的需求。
C. 使用 Amazon SNS 整合 Lambda 函數可能會導致資訊延遲和不穩定，因為 SNS 是設計用於發送通知而不是處理高容量資料的。相比之下，SQS 佇列是設計用於處理高容量資料和提供可靠的訊息傳遞的。

題目(英):
A company needs to review its AWS Cloud deployment to ensure that its Amazon S3 buckets do not have unauthorized conguration changes.
What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this goal?
選項(英):
A. Turn on AWS Cong with the appropriate rules.
B. Turn on AWS Trusted Advisor with the appropriate checks.
C. Turn on Amazon Inspector with the appropriate assessment template.
D. Turn on Amazon S3 server access logging. Congure Amazon EventBridge (Amazon Cloud Watch Events).
解析(英): To ensure that there are no unauthorized settings changes to Amazon S3 buckets, solutions architects should enable AWS Config with the appropriate rules. AWS Config is an AWS service that allows you to record and evaluate the settings of your AWS resources, including Amazon S3 buckets. By enabling AWS Config and setting the appropriate rules, companies can be notified when unauthorized configuration changes occur on Amazon S3 buckets. This allows companies to quickly respond to and correct these changes, ensuring the security and compliance of their AWS cloud deployments. The other options are incorrect because AWS Trusted Advisor is primarily used for best practices and cost optimization, Amazon Inspector is used for security vulnerability scanning, and Amazon S3 server access logging and Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) can be used for monitoring and alerting, but do not provide logging and evaluation of setting changes. Therefore, option A is the most appropriate answer.
題目(中): 一家公司需要審查其 AWS 雲端部署，以確保其 Amazon S3 儲存桶不會有未經授權的設定變更。解決方案架構師應該採取什麼行動來實現這個目標？
選項(中):
A. 啟用具有適當規則的 AWS Config。
B. 啟用具有適當檢查的 AWS Trusted Advisor。
C. 啟用具有適當評估模板的 Amazon Inspector。
D. 啟用 Amazon S3 伺服器存取記錄，並設定 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events)。
解析(中): 為了確保 Amazon S3 儲存桶不會有未經授權的設定變更，解決方案架構師應該啟用具有適當規則的 AWS Config。AWS Config 是一項 AWS 服務，允許您記錄和評估 AWS 資源的設定，包括 Amazon S3 儲存桶。通過啟用 AWS Config 和設定適當的規則，公司可以在 Amazon S3 儲存桶發生未經授權的設定變更時收到通知。這使得公司可以快速響應和糾正這些變更，確保其 AWS 雲端部署的安全性和合規性。其他選項不正確，因為 AWS Trusted Advisor 主要用於最佳實踐和成本優化，Amazon Inspector 用於安全漏洞掃描，Amazon S3 伺服器存取記錄和 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 可以用於監控和警報，但不提供設定變更的記錄和評估功能。因此，選項 A 是最適合的答案。

題目(英):
A company is launching a new application and will display application metrics on an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard. The company's product
manager needs to access this dashboard periodically. The product manager does not have an AWS account. A solutions architect must provide
access to the product manager by following the principle of least privilege.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Share the dashboard from the CloudWatch console. Enter the product manager's email address, and complete the sharing steps.
Provide a shareable link for the dashboard to the product manager.
B. Create an IAM user specically for the product manager. Attach the CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess AWS managed policy to the user. Share
the new login credentials with the product manager. Share the browser URL of the correct dashboard with the product manager.
C. Create an IAM user for the company's employees. Attach the ViewOnlyAccess AWS managed policy to the IAM user. Share the new login
credentials with the product manager. Ask the product manager to navigate to the CloudWatch console and locate the dashboard by name
in the Dashboards section.
D. Deploy a bastion server in a public subnet. When the product manager requires access to the dashboard, start the server and share the
RDP credentials. On the bastion server, ensure that the browser is congured to open the dashboard URL with cached AWS credentials that
have appropriate permissions to view the dashboard.
解析(英):
According to the question description, the company's product manager needs to access the Amazon CloudWatch dashboard but does not have an AWS account. Solutions Architects need to provide product managers with access based on the principle of least privilege. Option A is the correct answer because it shares the dashboard directly with product managers without the need to create a new AWS account or IAM user. This follows the principle of least privilege, and product managers only need access to the shared dashboard.

Option B requires creating a new IAM user and attaching the CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess policy. While this can also provide access, it requires additional steps and management and may grant excessive permissions to the product manager.

Option C requires creating a new IAM user, attaching the ViewOnlyAccess policy, and then requiring the product manager to find the dashboard himself. This requires the product manager to have more AWS knowledge and access rights, and may grant too many permissions.

Option D requires deploying a bastion server, starting the server and sharing RDP credentials, and then configuring the browser on the bastion server to open the dashboard URL. This requires additional infrastructure and management and may lead to security risks.

Therefore, option A is the simplest and most secure solution, sharing the dashboard directly with product managers without creating a new AWS account or IAM user, complying with the principle of least privilege.
題目(中): 一家公司正在推出一款新應用程式，並將在 Amazon CloudWatch儀表板上顯示應用程式指標。公司的產品經理需要定期存取此儀表板。然而，產品經理沒有 AWS 帳戶。解決方案架構師必須按照最小權限原則為產品經理提供存取權。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些要求？
選項(中):
A. 從 CloudWatch 主控台共用儀表板。輸入產品經理的電子郵件地址，並完成共用步驟。為產品經理提供儀表板的共用連結。
B. 為產品經理創建一個特定的 IAM 使用者。將 CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess AWS 管理政策附加到使用者。與產品經理共用新的登入憑證。與產品經理共用正確儀表板的瀏覽器 URL。
C. 為公司員工創建一個 IAM 使用者。將 ViewOnlyAccess AWS 管理政策附加到 IAM 使用者。與產品經理共用新的登入憑證。要求產品經理導航到 CloudWatch 主控台並在儀表板部分根據名稱找到儀表板。
D. 在公用子網路中部署一個堡壘伺服器。當產品經理需要存取儀表板時，啟動伺服器並共用 RDP憑證。在堡壘伺服器上，確保瀏覽器配置為以快取的 AWS憑證開啟儀表板 URL，該憑證具有適當的權限來查看儀表板。
解析(中):
根據題目描述，公司的產品經理需要存取 Amazon CloudWatch 儀表板，但沒有 AWS 帳戶。解決方案架構師需要按照最小權限原則為產品經理提供存取權。選項 A 是正確答案，因為它直接共用儀表板給產品經理，無需建立新的 AWS 帳戶或 IAM 使用者。這符合最小權限原則，產品經理只需要存取共用儀表板的權限。

選項 B 需要建立一個新的 IAM 使用者，並附加 CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess 政策，雖然這也能夠提供存取權，但這需要額外的步驟和管理，且可能會授予產品經理過多的權限。

選項 C 則需要建立一個新的 IAM 使用者，並附加 ViewOnlyAccess 政策，然後要求產品經理自己找到儀表板，這需要產品經理有更多的 AWS 知識和存取權限，且可能會授予過多的權限。

選項 D 則需要部署一個堡壘伺服器，啟動伺服器並共用 RDP憑證，然後在堡壘伺服器上配置瀏覽器開啟儀表板 URL，這需要額外的基礎設施和管理，且可能會導致安全風險。

因此，選項 A 是最簡單和最安全的解決方案，直接共用儀表板給產品經理，無需建立新的 AWS 帳戶或 IAM 使用者，符合最小權限原則。

題目(英):
A company is migrating applications to AWS. The applications are deployed in different accounts. The company manages the accounts
centrally by using AWS Organizations. The company's security team needs a single sign-on (SSO) solution across all the company's accounts.
The company must continue managing the users and groups in its on-premises self-managed Microsoft Active Directory.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Enable AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) from the AWS SSO console. Create a one-way forest trust or a one-way domain trust to connect
the company's self-managed Microsoft Active Directory with AWS SSO by using AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory.
B. Enable AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) from the AWS SSO console. Create a two-way forest trust to connect the company's self-managed
Microsoft Active Directory with AWS SSO by using AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory.

D. Deploy an identity provider (IdP) on premises. Enable AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) from the AWS SSO console.
解析(英): According to the question description, the company needs to implement a single sign-on (SSO) solution across all accounts and must continue to manage users and groups in its internal self-managed Microsoft Active Directory. Therefore, a solution that can integrate with existing Active Directory is needed. Option B is the correct answer because it uses AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) and establishes a two-way forest trust to connect the company's self-managed Microsoft Active Directory with AWS SSO. This allows company users to log in to AWS accounts using their existing Active Directory authentication and manage user and group access in AWS SSO. Choice A is incorrect because a one-way forest trust or a one-way domain trust cannot provide two-way authentication and authorization. Option C is incorrect because it only establishes a two-way trust relationship but does not enable AWS SSO. 題目(中): 一家公司正在將應用程序遷移到 AWS。這些應用程序部署在不同的帳戶中。公司使用 AWS Organizations 集中管理這些帳戶。公司的安全團隊需要在所有公司帳戶中實現單一登入（SSO）解決方案。公司必須繼續在其內部自管理的 Microsoft Active Directory 中管理使用者和群組。
選項(中):
A. 啟用 AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) 的 AWS SSO 主控台。使用 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 建立單向森林信任或單向網域信任，以連接公司的自管理 Microsoft Active Directory 與 AWS SSO。
B. 啟用 AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) 的 AWS SSO 主控台。使用 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 建立雙向森林信任，以連接公司的自管理 Microsoft Active Directory 與 AWS SSO。
C. 使用 AWS Directory Service。建立與公司自管理 Microsoft Active Directory 的雙向信任關係。
D. 在內部部署身份提供者 (IdP)。啟用 AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) 的 AWS SSO 主控台。
解析(中): 根據題目描述，公司需要在所有帳戶中實現單一登入（SSO）解決方案，並且必須繼續在其內部自管理的 Microsoft Active Directory 中管理使用者和群組。因此，需要一個能夠與現有的 Active Directory 整合的解決方案。選項 B 是正確答案，因為它使用 AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) 並建立雙向森林信任，以連接公司的自管理 Microsoft Active Directory 與 AWS SSO。這樣可以讓公司的使用者使用其現有的 Active Directory 認證登入 AWS 帳戶，並且可以在 AWS SSO 中管理使用者和群組的存取權限。選項 A 不正確，因為單向森林信任或單向網域信任不能提供雙向的認證和授權。選項 C 不正確，因為它只建立了雙向信任關係，但沒有啟用 AWS SSO。選項 D 不正確，因為它需要在內部部署身份提供者 (IdP)，而公司需要繼續在其內部自管理的 Microsoft Active Directory 中管理使用者和群組。

題目(英):
A company provides a Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) service that uses UDP connections. The service consists of Amazon EC2 instances
that run in an Auto Scaling group. The company has deployments across multiple AWS Regions.
The company needs to route users to the Region with the lowest latency. The company also needs automated failover between Regions.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Use the
NLB as an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint in each Region.
B. Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Use
the ALB as an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint in each Region.
C. Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Create
an Amazon Route 53 latency record that points to aliases for each NLB. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the latency
record as an origin.
D. Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group.
Create an Amazon Route 53 weighted record that points to aliases for each ALB. Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the
weighted record as an origin.
解析(英): The correct answer is A because Network Load Balancer (NLB) is the best choice for VoIP services, which use UDP connections. NLB can handle UDP traffic and provide low latency and high throughput. In addition, NLB can be integrated with automatic expansion groups to achieve automatic expansion and contraction. Using NLB as an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint enables automatic failover and routing of users to the region with the lowest latency. The other options are incorrect because Application Load Balancer (ALB) does not support UDP traffic, Amazon Route 53 latency logging and weighted logging do not provide automatic failover and routing users to the region with the lowest latency, and Amazon CloudFront distribution is not the best choice in this situation. Therefore, option A is the most suitable solution.
題目(中): 一家公司提供了一個使用UDP連接的VoIP服務，該服務由運行在自動擴展群組中的Amazon EC2實例組成。該公司在多個AWS區域中進行部署。該公司需要將用戶路由到延遲最低的區域，並需要在區域之間實現自動故障轉移。哪種解決方案可以滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 部署一個網路負載均衡器（NLB）和相關的目標群組。將目標群組與自動擴展群組關聯。使用NLB作為每個區域的AWS Global Accelerator端點。
B. 部署一個應用負載均衡器（ALB）和相關的目標群組。將目標群組與自動擴展群組關聯。使用ALB作為每個區域的AWS Global Accelerator端點。
C. 部署一個網路負載均衡器（NLB）和相關的目標群組。將目標群組與自動擴展群組關聯。建立一個Amazon Route 53延遲記錄，指向每個NLB的別名。建立一個Amazon CloudFront分發，使用延遲記錄作為原始來源。
D. 部署一個應用負載均衡器（ALB）和相關的目標群組。將目標群組與自動擴展群組關聯。建立一個Amazon Route 53加權記錄，指向每個ALB的別名。部署一個Amazon CloudFront分發，使用加權記錄作為原始來源。
解析(中): 正確答案是A，因為Network Load Balancer（NLB）是最適合VoIP服務的選擇，該服務使用UDP連接。NLB可以處理UDP流量，並提供低延遲和高吞吐量。另外，NLB可以與自動擴展群組整合，實現自動擴展和縮減。使用NLB作為AWS Global Accelerator端點，可以實現自動故障轉移和路由用戶到延遲最低的區域。其他選項不正確，因為Application Load Balancer（ALB）不支援UDP流量，Amazon Route 53延遲記錄和加權記錄不能提供自動故障轉移和路由用戶到延遲最低的區域的功能，Amazon CloudFront分發也不是這種情況下的最佳選擇。因此，選項A是最適合的解決方案。

題目(英):
A development team runs monthly resource-intensive tests on its general purpose Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with Performance
Insights enabled. The testing lasts for 48 hours once a month and is the only process that uses the database. The team wants to reduce the
cost of running the tests without reducing the compute and memory attributes of the DB instance.
Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
選項(英):
A. Stop the DB instance when tests are completed. Restart the DB instance when required.
B. Use an Auto Scaling policy with the DB instance to automatically scale when tests are completed.
C. Create a snapshot when tests are completed. Terminate the DB instance and restore the snapshot when required.
D. Modify the DB instance to a low-capacity instance when tests are completed. Modify the DB instance again when required.
解析(英):
The answer is C because this is the most cost-effective solution. When the test is completed, taking a snapshot and terminating the DB instance can save the running cost of the DB instance. When the test needs to be executed again, the DB instance can be restored from the snapshot, retaining the original computing and memory properties. This approach avoids unnecessary DB instance running costs without affecting test execution.

Choice A is incorrect because stopping and restarting a DB instance can cause database connection issues and other technical issues. Option B is incorrect because the Auto Scaling policy does not automatically terminate DB instances and may incur unnecessary scaling costs. Option D is incorrect because modifying the DB instance to a low-capacity instance may affect test execution performance and require additional modification steps. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一個開發團隊每月在其一般用途的 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 實例上執行資源密集的測試，該實例已啟用 Performance Insights。測試每月持續 48 小時，並且是唯一使用資料庫的程序。團隊希望在不降低 DB 實例的計算和記憶體屬性的情況下減少執行測試的成本。哪種解決方案能夠最具成本效益地滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 測試完成後停止 DB 實例。需要時重新啟動 DB 實例。
B. 使用具有 DB 實例的 Auto Scaling 政策，在測試完成後自動縮放。
C. 測試完成後建立快照。終止 DB 實例，需要時從快照還原。
D. 測試完成後將 DB 實例修改為低容量實例。需要時再次修改 DB 實例。
解析(中):
答案是 C，因為這是最具成本效益的解決方案。當測試完成後，建立快照並終止 DB 實例可以節省 DB 實例的運行成本。當需要再次執行測試時，可以從快照還原 DB 實例，保留原有的計算和記憶體屬性。這種方法可以避免不必要的 DB 實例運行成本，而不影響測試的執行。

選項 A 不正確，因為停止和重新啟動 DB 實例可能會導致資料庫連接問題和其他技術問題。選項 B 不正確，因為 Auto Scaling 政策不能自動終止 DB 實例，且可能會導致不必要的擴展成本。選項 D 不正確，因為修改 DB 實例為低容量實例可能會影響測試的執行效能，且需要額外的修改步驟。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A development team needs to host a website that will be accessed by other teams. The website contents consist of HTML, CSS, client-side
JavaScript, and images.
Which method is the MOST cost-effective for hosting the website?
選項(英):

解析(英): The correct answer is B, because Amazon S3 is an object storage service that can be used to host static websites, including files such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and images. Since website content is mainly static files, using Amazon S3 can save costs because it only charges based on actual usage and does not require server maintenance or resource configuration. In comparison, other options require more resources and maintenance and are therefore more costly. Option A requires containerizing and configuring AWS Fargate, Option C requires configuring and maintaining Amazon EC2 instances, and Option D requires configuring AWS Lambda and an application load balancer, all of which add cost and complexity. 題目(中): 一個開發團隊需要托管一個網站，該網站將被其他團隊存取。網站內容包括 HTML、CSS、客戶端 JavaScript 和圖像。哪種方法是托管網站最具成本效益的方法？

題目(英):
A company runs an online marketplace web application on AWS. The application serves hundreds of thousands of users during peak hours.
The company needs a scalable, near-real-time solution to share the details of millions of nancial transactions with several other internal
applications. Transactions also need to be processed to remove sensitive data before being stored in a document database for low-latency
retrieval.
What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Store the transactions data into Amazon DynamoDB. Set up a rule in DynamoDB to remove sensitive data from every transaction upon
write. Use DynamoDB Streams to share the transactions data with other applications.
B. Stream the transactions data into Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to store data in Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon S3. Use AWS Lambda
integration with Kinesis Data Firehose to remove sensitive data. Other applications can consume the data stored in Amazon S3.
C. Stream the transactions data into Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use AWS Lambda integration to remove sensitive data from every
transaction and then store the transactions data in Amazon DynamoDB. Other applications can consume the transactions data off the
Kinesis data stream.
D. Store the batched transactions data in Amazon S3 as les. Use AWS Lambda to process every le and remove sensitive data before
updating the les in Amazon S3. The Lambda function then stores the data in Amazon DynamoDB. Other applications can consume
transaction les stored in Amazon S3.
解析(英): The correct answer is C. That's because Amazon Kinesis Data Streams provides near-instant data processing and streaming capabilities that are ideal for hundreds of thousands of users during peak hours. Use AWS Lambda integration to remove sensitive data during data streaming and then store the data in Amazon DynamoDB for low-latency queries. Other applications can consume data directly from the Kinesis data stream without additional storage and processing steps. Choice A is incorrect because DynamoDB Streams can only handle data changes in DynamoDB and cannot directly stream transaction data. Option B is incorrect because Kinesis Data Firehose is primarily used for data backup and archiving and cannot provide near-instantaneous data processing capabilities. Choice D is incorrect because batch processing and storing archives in S3 introduces delays and inefficiencies that do not meet near-instant demand. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS 上運行一個線上市場網頁應用程式，該應用程式在高峰時段服務數十萬用戶。公司需要一個可擴展、近即時的解決方案，以便與其他幾個內部應用程式共享數百萬筆金融交易的詳細資料。交易也需要被處理以移除敏感資料，然後儲存到文件資料庫中，以便進行低延遲的查詢。解決方案架構師應該如何建議以滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將交易資料儲存到 Amazon DynamoDB 中。設定 DynamoDB 的規則，以便在寫入時從每筆交易中移除敏感資料。使用 DynamoDB Streams 將交易資料與其他應用程式共享。
B. 將交易資料串流到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 中，以儲存資料到 Amazon DynamoDB 和 Amazon S3 中。使用 AWS Lambda 與 Kinesis Data Firehose 整合，以移除敏感資料。其他應用程式可以從 Amazon S3 中的儲存資料中消費資料。
C. 將交易資料串流到 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 中。使用 AWS Lambda 整合，以從每筆交易中移除敏感資料，然後將交易資料儲存到 Amazon DynamoDB 中。其他應用程式可以從 Kinesis 資料串流中消費交易資料。
D. 將批次交易資料儲存到 Amazon S3 中的檔案中。使用 AWS Lambda 處理每個檔案，然後移除敏感資料，更新檔案到 Amazon S3 中。Lambda 函數然後將資料儲存到 Amazon DynamoDB 中。其他應用程式可以從 Amazon S3 中的交易檔案中消費資料。
解析(中): 正確答案是 C。這是因為 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 能夠提供近即時的資料處理和串流功能，非常適合高峰時段的數十萬用戶需求。使用 AWS Lambda 整合可以在資料串流的過程中移除敏感資料，然後將資料儲存到 Amazon DynamoDB 中，以便進行低延遲的查詢。其他應用程式可以直接從 Kinesis 資料串流中消費資料，無需額外的儲存和處理步驟。選項 A 不正確，因為 DynamoDB Streams 只能處理 DynamoDB 中的資料變化，不能直接串流交易資料。選項 B 不正確，因為 Kinesis Data Firehose 主要用於資料備份和歸檔，不能提供近即時的資料處理功能。選項 D 不正確，因為批次處理和儲存到 S3 中的檔案會導致延遲和效率低下，不能滿足近即時的需求。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

解析(中): 正確答案是 B。這是因為選項 B 使用跨區域的客戶管理 KMS 金鑰，可以滿足資料在兩個區域中使用相同的金鑰進行加密和解密的需求。同時，使用客戶端加密可以降低運營負擔，因為不需要設定伺服器端加密和複製。其他選項不正確的原因是：選項 A 使用 Amazon S3 管理加密金鑰，不能滿足使用客戶管理 KMS 金鑰的需求；選項 C 使用伺服器端加密和 Amazon S3 管理加密金鑰，不能滿足使用客戶管理 KMS 金鑰的需求；選項 D 使用伺服器端加密和 AWS KMS 金鑰，雖然可以滿足使用客戶管理 KMS 金鑰的需求，但需要設定複製和伺服器端加密，運營負擔較高。因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company recently launched a variety of new workloads on Amazon EC2 instances in its AWS account. The company needs to create a
strategy to access and administer the instances remotely and securely. The company needs to implement a repeatable process that works
with native AWS services and follows the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Use the EC2 serial console to directly access the terminal interface of each instance for administration.
B. Attach the appropriate IAM role to each existing instance and new instance. Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to establish a
remote SSH session.
C. Create an administrative SSH key pair. Load the public key into each EC2 instance. Deploy a bastion host in a public subnet to provide a
tunnel for administration of each instance.
D. Establish an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. Instruct administrators to use their local on-premises machines to connect directly to the
instances by using SSH keys across the VPN tunnel.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B. This is because Option B provides a low operational burden solution to access and manage EC2 instances remotely and securely. By attaching the appropriate IAM role to each instance, companies can ensure that only authorized users can access the instance. Then, use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to establish a remote SSH session, which provides a secure and controlled way to manage the instance. This approach follows the security and operational best practices of the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Choice A is incorrect because using the EC2 serial console requires direct access to each instance's terminal interface, which can lead to security risks and management complexity.

Choice C is incorrect because establishing an administrative SSH key pair and deploying a bastion host requires additional infrastructure and management effort, thereby increasing operational burden.

Choice D is incorrect because establishing an AWS site-to-site VPN connection requires additional infrastructure and management effort, which increases the operational burden. Additionally, this approach requires administrators to use their local on-premises machine to connect to the instance, which can lead to security risks and management complexity.
題目(中): 一家公司最近在其 AWS 帳戶中啟動了多個新工作負載的 Amazon EC2 實例。該公司需要建立一個策略，以遠程和安全地存取和管理這些實例。該公司需要實施一個可重複的過程，該過程與原生 AWS 服務一起工作，並遵循 AWS Well-Architected Framework。哪種解決方案能夠以最少的運營負擔滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 EC2 串列主控台直接存取每個實例的終端介面進行管理。
B. 將適當的 IAM 角色附加到每個現有實例和新實例。使用 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 建立遠端 SSH 會話。
C. 建立一個管理用的 SSH 金鑰對。將公鑰載入每個 EC2 實例。部署一個堡壘主機在公用子網中，為每個實例提供一個管理通道。

解析(中):
正確答案是 B。這是因為選項 B 提供了一種低運營負擔的解決方案，以遠程和安全地存取和管理 EC2 實例。通過將適當的 IAM 角色附加到每個實例，公司可以確保只有授權的使用者可以存取實例。然後，使用 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 建立遠端 SSH 會話，可以提供一個安全和受控的方式來管理實例。這種方法遵循 AWS Well-Architected Framework 的安全和運營最佳實踐。

選項 A 不正確，因為使用 EC2 串列主控台需要直接存取每個實例的終端介面，這可能會導致安全風險和管理複雜性。

選項 C 不正確，因為建立一個管理用的 SSH 金鑰對和部署一個堡壘主機需要額外的基礎設施和管理工作，從而增加運營負擔。

選項 D 不正確，因為建立一個 AWS 站點對站點 VPN 連線需要額外的基礎設施和管理工作，從而增加運營負擔。另外，這種方法需要管理員使用其本地內部部署機器連接到實例，這可能會導致安全風險和管理複雜性。

題目(英):
A company is hosting a static website on Amazon S3 and is using Amazon Route 53 for DNS. The website is experiencing increased demand
from around the world. The company must decrease latency for users who access the website.
Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
選項(英):
A. Replicate the S3 bucket that contains the website to all AWS Regions. Add Route 53 geolocation routing entries.
B. Provision accelerators in AWS Global Accelerator. Associate the supplied IP addresses with the S3 bucket. Edit the Route 53 entries to
point to the IP addresses of the accelerators.
C. Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the S3 bucket. Edit the Route 53 entries to point to the CloudFront distribution.
D. Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the bucket. Edit the Route 53 entries to point to the new endpoint.
解析(英):
The answer is C because Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) that distributes the content of static websites to edge locations around the world, thereby reducing the latency for users to access the website. This is the most cost-effective solution because CloudFront only pays for the actual bandwidth and number of requests used. The other options are incorrect for the following reasons:
A. Copying S3 buckets to all AWS regions requires a lot of storage space and data transfer, and requires manual setting of Route 53 geolocation routing entries, which increases complexity and cost. 
B. Using AWS Global Accelerator requires deploying an accelerator and setting an IP address, and editing Route 53 entries increases complexity and cost. 
D. Enabling S3 transfer acceleration can only speed up data transfer, but it cannot reduce the delay time for users to access the website. It also requires editing Route 53 entries to point to new endpoints, which increases complexity and cost. 
Therefore, option C is the most cost-effective solution.
題目(中): 一家公司正在 Amazon S3 上主持一個靜態網站，並使用 Amazon Route 53 進行 DNS。該網站正在從世界各地經歷日益增長的需求。該公司必須減少用戶存取網站的延遲時間。哪種解決方案能夠最具成本效益地滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將包含網站的 S3 儲存桶複製到所有 AWS 區域。新增 Route 53 地理位置路由條目。
B. 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中佈建加速器。將提供的 IP 地址與 S3 儲存桶關聯。編輯 Route 53 条目以指向加速器的 IP 地址。
C. 在 S3 儲存桶前添加 Amazon CloudFront 分佈。編輯 Route 53 条目以指向 CloudFront 分佈。
D. 啟用 S3 儲存桶的傳輸加速。編輯 Route 53 条目以指向新的端點。
解析(中):
答案是 C，因為 Amazon CloudFront 是一種內容傳遞網路 (CDN)，可以將靜態網站的內容分發到全球各地的邊緣位置，從而減少用戶存取網站的延遲時間。這是最具成本效益的解決方案，因為 CloudFront 只需為實際使用的帶寬和請求數量付費。其他選項不正確的原因如下： 
A. 複製 S3 儲存桶到所有 AWS 區域需要大量的儲存空間和資料傳輸，且需要手動設定 Route 53 地理位置路由條目，增加了複雜性和成本。 
B. 使用 AWS Global Accelerator 需要佈建加速器和設定 IP 地址，且需要編輯 Route 53 条目，增加了複雜性和成本。 
D. 啟用 S3 傳輸加速只可以加速資料傳輸，但不能減少用戶存取網站的延遲時間，且需要編輯 Route 53 条目以指向新的端點，增加了複雜性和成本。 
因此，選擇 C 是最具成本效益的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company maintains a searchable repository of items on its website. The data is stored in an Amazon RDS for MySQL database table that
contains more than 10 million rows. The database has 2 TB of General Purpose SSD storage. There are millions of updates against this data
every day through the company's website.
The company has noticed that some insert operations are taking 10 seconds or longer. The company has determined that the database
storage performance is the problem.
Which solution addresses this performance issue?
選項(英):
A. Change the storage type to Provisioned IOPS SSD.
B. Change the DB instance to a memory optimized instance class.
C. Change the DB instance to a burstable performance instance class.
D. Enable Multi-AZ RDS read replicas with MySQL native asynchronous replication.
解析(英):
The answer to this question is A, because the company has determined that database storage performance is the problem, and Provisioned IOPS SSDs can provide higher I/O performance, thus solving the latency issue of insert operations. Provisioned IOPS SSD allows you to configure specific I/O performance for a database instance, ensuring that the database can handle a large number of update and query operations. In contrast, the I/O performance of general-purpose SSD storage may be limited, resulting in delays in insert operations.

The other options are incorrect because:
B. Memory-optimized instance classes can improve the memory performance of the database, but they may not necessarily solve storage performance problems.
C. The burst performance instance category can provide temporary performance improvements, but is not suitable for long-term high-performance requirements.
D. Enabling Multi-AZ RDS read-only replication can improve the availability and read performance of the database, but it does not directly solve the storage performance problem. Therefore, option A is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在其網站上維護了一個可搜尋的項目儲存庫。數據儲存在Amazon RDS for MySQL資料庫表中，包含超過1,000萬行。資料庫具有2 TB的通用SSD儲存空間。每天通過公司網站對這些數據進行數百萬次更新。公司已經注意到有些插入操作需要10秒或更長時間。公司已經確定資料庫儲存性能是問題。哪種解決方案可以解決這個性能問題？
選項(中):
A. 將儲存類型改為Provisioned IOPS SSD。
B. 將DB實例改為內存優化的實例類別。
C. 將DB實例改為突發性能實例類別。
D. 啟用Multi-AZ RDS唯讀複製，使用MySQL原生非同步複製。
解析(中):
這個問題的答案是A，因為公司已經確定資料庫儲存性能是問題，而Provisioned IOPS SSD可以提供更高的I/O性能，從而解決插入操作的延遲問題。Provisioned IOPS SSD允許您為資料庫實例配置特定的I/O性能，從而確保資料庫能夠處理大量的更新和查詢操作。相比之下，通用SSD儲存空間的I/O性能可能會受到限制，導致插入操作的延遲。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
B. 內存優化的實例類別可以提高資料庫的記憶體性能，但不一定能夠解決儲存性能的問題。
C. 突發性能實例類別可以提供暫時的性能提升，但不適合長期的高性能需求。
D. 啟用Multi-AZ RDS唯讀複製可以提高資料庫的可用性和讀取性能，但不直接解決儲存性能的問題。因此，選項A是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has thousands of edge devices that collectively generate 1 TB of status alerts each day. Each alert is approximately 2 KB in size.
A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to ingest and store the alerts for future analysis.
The company wants a highly available solution. However, the company needs to minimize costs and does not want to manage additional
infrastructure. Additionally, the company wants to keep 14 days of data available for immediate analysis and archive any data older than 14
days.
What is the MOST operationally ecient solution that meets these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Congure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the
alerts to an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle conguration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days.
B. Launch Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones and place them behind an Elastic Load Balancer to ingest the alerts.
Create a script on the EC2 instances that will store the alerts in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle conguration to transition
data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days.
C. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Congure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the
alerts to an Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) cluster. Set up the Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon
Elasticsearch Service) cluster to take manual snapshots every day and delete data from the cluster that is older than 14 days.
D. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to ingest the alerts, and set the message retention period to 14
days. Congure consumers to poll the SQS queue, check the age of the message, and analyze the message data as needed. If the

解析(英):
The answer is A because this option provides a highly available, low-cost solution without the need to manage additional infrastructure.
