題目(中): 一家公司擁有數千個邊緣設備，每天共同生成1 TB的狀態警報，每個警報約為2 KB大小。一個解決方案架構師需要實施一個解決方案來接收和儲存這些警報，以便於未來的分析。公司希望有一個高可用性的解決方案，但同時需要盡量降低成本，不希望管理額外的基礎設施。此外，公司希望保留14天的數據以供立即分析，並將超過14天的數據進行歸檔。哪種是最具操作效率的解決方案，以滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 創建一個Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose傳遞串流來接收警報。設定Kinesis Data Firehose串流將警報傳遞到Amazon S3儲存桶。設定S3生命週期配置以在14天後將數據轉移到Amazon S3 Glacier。
B. 啟動Amazon EC2實例跨越兩個可用區域，並將它們放在彈性負載平衡器後面以接收警報。創建一個腳本在EC2實例上將警報儲存到Amazon S3儲存桶。設定S3生命週期配置以在14天後將數據轉移到Amazon S3 Glacier。
C. 創建一個Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose傳遞串流來接收警報。設定Kinesis Data Firehose串流將警報傳遞到Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）叢集。設定Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）叢集每天手動建立快照並刪除超過14天的數據。
D. 創建一個Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）標準隊列來接收警報，並設定訊息保留期限為14天。設定消費者輪詢SQS隊列，檢查訊息的年齡，並根據需要分析訊息數據。如果訊息已經14天，消費者應該將訊息複製到Amazon S3儲存桶並從SQS隊列中刪除訊息。
解析(中):
答案是A，因為這個選項提供了一個高可用性、低成本且無需管理額外基礎設施的解決方案。Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose是一個完全管理的服務，可以接收和處理大量的數據，並將其傳遞到Amazon S3儲存桶。設定S3生命週期配置可以自動將超過14天的數據轉移到Amazon S3 Glacier進行歸檔。這個解決方案滿足了公司的需求，同時也降低了成本和管理複雜度。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
B選項需要管理EC2實例和彈性負載平衡器，增加了管理複雜度和成本。
C選項需要手動建立快照和刪除數據，增加了管理工作量和成本。
D選項需要設定消費者輪詢SQS隊列，增加了管理複雜度和成本，並且可能導致數據丟失或延遲。因此，A選項是最具操作效率的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company's application integrates with multiple software-as-a-service (SaaS) sources for data collection. The company runs Amazon EC2
instances to receive the data and to upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket for analysis. The same EC2 instance that receives and uploads
the data also sends a notication to the user when an upload is complete. The company has noticed slow application performance and wants
to improve the performance as much as possible.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Create an Auto Scaling group so that EC2 instances can scale out. Congure an S3 event notication to send events to an Amazon
Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.
B. Create an Amazon AppFlow ow to transfer data between each SaaS source and the S3 bucket. Congure an S3 event notication to
send events to an Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.
C. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule for each SaaS source to send output data. Congure the S3 bucket as
the rule's target. Create a second EventBridge (Cloud Watch Events) rule to send events when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.
Congure an Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic as the second rule's target.
D. Create a Docker container to use instead of an EC2 instance. Host the containerized application on Amazon Elastic Container Service
(Amazon ECS). Congure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights to send events to an Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS)
topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.
解析(英):
The answer is B, because setting up Amazon AppFlow workflows can move data directly between SaaS sources and S3 buckets, reducing the burden and operational complexity of EC2 instances. At the same time, setting S3 event notification can send events to the Amazon SNS topic when the upload is completed to implement the notification function. This solution meets the company's needs with minimal operational burden.

The other options are incorrect for the following reasons:
A. Establishing an Auto Scaling group can expand EC2 instances, but it cannot reduce the burden and operational complexity of EC2 instances.
C. Establishing Amazon EventBridge rules can send events, but multiple rules and targets need to be set, which increases operational complexity.
D. Creating Docker containers and Amazon ECS can improve application performance, but requires additional configuration and management, increasing operational complexity. At the same time, setting up Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights to send events also increases the operational burden. Therefore, option B is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司的應用程式整合了多個軟體即服務（SaaS）來源以收集資料。公司運行 Amazon EC2 實例來接收資料並上傳資料到 Amazon S3 儲存桶進行分析。同一個 EC2 實例既接收和上傳資料，也在上傳完成時向用戶發送通知。公司已經注意到應用程式的效能變慢，想要盡可能地改善效能。哪種解決方案能夠以最少的運營負擔滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立 Auto Scaling 群組，以便 EC2 實例可以擴展。設定 S3 事件通知以在上傳到 S3 儲存桶完成時向 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題發送事件。
B. 建立 Amazon AppFlow 工作流程以在每個 SaaS 來源和 S3 儲存桶之間轉移資料。設定 S3 事件通知以在上傳到 S3 儲存桶完成時向 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題發送事件。
C. 建立 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 規則以從每個 SaaS 來源發送輸出資料。設定 S3 儲存桶為規則的目標。建立第二個 EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 規則以在上傳到 S3 儲存桶完成時發送事件。設定 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題為第二個規則的目標。
D. 建立 Docker 容器以取代 EC2 實例。將容器化應用程式託管在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上。設定 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights 以在上傳到 S3 儲存桶完成時向 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題發送事件。
解析(中):
答案是 B，因為建立 Amazon AppFlow 工作流程可以直接在 SaaS 來源和 S3 儲存桶之間轉移資料，減少了 EC2 實例的負擔和運營複雜度。同時，設定 S3 事件通知可以在上傳完成時向 Amazon SNS 主題發送事件，實現通知功能。這種解決方案以最少的運營負擔滿足了公司的需求。

其他選項不正確的原因如下：
A. 建立 Auto Scaling 群組可以擴展 EC2 實例，但不能減少 EC2 實例的負擔和運營複雜度。
C. 建立 Amazon EventBridge 規則可以發送事件，但需要設定多個規則和目標，增加了運營複雜度。
D. 建立 Docker 容器和 Amazon ECS 可以改善應用程式的效能，但需要額外的設定和管理，增加了運營複雜度。同時，設定 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights 來發送事件也增加了運營負擔。因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company runs a highly available image-processing application on Amazon EC2 instances in a single VPC. The EC2 instances run inside
several subnets across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances do not communicate with each other. However, the EC2 instances
download images from Amazon S3 and upload images to Amazon S3 through a single NAT gateway. The company is concerned about data
transfer charges.
What is the MOST cost-effective way for the company to avoid Regional data transfer charges?
選項(英):
A. Launch the NAT gateway in each Availability Zone.
B. Replace the NAT gateway with a NAT instance.
C. Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3.
D. Provision an EC2 Dedicated Host to run the EC2 instances.

題目(中): 一家公司在單一 VPC 中的 Amazon EC2 實例上運行高可用性的圖像處理應用程式，EC2 實例位於多個可用區域的多個子網路中。EC2 實例之間不進行通訊，但它們會通過單一 NAT 閘道從 Amazon S3 下載圖像並上傳圖像到 Amazon S3。該公司擔心資料傳輸費用。公司可以採取什麼最具成本效益的方法來避免區域資料傳輸費用？
選項(中):
A. 在每個可用區域啟動 NAT 閘道。
B. 用 NAT 實例取代 NAT 閘道。
C. 部署 Amazon S3 的閘道 VPC 端點。
D. 配置 EC2 專用主機來運行 EC2 實例。
解析(中):
正確答案是 C，部署 Amazon S3 的閘道 VPC 端點。這是因為當 EC2 實例通過 NAT 閘道存取 Amazon S3 時，會產生區域資料傳輸費用。通過部署閘道 VPC 端點，EC2 實例可以直接存取 Amazon S3，而不需要通過 NAT 閘道，從而避免區域資料傳輸費用。這種方法是最具成本效益的，因為它可以消除區域資料傳輸費用，而不需要增加其他成本。

其他選項不正確的原因如下：
A. 啟動多個 NAT 閘道並不能避免區域資料傳輸費用，反而會增加成本。
B. 用 NAT 實例取代 NAT 閘道並不能解決區域資料傳輸費用的問題，且 NAT 實例的成本可能高於 NAT 閘道。
D. 配置 EC2 專用主機並不能直接解決區域資料傳輸費用的問題，且這種方法的成本可能高於其他選項。因此，部署 Amazon S3 的閘道 VPC 端點是最具成本效益的方法。

題目(英):

題目(英):

解析(英): To protect important data in an Amazon S3 bucket from accidental deletion, a combination of steps that a solutions architect should take is enabling versioning (A) and enabling MFA deletion (B). However, according to the question, the correct answer is BD, which means that the correct combination of steps is to enable version control (A) and enable default encryption (D). This seems inconsistent with the question's need to protect data from accidental deletion, because default encryption is mainly used to protect the confidentiality of data, not to prevent deletion. However, version control does help protect data from accidental deletion or modification because it allows you to store and manage multiple versions of a file. MFA Delete (B) is also a related option as it requires two-factor authentication to delete items, thus increasing the security of the deletion. Bucket policies (C) and lifecycle policies (E) can also be used to manage buckets and objects, but they do not directly address the problem of protecting data from accidental deletion. So, while the answer to the question is BD, from the perspective of protecting data from accidental deletion, enabling version control (A) and enabling MFA deletion (B) appear to be the more directly relevant options.

題目(英):
A company has a data ingestion workow that consists of the following:
• An Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic for notications about new data deliveries
• An AWS Lambda function to process the data and record metadata
The company observes that the ingestion workow fails occasionally because of network connectivity issues. When such a failure occurs, the
Lambda function does not ingest the corresponding data unless the company manually reruns the job.
Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to ensure that the Lambda function ingests all data in the future? (Choose
two.)
選項(英):
A. Deploy the Lambda function in multiple Availability Zones.
B. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue, and subscribe it to the SNS topic.
C. Increase the CPU and memory that are allocated to the Lambda function.
D. Increase provisioned throughput for the Lambda function.
E. Modify the Lambda function to read from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.
解析(英): To ensure that the Lambda function is able to retrieve all the data, the combined action that the solution architect should take is BE. Option B creates an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and subscribes it to the SNS topic. This ensures that when the Lambda function fails due to network connection issues, the data will still be retained in the SQS queue and will be processed when the Lambda function resumes normal operation. Option E Modifies the Lambda function to read from the Amazon SQS queue. This allows the Lambda function to retrieve data directly from the SQS queue to avoid data loss. The combination of these two options ensures reliable delivery and processing of data. The other options are incorrect because deploying a Lambda function in multiple availability zones (option A) does not solve network connectivity issues, nor does increasing CPU and memory (option C) or reserving throughput (option D) guarantee reliable delivery of data.
題目(中): 一家公司有一個資料擷取工作流程，包括以下幾個部分：Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題，用于接收新資料傳遞的通知；AWS Lambda 函數，用于處理資料並記錄中繼資料。公司觀察到，資料擷取工作流程有時會因為網路連接問題而失敗。在這種情況下，Lambda 函數將不會擷取相應的資料，除非公司手動重新執行工作。哪種組合的動作應該由解決方案架構師採取，以確保 Lambda 函數在未來擷取所有資料？（選擇兩個。）

B. 建立 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列，並將其訂閱到 SNS 主題。
C. 增加分配給 Lambda 函數的 CPU 和記憶體。

題目(英):
A company has an application that provides marketing services to stores. The services are based on previous purchases by store customers.
The stores upload transaction data to the company through SFTP, and the data is processed and analyzed to generate new marketing offers.

Recently, the company discovered that some of the stores have uploaded les that contain personally identiable information (PII) that should
not have been included. The company wants administrators to be alerted if PII is shared again. The company also wants to automate
remediation.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
選項(英):
A. Use an Amazon S3 bucket as a secure transfer point. Use Amazon Inspector to scan the objects in the bucket. If objects contain PII,
trigger an S3 Lifecycle policy to remove the objects that contain PII.
B. Use an Amazon S3 bucket as a secure transfer point. Use Amazon Macie to scan the objects in the bucket. If objects contain PII, use

C. Implement custom scanning algorithms in an AWS Lambda function. Trigger the function when objects are loaded into the bucket. If
objects contain PII, use Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) to trigger a notication to the administrators to remove the
objects that contain PII.
D. Implement custom scanning algorithms in an AWS Lambda function. Trigger the function when objects are loaded into the bucket. If
objects contain PII, use Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to trigger a notication to the administrators and trigger an S3

題目(中): 一家公司有一個應用程式，為商店提供基於過往顧客購買記錄的行銷服務。商店透過SFTP上傳交易資料給公司，然後公司會處理和分析這些資料，以產生新的行銷方案。有些檔案大小超過200 GB。最近，公司發現有些商店上傳的檔案包含了不應該包含的個人可辨識資訊（PII）。公司希望當PII再次被分享時，管理員能夠收到通知，並且希望自動化補救措施。解決方案架構師應該如何以最少的開發努力滿足這些需求？

B. 使用Amazon S3儲存桶作為安全的傳輸點。使用Amazon Macie掃描儲存桶中的物件。如果物件包含PII，使用Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）觸發通知給管理員，以刪除包含PII的物件。

題目(英):
A company needs guaranteed Amazon EC2 capacity in three specic Availability Zones in a specic AWS Region for an upcoming event that
will last 1 week.
What should the company do to guarantee the EC2 capacity?
選項(英):
A. Purchase Reserved Instances that specify the Region needed.
B. Create an On-Demand Capacity Reservation that species the Region needed.
C. Purchase Reserved Instances that specify the Region and three Availability Zones needed.
D. Create an On-Demand Capacity Reservation that species the Region and three Availability Zones needed.
解析(英):
The correct answer is D because establishing an On-Demand Capacity Reservation is the most appropriate option when a company needs guaranteed EC2 capacity in a specific availability zone in a specific region. On-Demand Capacity Reservations allow companies to specify required regions and available zones to guarantee the required EC2 capacity for a specific period of time (1 week in this case).

Choices A and C are incorrect because Reserved Instances can offer discounted pricing but do not necessarily guarantee capacity in a specific availability zone. Reserved instances are mainly allocated based on regions and are not guaranteed to obtain capacity in a specific available region.

Choice B is incorrect because it only specifies the zone but not the available zone. This means companies may not be able to get EC2 capacity in the three specific availability zones they need. Therefore, Option D is the most appropriate choice because it specifies both regions and availability zones, guaranteeing that the company will get the EC2 capacity it needs within a specific time.
題目(中): 一家公司需要在特定 AWS 區域中的三個特定可用區域（Availability Zones）中保證 Amazon EC2 容量，以應對即將到來的為期 1 周的活動。公司應該採取什麼措施來保證 EC2 容量？
選項(中):
A. 購買指定所需區域的預留實例（Reserved Instances）。
B. 建立指定所需區域的隨需容量預留（On-Demand Capacity Reservation）。
C. 購買指定所需區域和三個可用區域的預留實例。
D. 建立指定所需區域和三個可用區域的隨需容量預留。
解析(中):
正確答案是 D，因為當公司需要在特定區域中的特定可用區域保證 EC2 容量時，建立隨需容量預留（On-Demand Capacity Reservation）是最合適的選擇。隨需容量預留允許公司指定所需的區域和可用區域，以保證在特定時間內（在此案例中為 1 周）獲得所需的 EC2 容量。

選項 A 和 C 不正確，因為預留實例（Reserved Instances）可以提供折扣價，但不一定能保證在特定可用區域中獲得容量。預留實例主要是根據區域（Region）進行分配的，不能保證在特定的可用區域中獲得容量。

選項 B 不正確，因為它只指定了區域，但沒有指定可用區域。這意味著公司可能無法在所需的三個特定可用區域中獲得 EC2 容量。因此，選項 D 是最合適的選擇，因為它同時指定了區域和可用區域，能夠保證公司在特定時間內獲得所需的 EC2 容量。

題目(英):
A company's website uses an Amazon EC2 instance store for its catalog of items. The company wants to make sure that the catalog is highly
available and that the catalog is stored in a durable location.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Move the catalog to Amazon ElastiCache for Redis.
B. Deploy a larger EC2 instance with a larger instance store.
C. Move the catalog from the instance store to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
D. Move the catalog to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) le system.
解析(英):
To meet the needs of high-availability and durable storage, solutions architects should migrate directories to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Amazon EFS is a fully managed file system that provides highly available and durable storage, ideal for storing files that require shared access, such as product catalogs. Amazon EFS supports multiple availability zones and automatically replicates files to ensure data security and availability.

Option A is incorrect because Amazon ElastiCache for Redis is mainly used to store temporary data and cache and cannot provide high availability and durability storage. Option B is incorrect because increasing the size of the EC2 instance and the instance store cannot provide highly available and durable storage, and the instance store still presents the risk of a single point of failure. Option C is incorrect because Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive is mainly used for long-term storage and archiving and cannot provide high availability and fast access requirements. 題目(中): 一家公司的網站使用 Amazon EC2 實例存儲來儲存其商品目錄。公司希望確保目錄具有高可用性，並且目錄儲存在一個耐用性存儲位置。解決方案架構師應該採取哪些措施來滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將目錄遷移到 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis。
B. 部署一個更大的 EC2 實例，並具有更大的實例存儲。
C. 將目錄從實例存儲遷移到 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
D. 將目錄遷移到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 檔案系統。
解析(中):
為了滿足高可用性和耐用性存儲的需求，解決方案架構師應該將目錄遷移到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)。Amazon EFS 是一個完全受管的檔案系統，提供高可用性和耐用性存儲，非常適合儲存需要共享存取的檔案，如商品目錄。Amazon EFS 支持多個可用區域，自動複製檔案，確保資料的安全性和可用性。

選項 A 不正確，因為 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 主要用於儲存暫時性資料和快取，不能提供高可用性和耐用性存儲。選項 B 不正確，因為增加 EC2 實例的大小和實例存儲不能提供高可用性和耐用性存儲，實例存儲仍然存在單點故障的風險。選項 C 不正確，因為 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive 主要用於長期儲存和歸檔，不能提供高可用性和快速存取的需求。因此，選項 D 是最適合的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company stores call transcript les on a monthly basis. Users access the les randomly within 1 year of the call, but users access the les
infrequently after 1 year. The company wants to optimize its solution by giving users the ability to query and retrieve les that are less than 1-
year-old as quickly as possible. A delay in retrieving older les is acceptable.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
選項(英):
A. Store individual les with tags in Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval. Query the tags to retrieve the les from S3 Glacier Instant
Retrieval.
B. Store individual les in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the les to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 1
year. Query and retrieve the les that are in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena. Query and retrieve the les that are in S3 Glacier by
using S3 Glacier Select.
C. Store individual les with tags in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Store search metadata for each archive in Amazon S3 Standard storage.
Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the les to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 1 year. Query and retrieve the les by searching for
metadata from Amazon S3.
D. Store individual les in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the les to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
Store search metadata in Amazon RDS. Query the les from Amazon RDS. Retrieve the les from S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
解析(英): The answer is B because this option meets the company's needs most cost-effectively. Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering can automatically migrate files to the most appropriate storage tier to reduce storage costs. Using the S3 Lifecycle policy, files can be migrated to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after one year to further reduce storage costs. Amazon Athena can quickly query and retrieve archives stored in Amazon S3, while S3 Glacier Select can query and retrieve archives stored in S3 Glacier, which is slower but still meets the company's needs. The other options are incorrect because option A requires manual querying and retrieval of the archive, option C requires storing metadata, and option D requires using Amazon RDS to store metadata, all of which add cost and complexity. Therefore, option B is the most cost-effective solution.
題目(中): 一家公司每月存儲通話記錄檔。使用者在通話後1年內隨機存取檔案，但在1年後存取檔案的頻率很低。公司希望透過優化解決方案，讓使用者能夠快速查詢和检索1年內的檔案，同時允許older檔案的检索延遲。哪種解決方案能夠最具成本效益地滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將個別檔案存儲在Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval中，使用標籤查詢檔案並從S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval中检索。
B. 將個別檔案存儲在Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering中，使用S3 Lifecycle策略在1年後將檔案遷移到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。使用Amazon Athena查詢和检索存儲在Amazon S3中的檔案，使用S3 Glacier Select查詢和检索存儲在S3 Glacier中的檔案。
C. 將個別檔案存儲在Amazon S3 Standard儲存中，存儲每個檔案的搜索中繼資料在Amazon S3 Standard儲存中。使用S3 Lifecycle策略在1年後將檔案遷移到S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。使用Amazon S3中的中繼資料進行查詢和检索檔案。
D. 將個別檔案存儲在Amazon S3 Standard儲存中，使用S3 Lifecycle策略在1年後將檔案遷移到S3 Glacier Deep Archive。存儲搜索中繼資料在Amazon RDS中，從Amazon RDS中查詢檔案，從S3 Glacier Deep Archive中检索檔案。
解析(中): 答案是B，因為這個選項能夠最具成本效益地滿足公司的需求。Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering可以自動將檔案遷移到最合適的儲存層，減少儲存成本。使用S3 Lifecycle策略可以在1年後將檔案遷移到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，進一步減少儲存成本。Amazon Athena可以快速查詢和检索存儲在Amazon S3中的檔案，而S3 Glacier Select可以查詢和检索存儲在S3 Glacier中的檔案，雖然速度較慢，但仍然可以滿足公司的需求。其他選項不正確，因為A選項需要手動查詢和检索檔案，C選項需要存儲中繼資料，D選項需要使用Amazon RDS存儲中繼資料，所有這些都會增加成本和複雜度。因此，B選項是最具成本效益的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has a production workload that runs on 1,000 Amazon EC2 Linux instances. The workload is powered by third-party software. The
company needs to patch the third-party software on all EC2 instances as quickly as possible to remediate a critical security vulnerability.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create an AWS Lambda function to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
B. Congure AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
C. Schedule an AWS Systems Manager maintenance window to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
D. Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run a custom command that applies the patch to all EC2 instances.
解析(英):
In order to patch third-party software on all EC2 instances as quickly as possible, solutions architects need to choose a method that can apply patches quickly and efficiently. Option D, using AWS Systems Manager Run Command, is the most appropriate choice because it allows you to execute custom commands to apply patches directly to all EC2 instances. This approach can be done quickly, especially when facing critical security vulnerabilities where time is of the essence.

Option A, creating an AWS Lambda function, automates the work but may require additional development and testing time, delaying the patching process. Option B Setup AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager can be used for automated patching, but it may require prior setup and configuration and may not be suitable for emergency situations. Option C Scheduling AWS Systems Manager maintenance windows can be used for planned maintenance, but it may not be suitable for emergency patching because it requires scheduling and waiting for maintenance windows in advance.

Therefore, Option D using AWS Systems Manager Run Command is the most appropriate choice as it provides a fast and flexible way to apply patches to all EC2 instances, effectively mitigating critical security vulnerabilities.
題目(中): 一家公司有一個生產工作負載，運行在 1,000 個 Amazon EC2 Linux 實例上。該工作負載由第三方軟體驅動。該公司需要盡快在所有 EC2 實例上修補第三方軟體，以緩解一個關鍵的安全漏洞。解決方案架構師應該做什麼來滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 創建一個 AWS Lambda 函數來將修補程式套用到所有 EC2 實例。
B. 設定 AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager 來將修補程式套用到所有 EC2 實例。
C. 安排一個 AWS Systems Manager 維護窗口來將修補程式套用到所有 EC2 實例。
D. 使用 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 執行一個自訂命令，將修補程式套用到所有 EC2 實例。
解析(中):
為了盡快在所有 EC2 實例上修補第三方軟體，解決方案架構師需要選擇一個能夠快速、有效地套用修補程式的方法。選項 D 使用 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 是最合適的選擇，因為它允許您執行自訂命令，直接將修補程式套用到所有 EC2 實例上。這種方法可以快速完成，尤其是在面臨關鍵安全漏洞時，時間是非常重要的。

選項 A 創建 AWS Lambda 函數雖然可以自動化工作，但可能需要額外的開發和測試時間，從而延遲修補過程。選項 B 設定 AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager 可以用於自動修補，但它可能需要事先設定和配置，可能不適合緊急情況。選項 C 安排 AWS Systems Manager 維護窗口可以用於計劃性維護，但它可能不適合緊急修補，因為它需要事先安排和等待維護窗口。

因此，選項 D 使用 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 是最合適的選擇，因為它提供了一種快速、靈活的方式來套用修補程式到所有 EC2 實例上，從而有效地緩解關鍵安全漏洞。

題目(英):
A company is developing an application that provides order shipping statistics for retrieval by a REST API. The company wants to extract the
shipping statistics, organize the data into an easy-to-read HTML format, and send the report to several email addresses at the same time
every morning.
Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Congure the application to send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose.
B. Use Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to format the data and to send the report by email.
C. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled event that invokes an AWS Glue job to query the application's
API for the data.
D. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled event that invokes an AWS Lambda function to query the
application's API for the data.
E. Store the application data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic as an S3 event destination
to send the report by email.
解析(英):
To meet the company's needs, shipping statistics need to be extracted, organized, and sent to multiple email addresses. The correct answer is DE. The reason is that the AWS Lambda function in option D can be used to query your application's API data and then organize the data into an easy-to-read HTML format. Amazon S3 and Amazon SNS in option E can be used to store and send reports. Amazon S3 can be used to store reports, and Amazon SNS can be used to send reports to multiple email addresses.

The other options are incorrect because:
Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose in option A is mainly used for processing and analyzing big data and is not suitable for sending reports.
Amazon SES in option B can be used to send email, but is not suitable for formatting data and querying API data.
The AWS Glue job in Option C is primarily used for data transformation and analysis and is not suitable for querying API data and sending reports.
題目(中): 一家公司正在開發一個應用程式，提供訂單運送統計數據，以供REST API查詢。該公司希望提取運送統計數據，將數據組織成易於閱讀的HTML格式，並將報告同時發送到多個電子郵件地址，每天早上。
選項(中):
A. 將應用程式配置為將數據發送到Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。
B. 使用Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES)格式化數據並通過電子郵件發送報告。
C. 創建Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 排程事件，調用AWS Glue工作以查詢應用程式的API數據。
D. 創建Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 排程事件，調用AWS Lambda函數以查詢應用程式的API數據。
E. 將應用程式數據存儲在Amazon S3中。創建Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題作為S3事件目的地，以通過電子郵件發送報告。
解析(中):
要滿足公司的需求，需要將運送統計數據提取、組織和發送給多個電子郵件地址。正確的答案是 DE。原因是 D 選項中的 AWS Lambda 函數可以用於查詢應用程式的 API 數據，然後將數據組織成易於閱讀的 HTML 格式。E 選項中的 Amazon S3 和 Amazon SNS 可以用於存儲和發送報告。Amazon S3 可以用於存儲報告，Amazon SNS 可以用於發送報告給多個電子郵件地址。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A 選項中的 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 主要用於處理和分析大數據，不適合用於發送報告。
B 選項中的 Amazon SES 可以用於發送電子郵件，但不適合用於格式化數據和查詢 API 數據。
C 選項中的 AWS Glue 工作主要用於數據轉換和分析，不適合用於查詢 API 數據和發送報告。

題目(英):
A company wants to migrate its on-premises application to AWS. The application produces output les that vary in size from tens of gigabytes
to hundreds of terabytes. The application data must be stored in a standard le system structure. The company wants a solution that scales
automatically. is highly available, and requires minimum operational overhead.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Migrate the application to run as containers on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Use Amazon S3 for storage.
B. Migrate the application to run as containers on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon Elastic Block Store
(Amazon EBS) for storage.
C. Migrate the application to Amazon EC2 instances in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) for
storage.
D. Migrate the application to Amazon EC2 instances in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) for
storage.
解析(英):
According to the question description, the company needed a solution that could scale automatically, be highly available, and require minimal operational burden. At the same time, application data must be stored in standard file system structures. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate solution. Option C uses Amazon EC2 instances in auto-scaling groups across multiple Availability Zones, with the ability to automatically scale up and down to meet your needs for high availability and minimal operational burden. At the same time, using Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) as storage can provide a standard file system structure to meet the application data storage needs.

Choices A and B are incorrect because Amazon S3 and Amazon EBS are not standard file system structures. Amazon S3 is an object storage service, while Amazon EBS is a block storage service that requires additional setup and management.

Option D is incorrect because Amazon EBS is a block storage service that requires additional setup and management and is not suitable for large-scale file storage. At the same time, Amazon EBS has limited storage capacity and may not be able to meet the large file storage needs generated by applications.

Therefore, Option C is the most appropriate solution that meets the company's needs.
題目(中): 一家公司想要將其內部應用程式遷移到 AWS。該應用程式會產生輸出檔案，檔案大小從幾十個吉گاب位到幾百個太字節不等。應用程式資料必須儲存在標準檔案系統結構中。公司想要一個能夠自動擴展、具有高可用性且需要最少運營負擔的解決方案。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將應用程式遷移到 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上的容器中，使用 Amazon S3 作為儲存。
B. 將應用程式遷移到 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上的容器中，使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 作為儲存。
C. 將應用程式遷移到 Amazon EC2 實例上，實例位於多個可用區域的自動擴展群組中，使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 作為儲存。
D. 將應用程式遷移到 Amazon EC2 實例上，實例位於多個可用區域的自動擴展群組中，使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 作為儲存。
解析(中):
根據題目描述，公司需要一個能夠自動擴展、具有高可用性且需要最少運營負擔的解決方案。同時，應用程式資料必須儲存在標準檔案系統結構中。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。選項 C 使用 Amazon EC2 實例在多個可用區域的自動擴展群組中，能夠自動擴展和縮減，滿足高可用性和最少運營負擔的需求。同時，使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 作為儲存，能夠提供標準檔案系統結構，滿足應用程式資料儲存的需求。

選項 A 和 B 不正確，因為 Amazon S3 和 Amazon EBS 不是標準檔案系統結構。Amazon S3 是一個物件儲存服務，而 Amazon EBS 是一個區塊儲存服務，需要額外的設定和管理。

選項 D 不正確，因為 Amazon EBS 是一個區塊儲存服務，需要額外的設定和管理，且不適合大規模的檔案儲存。同時，Amazon EBS 的儲存容量有限，可能無法滿足應用程式產生的大量檔案儲存需求。

因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案，能夠滿足公司的需求。

題目(英):
A company needs to store its accounting records in Amazon S3. The records must be immediately accessible for 1 year and then must be
archived for an additional 9 years. No one at the company, including administrative users and root users, can be able to delete the records
during the entire 10-year period. The records must be stored with maximum resiliency.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Store the records in S3 Glacier for the entire 10-year period. Use an access control policy to deny deletion of the records for a period of
10 years.
B. Store the records by using S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use an IAM policy to deny deletion of the records. After 10 years, change the IAM
policy to allow deletion.
C. Use an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the records from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year. Use S3 Object Lock in
compliance mode for a period of 10 years.
D. Use an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the records from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 1 year.
Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode for a period of 10 years.
解析(英):
The correct answer is C because it meets all requirements. Use the S3 Lifecycle policy to automatically transfer records from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year to achieve record archiving and storage needs. S3 Object Lock's compliance model ensures that records cannot be deleted for 10 years, including administrative and root users. This mode also provides maximum fault tolerance, ensuring the security and integrity of records.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. S3 Glacier is not suitable for records that require immediate access, and using access control policies to deny deletion of records does not provide maximum fault tolerance.
B. S3 Intelligent-Tiering can automatically adjust storage tiers, but it cannot guarantee that records cannot be deleted within 10 years, and modifying IAM policies requires manual intervention.
D. S3 One Zone-IA is not suitable for storage needs that require maximum fault tolerance, and S3 Object Lock's governance model does not provide the same security and integrity as the compliance model.
題目(中): 一家公司需要在 Amazon S3 中存儲其會計記錄。這些記錄必須在 1 年內隨時可存取，然後必須在另外 9 年內進行歸檔。在整個 10 年期間，公司內的任何人，包括管理用戶和根用戶，都不能刪除這些記錄。這些記錄必須以最大程度的容錯性進行存儲。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將記錄存儲在 S3 Glacier 中整個 10 年期間。使用存取控制政策拒絕刪除記錄 10 年。
B. 使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存儲記錄。使用 IAM 政策拒絕刪除記錄。10 年後，修改 IAM 政策以允許刪除。
C. 使用 S3 Lifecycle 政策在 1 年後將記錄從 S3 Standard 轉移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。使用 S3 Object Lock 的合規模式 10 年。
D. 使用 S3 Lifecycle 政策在 1 年後將記錄從 S3 Standard 轉移到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。使用 S3 Object Lock 的治理模式 10 年。
解析(中):
正確答案是 C，因為它滿足了所有需求。使用 S3 Lifecycle 政策可以在 1 年後自動將記錄從 S3 Standard 轉移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，實現記錄的歸檔和儲存需求。S3 Object Lock 的合規模式可以確保記錄在 10 年內不能被刪除，包括管理用戶和根用戶。這種模式還可以提供最大程度的容錯性，確保記錄的安全性和完整性。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. S3 Glacier 不適合需要立即存取的記錄，而且使用存取控制政策拒絕刪除記錄不能提供最大程度的容錯性。
B. S3 Intelligent-Tiering 可以自動調整儲存層級，但它不能保證記錄在 10 年內不能被刪除，而且修改 IAM 政策需要人工干預。
D. S3 One Zone-IA 不適合需要最大程度容錯性的儲存需求，而且 S3 Object Lock 的治理模式不能提供與合規模式相同的安全性和完整性。

題目(英):
A company runs multiple Windows workloads on AWS. The company's employees use Windows le shares that are hosted on two Amazon EC2
instances. The le shares synchronize data between themselves and maintain duplicate copies. The company wants a highly available and
durable storage solution that preserves how users currently access the les.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Migrate all the data to Amazon S3. Set up IAM authentication for users to access les.
B. Set up an Amazon S3 File Gateway. Mount the S3 File Gateway on the existing EC2 instances.
C. Extend the le share environment to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server with a Multi-AZ conguration. Migrate all the data to FSx for
Windows File Server.
D. Extend the le share environment to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with a Multi-AZ conguration. Migrate all the data to
Amazon EFS.
解析(英): The answer is C, because Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is a fully managed file server service that supports Windows native file sharing protocols and can provide high availability and durability storage solutions. By using a multi-AZ configuration, FSx for Windows File Server ensures high data availability and durability. In addition, FSx for Windows File Server supports the Windows file sharing protocol and can preserve the way users currently access files. Option A is incorrect because Amazon S3 does not support the Windows native file sharing protocol and requires additional IAM authentication setup. Choice B is incorrect because the Amazon S3 file gateway requires additional setup and maintenance. Option D is incorrect because Amazon EFS does not support Windows native file sharing protocols and requires additional setup and maintenance. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS 上運行多個 Windows 工作負載。公司的員工使用 Windows 檔案共享，該檔案共享由兩個 Amazon EC2 實例主機。檔案共享之間同步資料並維護副本。公司希望有一個高可用性和耐用性的儲存解決方案，以保留用戶目前存取檔案的方式。解決方案架構師應該如何滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將所有資料遷移到 Amazon S3。設定 IAM 身分驗證讓用戶存取檔案。
B. 設定 Amazon S3 檔案閘道。將 S3 檔案閘道掛載到現有的 EC2 實例上。
C. 將檔案共享環境擴展到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server，採用多可用區域配置。將所有資料遷移到 FSx for Windows File Server。
D. 將檔案共享環境擴展到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)，採用多可用區域配置。將所有資料遷移到 Amazon EFS。
解析(中): 答案是 C，因為 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是一個完全受管理的檔案伺服器服務，支援 Windows 原生檔案共享協定，能夠提供高可用性和耐用性的儲存解決方案。透過採用多可用區域配置，FSx for Windows File Server 可以確保資料的高可用性和耐用性。另外，FSx for Windows File Server 支援 Windows 檔案共享協定，能夠保留用戶目前存取檔案的方式。選項 A 不正確，因為 Amazon S3 不支援 Windows 原生檔案共享協定，需要額外設定 IAM 身分驗證。選項 B 不正確，因為 Amazon S3 檔案閘道需要額外設定和維護。選項 D 不正確，因為 Amazon EFS 不支援 Windows 原生檔案共享協定，需要額外設定和維護。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A solutions architect is developing a VPC architecture that includes multiple subnets. The architecture will host applications that use Amazon
EC2 instances and Amazon RDS DB instances. The architecture consists of six subnets in two Availability Zones. Each Availability Zone
includes a public subnet, a private subnet, and a dedicated subnet for databases. Only EC2 instances that run in the private subnets can have
access to the RDS databases.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create a new route table that excludes the route to the public subnets' CIDR blocks. Associate the route table with the database
subnets.
B. Create a security group that denies inbound trac from the security group that is assigned to instances in the public subnets. Attach
the security group to the DB instances.
C. Create a security group that allows inbound trac from the security group that is assigned to instances in the private subnets. Attach
the security group to the DB instances.
D. Create a new peering connection between the public subnets and the private subnets. Create a different peering connection between
the private subnets and the database subnets.
解析(英): The correct answer is C because this option ensures that only EC2 instances running in the private subnet can access the RDS database. This requirement can be achieved by creating a security group that allows incoming traffic from the security group of the instance in the private subnet and attaching it to the DB instance. This allows EC2 instances in the private subnet to access the RDS database, but instances in the public subnet cannot. The other options are incorrect because: option A, excluding the public subnet's route table will not affect the EC2 instance's access to the RDS database; option B, denying incoming traffic from the instance's security group in the public subnet will not allow instances in the private subnet to access the RDS database; option D, creating a peering connection will not affect the EC2 instance's access to the RDS database. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一位解決方案架構師正在開發一個包含多個子網路的 VPC 架構。該架構將主機應用程序，使用 Amazon EC2 實例和 Amazon RDS DB 實例。該架構由兩個可用區域中的六個子網路組成。每個可用區域都包含一個公用子網路、一个私有子網路和一個專用於數據庫的子網路。只有在私有子網路中運行的 EC2 實例才能存取 RDS 數據庫。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 創建一個新的路由表，排除公用子網路的 CIDR 區塊路由。將路由表與數據庫子網路關聯。
B. 創建一個安全群組，拒絕從公用子網路中實例的安全群組傳入的流量。將安全群組附加到 DB 實例。
C. 創建一個安全群組，允許從私有子網路中實例的安全群組傳入的流量。將安全群組附加到 DB 實例。
D. 創建公用子網路和私有子網路之間的新對等連接。創建私有子網路和數據庫子網路之間的不同對等連接。
解析(中): 正確答案是 C，因為這個選項能夠確保只有在私有子網路中運行的 EC2 實例才能存取 RDS 數據庫。通過創建一個安全群組，允許從私有子網路中實例的安全群組傳入的流量，並將其附加到 DB 實例，可以實現此需求。這樣，私有子網路中的 EC2 實例就可以存取 RDS 數據庫，而公用子網路中的實例則無法存取。其他選項不正確，因為：A 選項中排除公用子網路的路由表不會影響 EC2 實例對 RDS 數據庫的存取；B 選項中拒絕從公用子網路中實例的安全群組傳入的流量不會允許私有子網路中的實例存取 RDS 數據庫；D 選項中創建對等連接不會影響 EC2 實例對 RDS 數據庫的存取。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has registered its domain name with Amazon Route 53. The company uses Amazon API Gateway in the ca-central-1 Region as a
public interface for its backend microservice APIs. Third-party services consume the APIs securely. The company wants to design its API
Gateway URL with the company's domain name and corresponding certicate so that the third-party services can use HTTPS.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create stage variables in API Gateway with Name="Endpoint-URL" and Value="Company Domain Name" to overwrite the default URL.
Import the public certicate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certicate Manager (ACM).
B. Create Route 53 DNS records with the company's domain name. Point the alias record to the Regional API Gateway stage endpoint.
Import the public certicate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certicate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region.
C. Create a Regional API Gateway endpoint. Associate the API Gateway endpoint with the company's domain name. Import the public
certicate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certicate Manager (ACM) in the same Region. Attach the certicate to
the API Gateway endpoint. Congure Route 53 to route trac to the API Gateway endpoint.
D. Create a Regional API Gateway endpoint. Associate the API Gateway endpoint with the company's domain name. Import the public
certicate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certicate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region. Attach the certicate
to the API Gateway APIs. Create Route 53 DNS records with the company's domain name. Point an A record to the company's domain
name.
解析(英):
The answer is C, because this option correctly describes how to set up an API Gateway with your company domain name and credentials so that third-party services can access the API using HTTPS. First, establish a regional API Gateway endpoint to ensure that API Gateway can use your company domain name. Then, import the public credentials associated with your company domain into AWS Credential Manager (ACM) in the same region to ensure that the credentials can be used by API Gateway. Next, append the credentials to the API Gateway endpoint to enable HTTPS. Finally, configure Route 53 to route traffic to the API Gateway endpoint to ensure that third-party services can access the API using your company domain name.
The other options are incorrect because:
In option A, the method of overriding the default URL using stage variables is incorrect and Route 53 is not configured to route traffic to the API Gateway endpoint.
In option B, importing the credentials into AWS Credential Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 region is incorrect because the credentials should be imported into AWS Credential Manager (ACM) in the same region.
In option D, appending the credentials to the API Gateway API is incorrect, and using an A record to point to the company domain name is incorrect. Instead, use an alias record to point to the API Gateway endpoint.
題目(中): 一家公司已在 Amazon Route 53 中註冊了其域名。該公司使用位於 ca-central-1 區域的 Amazon API Gateway 作為其後端微服務 API 的公用介面。第三方服務安全地消耗這些 API。該公司希望設計其 API Gateway URL，以使用公司的域名和相應的憑證，使第三方服務可以使用 HTTPS。哪種解決方案可以滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在 API Gateway 中建立階段變數，名稱為 "Endpoint-URL"，值為 "公司域名"，以覆蓋預設 URL。將公司域名相關的公用憑證匯入 AWS 憑證管理器 (ACM)。
B. 建立具有公司域名的 Route 53 DNS 記錄。將別名記錄指向區域 API Gateway 階段端點。將公司域名相關的公用憑證匯入 us-east-1 區域的 AWS 憑證管理器 (ACM)。
C. 建立區域 API Gateway 端點。將 API Gateway 端點與公司域名相關聯。將公司域名相關的公用憑證匯入相同區域的 AWS 憑證管理器 (ACM)。將憑證附加到 API Gateway 端點。設定 Route 53 將流量路由到 API Gateway 端點。
D. 建立區域 API Gateway 端點。將 API Gateway 端點與公司域名相關聯。將公司域名相關的公用憑證匯入 us-east-1 區域的 AWS 憑證管理器 (ACM)。將憑證附加到 API Gateway API。建立具有公司域名的 Route 53 DNS 記錄。將 A 記錄指向公司域名。
解析(中):
答案是 C，因為這個選項正確地描述了如何使用公司域名和憑證設定 API Gateway，以便第三方服務可以使用 HTTPS 來存取 API。首先，建立區域 API Gateway 端點，以確保 API Gateway 可以使用公司域名。然後，將公司域名相關的公用憑證匯入相同區域的 AWS 憑證管理器 (ACM) 中，以確保憑證可以被 API Gateway 使用。接下來，將憑證附加到 API Gateway 端點，以啟用 HTTPS。最後，設定 Route 53 將流量路由到 API Gateway 端點，以確保第三方服務可以使用公司域名存取 API。
其他選項不正確，因為：
A 選項中，使用階段變數覆蓋預設 URL 的方法不正確，且沒有設定 Route 53 將流量路由到 API Gateway 端點。
B 選項中，匯入憑證到 us-east-1 區域的 AWS 憑證管理器 (ACM) 中不正確，因為憑證應該匯入相同區域的 AWS 憑證管理器 (ACM) 中。
D 選項中，將憑證附加到 API Gateway API 中不正確，且使用 A 記錄指向公司域名也不正確，應該使用別名記錄指向 API Gateway 端點。

題目(英):
A company is running a popular social media website. The website gives users the ability to upload images to share with other users. The
company wants to make sure that the images do not contain inappropriate content. The company needs a solution that minimizes
development effort.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use Amazon Comprehend to detect inappropriate content. Use human review for low-condence predictions.
B. Use Amazon Rekognition to detect inappropriate content. Use human review for low-condence predictions.
C. Use Amazon SageMaker to detect inappropriate content. Use ground truth to label low-condence predictions.
D. Use AWS Fargate to deploy a custom machine learning model to detect inappropriate content. Use ground truth to label low-condence
predictions.
解析(英): To meet the company's needs, solutions architects needed to choose a solution that could effectively detect inappropriate content in images and minimize development effort. Amazon Rekognition is a fully managed service that analyzes images and videos to detect objects, faces, text, and more, and filters inappropriate images based on their content. Using Amazon Rekognition can significantly reduce development effort because it provides pre-trained models that can be directly applied to image analysis. For low-confidence predictions, using human review can further ensure the accuracy of the results. Therefore, option B is the most suitable solution. Option A uses Amazon Comprehend mainly for text analysis. Options C and D require more development effort and custom model training, which does not meet the need to minimize development effort.
題目(中): 一家公司運營著一個流行的社交媒體網站，該網站允許用戶上傳圖片與其他用戶分享。公司希望確保圖片不包含不適當的內容。公司需要一個能夠最小化開發工作量的解決方案。
選項(中):
A. 使用 Amazon Comprehend 檢測不適當的內容。對於低信心預測，使用人工審核。
B. 使用 Amazon Rekognition 檢測不適當的內容。對於低信心預測，使用人工審核。
C. 使用 Amazon SageMaker 檢測不適當的內容。使用真實標籤對低信心預測進行標記。
D. 使用 AWS Fargate 部署自定義機器學習模型來檢測不適當的內容。使用真實標籤對低信心預測進行標記。
解析(中): 為了滿足公司的需求，解決方案架構師需要選擇一個能夠有效檢測圖片中不適當內容且最小化開發工作量的解決方案。Amazon Rekognition 是一種完全托管的服務，能夠分析圖片和視頻，檢測物體、人臉、文字等，並能夠根據內容過濾不適當的圖片。使用 Amazon Rekognition 可以大大減少開發工作量，因為它提供了預先訓練好的模型，可以直接應用於圖片分析中。對於低信心預測，使用人工審核可以進一步確保結果的準確性。因此，選項 B 是最適合的解決方案。選項 A 使用 Amazon Comprehend 主要針對文本分析，選項 C 和 D 需要更多的開發工作量和自定義模型訓練，不符合最小化開發工作量的需求。

題目(英):
A company wants to run its critical applications in containers to meet requirements for scalability and availability. The company prefers to
focus on maintenance of the critical applications. The company does not want to be responsible for provisioning and managing the underlying
infrastructure that runs the containerized workload.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use Amazon EC2 instances, and install Docker on the instances.
B. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2 worker nodes.
C. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.
D. Use Amazon EC2 instances from an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)-optimized Amazon Machine Image (AMI).
解析(英):
The answer is C because companies don't want to be responsible for provisioning and managing the underlying infrastructure, and AWS Fargate is a serverless compute engine that allows companies to focus on maintaining critical applications instead of managing EC2 instances. Using Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate allows companies to deploy containerized workloads on Fargate to meet scalability and availability needs.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Using Amazon EC2 instances and installing Docker requires the company to manage the EC2 instances, which is contrary to the company's needs.
B. Using Amazon ECS on Amazon EC2 worker nodes also requires the company to manage EC2 instances, which is also contrary to the company's needs.
D. Using an Amazon EC2 instance to optimize the AMI from Amazon ECS, although it can simplify the setup of ECS, it still requires the company to manage the EC2 instance, so it is not suitable for the company's needs. Only option C fully meets the company's needs.
題目(中): 一家公司希望將其關鍵應用程式容器化，以滿足可擴展性和可用性的需求。公司偏好專注於維護關鍵應用程式，並不希望負責提供和管理執行容器化工作負載的底層基礎設施。解決方案架構師應該如何滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 Amazon EC2 實例，並在實例上安裝 Docker。
B. 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 在 Amazon EC2 工作節點上。
C. 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 在 AWS Fargate 上。
D. 使用 Amazon EC2 實例從 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 優化的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。
解析(中):
答案是 C，因為公司不希望負責提供和管理底層基礎設施，而 AWS Fargate 是一個無伺服器的計算引擎，可以讓公司專注於維護關鍵應用程式，而不需要管理 EC2 實例。使用 Amazon ECS 在 AWS Fargate 上，可以讓公司將容器化工作負載部署在 Fargate 上，從而滿足可擴展性和可用性的需求。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. 使用 Amazon EC2 實例並安裝 Docker，需要公司管理 EC2 實例，這與公司的需求相違背。
B. 使用 Amazon ECS 在 Amazon EC2 工作節點上，也需要公司管理 EC2 實例，同樣與公司的需求相違背。
D. 使用 Amazon EC2 實例從 Amazon ECS 優化的 AMI，雖然可以簡化 ECS 的設定，但仍需要公司管理 EC2 實例，因此也不符合公司的需求。只有選項 C 能夠完全滿足公司的需求。

題目(英):
A company hosts more than 300 global websites and applications. The company requires a platform to analyze more than 30 TB of
clickstream data each day.
What should a solutions architect do to transmit and process the clickstream data?
選項(英):
A. Design an AWS Data Pipeline to archive the data to an Amazon S3 bucket and run an Amazon EMR cluster with the data to generate
analytics.
B. Create an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to process the data and send it to an Amazon S3 data lake for Amazon Redshift
to use for analysis.
C. Cache the data to Amazon CloudFront. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. When an object is added to the S3 bucket. run an AWS
Lambda function to process the data for analysis.
D. Collect the data from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to transmit the data to an Amazon S3 data
lake. Load the data in Amazon Redshift for analysis.
解析(英):
The answer is D because Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose are the best choices for handling large-scale real-time data streams. Amazon Kinesis Data Streams can collect and process large amounts of clickstream data, and Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose can transfer the data to an Amazon S3 data lake for storage and analysis. Amazon Redshift is a data warehousing service suitable for analyzing and processing large amounts of data. This option provides a complete data processing and analysis workflow.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. AWS Data Pipeline and Amazon EMR can be used for data processing and analysis, but they are not suitable for handling large-scale real-time data streams.
B. Auto Scaling groups and Amazon EC2 instances can be used for data processing, but they are not suitable for handling large-scale real-time data flows and require more management and maintenance.
C. Amazon CloudFront and AWS Lambda can be used for data processing and analysis, but they are not suitable for processing large-scale real-time data flows and require more management and maintenance.
題目(中): 一家公司主持超過 300 個全球網站和應用程式。該公司需要一個平台來分析每天超過 30 TB 的點擊流資料。
選項(中):
A. 設計一個 AWS Data Pipeline 將資料歸檔到 Amazon S3 儲存桶，並運行 Amazon EMR 叢集以產生分析。
B. 建立一個 Amazon EC2 實例的 Auto Scaling 群組來處理資料並將其傳送到 Amazon S3 資料湖，以供 Amazon Redshift 用於分析。

解析(中):
答案是 D，因為 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 和 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 是處理大規模實時資料流的最佳選擇。Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 可以收集和處理大量的點擊流資料，而 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 可以將資料傳輸到 Amazon S3 資料湖進行儲存和分析。Amazon Redshift 是一個資料倉儲服務，適合用於分析和處理大量的資料。這個選項可以提供一個完整的資料處理和分析流程。

其他選項不正確的原因是：

B. Auto Scaling 群組和 Amazon EC2 實例可以用於資料處理，但它們不適合處理大規模實時資料流，且需要更多的管理和維護。
C. Amazon CloudFront 和 AWS Lambda 可以用於資料處理和分析，但它們不適合處理大規模實時資料流，且需要更多的管理和維護。

題目(英):
A company has a website hosted on AWS. The website is behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that is congured to handle HTTP and
HTTPS separately. The company wants to forward all requests to the website so that the requests will use HTTPS.
What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?
選項(英):
A. Update the ALB's network ACL to accept only HTTPS trac.
B. Create a rule that replaces the HTTP in the URL with HTTPS.
C. Create a listener rule on the ALB to redirect HTTP trac to HTTPS.
D. Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer congured to use Server Name Indication (SNI).
解析(英):
To meet the company's requirements, solutions architects need to ensure that all requests use the HTTPS protocol. Option C is the correct answer because it describes a way to create a listener rule on the ALB to redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS. In this way, when users access the website through HTTP, ALB will automatically redirect the request to HTTPS to ensure that all requests use the secure HTTPS protocol.

Choice A is incorrect because updating the network ACL does not automatically redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS. Option B is also incorrect because creating a rule to replace HTTP with HTTPS in URLs does not guarantee that all requests will use HTTPS. Choice D is incorrect because replacing the ALB with a network load balancer does not require the use of Server Name Indication (SNI) to resolve this issue. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS 上有一個網站，該網站位於一個應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB) 後面，該 ALB 被設定為分別處理 HTTP 和 HTTPS。該公司希望將所有請求轉發到網站，以便請求使用 HTTPS。解決方案架構師應該做什麼來滿足此要求？
選項(中):
A. 更新 ALB 的網路 ACL 以僅接受 HTTPS 流量。
B. 創建一個規則，以在 URL 中將 HTTP 替換為 HTTPS。
C. 在 ALB 上創建一個 listener 規則，以將 HTTP 流量重定向到 HTTPS。
D. 將 ALB 替換為配置為使用伺服器名稱指示 (SNI) 的網路負載平衡器。
解析(中):
為了滿足公司的要求，解決方案架構師需要確保所有請求都使用 HTTPS 協議。選項 C 是正確的答案，因為它描述了一種方法，可以在 ALB 上創建一個 listener 規則，以將 HTTP 流量重定向到 HTTPS。這樣，當用戶通過 HTTP 存取網站時，ALB 會自動將請求重定向到 HTTPS，確保所有請求都使用安全的 HTTPS 協議。

選項 A 不正確，因為更新網路 ACL 不能自動重定向 HTTP 流量到 HTTPS。選項 B 也不正確，因為創建一個規則以在 URL 中將 HTTP 替換為 HTTPS 不能保證所有請求都使用 HTTPS。選項 D 不正確，因為替換 ALB 為網路負載平衡器並不需要使用伺服器名稱指示 (SNI) 來解決此問題。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is developing a two-tier web application on AWS. The company's developers have deployed the application on an Amazon EC2
instance that connects directly to a backend Amazon RDS database. The company must not hardcode database credentials in the application.
The company must also implement a solution to automatically rotate the database credentials on a regular basis.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Store the database credentials in the instance metadata. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rules to run a
scheduled AWS Lambda function that updates the RDS credentials and instance metadata at the same time.
B. Store the database credentials in a conguration le in an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon
CloudWatch Events) rules to run a scheduled AWS Lambda function that updates the RDS credentials and the credentials in the
conguration le at the same time. Use S3 Versioning to ensure the ability to fall back to previous values.
C. Store the database credentials as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on automatic rotation for the secret. Attach the required
permission to the EC2 role to grant access to the secret.
D. Store the database credentials as encrypted parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on automatic rotation for the
encrypted parameters. Attach the required permission to the EC2 role to grant access to the encrypted parameters.
解析(英):
The answer is C because AWS Secrets Manager provides a secure and scalable way to store and manage sensitive application data, such as database credentials. Enabling automatic rotation ensures that credentials are updated on a regular basis, thereby reducing security risks. In addition, AWS Secrets Manager provides fine-grained access control and monitoring capabilities to help companies meet their security and compliance needs.
Choice A is incorrect because storing the credentials in the instance metadata is not secure and requires additional steps to update the credentials.
Option B is incorrect because storing the credentials in an encrypted S3 bucket requires additional steps to update the credentials and configuration files and may cause versioning issues.
Choice D is incorrect because storing credentials as encrypted parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store requires additional steps to update credentials and parameters and may cause versioning issues.

題目(中): 一家公司正在開發一個兩層式的網頁應用程式於 AWS。公司的開發人員已經將應用程式部署到 Amazon EC2 實例中，該實例直接連接到後端的 Amazon RDS 數據庫。公司不能在應用程式中硬編碼數據庫憑證。公司還必須實施一個解決方案，以便在定期基礎上自動輪換數據庫憑證。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求，並且具有最少的運營負擔？

選項 A 不正確，因為儲存憑證在實例中繼資料中並不安全，且需要額外的步驟來更新憑證。

因此，選項 C 是最好的解決方案，因為它提供了一個安全、可擴展且易於管理的方式來儲存和管理數據庫憑證。

題目(英):
A company runs its infrastructure on AWS and has a registered base of 700,000 users for its document management application. The company
intends to create a product that converts large .pdf les to .jpg image les. The .pdf les average 5 MB in size. The company needs to store
the original les and the converted les. A solutions architect must design a scalable solution to accommodate demand that will grow rapidly
over time.
Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
選項(英):
A. Save the .pdf les to Amazon S3. Congure an S3 PUT event to invoke an AWS Lambda function to convert the les to .jpg format and
store them back in Amazon S3.
B. Save the .pdf les to Amazon DynamoDUse the DynamoDB Streams feature to invoke an AWS Lambda function to convert the les to
.jpg format and store them back in DynamoDB.
C. Upload the .pdf les to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application that includes Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon
EBS) storage, and an Auto Scaling group. Use a program in the EC2 instances to convert the les to .jpg format. Save the .pdf les and the
.jpg les in the EBS store.
D. Upload the .pdf les to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application that includes Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon
EFS) storage, and an Auto Scaling group. Use a program in the EC2 instances to convert the le to .jpg format. Save the .pdf les and the
.jpg les in the EBS store.
解析(英):
Answer A is the most cost-effective solution. The reason is that Amazon S3 is an object storage service that can store large amounts of files and is highly available and durable. Using the S3 PUT event to trigger an AWS Lambda function can automate the archive conversion process without manual intervention. In addition, the AWS Lambda function will only be triggered when the file is uploaded, thus reducing the waste of computing resources.
Choice B is incorrect because DynamoDB is a NoSQL database primarily designed to store structured data rather than large archives. Storing large files in DynamoDB can cause performance issues and increased costs.
Options C and D are incorrect because using EC2 instances and EBS or EFS storage requires more management and maintenance work, such as setting up Auto Scaling groups, monitoring instance performance, etc. Additionally, using EC2 instances requires paying for the instance's runtime and storage costs, adding to the overall cost. In comparison, solution Option A is simpler and more cost-effective.
題目(中):
一家公司在 AWS 上運行其基礎設施，並且有 70 萬名註冊用戶使用其文件管理應用程式。該公司打算開發一個產品，將大型 .pdf 檔案轉換為 .jpg 圖像檔案。.pdf 檔案的平均大小為 5 MB。該公司需要儲存原始檔案和轉換後的檔案。一個解決方案架構師需要設計一個可擴展的解決方案，以滿足需求，並能夠在未來快速增長。
哪個解決方案能夠最具成本效益地滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將 .pdf 檔案儲存到 Amazon S3。設定 S3 PUT 事件來觸發 AWS Lambda 函數，將檔案轉換為 .jpg 格式，並儲存回 Amazon S3。
B. 將 .pdf 檔案儲存到 Amazon DynamoDB。使用 DynamoDB Streams 功能來觸發 AWS Lambda 函數，將檔案轉換為 .jpg 格式，並儲存回 DynamoDB。
C. 上傳 .pdf 檔案到 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 應用程式，該應用程式包含 Amazon EC2 實例、Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 儲存和 Auto Scaling 群組。使用 EC2 實例中的程式將檔案轉換為 .jpg 格式。儲存 .pdf 檔案和 .jpg 檔案在 EBS 儲存中。
D. 上傳 .pdf 檔案到 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 應用程式，該應用程式包含 Amazon EC2 實例、Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 儲存和 Auto Scaling 群組。使用 EC2 實例中的程式將檔案轉換為 .jpg 格式。儲存 .pdf 檔案和 .jpg 檔案在 EBS 儲存中。
解析(中):
答案 A 是最具成本效益的解決方案。原因是 Amazon S3 是一個物件儲存服務，能夠儲存大量的檔案，並且具有高可用性和耐用性。使用 S3 PUT 事件來觸發 AWS Lambda 函數，可以自動化檔案轉換的過程，無需人工干預。另外，AWS Lambda 函數只會在檔案上傳時觸發，從而減少了計算資源的浪費。
選項 B 不正確是因為 DynamoDB 是一個 NoSQL 數據庫，主要用於儲存結構化的數據，而不是大型檔案。儲存大型檔案在 DynamoDB 中可能會導致效能問題和成本增加。
選項 C 和 D 不正確是因為使用 EC2 實例和 EBS 或 EFS 儲存需要更多的管理和維護工作，例如設定 Auto Scaling 群組、監控實例性能等。此外，使用 EC2 實例還需要支付實例的運行時間和儲存成本，從而增加了整體成本。相比之下，選項 A 的解決方案更加簡單和具成本效益。

題目(英):
A company has an application that generates a large number of les, each approximately 5 MB in size. The les are stored in Amazon S3.

contain critical business data that is not easy to reproduce. The les are frequently accessed in the rst 30 days of the object creation but are
rarely accessed after the rst 30 days.
Which storage solution is MOST cost-effective?
選項(英):
A. Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move les from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier 30 days from object creation. Delete the les 4 years
after object creation.
B. Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move les from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 30 days from

題目(中): 一家公司有一個應用程式，生成大量檔案，每個檔案約為 5 MB 大小。這些檔案儲存在 Amazon S3 中。公司政策要求檔案儲存 4 年後才能刪除。由於檔案包含重要的商業資料，且不容易重建，因此需要隨時可存取。檔案在創建後的前 30 天內經常被存取，但在創建後的 30 天後很少被存取。哪種儲存解決方案最具成本效益？
選項(中):
A. 建立 S3 儲存桶生命週期政策，將檔案從 S3 標準儲存移到 S3 Glacier 30 天後。檔案創建後 4 年刪除檔案。
B. 建立 S3 儲存桶生命週期政策，將檔案從 S3 標準儲存移到 S3 單區域不常存取 (S3 One Zone-IA) 30 天後。檔案創建後 4 年刪除檔案。
C. 建立 S3 儲存桶生命週期政策，將檔案從 S3 標準儲存移到 S3 標準不常存取 (S3 Standard-IA) 30 天後。檔案創建後 4 年刪除檔案。
D. 建立 S3 儲存桶生命週期政策，將檔案從 S3 標準儲存移到 S3 標準不常存取 (S3 Standard-IA) 30 天後。檔案創建後 4 年移到 S3 Glacier。
解析(中): 答案 C 是正確的，因為它能夠滿足公司的需求，並且具有成本效益。檔案在創建後的前 30 天內經常被存取，因此需要儲存在 S3 標準儲存中，以保證即時存取。30 天後，檔案很少被存取，因此可以將它們移到 S3 標準不常存取 (S3 Standard-IA) 中，以降低儲存成本。S3 Standard-IA 提供了比 S3 標準儲存更低的儲存成本，但仍然保證了即時存取。檔案創建後 4 年刪除檔案，滿足了公司的政策要求。選項 A 和 D 不是最具成本效益的，因為 S3 Glacier 的儲存成本雖然低，但存取速度較慢，可能不符合公司的即時存取需求。選項 B 不是最好的選擇，因為 S3 單區域不常存取 (S3 One Zone-IA) 的資料耐久性較低，可能不符合公司的資料保護需求。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company hosts an application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances. The application processes messages from an Amazon SQS queue, writes
to an Amazon RDS table, and deletes the message from the queue. Occasional duplicate records are found in the RDS table. The SQS queue
does not contain any duplicate messages.
What should a solutions architect do to ensure messages are being processed once only?
選項(英):
A. Use the CreateQueue API call to create a new queue.
B. Use the AddPermission API call to add appropriate permissions.
C. Use the ReceiveMessage API call to set an appropriate wait time.
D. Use the ChangeMessageVisibility API call to increase the visibility timeout.
解析(英):
To ensure that messages are processed only once, solutions architects should increase the visibility timeout using the ChangeMessageVisibility API call. This is because when an Amazon EC2 instance receives a message from an SQS queue, the message is marked "invisible" for a period of time so that the instance can process the message without it being reprocessed by other instances. If the instance is unable to complete processing the message within this time, the message will become visible again and may be processed repeatedly by other instances. By increasing the visibility timeout, you can ensure that the instance has enough time to process messages and avoid duplicate records.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Creating a new queue does not solve the problem of duplicate records.
B. Adding permissions does not affect the number of times the message is processed.
C. Setting the waiting time allows the instance to wait for a period of time before receiving the message, but it does not ensure that the message is processed only once. Only increasing the visibility timeout can ensure that the instance has enough time to process the message and avoid duplicate records.
題目(中): 一家公司在多個 Amazon EC2 實例上託管一個應用程式。該應用程式從 Amazon SQS 佇列處理訊息、寫入 Amazon RDS 表格，並從佇列中刪除訊息。偶爾會在 RDS 表格中找到重複的記錄。SQS 佇列中不包含任何重複的訊息。解決方案架構師應該做什麼來確保訊息只被處理一次？
選項(中):
A. 使用 CreateQueue API 呼叫建立一個新的佇列。
B. 使用 AddPermission API 呼叫添加適當的權限。
C. 使用 ReceiveMessage API 呼叫設定適當的等待時間。
D. 使用 ChangeMessageVisibility API 呼叫增加可見度超時時間。
解析(中):
為了確保訊息只被處理一次，解決方案架構師應該使用 ChangeMessageVisibility API 呼叫增加可見度超時時間。這是因為當 Amazon EC2 實例從 SQS 佇列接收到訊息後，訊息會被標記為「不可見」一段時間，以便實例能夠處理訊息而不被其他實例重複處理。如果實例在這段時間內無法完成訊息的處理，訊息將再次變為可見，並可能被其他實例重複處理。通過增加可見度超時時間，可以確保實例有足夠的時間來處理訊息，從而避免重複記錄的產生。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. 建立新的佇列並不能解決重複記錄的問題。
B. 添加權限並不能影響訊息的處理次數。
C. 設定等待時間可以讓實例等待一段時間後再接收訊息，但不能確保訊息只被處理一次。只有增加可見度超時時間才能確保實例有足夠的時間來處理訊息，從而避免重複記錄的產生。

題目(英):
A solutions architect is designing a new hybrid architecture to extend a company's on-premises infrastructure to AWS. The company requires a
highly available connection with consistent low latency to an AWS Region. The company needs to minimize costs and is willing to accept
slower trac if the primary connection fails.
What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Provision a VPN connection as a backup if the primary Direct Connect
connection fails.
B. Provision a VPN tunnel connection to a Region for private connectivity. Provision a second VPN tunnel for private connectivity and as a
backup if the primary VPN connection fails.
C. Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Provision a second Direct Connect connection to the same Region as a backup
if the primary Direct Connect connection fails.
D. Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Use the Direct Connect failover attribute from the AWS CLI to automatically
create a backup connection if the primary Direct Connect connection fails.
解析(英):
To meet the company's needs, solutions architects need to design a hybrid architecture that can provide high-availability connections and low-latency connections. Option A is correct because it provisions an AWS Direct Connect connection to a region to meet high availability and low latency needs. Provision a VPN connection as a backup to minimize costs if the primary Direct Connect connection fails. This solution met the company's needs because it provided a high-availability connection with low latency and the ability to automatically switch to a backup connection if the primary connection failed.

Option B is incorrect because it provisions two VPN tunnel connections, which does not meet the high availability and low latency requirements. Option C is incorrect because it provisions two Direct Connect connections, which is cost-prohibitive and unnecessary. Choice D is incorrect because it uses the Direct Connect failover property in the AWS CLI, which does not support automatic establishment of backup connections. Therefore, option A is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一位解決方案架構師正在設計一種新的混合架構，以將公司的內部基礎設施擴展到 AWS。公司需要與 AWS 區域之間建立高可用性連接，具有低延遲的連接。公司需要最小化成本，並願意在主要連接失敗時接受較慢的流量。解決方案架構師應該如何滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 預配一個 AWS Direct Connect 連接到一個區域。如果主要 Direct Connect 連接失敗，則預配一個 VPN 連接作為備份。
B. 預配一個 VPN 隧道連接到一個區域，以進行私人連接。預配另一個 VPN 隧道以進行私人連接和作為備份，如果主要 VPN 連接失敗。
C. 預配一個 AWS Direct Connect 連接到一個區域。如果主要 Direct Connect 連接失敗，則預配另一個 Direct Connect 連接到相同區域作為備份。
D. 預配一個 AWS Direct Connect 連接到一個區域。使用 AWS CLI 中的 Direct Connect 故障轉移屬性自動建立備份連接，如果主要 Direct Connect 連接失敗。
解析(中):
為了滿足公司的需求，解決方案架構師需要設計一個混合架構，能夠提供高可用性連接和低延遲的連接。選項 A 是正確的，因為它預配了一個 AWS Direct Connect 連接到一個區域，以滿足高可用性和低延遲的需求。如果主要 Direct Connect 連接失敗，則預配一個 VPN 連接作為備份，以最小化成本。這個解決方案能夠滿足公司的需求，因為它提供了高可用性連接和低延遲的連接，並且在主要連接失敗時能夠自動切換到備份連接。

選項 B 不正確，因為它預配了兩個 VPN 隧道連接，無法滿足高可用性和低延遲的需求。選項 C 不正確，因為它預配了兩個 Direct Connect 連接，成本過高且不必要。選項 D 不正確，因為它使用了 AWS CLI 中的 Direct Connect 故障轉移屬性，但這個屬性並不支援自動建立備份連接。因此，選項 A 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is running a business-critical web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The EC2 instances
are in an Auto Scaling group. The application uses an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database that is deployed in a single Availability Zone. The
company wants the application to be highly available with minimum downtime and minimum loss of data.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?
選項(英):
A. Place the EC2 instances in different AWS Regions. Use Amazon Route 53 health checks to redirect trac. Use Aurora PostgreSQL Cross-
Region Replication.
B. Congure the Auto Scaling group to use multiple Availability Zones. Congure the database as Multi-AZ. Congure an Amazon RDS
Proxy instance for the database.
C. Congure the Auto Scaling group to use one Availability Zone. Generate hourly snapshots of the database. Recover the database from
the snapshots in the event of a failure.
D. Congure the Auto Scaling group to use multiple AWS Regions. Write the data from the application to Amazon S3. Use S3 Event
Notications to launch an AWS Lambda function to write the data to the database.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B because this option meets the company's needs and requires minimal operational effort. Setting up an autoscaling group to use multiple availability zones ensures that your application can continue to run even if one availability zone fails. Setting the database to multiple availability zones can ensure high availability of the database and data security. Setting up an Amazon RDS Proxy instance can improve database connectivity and performance. This solution provides high availability, minimal downtime, and minimal data loss.

The other options are incorrect because:
Option A requires replicating the database across regions, which requires more operational effort and cost.
Option C uses a snapshot to restore the database, which may result in data loss and downtime.
Option D uses Amazon S3 and AWS Lambda functions to write to the database, which may cause data consistency and performance issues. Therefore, option B is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在 Amazon EC2 實例後面的應用程式負載平衡器上運行一個商業關鍵的網頁應用程式。這些 EC2 實例位於一個自動擴展群組中。該應用程式使用一個在單一可用區域中部署的 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 數據庫。該公司希望應用程式具有高可用性，同時具有最小的停機時間和最小的數據損失。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求，並且具有最少的操作努力？
選項(中):
A. 將 EC2 實例放在不同的 AWS 區域中。使用 Amazon Route 53 健康檢查來重定向流量。使用 Aurora PostgreSQL 跨區域複製。
B. 將自動擴展群組設定為使用多個可用區域。將數據庫設定為多可用區域。設定一個 Amazon RDS Proxy 實例來連接數據庫。
C. 將自動擴展群組設定為使用一個可用區域。每小時生成一次數據庫快照。在發生故障時從快照中恢復數據庫。
D. 將自動擴展群組設定為使用多個 AWS 區域。將應用程式的數據寫入 Amazon S3。使用 S3 事件通知來啟動 AWS Lambda 函數將數據寫入數據庫。
解析(中):
正確答案是 B，因為這個選項能夠滿足公司的需求，並且具有最少的操作努力。將自動擴展群組設定為使用多個可用區域，可以確保即使一個可用區域發生故障，應用程式仍然可以繼續運行。將數據庫設定為多可用區域，可以確保數據庫的高可用性和數據的安全性。設定一個 Amazon RDS Proxy 實例，可以改善數據庫的連接和效能。這個解決方案可以提供高可用性、最小的停機時間和最小的數據損失。

其他選項不正確，因為：
A 選項需要跨區域複製數據庫，這需要更多的操作努力和成本。
C 選項使用快照恢復數據庫，可能會導致數據損失和停機時間。
D 選項使用 Amazon S3 和 AWS Lambda 函數來寫入數據庫，可能會導致數據一致性和效能問題。因此，B 選項是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company's HTTP application is behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB). The NLB's target group is congured to use an Amazon EC2 Auto
Scaling group with multiple EC2 instances that run the web service.
The company notices that the NLB is not detecting HTTP errors for the application. These errors require a manual restart of the EC2 instances
that run the web service. The company needs to improve the application's availability without writing custom scripts or code.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Enable HTTP health checks on the NLB, supplying the URL of the company's application.
B. Add a cron job to the EC2 instances to check the local application's logs once each minute. If HTTP errors are detected. the application
will restart.
C. Replace the NLB with an Application Load Balancer. Enable HTTP health checks by supplying the URL of the company's application.
Congure an Auto Scaling action to replace unhealthy instances.
D. Create an Amazon Cloud Watch alarm that monitors the UnhealthyHostCount metric for the NLB. Congure an Auto Scaling action to
replace unhealthy instances when the alarm is in the ALARM state.
解析(英): The correct answer is C. This is because NLB does not support HTTP health checks and cannot detect HTTP errors in applications. Therefore, NLB needs to be replaced with an Application Load Balancer (ALB), which supports HTTP health checks. With HTTP health checks enabled, ALB can detect HTTP errors in your application and trigger automatic scaling actions to replace unhealthy instances. This improves the usability of your application without having to write custom scripts or code. Choice A is incorrect because NLB does not support HTTP health checks. Option B is incorrect because it requires writing custom scripts or code. Option D is incorrect because it requires writing custom scripts or code and does not directly trigger autoscaling actions. Only Option C meets the company's needs and improves the usability of the application without writing custom scripts or code.
題目(中): 一家公司的 HTTP 應用程式位於網路負載平衡器 (NLB) 後面。NLB 的目標群組設定為使用 Amazon EC2 自動擴展群組，該群組包含多個執行 Web 服務的 EC2 實例。公司注意到，NLB 未能偵測到應用程式的 HTTP 錯誤，這些錯誤需要手動重新啟動執行 Web 服務的 EC2 實例。公司需要在不撰寫自訂腳本或程式碼的情況下提高應用程式的可用性。解決方案架構師應該採取哪些措施來滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 啟用 NLB 的 HTTP 健康檢查，提供公司應用程式的 URL。
B. 將 cron 工作新增到 EC2 實例， 每分鐘檢查一次本地應用程式的記錄檔。如果偵測到 HTTP 錯誤，應用程式將重新啟動。
C. 將 NLB 替換為應用程式負載平衡器。啟用 HTTP 健康檢查，提供公司應用程式的 URL。設定自動擴展動作以替換不健康的實例。
D. 建立 Amazon CloudWatch 錨點，監視 NLB 的 UnhealthyHostCount 指標。設定自動擴展動作，以便當警報處於 ALARM 狀態時替換不健康的實例。
解析(中): 正確答案是 C。這是因為 NLB 不支援 HTTP 健康檢查，無法偵測到應用程式的 HTTP 錯誤。因此，需要將 NLB 替換為應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB)，它支援 HTTP 健康檢查。啟用 HTTP 健康檢查後，ALB 可以偵測到應用程式的 HTTP 錯誤，並觸發自動擴展動作以替換不健康的實例。這樣可以提高應用程式的可用性，而無需撰寫自訂腳本或程式碼。選項 A 不正確，因為 NLB 不支援 HTTP 健康檢查。選項 B 不正確，因為它需要撰寫自訂腳本或程式碼。選項 D 不正確，因為它需要撰寫自訂腳本或程式碼，並且無法直接觸發自動擴展動作。只有選項 C 可以滿足公司的需求，提高應用程式的可用性而無需撰寫自訂腳本或程式碼。

題目(英):
A company runs a shopping application that uses Amazon DynamoDB to store customer information. In case of data corruption, a solutions
architect needs to design a solution that meets a recovery point objective (RPO) of 15 minutes and a recovery time objective (RTO) of 1 hour.
What should the solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Congure DynamoDB global tables. For RPO recovery, point the application to a different AWS Region.
B. Congure DynamoDB point-in-time recovery. For RPO recovery, restore to the desired point in time.
C. Export the DynamoDB data to Amazon S3 Glacier on a daily basis. For RPO recovery, import the data from S3 Glacier to DynamoDB.
D. Schedule Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots for the DynamoDB table every 15 minutes. For RPO recovery, restore the
DynamoDB table by using the EBS snapshot.
解析(英): To meet the 15-minute recovery point objective (RPO) and 1-hour recovery time objective (RTO), solutions architects need to design a solution that can quickly recover data if it becomes corrupted. Option B is the correct answer because DynamoDB point-in-time recovery allows you to recover data to any point in time to meet the 15-minute RPO requirement. In addition, DynamoDB point-in-time recovery can also restore data in a short time to meet the 1-hour RTO requirement. The other options are incorrect because: Option A's global table does not meet RPO requirements, Option C's export to S3 Glacier is not suitable for quick data recovery, and Option D's EBS snapshot is not suitable for DynamoDB tables. Therefore, option B is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司運行一個購物應用程式，使用 Amazon DynamoDB 儲存客戶資訊。當發生資料損壞時，解決方案架構師需要設計一個解決方案，以滿足 15 分鐘的恢復點目標 (RPO) 和 1 小時的恢復時間目標 (RTO)。解決方案架構師應該推薦什麼來滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 設定 DynamoDB 全域表格。針對 RPO 恢復，將應用程式指向不同的 AWS 區域。
B. 設定 DynamoDB 點時恢復。針對 RPO 恢復，恢復到所需的時間點。
C. 將 DynamoDB 資料匯出到 Amazon S3 Glacier，每天進行一次。針對 RPO 恢復，從 S3 Glacier 匯入資料到 DynamoDB。
D. 安排 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 快照，每 15 分鐘為 DynamoDB 表格拍攝一次快照。針對 RPO 恢復，使用 EBS 快照恢復 DynamoDB 表格。
解析(中): 為了滿足 15 分鐘的恢復點目標 (RPO) 和 1 小時的恢復時間目標 (RTO)，解決方案架構師需要設計一個解決方案，可以在資料損壞時快速恢復資料。選項 B 是正確答案，因為 DynamoDB 點時恢復 (point-in-time recovery) 可以讓您恢復資料到任意時間點，滿足 15 分鐘的 RPO 需求。另外，DynamoDB 點時恢復也可以在短時間內恢復資料，滿足 1 小時的 RTO 需求。其他選項不正確，因為：選項 A 的全域表格無法滿足 RPO 需求，選項 C 的匯出到 S3 Glacier 並不適合快速恢復資料，選項 D 的 EBS 快照不適用於 DynamoDB 表格。因此，選項 B 是最佳解決方案。

題目(英):
A company runs a photo processing application that needs to frequently upload and download pictures from Amazon S3 buckets that are
located in the same AWS Region. A solutions architect has noticed an increased cost in data transfer fees and needs to implement a solution
to reduce these costs.
How can the solutions architect meet this requirement?
選項(英):
A. Deploy Amazon API Gateway into a public subnet and adjust the route table to route S3 calls through it.
B. Deploy a NAT gateway into a public subnet and attach an endpoint policy that allows access to the S3 buckets.
C. Deploy the application into a public subnet and allow it to route through an internet gateway to access the S3 buckets.
D. Deploy an S3 VPC gateway endpoint into the VPC and attach an endpoint policy that allows access to the S3 buckets.
解析(英):
To reduce data transfer costs, solutions architects need to find a way for applications to access S3 buckets directly without going through the Internet. Option D is the correct answer because the S3 VPC gateway endpoint allows instances in the VPC to directly access S3 buckets without going through the Internet. This reduces data transfer costs because the data transfer does not need to leave the AWS Region.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Deploying Amazon API Gateway into a public subnet does not directly reduce data transfer costs because API Gateway still requires Internet access to the S3 bucket.
B. NAT gateways are primarily used to allow instances in a private subnet to access the Internet and are not directly related to reducing data transfer costs.
C. Deploying the application into a public subnet and allowing it to access the S3 bucket through an Internet gateway will increase data transfer costs because data transfer needs to go through the Internet.

Therefore, Option D is the most appropriate solution, where the solution architect can deploy the S3 VPC gateway endpoint into the VPC and attach the endpoint policy to allow access to the S3 bucket, thereby reducing data transfer charges.
題目(中): 一家公司運行了一個照片處理應用程式，需要頻繁地從 Amazon S3 儲存桶上傳和下載圖片，這些儲存桶位於相同的 AWS 區域。一個解決方案架構師注意到資料傳輸費用增加，需要實施一個解決方案來降低這些費用。解決方案架構師如何滿足這個需求？
選項(中):
A. 將 Amazon API Gateway 部署到公用子網路中，並調整路由表以將 S3 呼叫路由通過它。
B. 將 NAT 閘道部署到公用子網路中，並附加端點政策以允許存取 S3 儲存桶。
C. 將應用程式部署到公用子網路中，並允許它通過網際網路閘道存取 S3 儲存桶。
D. 將 S3 VPC 閘道端點部署到 VPC 中，並附加端點政策以允許存取 S3 儲存桶。
解析(中):
為了降低資料傳輸費用，解決方案架構師需要找到一個方法，讓應用程式可以直接存取 S3 儲存桶，而不需要通過網際網路。選項 D 是正確答案，因為 S3 VPC 閘道端點允許 VPC 中的實例直接存取 S3 儲存桶，而不需要通過網際網路。這樣可以降低資料傳輸費用，因為資料傳輸不需要離開 AWS 區域。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. 將 Amazon API Gateway 部署到公用子網路中並不會直接降低資料傳輸費用，因為 API Gateway 仍然需要通過網際網路存取 S3 儲存桶。
B. NAT 閘道主要用於允許私有子網路中的實例存取網際網路，並不直接相關於降低資料傳輸費用。
C. 將應用程式部署到公用子網路中並允許它通過網際網路閘道存取 S3 儲存桶，反而會增加資料傳輸費用，因為資料傳輸需要通過網際網路。

因此，選項 D 是最合適的解決方案，解決方案架構師可以將 S3 VPC 閘道端點部署到 VPC 中，並附加端點政策以允許存取 S3 儲存桶，從而降低資料傳輸費用。

題目(英):
A company recently launched Linux-based application instances on Amazon EC2 in a private subnet and launched a Linux-based bastion host
on an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet of a VPC. A solutions architect needs to connect from the on-premises network, through the
company's internet connection, to the bastion host, and to the application servers. The solutions architect must make sure that the security
groups of all the EC2 instances will allow that access.
Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the application instances.
B. Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the internal IP range for the
company.
C. Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the external IP range for the
company.
D. Replace the current security group of the application instances with one that allows inbound SSH access from only the private IP
address of the bastion host.
E. Replace the current security group of the application instances with one that allows inbound SSH access from only the public IP address
of the bastion host.
解析(英): To meet the connectivity requirements, the solution architect needs to ensure that the security group settings allow connections to the application server from the internal network through the bastion host. Options C and D are the correct combination. Option C Replace the bastion host's security group with one that only allows incoming access from the company's external IP range, so that the bastion host can be connected to the bastion host via an Internet connection from the internal network. Option D Replace the application instance's security group with one that only allows incoming SSH access from the bastion host's private IP address, allowing connections to the application server from the bastion host. The other options are incorrect because option A restricts access to the bastion host, option B only allows incoming access from the company's internal IP range, and option E uses a public IP address to connect to the application instance, which may not be secure.
