D. 手動使用作業系統複製命令將資料推送到 EC2 實例。
E. 使用 AWS DataSync 來為內部 SFTP 伺服器建立一個合適的位置設定。
解析(中): 為了自動化將內部資料中心遷移到 AWS 的工作，解決方案架構師需要採取正確的步驟。正確答案是 AB。選項 A 是正確的，因為啟動 EC2 實例到與 EFS 檔案系統相同的可用區域可以確保資料傳輸的效率和可靠性。選項 B 也正確，因為安裝 AWS DataSync 代理程式可以讓資料從內部資料中心同步到 AWS。AWS DataSync 是一種資料同步工具，可以自動化資料傳輸的過程。其他選項不正確，因為選項 C 建立一個次要的 Amazon EBS 卷並不需要，選項 D 手動使用作業系統複製命令並不自動化，選項 E 使用 AWS DataSync 來建立一個合適的位置設定並不完全正確，因為需要安裝 AWS DataSync 代理程式來啟動同步過程。因此，選項 AB 是正確的答案。

題目(英):
A company has an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job that runs every day at the same time. The job processes XML data that is
in an Amazon S3 bucket. New data is added to the S3 bucket every day. A solutions architect notices that AWS Glue is processing all the data
during each run.
What should the solutions architect do to prevent AWS Glue from reprocessing old data?
選項(英):
A. Edit the job to use job bookmarks.
B. Edit the job to delete data after the data is processed.
C. Edit the job by setting the NumberOfWorkers eld to 1.
D. Use a FindMatches machine learning (ML) transform.
解析(英):
To prevent AWS Glue from reprocessing old material, Solutions Architects should edit jobs to use Job Bookmarks. Job bookmarks are an AWS Glue feature that allows a job to remember the location of the last data it processed so that it can only process new data the next time it is run. This can avoid repeated processing of old data and improve work efficiency.
The other options are incorrect because:
- Option B: Deleting data does not necessarily prevent AWS Glue from reprocessing old data, especially when new data is added to the S3 bucket.
- Option C: Setting the NumberOfWorkers field to 1 only affects the parallelism of the work, but does not prevent the duplication of old data.
- Option D: The FindMatches machine learning (ML) transformation is a feature for matching and merging profiles and has nothing to do with preventing reprocessing of old profiles.
Therefore, option A is the correct answer.
題目(中): 一家公司有一個 AWS Glue 的抽取、轉換和載入 (ETL) 工作，每天在同一時間運行。該工作處理 Amazon S3 儲存桶中的 XML 資料。每天都會將新資料添加到 S3 儲存桶中。一個解決方案架構師注意到，AWS Glue 每次運行都會處理所有資料。
選項(中):
A. 編輯工作以使用工作書籤。
B. 編輯工作以在資料處理後刪除資料。
C. 編輯工作並將 NumberOfWorkers 欄位設為 1。
D. 使用 FindMatches 機器學習 (ML) 轉換。
解析(中):
為了防止 AWS Glue 重複處理舊資料，解決方案架構師應該編輯工作以使用工作書籤 (Job Bookmarks)。工作書籤是一個 AWS Glue 的功能，允許工作記住上一次處理的資料位置，從而在下一次運行時只處理新資料。這樣可以避免重複處理舊資料，提高工作的效率。
其他選項不正確，因為：
- 選項 B：刪除資料並不一定能夠防止 AWS Glue 重複處理舊資料，尤其是當新資料被添加到 S3 儲存桶中時。
- 選項 C：設置 NumberOfWorkers 欄位為 1 只能夠影響工作的並行度，不能夠防止重複處理舊資料。
- 選項 D：FindMatches 機器學習 (ML) 轉換是一個用於資料匹配和合併的功能，與防止重複處理舊資料無關。
因此，選項 A 是正確答案。

題目(英):
A solutions architect must design a highly available infrastructure for a website. The website is powered by Windows web servers that run on
Amazon EC2 instances. The solutions architect must implement a solution that can mitigate a large-scale DDoS attack that originates from
thousands of IP addresses. Downtime is not acceptable for the website.
Which actions should the solutions architect take to protect the website from such an attack? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Use AWS Shield Advanced to stop the DDoS attack.
B. Congure Amazon GuardDuty to automatically block the attackers.
C. Congure the website to use Amazon CloudFront for both static and dynamic content.
D. Use an AWS Lambda function to automatically add attacker IP addresses to VPC network ACLs.
E. Use EC2 Spot Instances in an Auto Scaling group with a target tracking scaling policy that is set to 80% CPU utilization.
解析(英):
To protect a website from a large-scale DDoS attack, solutions architects should take two actions: use AWS Shield Advanced to stop the DDoS attack (option A), and set up the website to use Amazon CloudFront to serve static and dynamic content (option C). AWS Shield Advanced is a comprehensive DDoS protection service that automatically detects and mitigates large-scale DDoS attacks. Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) service that helps distribute traffic, reduce load on your website, and provide an additional layer of security. 

Option B (Set up Amazon GuardDuty to automatically block attackers) is incorrect because Amazon GuardDuty is a threat detection service designed primarily to detect and warn of potential security threats, rather than proactively defending against DDoS attacks. Option D (using an AWS Lambda function to automatically add the attacker IP address to the VPC network ACL) is also incorrect because this approach may not respond quickly and effectively to a large-scale DDoS attack. Option E (Using EC2 Spot instances in an Auto Scaling group with Target Tracking scaling policy, set to 80% CPU usage) is not directly related to defense against DDoS attacks. Therefore, the correct answer is AC.
題目(中): 一位解決方案架構師必須設計一個高可用性的基礎設施，供一個網站使用。該網站由在 Amazon EC2 執行個體上運行的 Windows 網頁伺服器提供動力。解決方案架構師必須實施一個解決方案，以減輕來自數千個 IP 地址的大規模 DDoS 攻擊。網站不允許停機。
選項(中):
A. 使用 AWS Shield Advanced 來停止 DDoS 攻擊。
B. 設定 Amazon GuardDuty 自動封鎖攻擊者。
C. 設定網站使用 Amazon CloudFront 來提供靜態和動態內容。
D. 使用 AWS Lambda 函數自動將攻擊者 IP 地址新增到 VPC 網路 ACL 中。
E. 使用 EC2 Spot 執行個體在具有目標追蹤擴展政策的 Auto Scaling 群組中，設定為 80% CPU 使用率。
解析(中):
為了保護網站免受大規模 DDoS 攻擊的影響，解決方案架構師應該採取兩個行動：使用 AWS Shield Advanced 來停止 DDoS 攻擊（選項 A），以及設定網站使用 Amazon CloudFront 來提供靜態和動態內容（選項 C）。AWS Shield Advanced 是一項全面的 DDoS 保護服務，可以自動偵測和緩解大規模 DDoS 攻擊。Amazon CloudFront 是一項內容傳遞網路 (CDN) 服務，可以幫助分散流量，減少網站的負載，並提供額外的安全層。 

選項 B（設定 Amazon GuardDuty 自動封鎖攻擊者）不正確，因為 Amazon GuardDuty 是一項威脅偵測服務，主要用於偵測和警告潛在的安全威脅，而不是用於主動防禦 DDoS 攻擊。選項 D（使用 AWS Lambda 函數自動將攻擊者 IP 地址新增到 VPC 網路 ACL 中）也不正確，因為這種方法可能無法快速有效地應對大規模 DDoS 攻擊。選項 E（使用 EC2 Spot 執行個體在具有目標追蹤擴展政策的 Auto Scaling 群組中，設定為 80% CPU 使用率）與 DDoS 攻擊的防禦無直接關係。因此，正確答案是 AC。

題目(英):
A company is preparing to deploy a new serverless workload. A solutions architect must use the principle of least privilege to congure
permissions that will be used to run an AWS Lambda function. An Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule will invoke the
function.
Which solution meets these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Add an execution role to the function with lambda:InvokeFunction as the action and * as the principal.
B. Add an execution role to the function with lambda:InvokeFunction as the action and Service: lambda.amazonaws.com as the principal.
C. Add a resource-based policy to the function with lambda:* as the action and Service: events.amazonaws.com as the principal.
D. Add a resource-based policy to the function with lambda:InvokeFunction as the action and Service: events.amazonaws.com as the
principal.
解析(英): According to the topic description, you need to use the principle of least privilege to set permissions for AWS Lambda functions. This means we need to grant the minimum permissions to the function in order for it to function properly. The Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule will call this function, so we need to grant EventBridge permission to call the function. Option D is correct because it adds the resource-based policy to the function, using lambda:InvokeFunction as the action and Service: events.amazonaws.com as the body. This means that only the EventBridge service can call this function, and only using the InvokeFunction action. Other options are incorrect because they grant too much permission or the wrong principal. Option A gives Everyone (*) permission to call the function, Option B gives the Lambda service permission to call the function, but this is not required. Option C grants the EventBridge service permissions on all actions (lambda:*) of the function, but this exceeds the requirements of the principle of least privilege. Therefore, option D is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司正在準備部署新的無伺服器工作負載。一個解決方案架構師必須使用最小權限原則來設定將用於運行 AWS Lambda 函數的權限。一個 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 規則將會呼叫這個函數。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將執行角色添加到函數中，使用 lambda:InvokeFunction 作為動作和 * 作為主體。
B. 將執行角色添加到函數中，使用 lambda:InvokeFunction 作為動作和 Service: lambda.amazonaws.com 作為主體。
C. 將基於資源的政策添加到函數中，使用 lambda:* 作為動作和 Service: events.amazonaws.com 作為主體。
D. 將基於資源的政策添加到函數中，使用 lambda:InvokeFunction 作為動作和 Service: events.amazonaws.com 作為主體。
解析(中): 根據題目描述，需要使用最小權限原則來設定 AWS Lambda 函數的權限。這意味著我們需要授予最少的權限給函數，以便它能夠正常運行。Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 規則將會呼叫這個函數，因此我們需要授予 EventBridge 對函數的呼叫權限。選項 D 是正確的，因為它將基於資源的政策添加到函數中，使用 lambda:InvokeFunction 作為動作和 Service: events.amazonaws.com 作為主體。這意味著只有 EventBridge 服務可以呼叫這個函數，且只能使用 InvokeFunction 動作。其他選項不正確，因為它們授予了過多的權限或錯誤的主體。選項 A 授予所有人（*）呼叫函數的權限，選項 B 授予 Lambda 服務呼叫函數的權限，但這不是必要的。選項 C 授予 EventBridge 服務對函數的所有動作（lambda:*）的權限，但這超出了最小權限原則的要求。因此，選項 D 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is preparing to store condential data in Amazon S3. For compliance reasons, the data must be encrypted at rest. Encryption key
usage must be logged for auditing purposes. Keys must be rotated every year.
Which solution meets these requirements and is the MOST operationally ecient?
選項(英):
A. Server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C)
B. Server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)
C. Server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) with manual rotation
D. Server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) with automatic rotation
解析(英):
The answer is D, because using AWS KMS keys for server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) with automatic rotation meets all requirements. First, SSE-KMS provides encryption at rest, ensuring data security. Secondly, AWS KMS provides the key usage recording function, which can meet the needs of audit purposes. Finally, AWS KMS supports automatic key rotation and automatically rotates keys once a year, reducing the risk and workload of manual operations.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Server-side encryption (SSE-C) using customer-provided keys requires customers to manage the keys themselves, including rotating and recording usage, which increases customer workload and risk.
B. Using keys managed by Amazon S3 for server-side encryption (SSE-S3) does not provide the key usage record function and cannot meet the needs of audit purposes.
C. Using AWS KMS keys for server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) and manually rotating keys requires manual operation, increasing workload and risk, and key rotation may be forgotten or delayed. Therefore, option D is the optimal solution.
題目(中): 一家公司正準備在 Amazon S3 中存儲機密數據。出於合規性原因，數據必須在靜止時加密。加密金鑰的使用情況必須記錄以供審計目的。金鑰必須每年輪換一次。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些要求並且在運營效率上最優？
選項(中):
A. 使用客戶提供的金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-C)
B. 使用 Amazon S3 管理的金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-S3)
C. 使用 AWS KMS 金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-KMS) 並手動輪換
D. 使用 AWS KMS 金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-KMS) 並自動輪換
解析(中):
答案是 D，因為使用 AWS KMS 金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-KMS) 並自動輪換能夠滿足所有的要求。首先，SSE-KMS 提供了在靜止時的加密功能，確保數據的安全性。其次，AWS KMS 提供了金鑰的使用記錄功能，能夠滿足審計目的的需求。最後，AWS KMS 支持自動輪換金鑰，每年自動輪換一次金鑰，減少了人工操作的風險和工作量。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. 使用客戶提供的金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-C) 需要客戶自己管理金鑰，包括輪換和記錄使用情況，這增加了客戶的工作量和風險。
B. 使用 Amazon S3 管理的金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-S3) 不提供金鑰的使用記錄功能，無法滿足審計目的的需求。
C. 使用 AWS KMS 金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-KMS) 並手動輪換需要人工操作輪換金鑰，增加了工作量和風險，且可能會忘記或延遲輪換金鑰。因此，選項 D 是最優的解決方案。

題目(英):
A bicycle sharing company is developing a multi-tier architecture to track the location of its bicycles during peak operating hours. The
company wants to use these data points in its existing analytics platform. A solutions architect must determine the most viable multi-tier
option to support this architecture. The data points must be accessible from the REST API.

C. Use Amazon QuickSight with Amazon Redshift.

題目(中): 一家自行車共享公司正在開發一個多層架構，以追蹤其自行車在高峰運營時間的位置。該公司希望在其現有的分析平台中使用這些數據點。一個解決方案架構師必須確定最可行的多層選項來支持此架構。數據點必須可以從 REST API 存取。哪個動作滿足存儲和检索位置數據的要求？

A. 使用 Amazon Athena 與 Amazon S3。

題目(英):
A company has an automobile sales website that stores its listings in a database on Amazon RDS. When an automobile is sold, the listing
needs to be removed from the website and the data must be sent to multiple target systems.
Which design should a solutions architect recommend?
選項(英):
A. Create an AWS Lambda function triggered when the database on Amazon RDS is updated to send the information to an Amazon Simple
Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue for the targets to consume.
B. Create an AWS Lambda function triggered when the database on Amazon RDS is updated to send the information to an Amazon Simple
Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue for the targets to consume.
C. Subscribe to an RDS event notication and send an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue fanned out to multiple Amazon
Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topics. Use AWS Lambda functions to update the targets.
D. Subscribe to an RDS event notication and send an Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic fanned out to multiple
Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Use AWS Lambda functions to update the targets.
解析(英):
The correct answer is A because this design is the simplest and most effective. When the Amazon RDS database is updated, an AWS Lambda function is triggered to transfer the data to an Amazon SQS queue, where the target system can then consume the data from the queue. This design can ensure the reliability and sequence of data transmission.

Option B is incorrect because the FIFO queue only guarantees the order of the data, but does not guarantee the reliability of the data. If the target system needs to ensure the reliability of the data, other mechanisms will need to be used.

Options C and D are incorrect because they both use a combination of Amazon SNS topics and AWS Lambda functions, which adds complexity and cost to the system. Additionally, Amazon SNS topics are not suitable for transmitting large amounts of data and may result in delays or loss of data. Therefore, option A is the best design choice.
題目(中): 一家公司有一個汽車銷售網站，該網站將其清單儲存在 Amazon RDS 的資料庫中。當一輛汽車被賣出時，清單需要從網站中刪除，並且資料必須傳送到多個目標系統。解決方案架構師應該推薦哪種設計？
選項(中):
A. 建立一個 AWS Lambda 函數，當 Amazon RDS 的資料庫更新時觸發，將資料傳送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列中，以便目標系統消耗。
B. 建立一個 AWS Lambda 函數，當 Amazon RDS 的資料庫更新時觸發，將資料傳送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 佇列中，以便目標系統消耗。
C. 訂閱 RDS 事件通知，並將 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列分發到多個 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題。使用 AWS Lambda 函數更新目標系統。
D. 訂閱 RDS 事件通知，並將 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題分發到多個 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列中。使用 AWS Lambda 函數更新目標系統。
解析(中):
正確答案是 A，因為這種設計最簡單且有效。當 Amazon RDS 的資料庫更新時，觸發 AWS Lambda 函數將資料傳送到 Amazon SQS 佇列中，然後目標系統可以從佇列中消耗資料。這種設計可以確保資料傳送的可靠性和順序性。

選項 B 不正確，因為 FIFO 佇列只保證資料的順序性，但不保證資料的可靠性。如果目標系統需要確保資料的可靠性，則需要使用其他機制。

選項 C 和 D 不正確，因為它們都使用了 Amazon SNS 主題和 AWS Lambda 函數的組合，這增加了系統的複雜性和成本。另外，Amazon SNS 主題不適合用於傳送大量資料，且可能會導致資料延遲或遺失。因此，選項 A 是最好的設計選擇。

題目(英):
A company needs to store data in Amazon S3 and must prevent the data from being changed. The company wants new objects that are
uploaded to Amazon S3 to remain unchangeable for a nonspecic amount of time until the company decides to modify the objects. Only
specic users in the company's AWS account can have the ability 10 delete the objects.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create an S3 Glacier vault. Apply a write-once, read-many (WORM) vault lock policy to the objects.
B. Create an S3 bucket with S3 Object Lock enabled. Enable versioning. Set a retention period of 100 years. Use governance mode as the
S3 bucket’s default retention mode for new objects.
C. Create an S3 bucket. Use AWS CloudTrail to track any S3 API events that modify the objects. Upon notication, restore the modied

permission to the IAM policies of users who need to delete the objects.
解析(英): The correct answer is D. Because the company needs to prevent data from being modified, and only specific users can delete objects. Option D creates an S3 bucket with S3 object locking enabled, enables versioning, and adds a legal hold to the object. This ensures that the object remains unmodifiable for an unspecified amount of time. At the same time, add the s3:PutObjectLegalHold permission to the IAM policy of the user who needs to delete the object to control who can delete the object. Option A is incorrect because the S3 Glacier repository locking policy does not apply to S3 buckets. Choice B is incorrect because setting the retention period to 100 years does not mean that the object will remain unmodifiable. Choice C is incorrect because tracking modification events using AWS CloudTrail does not prevent the object from being modified. Only option D satisfies all of the company's needs.
題目(中): 一家公司需要在 Amazon S3 中存儲數據，並且必須防止數據被修改。該公司希望新上傳到 Amazon S3 的物件在未指定的時間內保持不可修改，直到公司決定修改物件。只有公司 AWS 賬戶中的特定用戶才能具有刪除物件的能力。解決方案架構師應該採取哪些措施來滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 創建 S3 Glacier 儲存庫。將寫入一次、讀取多次 (WORM) 儲存庫鎖定策略應用於物件。
B. 創建啟用 S3 物件鎖定的 S3 儲存桶。啟用版本控制。將保留期設置為 100 年。使用治理模式作為新物件的默認保留模式。
C. 創建 S3 儲存桶。使用 AWS CloudTrail 跟蹤任何修改物件的 S3 API 事件。在收到通知後，從公司的任何備份版本中恢復修改的物件。
D. 創建啟用 S3 物件鎖定的 S3 儲存桶。啟用版本控制。為物件添加法律保留。將 s3:PutObjectLegalHold 權限添加到需要刪除物件的用戶的 IAM 政策中。
解析(中): 正確答案是 D。因為公司需要防止數據被修改，並且只有特定用戶才能刪除物件。選項 D 創建了啟用 S3 物件鎖定的 S3 儲存桶，啟用版本控制，並為物件添加法律保留。這樣可以確保物件在未指定的時間內保持不可修改。同時，將 s3:PutObjectLegalHold 權限添加到需要刪除物件的用戶的 IAM 政策中，可以控制誰可以刪除物件。選項 A 不正確，因為 S3 Glacier 儲存庫鎖定策略不適用於 S3 儲存桶。選項 B 不正確，因為設置保留期為 100 年並不意味著物件將保持不可修改。選項 C 不正確，因為使用 AWS CloudTrail 跟蹤修改事件並不會防止物件被修改。只有選項 D 能夠滿足公司的所有需求。

題目(英):
A social media company allows users to upload images to its website. The website runs on Amazon EC2 instances. During upload requests,
the website resizes the images to a standard size and stores the resized images in Amazon S3. Users are experiencing slow upload requests
to the website.
The company needs to reduce coupling within the application and improve website performance. A solutions architect must design the most
operationally ecient process for image uploads.
Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Congure the application to upload images to S3 Glacier.
B. Congure the web server to upload the original images to Amazon S3.
C. Congure the application to upload images directly from each user's browser to Amazon S3 through the use of a presigned URL
D. Congure S3 Event Notications to invoke an AWS Lambda function when an image is uploaded. Use the function to resize the image.
E. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function on a schedule to resize
uploaded images.
解析(英):
To reduce coupling within the application and improve website performance, the combined actions that solutions architects should take are B and D. Option B, configuring the web server to upload the original images to Amazon S3, can reduce the load on the EC2 instances and allow them to focus on other tasks. Option D, configure S3 event notifications to invoke an AWS Lambda function when an image is uploaded, and use the function to reshape the image, offloading the work of reshaping the image from the EC2 instance, allowing them to focus on other tasks. This combination improves the performance and scalability of your website.

Choice A is incorrect because S3 Glacier is a long-term storage service and is not suitable for image uploads and reshapes. Choice C is incorrect because while uploading directly to S3 reduces coupling, it does not solve the problem of image reshaping. Choice E is incorrect because scheduling calls to an AWS Lambda function to reshape the uploaded image can cause delays and inefficiencies. Therefore, the correct answer is BD.
題目(中): 一家社交媒體公司允許用戶將圖片上傳到其網站。網站運行在 Amazon EC2 實例上。在上傳請求期間，網站將圖片重塑為標準大小並將重塑的圖片存儲在 Amazon S3 中。用戶正在經歷緩慢的上傳請求到網站。該公司需要減少應用程序內的耦合並提高網站性能。一個解決方案架構師必須設計最操作高效的圖片上傳過程。哪種組合的操作應該解決方案架構師採取以滿足這些需求？（選擇兩個。）
選項(中):
A. 配置應用程序將圖片上傳到 S3 Glacier。
B. 配置網頁伺服器將原始圖片上傳到 Amazon S3。
C. 配置應用程序直接從每個用戶的瀏覽器將圖片上傳到 Amazon S3，使用預簽名 URL。
D. 配置 S3 事件通知以在上傳圖片時調用 AWS Lambda 函數。使用函數重塑圖片。
E. 創建 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 規則以在排程上調用 AWS Lambda 函數來重塑上傳的圖片。
解析(中):
為了減少應用程序內的耦合並提高網站性能，解決方案架構師應該採取的組合操作是 B 和 D。選項 B，配置網頁伺服器將原始圖片上傳到 Amazon S3，可以減少 EC2 實例的負擔，讓它們專注於其他任務。選項 D，配置 S3 事件通知以在上傳圖片時調用 AWS Lambda 函數，使用函數重塑圖片，可以將圖片重塑的工作從 EC2 實例中卸載，讓它們專注於其他任務。這種組合可以提高網站的性能和可擴展性。

選項 A 不正確，因為 S3 Glacier 是一個長期存儲服務，不適合用於圖片上傳和重塑。選項 C 不正確，因為雖然直接上傳到 S3 可以減少耦合，但它不會解決圖片重塑的問題。選項 E 不正確，因為排程調用 AWS Lambda 函數來重塑上傳的圖片可能會導致延遲和效率低下。因此，正確答案是 BD。

題目(英):
A company recently migrated a message processing system to AWS. The system receives messages into an ActiveMQ queue running on an
Amazon EC2 instance. Messages are processed by a consumer application running on Amazon EC2. The consumer application processes the
messages and writes results to a MySQL database running on Amazon EC2. The company wants this application to be highly available with
low operational complexity.
Which architecture offers the HIGHEST availability?
選項(英):
A. Add a second ActiveMQ server to another Availability Zone. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone.
Replicate the MySQL database to another Availability Zone.
B. Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers congured across two Availability Zones. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in
another Availability Zone. Replicate the MySQL database to another Availability Zone.
C. Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers congured across two Availability Zones. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in
another Availability Zone. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with Multi-AZ enabled.
D. Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers congured across two Availability Zones. Add an Auto Scaling group for the consumer EC2
instances across two Availability Zones. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with Multi-AZ enabled.
解析(英): The answer is D because it provides the highest availability and the lowest operational complexity. Using Amazon MQ's active/standby broker configuration ensures high availability of message queues. Auto-scaling groups can dynamically adjust the number of consumer EC2 instances based on demand, ensuring high availability and efficiency of message processing. At the same time, using the multi-availability zone feature of Amazon RDS for MySQL ensures high availability and durability of the database. This architecture provides high availability, low operational complexity, and efficient message processing. The other options are incorrect because they do not provide the same usability and efficiency. For example, Option A simply adds a second ActiveMQ server and consumer EC2 instance, but does not provide the features of autoscaling and multiple Availability Zones. Options B and C do not provide the function of automatically expanding the group, which may result in reduced efficiency and availability of message processing.
題目(中): 一家公司最近將一個消息處理系統遷移到 AWS。該系統將消息接收到在 Amazon EC2 實例上運行的 ActiveMQ 佇列中。消息由在 Amazon EC2 上運行的消費者應用程序處理。消費者應用程序處理消息並將結果寫入在 Amazon EC2 上運行的 MySQL 數據庫中。該公司希望此應用程序具有高可用性和低運營複雜性。哪種架構提供最高的可用性？
選項(中):
A. 在另一個可用區域添加第二個 ActiveMQ 伺服器。在另一個可用區域添加額外的消費者 EC2 實例。將 MySQL 數據庫複製到另一個可用區域。
B. 使用跨兩個可用區域配置的主動/備用代理的 Amazon MQ。在另一個可用區域添加額外的消費者 EC2 實例。將 MySQL 數據庫複製到另一個可用區域。
C. 使用跨兩個可用區域配置的主動/備用代理的 Amazon MQ。在另一個可用區域添加額外的消費者 EC2 實例。使用啟用多可用區域的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。
D. 使用跨兩個可用區域配置的主動/備用代理的 Amazon MQ。為消費者 EC2 實例跨兩個可用區域添加自動擴展組。使用啟用多可用區域的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。
解析(中): 答案是 D，因為它提供了最高的可用性和最低的運營複雜性。使用 Amazon MQ 的主動/備用代理配置可以確保消息佇列的高可用性。自動擴展組可以根據需求動態調整消費者 EC2 實例的數量，確保消息處理的高可用性和效率。同時，使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL 的多可用區域功能可以確保數據庫的高可用性和耐用性。這種架構可以提供高可用性、低運營複雜性和高效的消息處理能力。其他選項不正確，因為它們沒有提供相同的可用性和效率。例如，選項 A 只是添加了第二個 ActiveMQ 伺服器和消費者 EC2 實例，但沒有提供自動擴展和多可用區域的功能。選項 B 和 C 沒有提供自動擴展組的功能，可能導致消息處理的效率和可用性降低。

題目(英):

題目(中): 一家公司在一組內部伺服器上託管一個容器化的網頁應用程式，該應用程式處理傳入的請求。請求的數量正在迅速增長，內部伺服器無法處理增加的請求數量。該公司希望將應用程式遷移到 AWS，同時盡量減少程式碼變更和開發工作。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求，並且具有最少的運營負擔？

題目(中): 一家公司使用 50 TB 的數據進行報告。該公司希望將這些數據從內部部署遷移到 AWS。公司的數據中心有一個自訂應用程式，每週運行一次數據轉換工作。該公司計劃在數據轉移完成之前暫停應用程式，並需要盡快開始轉移過程。數據中心沒有可用的網路頻寬來處理額外的工作負載。解決方案架構師必須轉移數據，並必須配置轉換工作以繼續在 AWS 雲端運行。哪種解決方案能夠以最少的運營負擔滿足這些需求？

題目(英):

題目(中): 一家公司創建了一個圖片分析應用程式，允許用戶上傳照片並為其圖片添加相框。用戶上傳圖片和元資料以指示要添加到圖片的相框。應用程式使用單個 Amazon EC2 實例和 Amazon DynamoDB 來儲存元資料。由於應用程式越來越受歡迎，使用者數量不斷增加，公司預計同時使用者數量將根據時間和星期幾有顯著變化。公司必須確保應用程式能夠擴展以滿足不斷增長的用戶需求。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？

Choice A is incorrect because the NAT gateway is used to allow instances in a private subnet to access the Internet, not for private routing to access Amazon S3.

題目(中): 一家醫療紀錄公司正在Amazon EC2實例上託管一個應用程式。該應用程式處理儲存在Amazon S3上的客戶資料檔案。EC2實例位於公有子網路中。EC2實例通過網際網路存取Amazon S3，但它們不需要任何其他網路存取。有一個新的需求，要求檔案傳輸的網路流量採取私有路由，不要通過網際網路傳送。解決方案架構師應該推薦哪種網路架構變更，以滿足這個需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立一個NAT閘道。設定公有子網路的路由表，將流量發送到Amazon S3通過NAT閘道。
B. 設定EC2實例的安全群組，限制出站流量，僅允許流量發送到S3的前綴列表。
C. 將EC2實例移到私有子網路。為Amazon S3建立一個VPC端點，並將端點連結到私有子網路的路由表。
D. 從VPC中移除網際網路閘道。設定AWS Direct Connect連線，並將流量路由到Amazon S3通過Direct Connect連線。
解析(中):
為了滿足檔案傳輸的網路流量採取私有路由，不要通過網際網路傳送的需求，正確的選擇是C。這是因為將EC2實例移到私有子網路，並為Amazon S3建立一個VPC端點，可以讓EC2實例通過私有路由存取Amazon S3，避免通過網際網路傳送流量。VPC端點是一個虛擬網路介面，允許私有子網路中的EC2實例存取Amazon S3，而不需要通過網際網路。

選項A不正確，因為NAT閘道是用於允許私有子網路中的實例存取網際網路，而不是用於私有路由存取Amazon S3。

選項B不正確，因為設定安全群組限制出站流量只能發送到S3的前綴列表，不能滿足私有路由存取Amazon S3的需求。

選項D不正確，因為移除網際網路閘道和設定AWS Direct Connect連線，不能直接滿足私有路由存取Amazon S3的需求，且這種設定可能會影響其他網路流量的傳送。因此，選擇C是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):

題目(中): 一家公司使用一套流行的內容管理系統（CMS）來管理其企業網站。然而，所需的補丁和維護工作量很大。該公司正在重新設計其網站，並希望找到一個新的解決方案。網站每年將更新四次，並且不需要有任何動態內容。解決方案必須提供高可擴展性和增強的安全性。哪種組合的變化可以滿足這些需求，並且具有最少的運營負擔？（選擇兩個。）

題目(英):

A. Congure a CloudWatch Logs subscription to stream the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).
B. Create an AWS Lambda function. Use the log group to invoke the function to write the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon

題目(英):

B. Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
C. Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service)

題目(英):
A company has implemented a self-managed DNS solution on three Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in the us-
west-2 Region. Most of the company's users are located in the United States and Europe. The company wants to improve the performance and
availability of the solution. The company launches and congures three EC2 instances in the eu-west-1 Region and adds the EC2 instances as
targets for a new NLB.
Which solution can the company use to route trac to all the EC2 instances?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the two NLBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront
distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin.
B. Create a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Create endpoint groups in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Add the two NLBs as
endpoints for the endpoint groups.
C. Attach Elastic IP addresses to the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of
the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution's origin.
D. Replace the two NLBs with two Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Create an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to route requests
to one of the two ALBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B. AWS Global Accelerator is a traffic management service that can improve application availability and performance by routing traffic to multiple endpoint groups. In this case, the company could set up a standard accelerator, establish endpoint groups at us-west-2 and eu-west-1, and use both NLBs as endpoints for the endpoint groups. This way, traffic can be routed to all EC2 instances, improving the performance and availability of the solution.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Using Amazon Route 53's geo-location routing policy with an Amazon CloudFront distribution can improve performance, but is not suitable for this scenario because it requires routing traffic to one of the two NLBs instead of all EC2 instances.
C. Attaching an Elastic IP address to an EC2 instance and using Amazon Route 53's geolocation routing policy can route traffic to individual EC2 instances, but is not suitable for this scenario because it requires routing traffic to all EC2 instances.
D. Replacing NLBs with Application Load Balancers (ALBs) and using Amazon Route 53's deferred routing policy can improve performance, but is not suitable for this scenario because it requires routing traffic to one of the two ALBs instead of all EC2 instances.
題目(中): 一家公司在 us-west-2 區域的三個 Amazon EC2 實例後面實現了一個自管理的 DNS 解決方案，並使用 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。大部分公司的用戶位於美國和歐洲。公司希望改善解決方案的性能和可用性。公司在 eu-west-1 區域啟動和配置三個 EC2 實例，並將這些 EC2 實例作為新的 NLB 的目標。哪種解決方案可以讓公司將流量路由到所有 EC2 實例？
選項(中):

B. 建立 AWS Global Accelerator 的標準加速器。在 us-west-2 和 eu-west-1 建立端點群組。將兩個 NLB 作為端點群組的端點。
C. 將彈性 IP 地址附加到六個 EC2 實例。建立 Amazon Route 53的地理位置路由策略，以將請求路由到六個 EC2 實例之一。建立 Amazon CloudFront 分佈。使用 Route 53 記錄作為分佈的原始來源。
D. 用兩個 Application Load Balancers (ALBs) 取代兩個 NLB。建立 Amazon Route 53 的延遲路由策略，以將請求路由到兩個 ALB 之一。建立 Amazon CloudFront 分佈。使用 Route 53 記錄作為分佈的原始來源。
解析(中):
正確答案是 B。AWS Global Accelerator 是一個流量管理服務，可以將流量路由到多個端點群組，從而提高應用程式的可用性和性能。在這種情況下，公司可以建立一個標準加速器，在 us-west-2 和 eu-west-1 建立端點群組，並將兩個 NLB 作為端點群組的端點。這樣，流量就可以路由到所有 EC2 實例，從而提高解決方案的性能和可用性。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. 使用 Amazon Route 53的地理位置路由策略和 Amazon CloudFront 分佈可以提高性能，但不適合這種情況，因為它需要將流量路由到兩個 NLB 之一，而不是所有 EC2 實例。
C. 將彈性 IP 地址附加到 EC2 實例並使用 Amazon Route 53的地理位置路由策略可以路由流量到個別的 EC2 實例，但不適合這種情況，因為它需要將流量路由到所有 EC2 實例。
D. 用 Application Load Balancers (ALBs) 取代 NLB 並使用 Amazon Route 53 的延遲路由策略可以提高性能，但不適合這種情況，因為它需要將流量路由到兩個 ALB 之一，而不是所有 EC2 實例。

題目(英):
A company is running an online transaction processing (OLTP) workload on AWS. This workload uses an unencrypted Amazon RDS DB instance
in a Multi-AZ deployment. Daily database snapshots are taken from this instance.
What should a solutions architect do to ensure the database and snapshots are always encrypted moving forward?
選項(英):
A. Encrypt a copy of the latest DB snapshot. Replace existing DB instance by restoring the encrypted snapshot.
B. Create a new encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and copy the snapshots to it. Enable encryption on the DB
instance.
C. Copy the snapshots and enable encryption using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) Restore encrypted snapshot to an existing
DB instance.
D. Copy the snapshots to an Amazon S3 bucket that is encrypted using server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS
KMS) managed keys (SSE-KMS).
解析(英): The answer is A because this is the most straightforward and efficient way to ensure that your database and snapshots are always encrypted going forward. First, encrypt the latest DB snapshot, then replace the existing DB instance with the encrypted snapshot. This ensures that new DB instances are encrypted and all future snapshots will also be encrypted. The other options are incorrect because they do not directly address the problem. Option B creates a new encrypted volume but does not resolve the encryption issues for existing DB instances and snapshots. Option C copies the snapshot and enables encryption, but does not replace the existing DB instance. Option D copies the snapshot to an S3 bucket, but this is not a straightforward way around encryption of the DB instance and snapshot. Therefore, option A is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司正在 AWS 上運行一個線上交易處理（OLTP）工作負載。該工作負載使用未加密的 Amazon RDS DB 實例，部署在多個可用區域（Multi-AZ）。每天都會從該實例中創建數據庫快照。解決方案架構師應該採取哪些措施，以確保數據庫和快照在未來始終加密？

A. 對最新的 DB 快照進行加密，然後用加密的快照替換現有的 DB 實例。
B. 創建一個新的加密 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）卷，然後將快照複製到其中。啟用 DB 實例的加密。
C. 複製快照並使用 AWS 金鑰管理服務（AWS KMS）啟用加密。將加密的快照恢復到現有的 DB 實例。
D. 將快照複製到使用 AWS 金鑰管理服務（AWS KMS）管理金鑰的伺服器端加密（SSE-KMS）加密的 Amazon S3 儲存桶。
解析(中): 答案是 A，因為這是最直接和有效的方法，可以確保數據庫和快照在未來始終加密。首先，對最新的 DB 快照進行加密，然後用加密的快照替換現有的 DB 實例。這樣可以確保新的 DB 實例是加密的，並且所有未來的快照也會是加密的。其他選項不正確，因為它們沒有直接解決問題。選項 B 創建了一個新的加密卷，但沒有解決現有的 DB 實例和快照的加密問題。選項 C 複製了快照並啟用了加密，但沒有替換現有的 DB 實例。選項 D 將快照複製到 S3 儲存桶，但這不是解決 DB 實例和快照加密的直接方法。因此，選項 A 是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company wants to build a scalable key management infrastructure to support developers who need to encrypt data in their applications.
What should a solutions architect do to reduce the operational burden?
選項(英):
A. Use multi-factor authentication (MFA) to protect the encryption keys.
B. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to protect the encryption keys.
C. Use AWS Certicate Manager (ACM) to create, store, and assign the encryption keys.
D. Use an IAM policy to limit the scope of users who have access permissions to protect the encryption keys.
解析(英):
To reduce operational burden, solutions architects should use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to protect encryption keys. AWS KMS is a fully managed service that allows you to easily create and manage encryption keys and use them to encrypt and decrypt data. Use AWS KMS to reduce operational burden by automating tasks such as key rotation, key versioning, and key storage.

Choice A is incorrect because multi-factor authentication (MFA) is a security mechanism used to protect a user's identity, not an encryption key. Choice C is incorrect because AWS Credential Manager (ACM) is primarily used to manage SSL/TLS credentials, not encryption keys. Choice D is incorrect because IAM policies can be used to restrict access, but they do not provide key management capabilities. Therefore, option B is the correct answer.
題目(中): 一家公司想要建立一個可擴展的金鑰管理基礎設施，以支持開發人員在其應用程式中加密資料。作為解決方案架構師，應該採取什麼措施來減少操作負擔？
選項(中):
A. 使用多因素驗證 (MFA) 來保護加密金鑰。
B. 使用 AWS 金鑰管理服務 (AWS KMS) 來保護加密金鑰。
C. 使用 AWS 憑證管理員 (ACM) 來建立、儲存和指派加密金鑰。
D. 使用 IAM 政策來限制存取權限，以保護加密金鑰的使用者範圍。
解析(中):
為了減少操作負擔，解決方案架構師應該使用 AWS 金鑰管理服務 (AWS KMS) 來保護加密金鑰。AWS KMS 是一種完全受管理的服務，允許您輕鬆地建立和管理加密金鑰，並將其用於加密和解密資料。使用 AWS KMS 可以自動化金鑰輪替、金鑰版本控制和金鑰存儲等任務，從而減少操作負擔。

選項 A 不正確，因為多因素驗證 (MFA) 是用於保護使用者身份的安全機制，而不是用於保護加密金鑰。選項 C 不正確，因為 AWS 憑證管理員 (ACM) 主要用於管理 SSL/TLS 憑證，而不是加密金鑰。選項 D 不正確，因為 IAM 政策可以用於限制存取權限，但它們不能提供金鑰管理的功能。因此，選項 B 是正確答案。

題目(英):
A company has a dynamic web application hosted on two Amazon EC2 instances. The company has its own SSL certicate, which is on each
instance to perform SSL termination.
There has been an increase in trac recently, and the operations team determined that SSL encryption and decryption is causing the compute
capacity of the web servers to reach their maximum limit.
What should a solutions architect do to increase the application's performance?
選項(英):
A. Create a new SSL certicate using AWS Certicate Manager (ACM). Install the ACM certicate on each instance.
B. Create an Amazon S3 bucket Migrate the SSL certicate to the S3 bucket. Congure the EC2 instances to reference the bucket for SSL
termination.
C. Create another EC2 instance as a proxy server. Migrate the SSL certicate to the new instance and congure it to direct connections to
the existing EC2 instances.
D. Import the SSL certicate into AWS Certicate Manager (ACM). Create an Application Load Balancer with an HTTPS listener that uses
the SSL certicate from ACM.
解析(英): The correct answer is D. The reason is that importing an SSL certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) and creating an application load balancer with an HTTPS listener effectively offloads the SSL encryption and decryption work on the EC2 instances, thereby improving application performance. This is because the load balancer can handle SSL termination, reducing the computational load on the web server. The other options are incorrect because: option A creates a new SSL certificate and installs it on each instance, which still requires SSL encryption and decryption on each instance, which cannot solve the limitation of computing power; option B uses an S3 bucket to store the SSL certificate, which still requires SSL termination on each instance, and cannot offload the computing burden; option C creates a proxy server for SSL termination, which can offload part of the computing burden, but still requires the proxy server to perform SSL encryption and decryption, which may cause new bottlenecks. Therefore, option D is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司有一個動態網頁應用程式，部署在兩個 Amazon EC2 實例上。該公司有自己的 SSL 證書，分別安裝在每個實例上，以執行 SSL 終止。最近，流量增加，運營團隊發現 SSL 加密和解密導致網頁伺服器的計算能力達到最大限制。作為解決方案架構師，應該如何提高應用程式的性能？
選項(中):
A. 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 創建新的 SSL 證書，並在每個實例上安裝 ACM 證書。
B. 創建 Amazon S3 儲存桶，將 SSL 證書遷移到 S3 儲存桶，然後設定 EC2 實例參考儲存桶進行 SSL 終止。
C. 創建另一個 EC2 實例作為代理伺服器，將 SSL 證書遷移到新實例，並設定它將連接導向現有的 EC2 實例。
D. 將 SSL 證書導入 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)，創建具有 HTTPS 聽眾的應用程式負載平衡器，使用 ACM 中的 SSL 證書。
解析(中): 正確答案是 D。原因是將 SSL 證書導入 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 並創建具有 HTTPS 聽眾的應用程式負載平衡器，可以有效地卸載 EC2 實例上的 SSL 加密和解密工作，從而提高應用程式的性能。這是因為負載平衡器可以處理 SSL 終止，減少網頁伺服器的計算負擔。其他選項不正確，因為：A 選項創建新的 SSL 證書並安裝在每個實例上，仍然需要每個實例進行 SSL 加密和解密，無法解決計算能力的限制；B 選項使用 S3 儲存桶存儲 SSL 證書，仍然需要每個實例進行 SSL 終止，無法卸載計算負擔；C 選項創建代理伺服器進行 SSL 終止，雖然可以卸載部分計算負擔，但仍然需要代理伺服器進行 SSL 加密和解密，可能導致新的瓶頸。因此，選項 D 是最佳解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has a highly dynamic batch processing job that uses many Amazon EC2 instances to complete it. The job is stateless in nature,
can be started and stopped at any given time with no negative impact, and typically takes upwards of 60 minutes total to complete. The
company has asked a solutions architect to design a scalable and cost-effective solution that meets the requirements of the job.
What should the solutions architect recommend?
選項(英):
A. Implement EC2 Spot Instances.
B. Purchase EC2 Reserved Instances.
C. Implement EC2 On-Demand Instances.
D. Implement the processing on AWS Lambda.
解析(英):
According to the title description, this batch processing job is highly dynamic and stateless and can be started and stopped at any time without negative impact. This means that the job can be interrupted and restarted without affecting the results of the job. Therefore, implementing EC2 Spot Instances is the most suitable option. EC2 Spot Instances provide low-cost computing resources that can be dynamically increased or decreased based on demand, making them ideal for this type of work. Additionally, EC2 Spot instances are much cheaper than On-Demand instances, thus helping companies save costs.

The other options are incorrect because:
- B. Purchase EC2 Reserved instances: Reserved instances require payment upfront and require a minimum 1-year commitment period, which is not suitable for this kind of dynamic work.
- C. Implement EC2 On-Demand instances: On-Demand instances are much more expensive than Spot instances and require manual management of starting and stopping the instance.
- D. Implement processing on AWS Lambda: AWS Lambda is a serverless computing service suitable for small, short-term jobs rather than long-term batch processing jobs. Therefore, implementing EC2 Spot Instances is the most suitable option.
題目(中): 一家公司有一個高度動態的批次處理工作，使用許多 Amazon EC2 實例來完成它。該工作是無狀態的，可以在任何時間啟動和停止而不會產生負面影響，通常需要 60 分鐘以上的時間來完成。公司要求解決方案架構師設計一個可擴展且成本有效的解決方案，以滿足工作的需求。解決方案架構師應該推薦什麼？
選項(中):
A. 實施 EC2 Spot 實例。
B. 購買 EC2 Reserved 實例。
C. 實施 EC2 On-Demand 實例。
D. 在 AWS Lambda 上實施處理。
解析(中):
根據題目描述，該批次處理工作是高度動態、無狀態的，可以在任何時間啟動和停止而不會產生負面影響。這意味著該工作可以被中斷和重新啟動，而不會影響工作的結果。因此，實施 EC2 Spot 實例是最合適的選擇。EC2 Spot 實例提供了低成本的計算資源，可以根據需求動態增加或減少，非常適合這種類型的工作。另外，EC2 Spot 實例的價格比 On-Demand 實例低很多，因此可以幫助公司節省成本。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
- B. 購買 EC2 Reserved 實例：Reserved 實例需要提前支付費用，且需要至少 1 年的承諾期，這不適合這種動態的工作。
- C. 實施 EC2 On-Demand 實例：On-Demand 實例的價格比 Spot 實例高很多，且需要手動管理實例的啟動和停止。
- D. 在 AWS Lambda 上實施處理：AWS Lambda 是一個無伺服器的計算服務，適合於小型、短期的工作，而不是長期的批次處理工作。因此，實施 EC2 Spot 實例是最合適的選擇。

題目(英):
A company runs its two-tier ecommerce website on AWS. The web tier consists of a load balancer that sends trac to Amazon EC2 instances.
The database tier uses an Amazon RDS DB instance. The EC2 instances and the RDS DB instance should not be exposed to the public internet.
The EC2 instances require internet access to complete payment processing of orders through a third-party web service. The application must
be highly available.
Which combination of conguration options will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in private subnets. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.
B. Congure a VPC with two private subnets and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in
the private subnets.
C. Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in public subnets across two Availability Zones. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB
instance in private subnets.
D. Congure a VPC with one public subnet, one private subnet, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application
Load Balancer in the public subnet.
D. Congure a VPC with two public subnets, two private subnets, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an
Application Load Balancer in the public subnets.
解析(英): The answer is A because using Auto Scaling groups to launch EC2 instances in a private subnet ensures that the EC2 instances are not exposed to the public internet. At the same time, deploying an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in a private subnet also ensures that the database is not exposed to the public Internet. This meets security requirements. Additionally, using Auto Scaling groups and RDS Multi-AZ DB instances ensures high availability for your applications. The other options are incorrect because the Application Load Balancer in option B is deployed on a private subnet and cannot receive traffic from the public internet. The EC2 instances in option C are deployed in the public subnet and are exposed to the public Internet, posing security risks. The Application Load Balancer in Option D is deployed in the public subnet and cannot ensure the security of the EC2 instances and RDS DB instances. Therefore, option A is the most appropriate choice.
題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS 上運行其兩層電子商務網站。網頁層由一個負載平衡器組成，負載平衡器將流量發送到 Amazon EC2 實例。數據庫層使用 Amazon RDS DB 實例。EC2 實例和 RDS DB 實例不應暴露在公共網際網路上。EC2 實例需要網際網路存取權限，以通過第三方網路服務完成訂單的付款處理。應用程式必須具有高可用性。哪種組合的設定選項可以滿足這些需求？（選擇兩個。）
選項(中):
A. 使用 Auto Scaling 群組在私有子網路中啟動 EC2 實例。部署 RDS Multi-AZ DB 實例在私有子網路中。
B. 配置一個 VPC，具有兩個私有子網路和兩個 NAT 閘道，橫跨兩個可用區域。部署 Application Load Balancer 在私有子網路中。
C. 使用 Auto Scaling 群組在公有子網路中啟動 EC2 實例，橫跨兩個可用區域。部署 RDS Multi-AZ DB 實例在私有子網路中。
D. 配置一個 VPC，具有一個公有子網路、一個私有子網路和兩個 NAT 閘道，橫跨兩個可用區域。部署 Application Load Balancer 在公有子網路中。
D. 配置一個 VPC，具有兩個公有子網路、兩個私有子網路和兩個 NAT 閘道，橫跨兩個可用區域。部署 Application Load Balancer 在公有子網路中。
解析(中): 答案是 A，因為使用 Auto Scaling 群組在私有子網路中啟動 EC2 實例，可以確保 EC2 實例不暴露在公共網際網路上。同時，部署 RDS Multi-AZ DB 實例在私有子網路中，也可以確保數據庫不暴露在公共網際網路上。這樣可以滿足安全性需求。另外，使用 Auto Scaling 群組和 RDS Multi-AZ DB 實例，可以確保應用程式具有高可用性。其他選項不正確，因為選項 B 中的 Application Load Balancer 部署在私有子網路中，無法接收來自公共網際網路的流量。選項 C 中的 EC2 實例部署在公有子網路中，暴露在公共網際網路上，存在安全風險。選項 D 中的 Application Load Balancer 部署在公有子網路中，無法確保 EC2 實例和 RDS DB 實例的安全性。因此，選項 A 是最合適的選擇。

題目(英):
A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to reduce a company's storage costs. All the company's data is in the Amazon S3
Standard storage class. The company must keep all data for at least 25 years. Data from the most recent 2 years must be highly available and
immediately retrievable.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive immediately.
B. Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years.
C. Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Activate the archiving option to ensure that data is archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
D. Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) immediately and to S3 Glacier
Deep Archive after 2 years.
解析(英):
According to the question requirements, companies need to retain all data for at least 25 years, and the data from the last 2 years must be highly available and immediately retrievable. Therefore, option B is the most appropriate solution. Option B sets the S3 lifecycle policy to move objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years, which meets the needs of the company. Because S3 Glacier Deep Archive is a low-cost storage option, suitable for long-term storage of data, and the data of the last 2 years are still stored in the S3 standard storage level, with high availability and immediate retrieval.

Option A is incorrect because it immediately moves all material to S3 Glacier Deep Archive, thereby losing the high availability and immediate resemblance of the last 2 years of material. Option C is incorrect because S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatically moves data to different storage classes based on the frequency of data access, but it does not guarantee that data will be moved to S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Option D is incorrect because it would move the data to S3 One Zone-IA and then to S3 Glacier Deep Archive, which would increase storage costs and complexity of data transfer. Therefore, option B is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一位解決方案架構師需要實施一個解決方案，以減少公司的儲存成本。公司所有的資料都儲存在 Amazon S3 標準儲存等級中。公司必須至少保留所有資料 25 年。最近 2 年的資料必須具有高可用性和立即可取性。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 設定 S3 生命週期政策，立即將物件轉移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
B. 設定 S3 生命週期政策，在 2 年後將物件轉移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
C. 使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering，啟用歸檔選項，以確保資料在 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 中歸檔。
D. 設定 S3 生命週期政策，立即將物件轉移到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)，並在 2 年後轉移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
解析(中):
根據題目要求，公司需要保留所有資料至少 25 年，並且最近 2 年的資料必須具有高可用性和立即可取性。因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案。選項 B 設定 S3 生命週期政策，在 2 年後將物件轉移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，這樣可以滿足公司的需求。因為 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 是一個低成本的儲存選項，適合於長期儲存資料，而最近 2 年的資料仍然儲存在 S3 標準儲存等級中，具有高可用性和立即可取性。

選項 A 不正確，因為它會立即將所有資料轉移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，從而喪失最近 2 年資料的高可用性和立即可取性。選項 C 不正確，因為 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 會根據資料的存取頻率自動轉移資料到不同的儲存等級，但它不能保證資料會被轉移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。選項 D 不正確，因為它會將資料轉移到 S3 One Zone-IA，然後再轉移到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，這樣會增加儲存成本和資料轉移的複雜性。因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company wants to run applications in containers in the AWS Cloud. These applications are stateless and can tolerate disruptions within the
underlying infrastructure. The company needs a solution that minimizes cost and operational overhead.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):

B. Use Spot Instances in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) managed node group.

Choice A is incorrect because using Amazon EC2 autoscaling groups requires more operational overhead. Choices C and D are incorrect because the cost of On-Demand execution instances is higher than that of Spot execution instances and the cost cannot be minimized. 題目(中): 一家公司想要在 AWS 雲端運行容器化應用程式。這些應用程式是無狀態的，可以容忍底層基礎設施的中斷。公司需要一個能夠最小化成本和操作負擔的解決方案。一個解決方案架構師應該如何滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 Amazon EC2 自動擴展群組中的 Spot 執行個體來運行應用程式容器。
B. 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 管理節點群組中的 Spot 執行個體。

題目(英):
A company is running a multi-tier web application on premises. The web application is containerized and runs on a number of Linux hosts
connected to a PostgreSQL database that contains user records. The operational overhead of maintaining the infrastructure and capacity
planning is limiting the company's growth. A solutions architect must improve the application's infrastructure.
Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to accomplish this? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora.
B. Migrate the web application to be hosted on Amazon EC2 instances.
C. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the web application content.
D. Set up Amazon ElastiCache between the web application and the PostgreSQL database.
E. Migrate the web application to be hosted on AWS Fargate with Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS).
解析(英):
The answer is AE, as these two options can effectively improve the application's infrastructure. Option A, migrating the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora can reduce the operational burden of database maintenance and improve the availability and scalability of the database. Option E, migrating web applications to AWS Fargate, paired with Amazon ECS, allows companies to no longer need to manage infrastructure, thereby reducing operational burdens and improving application scalability and reliability.

Choice B is incorrect because migrating a web application to an Amazon EC2 instance still requires management of the infrastructure and does not reduce the operational burden. Choice C is incorrect because setting up Amazon CloudFront distribution only accelerates the delivery of web application content and does not improve the application's infrastructure. Choice D is incorrect because setting up Amazon ElastiCache can only improve database performance, but cannot reduce operational burden or improve application infrastructure. Therefore, the answer is AE.
題目(中): 一家公司正在內部運行一個多層次的網頁應用程式。該網頁應用程式被容器化，並在多個連接到包含用戶記錄的PostgreSQL資料庫的Linux主機上運行。維護基礎設施和容量規劃的運營負擔限制了公司的成長。一個解決方案架構師必須改善應用程式的基礎設施。解決方案架構師應該採取哪些組合的動作來實現這一點？（選擇兩個。）
選項(中):
A. 將PostgreSQL資料庫遷移到Amazon Aurora。
B. 將網頁應用程式遷移到Amazon EC2實例上。
C. 為網頁應用程式內容設定Amazon CloudFront分發。
D. 在網頁應用程式和PostgreSQL資料庫之間設定Amazon ElastiCache。
E. 將網頁應用程式遷移到AWS Fargate上，搭配Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。
解析(中):
答案是AE，因為這兩個選項可以有效地改善應用程式的基礎設施。選項A，將PostgreSQL資料庫遷移到Amazon Aurora，可以減少資料庫維護的運營負擔，並提高資料庫的可用性和擴展性。選項E，將網頁應用程式遷移到AWS Fargate上，搭配Amazon ECS，可以讓公司不再需要管理基礎設施，從而減少運營負擔，並提高應用程式的可擴展性和可靠性。

選項B不正確，因為將網頁應用程式遷移到Amazon EC2實例上仍然需要管理基礎設施，從而不能減少運營負擔。選項C不正確，因為設定Amazon CloudFront分發只能加速網頁應用程式內容的傳遞，不能改善應用程式的基礎設施。選項D不正確，因為設定Amazon ElastiCache只能改善資料庫的性能，不能減少運營負擔和改善應用程式的基礎設施。因此，答案是AE。

題目(英):
An application runs on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zonas. The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group
behind an Application Load Balancer. The application performs best when the CPU utilization of the EC2 instances is at or near 40%.
What should a solutions architect do to maintain the desired performance across all instances in the group?
選項(英):
A. Use a simple scaling policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group.
B. Use a target tracking policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group.
C. Use an AWS Lambda function ta update the desired Auto Scaling group capacity.
D. Use scheduled scaling actions to scale up and scale down the Auto Scaling group.
解析(英):
To maintain the desired performance of all instances in the group, solutions architects should use target tracking policies to dynamically scale Auto Scaling groups. This is because the target tracking policy can dynamically adjust the capacity of the Auto Scaling group based on a specific metric (in this case, CPU usage) to maintain optimal performance. Option B is the correct answer because it allows the Auto Scaling group to dynamically scale up or down based on changes in CPU usage to maintain optimal performance.

Option A is incorrect because a simple expansion policy requires manually setting expansion conditions and actions, and cannot dynamically adjust capacity based on specific indicators. Choice C is incorrect because using an AWS Lambda function to update Auto Scaling group capacity requires manual coding and configuration and does not automatically adjust capacity based on metrics. Option D is incorrect because scheduled expansion actions require manual setting of expansion time and capacity, and capacity cannot be dynamically adjusted based on real-time indicator changes. Therefore, option B is the best solution.
題目(中): 一個應用程式在多個可用區域中的 Amazon EC2 實例上運行。這些實例在一個 Application Load Balancer 後面的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 群組中運行。當 EC2 實例的 CPU 使用率在或接近 40% 時，應用程式的性能最佳。為了維持群組中所有實例的期望性能，解決方案架構師應該採取什麼措施？
選項(中):
A. 使用簡單的擴展政策來動態擴展 Auto Scaling 群組。
B. 使用目標追蹤政策來動態擴展 Auto Scaling 群組。
C. 使用 AWS Lambda 函數來更新所需的 Auto Scaling 群組容量。
D. 使用排程擴展動作來擴展和縮減 Auto Scaling 群組。
解析(中):
為了維持群組中所有實例的期望性能，解決方案架構師應該使用目標追蹤政策來動態擴展 Auto Scaling 群組。這是因為目標追蹤政策可以根據特定的指標（在這種情況下是 CPU 使用率）來動態調整 Auto Scaling 群組的容量，以維持最佳的性能。選項 B 是正確的答案，因為它允許 Auto Scaling 群組根據 CPU 使用率的變化來動態擴展或縮減，以維持最佳的性能。

選項 A 不正確，因為簡單的擴展政策需要手動設定擴展條件和動作，不能根據特定的指標來動態調整容量。選項 C 不正確，因為使用 AWS Lambda 函數來更新 Auto Scaling 群組容量需要手動編寫代碼和配置，不能自動根據指標來調整容量。選項 D 不正確，因為排程擴展動作需要手動設定擴展時間和容量，不能根據實時的指標變化來動態調整容量。因此，選項 B 是最佳的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is developing a le-sharing application that will use an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. The company wants to serve all the les
through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The company does not want the les to be accessible through direct navigation to the S3 URL.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Write individual policies for each S3 bucket to grant read permission for only CloudFront access.

D. Create an origin access identity (OAI). Assign the OAI to the CloudFront distribution. Congure the S3 bucket permissions so that only
the OAI has read permission.
解析(英): To meet the company's needs, solutions architects should create an original access identity (OAI) and assign it to the CloudFront distributed network. Then, set the permissions on the S3 bucket so that only OAI has read access. This ensures that files are only accessible through the CloudFront distribution network and not by navigating directly to the S3 URL. Choice D is the correct answer because it correctly describes how to use OAI to restrict access to an S3 bucket. Choices A, B, and C are incorrect because they do not correctly describe how to use OAI to restrict access. Option A requires writing individual policies for each S3 bucket, which is not a scalable solution. Option B creates an IAM user, but this is not the correct way to restrict access to your S3 bucket. Option C writes an S3 bucket policy, but it does not properly describe how to use OAI to restrict access. Therefore, option D is the most correct answer.
題目(中): 一家公司正在開發一個檔案分享應用程式，該應用程式將使用 Amazon S3 儲存桶進行儲存。公司希望通過 Amazon CloudFront 分佈式網路提供所有檔案的存取。公司不希望檔案可以通過直接導航到 S3 URL 進行存取。解決方案架構師應該採取哪些措施來滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 為每個 S3 儲存桶編寫個別的政策，以授予 CloudFront 存取權限。
B. 建立一個 IAM 使用者，授予使用者對 S3 儲存桶中物件的讀取權限，並將使用者指派給 CloudFront。
C. 編寫一個 S3 儲存桶政策，將 CloudFront 分佈式網路 ID 指定為主要實體，並將目標 S3 儲存桶指定為 Amazon 資源名稱 (ARN)。
D. 建立一個原始存取身分 (OAI)，將 OAI 指派給 CloudFront 分佈式網路，並設定 S3 儲存桶的權限，以便只有 OAI 有讀取權限。
解析(中): 為了滿足公司的需求，解決方案架構師應該建立一個原始存取身分 (OAI) 並將其指派給 CloudFront 分佈式網路。然後，設定 S3 儲存桶的權限，以便只有 OAI 有讀取權限。這樣可以確保檔案只能通過 CloudFront 分佈式網路進行存取，不能通過直接導航到 S3 URL 進行存取。選項 D 是正確的答案，因為它正確地描述了如何使用 OAI 來限制 S3 儲存桶的存取權限。選項 A、B 和 C 不正確，因為它們沒有正確地描述如何使用 OAI 來限制存取權限。選項 A 需要為每個 S3 儲存桶編寫個別的政策，這不是一個可擴展的解決方案。選項 B 建立一個 IAM 使用者，但這不是限制 S3 儲存桶存取權限的正確方法。選項 C 編寫了一個 S3 儲存桶政策，但它沒有正確地描述如何使用 OAI 來限制存取權限。因此，選項 D 是最正確的答案。

題目(英):
A company’s website provides users with downloadable historical performance reports. The website needs a solution that will scale to meet
the company’s website demands globally. The solution should be cost-effective, limit the provisioning of infrastructure resources, and provide
the fastest possible response time.
Which combination should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3
B. AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB
C. Application Load Balancer with Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
D. Amazon Route 53 with internal Application Load Balancers
解析(英):
To meet the needs of corporate websites, solutions need to be globally scalable, cost effective, constrained by infrastructure resources and have the fastest response times. Option A, Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3, is the best combination. Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) that delivers static content, such as historical performance reports, to edge locations around the world, providing the fastest response times. Amazon S3 is an object storage service that can be used to store and serve downloaded reports. The combination of these two services provides global scalability, cost effectiveness and the fastest response times.

Option B, AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB, is not the best combination. AWS Lambda is a serverless computing service that can be used to handle requests, but it is not suitable for serving static content. Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database that can be used to store and query data, but it is not suitable for serving downloads of large archives.

Option C, application load balancer with Amazon EC2 autoscaling, is also not the best combination. This combination can provide some scalability and load balancing, but it requires more infrastructure resources and management effort, and may not provide the fastest response times.

Option D, Amazon Route 53 with an internal application load balancer, is also not the best combination. Amazon Route 53 is a DNS service that can be used to map domain names to IP addresses, but it is not suitable for serving static content or downloads of large files. An internal application load balancer can be used to balance the load of internal applications, but it is not suitable for providing global scalability and the fastest response times. Therefore, option A is the most appropriate combination.
題目(中): 一家公司的網站為用戶提供可下載的歷史績效報告。網站需要一個解決方案，以滿足公司全球網站的需求。解決方案應該是成本有效的，限制基礎設施資源的佈建，並提供最快的可能響應時間。哪種組合是解決方案架構師推薦以滿足這些需求的？
選項(中):
A. Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon S3
B. AWS Lambda 和 Amazon DynamoDB
C. 應用程式負載平衡器與 Amazon EC2 自動擴展
D. Amazon Route 53 與內部應用程式負載平衡器
解析(中):
為了滿足公司網站的需求，解決方案需要具備全球擴展性、成本有效性、基礎設施資源的限制和最快的響應時間。選項 A，Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon S3，是最合適的組合。Amazon CloudFront 是一種內容傳遞網路（CDN），可以將靜態內容（如歷史績效報告）分發到全球各地的邊緣位置，從而提供最快的響應時間。Amazon S3 是一個物件儲存服務，可以用於儲存和提供下載的報告。這兩個服務的組合可以提供全球擴展性、成本有效性和最快的響應時間。

選項 B，AWS Lambda 和 Amazon DynamoDB，不是最合適的組合。AWS Lambda 是一種無伺服器計算服務，可以用於處理請求，但它不適合用於提供靜態內容。Amazon DynamoDB 是一種 NoSQL 數據庫，可以用於儲存和查詢數據，但它不適合用於提供大型檔案的下載。

選項 C，應用程式負載平衡器與 Amazon EC2 自動擴展，也不是最合適的組合。這個組合可以提供一定的擴展性和負載平衡，但它需要更多的基礎設施資源和管理工作，並且可能無法提供最快的響應時間。

選項 D，Amazon Route 53 與內部應用程式負載平衡器，也不是最合適的組合。Amazon Route 53 是一種 DNS 服務，可以用於將網域名稱映射到 IP 地址，但它不適合用於提供靜態內容或大型檔案的下載。內部應用程式負載平衡器可以用於平衡內部應用程式的負載，但它不適合用於提供全球擴展性和最快的響應時間。因此，選項 A 是最合適的組合。

題目(英):
A company runs an Oracle database on premises. As part of the company’s migration to AWS, the company wants to upgrade the database to
the most recent available version. The company also wants to set up disaster recovery (DR) for the database. The company needs to minimize
the operational overhead for normal operations and DR setup. The company also needs to maintain access to the database's underlying
operating system.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Migrate the Oracle database to an Amazon EC2 instance. Set up database replication to a different AWS Region.
B. Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Activate Cross-Region automated backups to replicate the snapshots to
another AWS Region.
C. Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Create a read replica for the database in another AWS Region.
D. Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Create a standby database in another Availability Zone.
解析(英):
The correct answer is C. Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle provides access to the underlying operating system, which was one of the company's requirements. At the same time, Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle supports cross-region read-only replication, which can meet the company's disaster recovery needs. This solution also minimizes operational burden, as Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle provides features such as automated backup and repair.

Choice A is incorrect because while it is possible to run an Oracle database on Amazon EC2 instances, this requires more operational burden and maintenance effort. Option B is incorrect because Amazon RDS for Oracle's cross-region automated backups can only replicate snapshots and cannot provide real-time disaster recovery capabilities. Option D is incorrect because creating a standby database in another Availability Zone does not provide cross-region disaster recovery capabilities. 題目(中): 一家公司在內部運行 Oracle 數據庫。作為公司遷移到 AWS 的一部分，公司想要升級數據庫到最新可用的版本。公司還想要為數據庫設置災難恢復（DR）。公司需要盡量減少正常運營和 DR 設置的運營負擔。公司還需要維護對數據庫底層操作系統的訪問權限。哪種解決方案可以滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將 Oracle 數據庫遷移到 Amazon EC2 實例。設置數據庫複製到不同的 AWS 區域。
B. 將 Oracle 數據庫遷移到 Amazon RDS for Oracle。啟用跨區域自動備份以複製快照到另一個 AWS 區域。
C. 將 Oracle 數據庫遷移到 Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle。為數據庫在另一個 AWS 區域創建只讀複製。

解析(中):
正確答案是 C。Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle 提供了對底層操作系統的訪問權限，這是公司的需求之一。同時，Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle 支持跨區域只讀複製，這可以滿足公司的災難恢復需求。這種解決方案也可以盡量減少運營負擔，因為 Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle 提供了自動備份和修復等功能。

選項 A 不正確，因為雖然可以在 Amazon EC2 實例上運行 Oracle 數據庫，但這需要更多的運營負擔和維護工作。選項 B 不正確，因為 Amazon RDS for Oracle 的跨區域自動備份只能複製快照，不能提供實時的災難恢復功能。選項 D 不正確，因為在另一個可用區域創建備用數據庫不能提供跨區域的災難恢復功能。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(中): 一家公司想要將其應用程式移至無伺服器解決方案。無伺服器解決方案需要使用 SL 分析現有和新資料。公司將資料儲存於 Amazon S3 儲存桶中。資料需要加密，並且必須複製到不同的 AWS 區域。哪個解決方案可以在最少的操作負擔下滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立新的 S3 儲存桶。將資料載入新的 S3 儲存桶。使用 S3 跨區域複製 (CRR) 將加密物件複製到另一個區域的 S3 儲存桶。使用伺服器端加密與 AWS KMS 多區域金鑰 (SSE-KMS)。使用 Amazon Athena 查詢資料。
B. 建立新的 S3 儲存桶。將資料載入新的 S3 儲存桶。使用 S3 跨區域複製 (CRR) 將加密物件複製到另一個區域的 S3 儲存桶。使用伺服器端加密與 AWS KMS 多區域金鑰 (SSE-KMS)。使用 Amazon RDS 查詢資料。
C. 將資料載入現有的 S3 儲存桶。使用 S3 跨區域複製 (CRR) 將加密物件複製到另一個區域的 S3 儲存桶。使用伺服器端加密與 Amazon S3 受管理的加密金鑰 (SSE-S3)。使用 Amazon Athena 查詢資料。
D. 將資料載入現有的 S3 儲存桶。使用 S3 跨區域複製 (CRR) 將加密物件複製到另一個區域的 S3 儲存桶。使用伺服器端加密與 Amazon S3 受管理的加密金鑰 (SSE-S3)。使用 Amazon RDS 查詢資料。

答案是 C，因為它能夠在最少的操作負擔下滿足公司的需求。選項 C 使用現有的 S3 儲存桶，減少了建立新的儲存桶和資料遷移的工作。同時，使用 S3 跨區域複製 (CRR) 和 Amazon S3 受管理的加密金鑰 (SSE-S3) 可以滿足資料加密和跨區域複製的需求。最後，使用 Amazon Athena 查詢資料可以提供無伺服器的查詢解決方案，減少了操作負擔。

- 選項 B 和 D 使用 Amazon RDS 查詢資料，需要管理和維護關係式資料庫，增加了操作負擔。

題目(英):
A company runs workloads on AWS. The company needs to connect to a service from an external provider. The service is hosted in the
provider's VPC. According to the company’s security team, the connectivity must be private and must be restricted to the target service. The
connection must be initiated only from the company’s VPC.
Which solution will mast these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create a VPC peering connection between the company's VPC and the provider's VPC. Update the route table to connect to the target
service.
B. Ask the provider to create a virtual private gateway in its VPC. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service.
C. Create a NAT gateway in a public subnet of the company’s VPUpdate the route table to connect to the target service.
D. Ask the provider to create a VPC endpoint for the target service. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service.
解析(英):
According to the question description, the company needs to connect to the services of an external provider from its VPC, and the connection must be private and limited to the target service. This means a secure, private connection is needed. Option D is the correct answer because it uses AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service. AWS PrivateLink is a secure, private connection that allows companies to connect from their VPC to services from external providers without going through the public internet. The provider needs to establish a VPC endpoint for the target service, and companies can then connect to that endpoint using AWS PrivateLink. This ensures that the connection is private and limited to the target service.

The other options are incorrect for the following reasons:
A. VPC peering can connect two VPCs, but it does not provide a private connection method and requires routing table updates, which may cause security issues.
B. A virtual private gateway can provide a private connection method, but it requires the establishment of a virtual private gateway in the provider's VPC, which may increase complexity and cost.
C. The NAT gateway can provide public Internet connections, but it does not provide private connections and requires updating the routing table, which may cause security issues. Therefore, option D is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS 上運行工作負載，需要連接到外部提供商的服務。該服務位於提供商的 VPC 中。根據公司的安全團隊，連接必須是私有的，並且只能限制為目標服務。連接只能從公司的 VPC 初始化。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在公司的 VPC 和提供商的 VPC 之間建立 VPC 對等連接。更新路由表以連接到目標服務。
B. 請求提供商在其 VPC 中建立虛擬私有閘道。使用 AWS PrivateLink 連接到目標服務。
C. 在公司的 VPC 中的公用子網路中建立 NAT 閘道。更新路由表以連接到目標服務。
D. 請求提供商為目標服務建立 VPC 端點。使用 AWS PrivateLink 連接到目標服務。
解析(中):
根據題目描述，公司需要從其 VPC 連接到外部提供商的服務，且連接必須是私有的，僅限於目標服務。這意味著需要一個安全、私有的連接方式。選項 D 是正確答案，因為它使用 AWS PrivateLink 連接到目標服務。AWS PrivateLink 是一種安全、私有的連接方式，允許公司從其 VPC 連接到外部提供商的服務，而無需通過公用網際網路。提供商需要為目標服務建立 VPC 端點，然後公司可以使用 AWS PrivateLink 連接到該端點。這樣可以確保連接是私有的，僅限於目標服務。

其他選項不正確的原因如下：
A. VPC 對等連接可以連接兩個 VPC，但它不提供私有的連接方式，且需要更新路由表，這可能會導致安全性問題。
B. 虛擬私有閘道可以提供私有的連接方式，但它需要在提供商的 VPC 中建立虛擬私有閘道，這可能會增加複雜性和成本。
C. NAT 閘道可以提供公用網際網路連接，但它不提供私有的連接方式，且需要更新路由表，這可能會導致安全性問題。因此，選項 D 是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is migrating its on-premises PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The on-premises database must remain online
and accessible during the migration. The Aurora database must remain synchronized with the on-premises database.
Which combination of actions must a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):

B. Create a database backup of the on-premises database.

D. Convert the database schema by using the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT).
E. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to monitor the database synchronization.
解析(英): To meet the company's needs, solutions architects must take the right actions to ensure that on-premises PostgreSQL databases can be migrated to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and remain online and synchronized during the migration. Options C and D are the correct answers. The AWS DMS replication server in Option C can help set up a continuous data replication task to keep the Aurora database in sync with the on-premises database. AWS SCT in Option D can help transform the repository structure to ensure that the on-premises repository's structure can be rebuilt correctly in the Aurora repository. The other options are incorrect because option A only creates a replication task, but does not provide the function of converting the database structure; option B only creates a database backup, but does not provide the function of continuous synchronization; option E establishes a monitoring rule, but does not provide the function of database migration and synchronization. Therefore, option CD is the correct answer.
題目(中): 一家公司正在將其內部部署的PostgreSQL資料庫遷移至Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL。內部部署的資料庫必須在遷移期間保持在線並可存取。Aurora資料庫必須與內部部署的資料庫保持同步。哪組合的動作必須由解決方案架構師採取以滿足這些需求？（選擇兩個。）

B. 建立內部部署資料庫的資料庫備份。

解析(中): 為了滿足公司的需求，解決方案架構師必須採取正確的動作以確保內部部署的PostgreSQL資料庫可以遷移至Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL，並且在遷移期間保持在線和同步。選項C和D是正確的答案。選項C中的AWS DMS複製伺服器可以幫助建立持續的資料複製任務，以保持Aurora資料庫與內部部署資料庫的同步。選項D中的AWS SCT可以幫助轉換資料庫結構，以確保內部部署資料庫的結構可以在Aurora資料庫中正確地重建。其他選項不正確，因為選項A只建立了一個複製任務，但沒有提供轉換資料庫結構的功能；選項B只建立了一個資料庫備份，但沒有提供持續同步的功能；選項E建立了一個監控規則，但沒有提供資料庫遷移和同步的功能。因此，選項CD是正確的答案。

題目(英):
A company uses AWS Organizations to create dedicated AWS accounts for each business unit to manage each business unit's account

題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS 上運行其電子商務應用程序。每個新訂單都會發佈為 RabbitMQ 队列中的消息，該隊列運行在單個可用區域的 Amazon EC2 實例上。這些消息由運行在另一個 EC2 實例上的不同應用程序處理。該應用程序將詳細信息存儲在另一台 EC2 實例上的 PostgreSQL 數據庫中。所有 EC2 實例都位於相同的可用區域。公司需要重新設計其架構以提供最高可用性和最少的運營開銷。解決方案架構師應該做什麼來滿足這些要求？

B. 將隊列遷移到 Amazon MQ 上的 RabbitMQ 實例的冗余對（主動/備用）。為主機應用程序的 EC2 實例創建一個多可用區域的自動擴展組。將數據庫遷移到 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 的多可用區域部署上運行。
C. 為主機 RabbitMQ 队列的 EC2 實例創建一個多可用區域的自動擴展組。為主機應用程序的 EC2 實例創建另一個多可用區域的自動擴展組。將數據庫遷移到 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 的多可用區域部署上運行。
D. 為主機 RabbitMQ 队列的 EC2 實例創建一個多可用區域的自動擴展組。為主機應用程序的 EC2 實例創建另一個多可用區域的自動擴展組。為主機 PostgreSQL 數據庫的 EC2 實例創建第三個多可用區域的自動擴展組。

B. 建立 Lambda 函數以將檔案複製到分析 S3 儲存桶。設定分析 S3 儲存桶以將事件通知傳送到 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events)。設定 EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 中的 ObjectCreated 規則。設定 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 作為規則的目標。
C. 設定 S3 複製之間的 S3 儲存桶。建立 S3 事件通知給分析 S3 儲存桶。設定 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 作為事件通知的目的地。設定 s3:ObjectCreated:Put 作為事件類型。
D. 設定 S3 複製之間的 S3 儲存桶。設定分析 S3 儲存桶以將事件通知傳送到 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events)。設定 EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 中的 ObjectCreated 規則。設定 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 作為規則的目標。
解析(中): 正確答案是 D。這是因為選項 D 能夠滿足報告團隊的所有需求，同時最小化運營負擔。首先，設定 S3 複製之間的 S3 儲存桶可以自動將檔案從初始 S3 儲存桶複製到分析 S3 儲存桶，無需手動干預。接著，設定分析 S3 儲存桶以將事件通知傳送到 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 可以觸發 Lambda 函數和 SageMaker Pipelines 的執行。最後，設定 EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 中的 ObjectCreated 規則可以確保只有當檔案被複製到分析 S3 儲存桶時，才會觸發 Lambda 函數和 SageMaker Pipelines 的執行。其他選項要麼需要手動干預，要麼需要額外的設定和維護，因此不如選項 D 那樣能夠最小化運營負擔。

題目(英):

instances, AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda for compute within the architecture.
The EC2 instances will run the data ingestion layer of the application. EC2 usage will be sporadic and unpredictable. Workloads that run on
EC2 instances can be interrupted at any time. The application front end will run on Fargate, and Lambda will serve the API layer. The front-end

Which combination of purchasing options will provide the MOST cost-effective solution for hosting this application? (Choose two.)

解析(英): According to the question description, the use of EC2 instances is intermittent and unpredictable, so using Spot Instances is the most suitable choice because the cost of Spot Instances is much lower than On-Demand Instances and can save costs when the workload is interrupted. For the front-end and API layers, usage is predictable, so purchasing a 1-year Compute Savings plan provides the most cost-effective solution. Compute Savings plans offer lower costs than On-Demand Instances, with savings based on actual usage. Therefore, the correct answer is AC. Option B is incorrect because the cost of On-Demand Instances is too high, option D is incorrect because All Upfront Reserved Instances are not suitable for intermittent and unpredictable workloads, and option E is incorrect because the EC2 Instance Savings Plan is not available for Fargate and Lambda.
題目(中): 一位解決方案架構師需要幫助一家公司優化在 AWS 上運行應用程式的成本。該應用程式將使用 Amazon EC2 實例、AWS Fargate 和 AWS Lambda 進行計算。EC2 實例將運行應用程式的資料擷取層，EC2 的使用將是間歇性和不可預測的，運行在 EC2 實例上的工作負載可以在任何時間被中斷。應用程式的前端將運行在 Fargate 上，Lambda 將提供 API 層。前端和 API 層的使用率將在未來一年內是可預測的。哪種購買選項的組合將為此應用程式提供最具成本效益的解決方案？（選擇兩個。）
選項(中):
A. 對資料擷取層使用 Spot Instances
B. 對資料擷取層使用 On-Demand Instances
C. 為前端和 API 層購買 1 年的計算節省計劃
D. 為資料擷取層購買 1 年的全部預付費預留實例
E. 為前端和 API 層購買 1 年的 EC2 實例節省計劃
解析(中): 根據題目描述，EC2 實例的使用是間歇性和不可預測的，因此使用 Spot Instances 是最合適的選擇，因為 Spot Instances 的成本比 On-Demand Instances 低很多，而且可以在工作負載被中斷時節省成本。對於前端和 API 層，使用率是可預測的，因此購買 1 年的計算節省計劃可以提供最具成本效益的解決方案。計算節省計劃可以提供比 On-Demand Instances 更低的成本，並且可以根據實際使用情況進行節省。因此，正確答案是 AC。選項 B 不正確，因為 On-Demand Instances 的成本太高，選項 D 不正確，因為全部預付費預留實例不適合間歇性和不可預測的工作負載，選項 E 不正確，因為 EC2 實例節省計劃不適用於 Fargate 和 Lambda。

題目(英):
A company runs a web-based portal that provides users with global breaking news, local alerts, and weather updates. The portal delivers each
user a personalized view by using mixture of static and dynamic content. Content is served over HTTPS through an API server running on an
Amazon EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company wants the portal to provide this content to its users across
the world as quickly as possible.
How should a solutions architect design the application to ensure the LEAST amount of latency for all users?
選項(英):
A. Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve all static and dynamic content by specifying the
ALB as an origin.
B. Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in
the closest Region.
C. Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the static content. Serve the dynamic content
directly from the ALB.
D. Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to serve all content from the ALB
in the closest Region.
解析(英):
The correct answer is A.
Here’s why:
1. **Advantages of Amazon CloudFront**: CloudFront is a global content delivery network (CDN) that caches content using edge locations (Edge Locations) around the world. When an ALB is set up as a CloudFront source, CloudFront not only caches static content, but also accelerates the delivery of dynamic content through its optimized global network (using technologies such as AWS backbone and TCP connections that are pre-established). This significantly reduces latency when users around the world access applications.
2. **Why A is the best solution**: For global users, using CloudFront can push content to the edge node closest to the user, which is the most effective way to reduce latency. Moreover, CloudFront supports dynamic content acceleration and can achieve excellent performance without deploying in multiple regions.

Analysis of other options:
- **Options B and D**: While deploying applications in multiple regions (multi-region architecture) can improve availability, relying solely on Route 53 routing policies (latency or geolocation) does not optimize network transport paths the way CloudFront can. Users still need to establish a full TCP/TLS connection to the region's ALB, which results in higher latency than using CloudFront. In addition, multi-region deployment will significantly increase architectural complexity and maintenance costs.
- **Option C**: Although it is correct to hand over static content to CloudFront for processing, sending dynamic content directly from the ALB will cause global users to directly connect to the ALB in a single region across the Internet when accessing dynamic content. This will cause higher network latency and cannot meet the "fastest speed" goal required by the question.
題目(中): 一家公司經營一個網路入口網站，為使用者提供全球即時新聞、在地快訊及天氣預報。該入口網站透過結合靜態與動態內容，為每位使用者提供個人化的檢視畫面。內容透過 HTTPS 傳輸，由位於應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB) 後方的 Amazon EC2 執行個體上的 API 伺服器提供。該公司希望入口網站能以最快的速度將這些內容提供給全球使用者。解決方案架構師應如何設計應用程式，以確保所有使用者的延遲時間降至最低？
選項(中):
A. 在單一 AWS 區域部署應用程式堆疊。使用 Amazon CloudFront 將 ALB 指定為來源 (Origin)，以傳送所有靜態與動態內容。
B. 在兩個 AWS 區域部署應用程式堆疊。使用 Amazon Route 53 延遲路由政策，從最近區域的 ALB 提供所有內容。
C. 在單一 AWS 區域部署應用程式堆疊。使用 Amazon CloudFront 傳送靜態內容。直接從 ALB 傳送動態內容。
D. 在兩個 AWS 區域部署應用程式堆疊。使用 Amazon Route 53 地理位置路由政策，從最近區域的 ALB 提供所有內容。
解析(中):
正確答案是 A。
原因如下：
1. **Amazon CloudFront 的優勢**：CloudFront 是一個全球內容傳遞網路 (CDN)，它利用遍布全球的邊緣節點 (Edge Locations) 快取內容。當將 ALB 設定為 CloudFront 的來源時，CloudFront 不僅能快取靜態內容，還能透過其優化的全球網路加速動態內容的傳輸（利用 AWS 骨幹網路與 TCP 連線預先建立等技術）。這能顯著降低全球使用者存取應用程式時的延遲。
2. **為何 A 是最佳解**：對於全球使用者而言，使用 CloudFront 能夠將內容推送到離使用者最近的邊緣節點，這是降低延遲最有效的方法，且 CloudFront 支援動態內容加速，無需在多個區域部署即可達到極佳的效能。

其他選項分析：
- **選項 B 與 D**：雖然在多個區域部署應用程式（多區域架構）可以提高可用性，但僅依賴 Route 53 路由政策（延遲或地理位置）並不能像 CloudFront 那樣優化網路傳輸路徑。使用者仍需與該區域的 ALB 建立完整的 TCP/TLS 連線，這會導致比使用 CloudFront 更高的延遲。此外，多區域部署會大幅增加架構複雜度與維運成本。
- **選項 C**：雖然將靜態內容交由 CloudFront 處理是正確的，但將動態內容直接從 ALB 傳送會導致全球使用者在存取動態內容時，必須跨越網際網路直接連線至單一區域的 ALB，這會造成較高的網路延遲，無法滿足題目要求「最快速度」的目標。

題目(英):
A gaming company is designing a highly available architecture. The application runs on a modied Linux kernel and supports only UDP-based
trac. The company needs the front-end tier to provide the best possible user experience. That tier must have low latency, route trac to the
nearest edge location, and provide static IP addresses for entry into the application endpoints.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Congure Amazon Route 53 to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in AWS
Application Auto Scaling.
B. Congure Amazon CloudFront to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in an AWS
Application Auto Scaling group.
C. Congure AWS Global Accelerator to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in an
EC2 Auto Scaling group.
D. Congure Amazon API Gateway to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in
an EC2 Auto Scaling group.
解析(英):
The core requirements of this question are "support UDP traffic", "low latency", "routing to the nearest node" and "providing static IP".

1. **Why C is the correct answer:**
   - **AWS Global Accelerator**: Specifically designed to optimize global network traffic, it provides a static IP address as the entry point of the application and uses the AWS global network to route traffic to the nearest healthy endpoint, which can effectively reduce latency. Best of all, Global Accelerator supports TCP and UDP traffic.
   - **Network Load Balancer (NLB)**: NLB works at Layer 4 of the OSI model and natively supports UDP traffic. It is very suitable for scenarios such as game servers that need to process a large number of UDP packets.
   - **EC2 Auto Scaling**: Since the application runs on a modified Linux core, it must be deployed using EC2 execution instances, which meets the environmental requirements of the question.

2. **Why the other options are incorrect:**
   - **Options A and D**: Application Load Balancer (ALB) works at Layer 7 and only supports HTTP/HTTPS traffic and does not support UDP traffic, so it cannot meet the requirements of the question.
   - **Option B**: Amazon CloudFront is primarily used for content delivery (CDN). Although it supports WebSocket, it has limited support for general UDP traffic. In addition, AWS Lambda is a serverless computing service and cannot run "modified Linux kernel", and Lambda itself is not suitable for handling game UDP traffic that requires long-term connection.
題目(中): 一家遊戲公司正在設計一個高可用性的架構。該應用程式運行在修改過的 Linux 核心上，且僅支援基於 UDP 的流量。該公司需要前端層提供最佳的使用者體驗。該層必須具備低延遲、將流量路由至最近的邊緣節點，並提供靜態 IP 位址作為應用程式端點的入口。解決方案架構師應該怎麼做才能滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 設定 Amazon Route 53 將請求轉發至應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB)。在 AWS Application Auto Scaling 中使用 AWS Lambda 執行應用程式。
B. 設定 Amazon CloudFront 將請求轉發至網路負載平衡器 (NLB)。在 AWS Application Auto Scaling 群組中使用 AWS Lambda 執行應用程式。
C. 設定 AWS Global Accelerator 將請求轉發至網路負載平衡器 (NLB)。在 EC2 Auto Scaling 群組中使用 Amazon EC2 執行個體來執行應用程式。
D. 設定 Amazon API Gateway 將請求轉發至應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB)。在 EC2 Auto Scaling 群組中使用 Amazon EC2 執行個體來執行應用程式。
解析(中):
本題的核心需求在於「支援 UDP 流量」、「低延遲」、「路由至最近節點」以及「提供靜態 IP」。

1. **為什麼 C 是正確答案：**
   - **AWS Global Accelerator**：專門設計用於優化全球網路流量，它提供靜態 IP 位址作為應用程式的入口點，並利用 AWS 全球網路將流量路由至最近的健康端點，能有效降低延遲。最重要的是，Global Accelerator 支援 TCP 與 UDP 流量。
   - **網路負載平衡器 (NLB)**：NLB 工作在 OSI 模型的第四層 (Layer 4)，原生支援 UDP 流量，非常適合遊戲伺服器等需要處理大量 UDP 封包的場景。
   - **EC2 Auto Scaling**：由於應用程式運行在修改過的 Linux 核心上，必須使用 EC2 執行個體來部署，這符合題目對環境的需求。

2. **為什麼其他選項不正確：**
   - **選項 A 與 D**：應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB) 工作在第七層 (Layer 7)，僅支援 HTTP/HTTPS 流量，不支援 UDP 流量，因此無法滿足題目需求。
   - **選項 B**：Amazon CloudFront 主要用於內容傳遞 (CDN)，雖然它支援 WebSocket，但對於通用的 UDP 流量支援有限。此外，AWS Lambda 是無伺服器計算服務，無法運行「修改過的 Linux 核心」，且 Lambda 本身也不適合處理需要長期維持連線的遊戲 UDP 流量。

題目(英):
A company wants to migrate its existing on-premises monolithic application to AWS. The company wants to keep as much of the front-end
code and the backend code as possible. However, the company wants to break the application into smaller applications. A different team will
manage each application. The company needs a highly scalable solution that minimizes operational overhead.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Host the application on AWS Lambda. Integrate the application with Amazon API Gateway.
B. Host the application with AWS Amplify. Connect the application to an Amazon API Gateway API that is integrated with AWS Lambda.
C. Host the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Set up an Application Load Balancer with EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group as
targets.
D. Host the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up an Application Load Balancer with Amazon ECS as the
target.
解析(英):
The correct answer is D for the following reasons:
1. **Comply with splitting requirements**: Containerization is an industry standard practice when splitting a monolithic application into smaller services (microservices). Amazon ECS allows applications to be packaged in containers, which allows different teams to independently manage their own containerized services, which meets the requirement of "managing individual applications by different teams" in the question.
2. **Keep the code**: Compared to rewriting the code into a Lambda function (Serverless architecture), using containers allows the company to retain most of the existing back-end code. It only needs to be packaged in a Docker image file for migration, which meets the requirement of "preserving as much code as possible".
3. **High scalability and maintenance burden**: ECS provides a high degree of scalability and can be perfectly integrated with Application Load Balancer (ALB) to handle traffic distribution. Compared to EC2 (Option C), ECS reduces the maintenance burden at the operating system level (especially when using the Fargate launch type).

Reasons why other options are incorrect:
- **Options A and B**: These options involve refactoring the application to a serverless architecture (AWS Lambda).
