C. 創建一個 AWS CloudFormation 堆疊，以部署一個 AWS Lambda 函數。配置 Lambda 函數以查詢 RDS 數據庫中的適當成本中心，然後標記資源。創建一個 Amazon EventBridge 排程規則，以調用 CloudFormation 堆疊。
D. 創建一個 AWS Lambda 函數，以標記資源的默認值。配置一個 Amazon EventBridge 規則，反應 AWS CloudTrail 事件，以調用 Lambda 函數當資源缺少成本中心標籤時。
解析(中): 答案是 A，因為這個解決方案使用服務控制策略 (SCP) 來強制執行資源創建的標籤需求。SCP 可以定義在組織單位 (OU) 級別，這意味著所有在該 OU 中創建的資源都必須符合 SCP 中定義的標籤需求。在這種情況下，SCP 需要所有資源在創建之前具有正確的成本中心標籤。這個解決方案是最有效的，因為它在資源創建時就強制執行標籤需求，避免了資源創建後需要手動標記的問題。其他選項不正確，因為它們需要額外的步驟或不提供相同級別的強制執行。選項 B 和 D 需要使用 AWS Lambda 函數和 Amazon EventBridge 規則，這增加了複雜性和延遲。選項 C 使用 AWS CloudFormation 堆疊和排程規則，這也增加了複雜性和可能的錯誤。因此，選項 A 是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company recently migrated its web application to the AWS Cloud. The company uses an Amazon EC2 instance to run multiple processes to
host the application. The processes include an Apache web server that serves static content. The Apache web server makes requests to a
PHP application that uses a local Redis server for user sessions.
The company wants to redesign the architecture to be highly available and to use AWS managed solutions.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to host the static content and the PHP application. Congure Elastic Beanstalk to deploy its EC2 instance
into a public subnet. Assign a public IP address.
B. Use AWS Lambda to host the static content and the PHP application. Use an Amazon API Gateway REST API to proxy requests to the
Lambda function. Set the API Gateway CORS conguration to respond to the domain name. Congure Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to
handle session information.
C. Keep the backend code on the EC2 instance. Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster that has Multi-AZ enabled. Congure the
ElastiCache for Redis cluster in cluster mode. Copy the frontend resources to Amazon S3. Congure the backend code to reference the
EC2 instance.
D. Congure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an Amazon S3 endpoint to an S3 bucket that is congured to host the static content.
Congure an Application Load Balancer that targets an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service that runs AWS Fargate
tasks for the PHP application. Congure the PHP application to use an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster that runs in multiple
Availability Zones.
解析(英): Answer D is correct because it addresses the need for high availability and using a solution managed by AWS. First, using an Amazon CloudFront distribution and Amazon S3 endpoints provides high availability and low-latency access to static content. Second, using an application load balancer and Amazon ECS service can provide high availability and scalability for PHP applications. Finally, using Amazon ElastiCache for Redis clusters can provide high availability and low-latency access to session information. The other options are incorrect because they do not fully meet the needs of high availability and using an AWS-managed solution. For example, Option A only uses Elastic Beanstalk to host static content and PHP applications, but does not provide high availability and low-latency access. Option B uses AWS Lambda to host static content and PHP applications, but does not provide high availability and scalability for PHP applications. Option C keeps the backend code on the EC2 instance but does not provide high availability and low latency access. Therefore, answer D is the best choice.
題目(中): 一家公司最近將其網頁應用程式遷移到 AWS 雲端。該公司使用 Amazon EC2 實例來運行多個進程以主持應用程式。這些進程包括一個 Apache 網頁伺服器，負責提供靜態內容。Apache 網頁伺服器向使用本地 Redis 伺服器進行用戶會話的 PHP 應用程式發出請求。該公司希望重新設計架構以實現高可用性並使用 AWS 管理的解決方案。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 主持靜態內容和 PHP 應用程式。設定 Elastic Beanstalk 將其 EC2 實例部署到公用子網路中，並分配公用 IP 地址。
B. 使用 AWS Lambda 主持靜態內容和 PHP 應用程式。使用 Amazon API Gateway REST API 將請求代理到 Lambda 函數。設定 API Gateway CORS 配置以響應域名。設定 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 處理會話資訊。
C. 保留 EC2 實例上的後端代碼。建立一個啟用多可用區的 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 叢集。設定 ElastiCache for Redis 叢集在叢集模式下運行。將前端資源複製到 Amazon S3。設定後端代碼參考 EC2 實例。
D. 設定 Amazon CloudFront 分佈以使用 Amazon S3 端點連接到配置為主持靜態內容的 S3 儲存桶。設定應用程式負載平衡器以將目標設為 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 服務，該服務運行 AWS Fargate 任務以執行 PHP 應用程式。設定 PHP 應用程式使用在多個可用區域運行的 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 叢集。
解析(中): 答案 D 是正確的，因為它滿足了高可用性和使用 AWS 管理的解決方案的需求。首先，使用 Amazon CloudFront 分佈和 Amazon S3 端點可以提供靜態內容的高可用性和低延遲的存取。其次，使用應用程式負載平衡器和 Amazon ECS 服務可以提供 PHP 應用程式的高可用性和可擴展性。最後，使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 叢集可以提供高可用性和低延遲的會話資訊存取。其他選項不正確，因為它們沒有完全滿足高可用性和使用 AWS 管理的解決方案的需求。例如，選項 A 只使用 Elastic Beanstalk 主持靜態內容和 PHP 應用程式，但沒有提供高可用性和低延遲的存取。選項 B 使用 AWS Lambda 主持靜態內容和 PHP 應用程式，但沒有提供高可用性和可擴展性的 PHP 應用程式。選項 C 保留 EC2 實例上的後端代碼，但沒有提供高可用性和低延遲的存取。因此，答案 D 是最好的選擇。

題目(英):
A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group that has a target group. The company designed the
application to work with session anity (sticky sessions) for a better user experience.
The application must be available publicly over the internet as an endpoint. A WAF must be applied to the endpoint for additional security.
Session anity (sticky sessions) must be congured on the endpoint.
Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Create a public Network Load Balancer. Specify the application target group.
B. Create a Gateway Load Balancer. Specify the application target group.
C. Create a public Application Load Balancer. Specify the application target group.
D. Create a second target group. Add Elastic IP addresses to the EC2 instances.
E. Create a web ACL in AWS WAF. Associate the web ACL with the endpoint
解析(英): To meet these requirements, we need web ACLs using a public Application Load Balancer and AWS WAF. Utility application load balancers can provide session affinity (sticky sessions) and can also apply WAF to endpoints for added security. Therefore, options C and E are the correct combination. Option A's network load balancer does not support session affinity, Option B's gateway load balancer is primarily used for third-party virtual network functionality, and Option D's second target group and Elastic IP address do not suffice. Therefore, the correct answer is CE.
題目(中): 一家公司在具有目標群組的 Auto Scaling 群組中運行 Amazon EC2 實例上的網頁應用程式。該公司設計了應用程式以使用會話親和性（sticky sessions）來提供更好的使用者體驗。應用程式必須作為端點公開在網際網路上。必須將 WAF 應用於端點以增加安全性。必須在端點上設定會話親和性（sticky sessions）。哪種組合的步驟可以滿足這些要求？（選擇兩個。）
選項(中):
A. 建立公用網路負載平衡器。指定應用程式目標群組。
B. 建立閘道負載平衡器。指定應用程式目標群組。
C. 建立公用應用程式負載平衡器。指定應用程式目標群組。
D. 建立第二個目標群組。將彈性 IP 地址添加到 EC2 實例。
E. 建立 AWS WAF 的網頁 ACL。將網頁 ACL 與端點關聯
解析(中): 為了滿足這些要求，我們需要使用公用應用程式負載平衡器（Application Load Balancer）和 AWS WAF 的網頁 ACL。公用應用程式負載平衡器可以提供會話親和性（sticky sessions）的功能，同時也可以將 WAF 應用於端點以增加安全性。因此，選項 C 和 E 是正確的組合。選項 A 的網路負載平衡器不支援會話親和性，選項 B 的閘道負載平衡器主要用於第三方虛擬網路功能，選項 D 的第二個目標群組和彈性 IP 地址不能滿足要求。因此，正確答案是 CE。

題目(英):
A company runs a website that stores images of historical events. Website users need the ability to search and view images based on the
year that the event in the image occurred. On average, users request each image only once or twice a year. The company wants a highly
available solution to store and deliver the images to users.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
選項(英):
A. Store images in Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS). Use a web server that runs on Amazon EC2.
B. Store images in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Use a web server that runs on Amazon EC2.
C. Store images in Amazon S3 Standard. Use S3 Standard to directly deliver images by using a static website.
D. Store images in Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA). Use S3 Standard-IA to directly deliver images by using a static
website.
解析(英): The answer is D, because Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) is a storage type that is well-suited for storing data that is accessed infrequently. According to the title description, users only request each image once or twice per year, which means that the images are not accessed frequently. The storage cost of S3 Standard-IA is much lower than that of S3 Standard, but its access speed and availability are still very high. Additionally, using S3 Standard-IA to deliver images directly and use static websites reduces the need for Amazon EC2, thereby lowering overall costs. Therefore, option D is the most cost-effective solution. Options A and B require Amazon EC2, adding cost and management complexity. Option C uses S3 Standard, but its storage costs are higher than S3 Standard-IA. Therefore, option D is the best choice.
題目(中): 一家公司運營一個網站，該網站存儲歷史事件的圖片。網站用戶需要根據圖片中事件發生的年份搜索和查看圖片的能力。平均而言，用戶每年只請求每張圖片一次或兩次。公司希望有一個高可用的解決方案來存儲和傳遞圖片給用戶。哪種解決方案能夠以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將圖片存儲在 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 中。使用在 Amazon EC2 上運行的網頁伺服器。
B. 將圖片存儲在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 中。使用在 Amazon EC2 上運行的網頁伺服器。
C. 將圖片存儲在 Amazon S3 Standard 中。使用 S3 Standard 直接傳遞圖片，並使用靜態網站。
D. 將圖片存儲在 Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 中。使用 S3 Standard-IA 直接傳遞圖片，並使用靜態網站。
解析(中): 答案是 D，因為 Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 是一個非常適合存儲不經常存取的資料的儲存類型。根據題目描述，用戶每年只請求每張圖片一次或兩次，這意味著圖片不經常被存取。S3 Standard-IA 的儲存成本比 S3 Standard 低很多，但是它的存取速度和可用性仍然非常高。另外，使用 S3 Standard-IA 直接傳遞圖片並使用靜態網站，可以減少對 Amazon EC2 的需求，從而降低整體成本。因此，選項 D 是最具成本效益的解決方案。選項 A 和 B 需要使用 Amazon EC2，增加了成本和管理複雜性。選項 C 使用 S3 Standard，但是它的儲存成本比 S3 Standard-IA 高。因此，選項 D 是最好的選擇。

題目(英):
A company has multiple AWS accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations that different business units use. The company has multiple
oces around the world. The company needs to update security group rules to allow new oce CIDR ranges or to remove old CIDR ranges
across the organization. The company wants to centralize the management of security group rules to minimize the administrative overhead
that updating CIDR ranges requires.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
選項(英):
A. Create VPC security groups in the organization's management account. Update the security groups when a CIDR range update is
necessary.
B. Create a VPC customer managed prex list that contains the list of CIDRs. Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the
prex list across the organization. Use the prex list in the security groups across the organization.
C. Create an AWS managed prex list. Use an AWS Security Hub policy to enforce the security group update across the organization. Use
an AWS Lambda function to update the prex list automatically when the CIDR ranges change.
D. Create security groups in a central administrative AWS account. Create an AWS Firewall Manager common security group policy for the
whole organization. Select the previously created security groups as primary groups in the policy.
解析(英):
Answer B is the most cost-effective solution. This is because using AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) shared prefix lists allows companies to centrally manage security group rules while minimizing administrative burden. By establishing a VPC customer-managed prefix list that contains a list of CIDR ranges, companies can easily update security group rules without having to manually update each security group.

Choice A is incorrect because establishing a VPC security group in a management account does not automatically update the security group rules in other accounts. Choice C is incorrect because using AWS Security Hub policies and AWS Lambda functions adds unnecessary complexity and cost. Choice D is incorrect because AWS Firewall Manager common security group policies do not support centralized management of security group rules.

Therefore, Option B is the most appropriate solution as it provides a simple, centralized, and cost-effective way to manage security group rules while minimizing the administrative burden.
題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中擁有多個 AWS 帳戶，供不同業務單位使用。該公司在全球各地設有多個辦公室。公司需要更新安全群組規則，以允許新的辦公室 CIDR 範圍或移除舊的 CIDR 範圍，遍及整個組織。公司希望集中管理安全群組規則，以最小化更新 CIDR 範圍所需的管理負擔。哪種解決方案能夠以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在組織的管理帳戶中建立 VPC 安全群組。當需要更新 CIDR 範圍時，更新安全群組。
B. 建立一個包含 CIDR 範圍列表的 VPC 客戶管理前綴列表。使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 在組織中共享前綴列表。在組織中的安全群組中使用前綴列表。
C. 建立一個 AWS 管理的前綴列表。使用 AWS Security Hub 政策強制執行安全群組更新，遍及整個組織。使用 AWS Lambda 函數自動更新前綴列表，當 CIDR 範圍發生變化時。
D. 在中央管理 AWS 帳戶中建立安全群組。建立一個適用於整個組織的 AWS Firewall Manager 共同安全群組政策。將之前建立的安全群組選為政策中的主要群組。
解析(中):
答案 B 是最具成本效益的解決方案。這是因為使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 共享前綴列表可以讓公司集中管理安全群組規則，同時最小化管理負擔。通過建立一個包含 CIDR 範圍列表的 VPC 客戶管理前綴列表，公司可以輕鬆地更新安全群組規則，而不需要手動更新每個安全群組。

選項 A 不正確，因為在管理帳戶中建立 VPC 安全群組並不會自動更新其他帳戶中的安全群組規則。選項 C 不正確，因為使用 AWS Security Hub 政策和 AWS Lambda 函數會增加不必要的複雜性和成本。選項 D 不正確，因為 AWS Firewall Manager 共同安全群組政策不支援集中管理安全群組規則。

因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案，因為它提供了一種簡單、集中化和成本有效的方式來管理安全群組規則，同時最小化管理負擔。

題目(英):
A company uses an on-premises network-attached storage (NAS) system to provide le shares to its high performance computing (HPC)
workloads. The company wants to migrate its latency-sensitive HPC workloads and its storage to the AWS Cloud. The company must be able
to provide NFS and SMB multi-protocol access from the le system.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST latency? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Deploy compute optimized EC2 instances into a cluster placement group.
B. Deploy compute optimized EC2 instances into a partition placement group.
C. Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for Lustre le system.
D. Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS le system.
E. Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP le system.
解析(英): According to the title description, the company needs to migrate latency-sensitive HPC workloads and storage to the AWS cloud and provide NFS and SMB multi-protocol access. To meet these needs and have the lowest latency, the correct answer is AE. Option A, deploying compute-optimized EC2 instances into a cluster placement group can provide low-latency computing resources. Option E, attach the EC2 instance to the Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system, which can provide NFS and SMB multi-protocol access, and NetApp ONTAP is an industry-leading storage solution that can provide high-performance and low-latency storage services. The reasons why the other options are incorrect are: option B, split placement groups are not suitable for HPC workloads that require low latency; option C, Amazon FSx for Luster file system is mainly targeted at high-performance computing and machine learning workloads, and does not provide NFS and SMB multi-protocol access; option D, Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system does not provide NFS and SMB multi-protocol access. Therefore, AE is the most suitable solution.
題目(中): 一家公司使用內部網路附加儲存（NAS）系統為其高效能計算（HPC）工作負載提供檔案共享。該公司希望將其延遲敏感的HPC工作負載和儲存遷移到AWS雲端。該公司必須能夠從檔案系統提供NFS和SMB多協定存取。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求並具有最低延遲？（選擇兩個。）
選項(中):
A. 將計算最佳化的EC2實例部署到集群放置群組中。
B. 將計算最佳化的EC2實例部署到分割放置群組中。
C. 將EC2實例附加到Amazon FSx for Lustre檔案系統。
D. 將EC2實例附加到Amazon FSx for OpenZFS檔案系統。
E. 將EC2實例附加到Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP檔案系統。
解析(中): 根據題目描述，公司需要將延遲敏感的HPC工作負載和儲存遷移到AWS雲端，並提供NFS和SMB多協定存取。為了滿足這些需求並具有最低延遲，正確答案是AE。選項A，部署計算最佳化的EC2實例到集群放置群組中，可以提供低延遲的計算資源。選項E，將EC2實例附加到Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP檔案系統，可以提供NFS和SMB多協定存取，並且NetApp ONTAP是業界領先的儲存解決方案，能夠提供高效能和低延遲的儲存服務。其他選項不正確的原因是：選項B，分割放置群組不適合需要低延遲的HPC工作負載；選項C，Amazon FSx for Lustre檔案系統主要針對高效能計算和機器學習工作負載，不提供NFS和SMB多協定存取；選項D，Amazon FSx for OpenZFS檔案系統不提供NFS和SMB多協定存取。因此，AE是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is relocating its data center and wants to securely transfer 50 TB of data to AWS within 2 weeks. The existing data center has a
Site-to-Site VPN connection to AWS that is 90% utilized.
Which AWS service should a solutions architect use to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. AWS DataSync with a VPC endpoint
B. AWS Direct Connect
C. AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized
D. AWS Storage Gateway
解析(英):
According to the topic description, the company needs to transfer 50 TB of data to AWS within 2 weeks, and the existing VPN connection is already 90% used, which means that the existing connection may not be able to bear such a large amount of data transfer. Therefore, a solution that can transfer large amounts of data quickly and securely is needed. 
Option A, AWS DataSync, is mainly used for data synchronization and transfer, but it requires a stable network connection, which may not be enough if the VPN connection is already 90% used. 
Option B, AWS Direct Connect, provides a dedicated network connection, but it may take longer to establish and may not be completed within 2 weeks. 
Option D, AWS Storage Gateway, is mainly used to integrate existing storage systems with AWS, but it is not suitable for transferring large amounts of data. 
Option C, storage-optimized AWS Snowball Edge, provides an offline data transfer solution that uses physical devices to transfer data to AWS. It can transfer large amounts of data quickly and does not rely on network connections, so it is the most suitable choice.
題目(中): 一家公司正在遷移其資料中心，並希望在 2 周內安全地將 50 TB 的資料轉移到 AWS。現有的資料中心具有與 AWS 的站點對站點 VPN 連接，該連接的使用率為 90%。解決方案架構師應該使用哪項 AWS 服務來滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 搭配 VPC 端點的 AWS DataSync
B. AWS Direct Connect
C. 優化儲存的 AWS Snowball Edge
D. AWS Storage Gateway
解析(中):
根據題目描述，公司需要在 2 周內將 50 TB 的資料轉移到 AWS，而現有的 VPN 連接已經使用了 90%，這意味著現有的連接可能無法承擔如此大量的資料傳輸。因此，需要一個能夠快速、安全地傳輸大量資料的解決方案。 
選項 A，AWS DataSync，主要用於資料同步和傳輸，但它需要穩定的網路連接，如果 VPN 連接已經使用了 90%，可能無法滿足需求。 
選項 B，AWS Direct Connect，提供了一條專用的網路連接，但建立這種連接可能需要較長的時間，可能無法在 2 周內完成。 
選項 D，AWS Storage Gateway，主要用於將現有的儲存系統與 AWS 整合，但它不適合用於大量資料的傳輸。

題目(英):
A company hosts an application on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group. Application peak hours occur at the same
time each day. Application users report slow application performance at the start of peak hours. The application performs normally 2-3 hours
after peak hours begin. The company wants to ensure that the application works properly at the start of peak hours.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Congure an Application Load Balancer to distribute trac properly to the instances.
B. Congure a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on memory utilization.
C. Congure a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on CPU utilization.
D. Congure a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances before peak hours.
解析(英): According to the problem description, the company's application will experience slow execution speed at the beginning of the peak period every day, but will return to normal within 2-3 hours after the peak period begins. This indicates that the load on the application suddenly increases at the beginning of peak hours, causing the instance to be insufficient to handle the traffic. Therefore, a solution is needed to launch new instances in advance to meet demand during peak hours. Option D is the most appropriate solution because it configures the Auto Scaling group's scheduled scaling policy to launch new instances before the peak period to ensure that the application has enough instances to handle the traffic when the peak period begins. Option A can only allocate traffic to existing instances, but cannot increase the number of instances. Dynamic scaling strategies for Options B and C launch new instances based on memory usage or CPU usage, but these metrics may not accurately reflect demand during peak hours and may result in delayed instance launches. Therefore, option D is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在 Auto Scaling 群組中使用 Amazon EC2 按需實例來主機應用程式。應用程式的高峰時段每天在相同的時間發生。使用者在高峰時段開始時報告應用程式執行速度慢。應用程式在高峰時段開始後 2-3 小時內執行正常。公司希望確保應用程式在高峰時段開始時能夠正常運作。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 配置應用程式負載平衡器，以正確地將流量分配到實例。
B. 配置 Auto Scaling 群組的動態擴展策略，以根據記憶體使用率啟動新實例。
C. 配置 Auto Scaling 群組的動態擴展策略，以根據 CPU 使用率啟動新實例。
D. 配置 Auto Scaling 群組的排程擴展策略，在高峰時段之前啟動新實例。
解析(中): 根據題目描述，公司的應用程式在每天的高峰時段開始時會出現執行速度慢的問題，但在高峰時段開始後 2-3 小時內會恢復正常。這表明應用程式的負載在高峰時段開始時會突然增加，導致實例不足以處理流量。因此，需要一個解決方案來提前啟動新實例，以滿足高峰時段的需求。選項 D 是最合適的解決方案，因為它可以配置 Auto Scaling 群組的排程擴展策略，在高峰時段之前啟動新實例，以確保應用程式在高峰時段開始時有足夠的實例來處理流量。選項 A 只能分配流量到現有的實例，但不能增加實例的數量。選項 B 和 C 的動態擴展策略是根據記憶體使用率或 CPU 使用率來啟動新實例，但這些指標可能不能準確反映高峰時段的需求，而且可能會導致實例啟動延遲。因此，選項 D 是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company runs applications on AWS that connect to the company's Amazon RDS database. The applications scale on weekends and at peak
times of the year. The company wants to scale the database more effectively for its applications that connect to the database.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Use Amazon DynamoDB with connection pooling with a target group conguration for the database. Change the applications to use the
DynamoDB endpoint.
B. Use Amazon RDS Proxy with a target group for the database. Change the applications to use the RDS Proxy endpoint.
C. Use a custom proxy that runs on Amazon EC2 as an intermediary to the database. Change the applications to use the custom proxy
endpoint.
D. Use an AWS Lambda function to provide connection pooling with a target group conguration for the database. Change the applications
to use the Lambda function.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B because Amazon RDS Proxy is a fully managed database proxy service that helps reduce the number of connections between applications and databases, thereby reducing load and latency on the database. Using RDS Proxy, you can scale your database more efficiently to meet the needs of the applications that connect to your database. In addition, RDS Proxy can also provide connection pool settings and target group settings, making it easier for applications to connect to the database.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Using Amazon DynamoDB requires modifying your application to use the DynamoDB endpoint, which may require extensive code modification and testing. In addition, DynamoDB's data model is different from that of RDS, which may require additional data conversion and processing.
C. Using a custom agent needs to run on Amazon EC2, requiring management and maintenance of EC2 instances, which increases the operational burden. Additionally, custom proxies may require additional code modification and testing.
D. Using AWS Lambda functions requires modifying the application to use Lambda functions, which may require extensive code modification and testing. In addition, the execution time and memory limitations of Lambda functions may affect the performance and availability of the library.

Therefore, using Amazon RDS Proxy is the best solution as it provides the least operational burden and the best performance and availability.
題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS 上運行應用程式，連接到公司的 Amazon RDS 數據庫。這些應用程式在週末和一年中的高峰時段會進行擴展。公司希望更有效地擴展數據庫，以滿足連接到數據庫的應用程式的需求。哪種解決方案能夠在最少的操作負擔下滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 Amazon DynamoDB 並搭配目標群組設定進行連接池設定，修改應用程式以使用 DynamoDB 端點。
B. 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 並搭配目標群組設定，修改應用程式以使用 RDS Proxy 端點。
C. 使用在 Amazon EC2 上運行的自訂代理作為數據庫的中間層，修改應用程式以使用自訂代理端點。
D. 使用 AWS Lambda 函數提供連接池設定並搭配目標群組設定，修改應用程式以使用 Lambda 函數。
解析(中):
正確答案是 B，因為 Amazon RDS Proxy 是一種完全管理的資料庫代理服務，可以幫助減少應用程式和資料庫之間的連接數量，從而降低資料庫的負載和延遲。使用 RDS Proxy，可以更有效地擴展資料庫，以滿足連接到資料庫的應用程式的需求。另外，RDS Proxy 還可以提供連接池設定和目標群組設定，讓應用程式可以更容易地連接到資料庫。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. 使用 Amazon DynamoDB 需要修改應用程式以使用 DynamoDB 端點，這可能需要大量的程式碼修改和測試。此外，DynamoDB 的資料模型和 RDS 的資料模型不同，可能需要額外的資料轉換和處理。
C. 使用自訂代理需要在 Amazon EC2 上運行，需要管理和維護 EC2 實例，增加了操作負擔。此外，自訂代理可能需要額外的程式碼修改和測試。
D. 使用 AWS Lambda 函數需要修改應用程式以使用 Lambda 函數，可能需要大量的程式碼修改和測試。此外，Lambda 函數的執行時間和記憶體限制可能會影響資料庫的性能和可用性。

因此，使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 是最好的解決方案，因為它可以提供最少的操作負擔和最好的性能和可用性。

E. Create an Application Load Balancer to distribute trac to an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances that are distributed across two
Availability Zones.
解析(英): To achieve high availability for a website, the solutions architect needs to take two actions: B and E. Option B Migrating the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance ensures high availability and durability of the database. This is because RDS Multi-AZ DB instances can automatically synchronize data across multiple Availability Zones, ensuring data security and availability. Option E creates an application load balancer to distribute traffic to an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances spread across two Availability Zones to ensure high availability and scalability of the application. This is because load balancers automatically distribute traffic across multiple instances, ensuring application availability and scalability. The other options are incorrect because option A only deploys an Internet gateway and cannot ensure high availability; option C migrates the database to DynamoDB, which may require modifications to the application code; option D uses DataSync to synchronize database data, which cannot ensure high availability and durability. Therefore, the correct answer is BE.
題目(中): 一家創業公司正在使用 Amazon EC2 實例為其客戶主持一個網站。網站由一個無狀態的 Python 應用程式和一個 MySQL 數據庫組成。網站只服務少量的流量。公司對實例的可靠性感到擔憂，需要遷移到高可用性架構。公司無法修改應用程式代碼。哪種組合的動作應該由解決方案架構師採取，以實現網站的高可用性？（選擇兩個。）
選項(中):
A. 在使用的每個可用區域中佈建一個網際網關。
B. 將數據庫遷移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 多可用區域 DB 實例。
C. 將數據庫遷移到 Amazon DynamoDB，並啟用 DynamoDB 自動擴展。
D. 使用 AWS DataSync 將數據庫數據在多個 EC2 實例之間同步。
E. 建立一個應用程式負載平衡器，以將流量分配到一個 Auto Scaling 群組的 EC2 實例，這些實例分佈在兩個可用區域。
解析(中): 為了實現網站的高可用性，解決方案架構師需要採取兩個動作：B 和 E。選項 B 將數據庫遷移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 多可用區域 DB 實例，可以確保數據庫的高可用性和耐用性。這是因為 RDS 多可用區域 DB 實例可以自動在多個可用區域之間同步數據，從而確保數據的安全性和可用性。選項 E 建立一個應用程式負載平衡器，以將流量分配到一個 Auto Scaling 群組的 EC2 實例，這些實例分佈在兩個可用區域，可以確保應用程式的高可用性和可擴展性。這是因為負載平衡器可以自動將流量分配到多個實例，從而確保應用程式的可用性和可擴展性。其他選項不正確，因為選項 A 只是佈建網際網關，不能確保高可用性；選項 C 將數據庫遷移到 DynamoDB，可能需要修改應用程式代碼；選項 D 使用 DataSync 將數據庫數據同步，不能確保高可用性和耐用性。因此，正確答案是 BE。

題目(英):
A company is moving its data and applications to AWS during a multiyear migration project. The company wants to securely access data on
Amazon S3 from the company's AWS Region and from the company's on-premises location. The data must not traverse the internet. The
company has established an AWS Direct Connect connection between its Region and its on-premises location.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create gateway endpoints for Amazon S3. Use the gateway endpoints to securely access the data from the Region and the on-premises
location.
B. Create a gateway in AWS Transit Gateway to access Amazon S3 securely from the Region and the on-premises location.
C. Create interface endpoints for Amazon S3. Use the interface endpoints to securely access the data from the Region and the on-
premises location.
D. Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key to access the data securely from the Region and the on-premises location.
解析(英): The answer is C because Interface Endpoints are private endpoints provided by AWS that allow you to securely access Amazon S3 from a VPC or on-premises location without going through the Internet. Since the company has established an AWS Direct Connect connection, using interface endpoints ensures that data remains private and secure during transmission. The reasons why the other options are incorrect are: the Gateway Endpoints in option A can only be used for S3 and DynamoDB and need to go through the Internet; the AWS Transit Gateway in option B requires additional settings and configuration; the AWS KMS key in option D can only be used to encrypt and decrypt data, and cannot be used to access Amazon S3. Therefore, establishing an interface endpoint for Amazon S3 is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司正在進行多年遷移項目，將其資料和應用程式遷移到 AWS。公司希望從其 AWS 區域和公司的內部部署位置安全地存取 Amazon S3 上的資料。資料不得經過互聯網傳輸。公司已在其區域和內部部署位置之間建立了 AWS Direct Connect 連接。哪種解決方案可以滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立 Amazon S3 的閘道端點。使用閘道端點從區域和內部部署位置安全地存取資料。
B. 在 AWS Transit Gateway 中建立閘道，以安全地從區域和內部部署位置存取 Amazon S3。
C. 建立 Amazon S3 的介面端點。使用介面端點從區域和內部部署位置安全地存取資料。
D. 使用 AWS 金鑰管理服務 (AWS KMS) 金鑰從區域和內部部署位置安全地存取資料。
解析(中): 答案是 C，因為介面端點 (Interface Endpoints) 是 AWS 提供的一種私有端點，可以讓您從 VPC 或內部部署位置安全地存取 Amazon S3，無需經過互聯網。由於公司已經建立了 AWS Direct Connect 連接，使用介面端點可以確保資料在傳輸過程中保持私有和安全。其他選項不正確的原因是：A 選項中的閘道端點 (Gateway Endpoints) 只能用於 S3 和 DynamoDB，且需要經過互聯網；B 選項中的 AWS Transit Gateway 需要額外的設定和配置；D 選項中的 AWS KMS 金鑰只能用於加密和解密資料，不能用於存取 Amazon S3。因此，建立 Amazon S3 的介面端點是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):

題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中創建了一個新的組織，該組織包含多個用於公司開發團隊的帳戶。開發團隊成員使用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 來存取這些帳戶。對於公司的每個應用程式，開發團隊必須使用預先定義的應用程式名稱來標記創建的資源。一個解決方案架構師需要設計一個解決方案，以便開發團隊只能在應用程式名稱標記具有批准值的情況下創建資源。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 創建一個 IAM 群組，它具有條件允許政策，要求資源創建時指定應用程式名稱標記。

題目(英):

題目(英):
A company performs tests on an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table. The tests run for 4 hours once a week. The company
knows how many read and write operations the application performs to the table each second during the tests. The company does not
currently use DynamoDB for any other use case. A solutions architect needs to optimize the costs for the table.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Choose on-demand mode. Update the read and write capacity units appropriately.
B. Choose provisioned mode. Update the read and write capacity units appropriately.
C. Purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity for a 1-year term.

解析(英): According to the question description, the company's test runs for 4 hours per week, and the number of read and write operations per second performed by the application on the table is known. This means companies can predict the read and write needs of their DynamoDB tables. Therefore, choosing Provisioned Mode is the most suitable choice. Reservation mode allows companies to optimize costs by setting units of read and write capacity based on their forecasted needs. Choosing On-Demand Mode may result in unpredictable costs, while purchasing DynamoDB Reserved Capacity requires a long-term commitment and may not be suitable for your company's needs. Therefore, option B is the correct answer. Choice A is incorrect because the on-demand model is not suitable for a company's predictable needs. Options C and D are incorrect because purchasing reserved capacity requires a long-term commitment and may not be appropriate for the company's needs.
題目(中): 一家公司對使用 Amazon DynamoDB 表的應用程序進行測試。測試每周運行 4 小時。公司知道應用程序在測試期間每秒對表進行的讀取和寫入操作數。公司目前不使用 DynamoDB 進行任何其他用例。解決方案架構師需要優化表的成本。
選項(中):

解析(中): 根據題目描述，公司的測試每周運行 4 小時，且知道應用程序每秒對表進行的讀取和寫入操作數。這意味著公司可以預測其 DynamoDB 表的讀取和寫入需求。因此，選擇預留模式（Provisioned Mode）是最適合的選擇。預留模式允許公司根據其預測的需求設定讀取和寫入容量單位，從而優化成本。選擇按需模式（On-Demand Mode）可能會導致成本不可預測，而購買 DynamoDB 預留容量（Reserved Capacity）需要長期承諾，可能不適合公司的需求。因此，選項 B 是正確答案。選項 A 不正確，因為按需模式不適合公司可預測的需求。選項 C 和 D 不正確，因為購買預留容量需要長期承諾，可能不適合公司的需求。

題目(中): 一家公司在其資料中心運行一個SMB檔案伺服器。檔案伺服器儲存大量檔案，公司經常在檔案建立日期後的7天內存取這些檔案。在7天後，公司需要能夠在24小時內存取檔案的最大取回時間。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？

題目(英):
A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The application uses a database that runs on an
Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. The application performs slowly when trac increases. The database experiences a heavy read load
during periods of high trac.
Which actions should a solutions architect take to resolve these performance issues? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Turn on auto scaling for the DB instance.
B. Create a read replica for the DB instance. Congure the application to send read trac to the read replica.
C. Convert the DB instance to a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment. Congure the application to send read trac to the standby DB
instance.
D. Create an Amazon ElastiCache cluster. Congure the application to cache query results in the ElastiCache cluster.
E. Congure the Auto Scaling group subnets to ensure that the EC2 instances are provisioned in the same Availability Zone as the DB
instance.
解析(英):
To address these performance issues, solutions architects need to take two actions. The correct answers are A and C. 
Option A enables automatic expansion of DB instances, which allows the database to automatically increase the number of instances when traffic increases to cope with the increase in read load. This improves database performance and availability.
Option C converts the DB instance to a multi-AZ DB instance deployment, which provides high availability and fault tolerance. Setting the application to send read traffic to the standby DB instance can reduce the read load on the primary DB instance and improve performance.
The other options are incorrect because:
Option B Creating a read replica can reduce the read load on the primary DB instance, but requires configuring the application to send read traffic to the read replica, which may require modifications to the application code.
Option D Creating an Amazon ElastiCache cluster can improve query performance, but it requires configuring the application to cache query results in the ElastiCache cluster, which may require modifications to the application code.
Option E sets the subnet of the Auto Scaling group to ensure that the EC2 instance is deployed in the same availability zone as the DB instance. This can reduce network latency, but it cannot directly solve the database read load problem.
題目(中): 一家公司在 Auto Scaling 群組中的 Amazon EC2 實例上運行 Web 應用程式。該應用程式使用在 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB 實例上運行的資料庫。在流量增加時，應用程式執行速度變慢，資料庫在高流量期間會遇到重大的讀取負載。哪些行動可以讓解決方案架構師解決這些效能問題？（選擇兩個。）
選項(中):
A. 啟用 DB 實例的自動擴展。
B. 為 DB 實例建立讀取複製品。設定應用程式將讀取流量發送到讀取複製品。
C. 將 DB 實例轉換為多可用區域的 DB 實例部署。設定應用程式將讀取流量發送到待機 DB 實例。
D. 建立 Amazon ElastiCache 叢集。設定應用程式在 ElastiCache 叢集中快取查詢結果。
E. 設定 Auto Scaling 群組的子網路，以確保 EC2 實例在與 DB 實例相同的可用區域中佈建。
解析(中):
為了解決這些效能問題，解決方案架構師需要採取兩個行動。正確答案是 A 和 C。 
選項 A 啟用 DB 實例的自動擴展，可以讓資料庫在流量增加時自動增加實例數量，以應對讀取負載的增加。這可以提高資料庫的效能和可用性。
選項 C 將 DB 實例轉換為多可用區域的 DB 實例部署，可以提供高可用性和容錯能力。設定應用程式將讀取流量發送到待機 DB 實例，可以減少主 DB 實例的讀取負載，提高效能。
其他選項不正確，因為：
選項 B 建立讀取複製品可以減少主 DB 實例的讀取負載，但需要設定應用程式將讀取流量發送到讀取複製品，這可能需要修改應用程式代碼。
選項 D 建立 Amazon ElastiCache 叢集可以提高查詢效能，但需要設定應用程式在 ElastiCache 叢集中快取查詢結果，這可能需要修改應用程式代碼。
選項 E 設定 Auto Scaling 群組的子網路，以確保 EC2 實例在與 DB 實例相同的可用區域中佈建，可以減少網路延遲，但不能直接解決資料庫的讀取負載問題。

題目(英):
A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes to run an application. The company creates
one snapshot of each EBS volume every day to meet compliance requirements. The company wants to implement an architecture that
prevents the accidental deletion of EBS volume snapshots. The solution must not change the administrative rights of the storage
administrator user.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort?
選項(英):
A. Create an IAM role that has permission to delete snapshots. Attach the role to a new EC2 instance. Use the AWS CLI from the new EC2
instance to delete snapshots.
B. Create an IAM policy that denies snapshot deletion. Attach the policy to the storage administrator user.
C. Add tags to the snapshots. Create retention rules in Recycle Bin for EBS snapshots that have the tags.
D. Lock the EBS snapshots to prevent deletion.
解析(英): The correct answer to this question is D. Amazon EBS snapshot blocking prevents snapshots from being accidentally deleted without changing the storage administrator user's administrative permissions. This feature can be easily enabled in the AWS Management Console and requires no additional setup or code. Option A requires establishing new EC2 instances and IAM roles, Option B requires establishing new IAM policies, and Option C requires establishing trash retention rules, all of which require more administrative effort. Therefore, option D is the simplest and most effective solution.
題目(中): 一家公司使用 Amazon EC2 執行個體和 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷來運行一個應用程式。該公司每天為每個 EBS 卷建立一個快照，以滿足合規性要求。該公司希望實施一個架構，以防止意外刪除 EBS 卷快照。該解決方案不得更改儲存管理員使用者的管理權限。哪個解決方案能夠以最少的管理努力滿足這些要求？
選項(中):
A. 建立一個具有刪除快照權限的 IAM 角色。將角色附加到新的 EC2 執行個體。使用新的 EC2 執行個體上的 AWS CLI 刪除快照。
B. 建立一個拒絕快照刪除的 IAM 政策。將政策附加到儲存管理員使用者。
C. 將標籤添加到快照。為具有標籤的 EBS 快照建立回收筒保留規則。
D. 封鎖 EBS 快照以防止刪除。
解析(中): 對於這個問題，正確答案是 D。因為 Amazon EBS 快照的封鎖功能可以防止快照被意外刪除，而不需要更改儲存管理員使用者的管理權限。這個功能可以在 AWS 管理主控台中輕鬆啟用，且不需要額外的設定或代碼。選項 A 需要建立新的 EC2 執行個體和 IAM 角色，選項 B 需要建立新的 IAM 政策，選項 C 需要建立回收筒保留規則，所有這些選項都需要更多的管理努力。因此，選項 D 是最簡單且最有效的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company's application uses Network Load Balancers, Auto Scaling groups, Amazon EC2 instances, and databases that are deployed in an
Amazon VPC. The company wants to capture information about trac to and from the network interfaces in near real time in its Amazon VPC.
The company wants to send the information to Amazon OpenSearch Service for analysis.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Congure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis
Data Streams to stream the logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service.
B. Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Congure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis
Data Firehose to stream the logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service.
C. Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Congure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream
the logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service.
D. Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Congure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream
the logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service.
解析(英):
The answer is B because Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose automatically converts the data into the format required by OpenSearch Service and provides the ability to stream the data to OpenSearch Service. This option meets the company's need to capture network interface traffic information in near real-time and send it to OpenSearch Service for analysis.

Choice A is incorrect because Amazon Kinesis Data Streams requires additional processing and transformation to deliver data to OpenSearch Service and does not provide automatic transformation and streaming like Data Firehose.

Choices C and D are incorrect because AWS CloudTrail traces are primarily used to record API activity for AWS services, rather than capturing traffic information for network interfaces. VPC Flow Logs is a tool for capturing traffic information for network interfaces and should be used with Amazon CloudWatch Logs, not AWS CloudTrail.
題目(中): 一家公司的應用程式使用 Network Load Balancers、Auto Scaling 群組、Amazon EC2 實例和部署在 Amazon VPC 中的資料庫。該公司希望在其 Amazon VPC 中近乎實時地捕獲網路介面的流量資訊，並將這些資訊傳送到 Amazon OpenSearch Service 進行分析。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 的日誌群組。設定 VPC Flow Logs 將日誌資料傳送到日誌群組。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 將日誌從日誌群組串流到 OpenSearch Service。
B. 建立 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 的日誌群組。設定 VPC Flow Logs 將日誌資料傳送到日誌群組。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 將日誌從日誌群組串流到 OpenSearch Service。
C. 建立 AWS CloudTrail 的追蹤記錄。設定 VPC Flow Logs 將日誌資料傳送到追蹤記錄。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 將日誌從追蹤記錄串流到 OpenSearch Service。
D. 建立 AWS CloudTrail 的追蹤記錄。設定 VPC Flow Logs 將日誌資料傳送到追蹤記錄。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 將日誌從追蹤記錄串流到 OpenSearch Service。
解析(中):
答案是 B，因為 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 能夠自動將資料轉換成 OpenSearch Service 所需的格式，並提供了將資料串流到 OpenSearch Service 的功能。這個選項能夠滿足公司的需求，即近乎實時地捕獲網路介面的流量資訊並將其傳送到 OpenSearch Service 進行分析。

選項 A 不正確，因為 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 需要額外的處理和轉換才能將資料傳送到 OpenSearch Service，且不像 Data Firehose 那樣提供自動轉換和串流功能。

選項 C 和 D 不正確，因為 AWS CloudTrail 的追蹤記錄主要用於記錄 AWS 服務的 API 活動，而不是用於捕獲網路介面的流量資訊。VPC Flow Logs 是用於捕獲網路介面的流量資訊的工具，應該與 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 一起使用，而不是 AWS CloudTrail。

題目(英):
A company is developing an application that will run on a production Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The EKS
cluster has managed node groups that are provisioned with On-Demand Instances.
The company needs a dedicated EKS cluster for development work. The company will use the development cluster infrequently to test the
resiliency of the application. The EKS cluster must manage all the nodes.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
選項(英):
A. Create a managed node group that contains only Spot Instances.
B. Create two managed node groups. Provision one node group with On-Demand Instances. Provision the second node group with Spot
Instances.
C. Create an Auto Scaling group that has a launch conguration that uses Spot Instances. Congure the user data to add the nodes to the
EKS cluster.
D. Create a managed node group that contains only On-Demand Instances.
解析(英): The correct answer is A. Since companies only need to intermittently test the fault tolerance of their applications in a development environment, using Spot Instances is the most cost-effective option. Spot Instances are much cheaper than On-Demand Instances and are ideal for workloads that are intermittent or can tolerate interruptions. Option A, establishing a managed node group containing only Spot Instances, meets the company's needs and minimizes costs. The other options are incorrect because Option B requires deploying both On-Demand Instances and Spot Instances, which increases unnecessary costs; Option C requires manual setting of user data and automatic expansion of groups, which increases management complexity; Option D only uses On-Demand Instances, which is much more expensive than using Spot Instances. Therefore, option A is the most cost-effective solution.
題目(中): 一家公司正在開發一個應用程式，該應用程式將在生產環境的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 叢集上運行。EKS 叢集具有管理節點群組，該群組由按需實例（On-Demand Instances）佈建。該公司需要一個專用的 EKS 叢集用於開發工作。該公司將不常使用開發叢集來測試應用程式的容錯性。EKS 叢集必須管理所有節點。哪種解決方案能夠最具成本效益地滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立一個包含僅 Spot Instances 的管理節點群組。
B. 建立兩個管理節點群組。其中一個節點群組使用按需實例（On-Demand Instances）佈建，另一個節點群組使用 Spot Instances 佈建。
C. 建立一個具有啟動配置的自動擴展群組，該配置使用 Spot Instances。設定使用者資料以將節點添加到 EKS 叢集。
D. 建立一個包含僅按需實例（On-Demand Instances）的管理節點群組。
解析(中): 正確答案是 A。由於公司只需要在開發環境中間歇性地測試應用程式的容錯性，因此使用 Spot Instances 是最具成本效益的選擇。Spot Instances 的價格比按需實例（On-Demand Instances）低很多，非常適合於間歇性或可容忍中斷的工作負載。選項 A 建立一個包含僅 Spot Instances 的管理節點群組，可以滿足公司的需求，並且可以最小化成本。其他選項不正確，因為選項 B 需要同時佈建按需實例和 Spot Instances，增加了不必要的成本；選項 C 需要手動設定使用者資料和自動擴展群組，增加了管理複雜性；選項 D 僅使用按需實例，成本遠高於使用 Spot Instances。因此，選項 A 是最具成本效益的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company stores sensitive data in Amazon S3. A solutions architect needs to create an encryption solution. The company needs to fully
control the ability of users to create, rotate, and disable encryption keys with minimal effort for any data that must be encrypted.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use default server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) to store the sensitive data.
B. Create a customer managed key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the new key to encrypt the S3 objects by using
server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
C. Create an AWS managed key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the new key to encrypt the S3 objects by using
server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
D. Download S3 objects to an Amazon EC2 instance. Encrypt the objects by using customer managed keys. Upload the encrypted objects
back into Amazon S3.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B because using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to create customer-managed keys gives companies full control over a user's ability to create, rotate, and deactivate encryption keys. Customer-managed keys can be used for server-side encryption (SSE-KMS), allowing companies to encrypt any data that needs to be encrypted while minimizing effort.

Choice A is incorrect because with default server-side encryption using Amazon S3-managed encryption keys (SSE-S3), the company does not have full control over the user's ability to create, rotate, and deactivate encryption keys.

Choice C is incorrect because by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to create AWS-managed keys, the company does not have full control over the user's ability to create, rotate, and deactivate encryption keys.

Choice D is incorrect because downloading an S3 object to an Amazon EC2 instance, encrypting it using a customer-managed key, and then uploading the encrypted object back to Amazon S3 requires additional work and resources and is not as convenient as using server-side encryption (SSE-KMS).
題目(中): 一家公司將敏感資料儲存在 Amazon S3 中，需要建立一個加密解決方案。解決方案架構師需要建立一個加密解決方案，以便公司可以完全控制使用者創建、輪替和停用加密金鑰的能力，同時對於任何需要加密的資料，盡量減少工作量。哪個解決方案可以滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 Amazon S3 管理的加密金鑰（SSE-S3）進行預設的伺服器端加密，以儲存敏感資料。
B. 使用 AWS 金鑰管理服務（AWS KMS）建立客戶管理的金鑰，然後使用此金鑰對 S3 物件進行伺服器端加密（SSE-KMS）。
C. 使用 AWS 金鑰管理服務（AWS KMS）建立 AWS 管理的金鑰，然後使用此金鑰對 S3 物件進行伺服器端加密（SSE-KMS）。
D. 將 S3 物件下載到 Amazon EC2 實例中，使用客戶管理的金鑰進行加密，然後將加密的物件上傳回 Amazon S3。
解析(中):
正確答案是 B，因為使用 AWS 金鑰管理服務（AWS KMS）建立客戶管理的金鑰，可以讓公司完全控制使用者創建、輪替和停用加密金鑰的能力。客戶管理的金鑰可以用於伺服器端加密（SSE-KMS），這樣公司就可以對任何需要加密的資料進行加密，同時盡量減少工作量。

選項 A 不正確，因為使用 Amazon S3 管理的加密金鑰（SSE-S3）進行預設的伺服器端加密，公司無法完全控制使用者創建、輪替和停用加密金鑰的能力。

選項 C 不正確，因為使用 AWS 金鑰管理服務（AWS KMS）建立 AWS 管理的金鑰，公司也無法完全控制使用者創建、輪替和停用加密金鑰的能力。

選項 D 不正確，因為將 S3 物件下載到 Amazon EC2 實例中，使用客戶管理的金鑰進行加密，然後將加密的物件上傳回 Amazon S3，需要額外的工作量和資源，且不如使用伺服器端加密（SSE-KMS）方便。

題目(英):
A company wants to back up its on-premises virtual machines (VMs) to AWS. The company's backup solution exports on-premises backups to
an Amazon S3 bucket as objects. The S3 backups must be retained for 30 days and must be automatically deleted after 30 days.
Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)
選項(英):
A. Create an S3 bucket that has S3 Object Lock enabled.
B. Create an S3 bucket that has object versioning enabled.
C. Congure a default retention period of 30 days for the objects.
D. Congure an S3 Lifecycle policy to protect the objects for 30 days.
E. Congure an S3 Lifecycle policy to expire the objects after 30 days.
F. Congure the backup solution to tag the objects with a 30-day retention period
解析(英): According to the question requirements, the company needs to back up internal virtual machines to AWS's S3 bucket, and the backup must be retained for 30 days and then automatically deleted. Therefore, the S3 lifecycle policy needs to be set to expire objects after 30 days. Option E "Set S3 lifecycle policy to expire objects after 30 days" is the option that meets this requirement. Additionally, option C, "Set a default retention period of 30 days for objects," can ensure that objects are deleted after 30 days, but this needs to be used in conjunction with option E, which ensures that objects are automatically deleted after 30 days. Therefore, the correct answer is CE. The other options are incorrect because option A enables S3 object locking, which will make the object unable to be deleted; option B enables object versioning, which will retain all object versions, but will not automatically delete them; option D, which sets the S3 lifecycle policy to protect the object for 30 days, will cause the object to be protected after 30 days, but will not be automatically deleted; option F, which sets the backup solution to mark the object for a 30-day retention period, requires additional setup and management, and is not as straightforward and effective as option CE.
題目(中): 一家公司想要將其內部虛擬機器（VM）備份到 AWS。該公司的備份解決方案將內部備份導出到 Amazon S3 儲存桶中作為物件。S3 備份必須保留 30 天，並且必須在 30 天後自動刪除。哪種步驟組合可以滿足這些需求？（選擇三個。）
選項(中):
A. 建立啟用 S3 物件鎖定的 S3 儲存桶。
B. 建立啟用物件版本控制的 S3 儲存桶。
C. 對物件設定 30 天的預設保留期。
D. 設定 S3 生命週期政策以保護物件 30 天。
E. 設定 S3 生命週期政策以在 30 天後過期物件。
F. 設定備份解決方案以標記物件為 30 天的保留期。
解析(中): 根據題目要求，公司需要將內部虛擬機器備份到 AWS 的 S3 儲存桶中，且備份必須保留 30 天後自動刪除。因此，需要設定 S3 生命週期政策以在 30 天後過期物件。選項 E「設定 S3 生命週期政策以在 30 天後過期物件」正是滿足這個需求的選項。另外，選項 C「對物件設定 30 天的預設保留期」可以確保物件在 30 天後被刪除，但這需要與選項 E 結合使用，以確保物件在 30 天後自動刪除。因此，正確答案是 CE。其他選項不正確，因為選項 A 啟用 S3 物件鎖定，會使物件無法刪除；選項 B 啟用物件版本控制，會保留所有物件版本，但不會自動刪除；選項 D 設定 S3 生命週期政策以保護物件 30 天，會使物件在 30 天後被保護，但不會自動刪除；選項 F 設定備份解決方案以標記物件為 30 天的保留期，需要額外的設定和管理，且不如選項 CE 直接和有效。

題目(英):
A solutions architect needs to copy les from an Amazon S3 bucket to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) le system and another
S3 bucket. The les must be copied continuously. New les are added to the original S3 bucket consistently. The copied les should be
overwritten only if the source le changes.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Create an AWS DataSync location for both the destination S3 bucket and the EFS le system. Create a task for the destination S3
bucket and the EFS le system. Set the transfer mode to transfer only data that has changed.
B. Create an AWS Lambda function. Mount the le system to the function. Set up an S3 event notication to invoke the function when les
are created and changed in Amazon S3. Congure the function to copy les to the le system and the destination S3 bucket.
C. Create an AWS DataSync location for both the destination S3 bucket and the EFS le system. Create a task for the destination S3
bucket and the EFS le system. Set the transfer mode to transfer all data.
D. Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in the same VPC as the le system. Mount the le system. Create a script to routinely synchronize all
objects that changed in the origin S3 bucket to the destination S3 bucket and the mounted le system.
解析(英): The answer is A because AWS DataSync is a fully managed service that automates data replication and synchronization. It supports copying data from an S3 bucket to an EFS file system and another S3 bucket. Setting the transfer mode to only transfer changed data ensures that the copied file will only be overwritten when the source file changes. This solution has minimal operational burden as it requires no manual management and maintenance. Other options, such as using AWS Lambda functions or Amazon EC2 instances, require more management and maintenance, adding to the operational burden. Choice C is incorrect because it transfers all data, not just the data that has changed. Option D is incorrect because it requires manual management and maintenance of Amazon EC2 instances and synchronization scripts. Option B is incorrect because it requires manual management and maintenance of AWS Lambda functions and synchronizers. Therefore, option A is the best solution.
題目(中): 一位解決方案架構師需要從 Amazon S3 儲存桶複製檔案到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 檔案系統和另一個 S3 儲存桶。檔案必須連續複製。新檔案會一致地新增到原始 S3 儲存桶中。只有當來源檔案變更時，才應該覆寫複製的檔案。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求，並且具有最低的運營負擔？
選項(中):
A. 為目的地 S3 儲存桶和 EFS 檔案系統建立 AWS DataSync 位置。為目的地 S3 儲存桶和 EFS 檔案系統建立任務。將傳輸模式設為僅傳輸已變更的資料。
B. 建立 AWS Lambda 函數。將檔案系統掛載到函數。設定 S3 事件通知以在 Amazon S3 中建立和變更檔案時呼叫函數。設定函數以將檔案複製到檔案系統和目的地 S3 儲存桶。
C. 為目的地 S3 儲存桶和 EFS 檔案系統建立 AWS DataSync 位置。為目的地 S3 儲存桶和 EFS 檔案系統建立任務。將傳輸模式設為傳輸所有資料。
D. 在檔案系統相同的 VPC 中啟動 Amazon EC2 實例。掛載檔案系統。建立腳本以定期同步原始 S3 儲存桶中變更的所有物件到目的地 S3 儲存桶和掛載的檔案系統。
解析(中): 答案是 A，因為 AWS DataSync 是一個完全管理的服務，可以自動化資料複製和同步的工作。它支援將資料從 S3 儲存桶複製到 EFS 檔案系統和另一個 S3 儲存桶。設定傳輸模式為僅傳輸已變更的資料，可以確保只有當來源檔案變更時，才會覆寫複製的檔案。這個解決方案具有最低的運營負擔，因為它不需要手動管理和維護。其他選項，例如使用 AWS Lambda 函數或 Amazon EC2 實例，需要更多的管理和維護工作，從而增加運營負擔。選項 C 不正確，因為它會傳輸所有資料，而不是僅傳輸已變更的資料。選項 D 不正確，因為它需要手動管理和維護 Amazon EC2 實例和同步腳本。選項 B 不正確，因為它需要手動管理和維護 AWS Lambda 函數和同步程式。因此，選項 A 是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is migrating its multi-tier on-premises application to AWS. The application consists of a single-node MySQL database and a multi-
node web tier. The company must minimize changes to the application during the migration. The company wants to improve application
resiliency after the migration.
Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.
B. Migrate the database to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind a Network Load Balancer.
C. Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployment.
D. Migrate the web tier to an AWS Lambda function.
E. Migrate the database to an Amazon DynamoDB table.
解析(英): To meet your company's needs, you need to choose the right mix to migrate your applications. Choices C and E are the correct answers. Option C Migrating the database to an Amazon RDS multi-availability zone deployment can improve the fault tolerance and availability of the database while minimizing modifications to the application. Because Amazon RDS supports the MySQL engine, existing MySQL databases can be directly migrated. Option E Migrating the database to Amazon DynamoDB tables can also improve the fault tolerance and availability of the database while also reducing changes to the application. Because Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database, it can support high-traffic and high-availability applications. The other options are incorrect because options A and B require modifications to the web tier and database, and option D migrating the web tier to an AWS Lambda function may require significant modifications to the application. Therefore, options C and E are the most suitable combination to meet the company's needs.
題目(中): 一家公司正在將其多層式內部應用程式遷移到 AWS。該應用程式由單節點 MySQL 數據庫和多節點網頁層組成。公司必須在遷移過程中盡量減少對應用程式的修改。公司希望在遷移後提高應用程式的容錯能力。哪種組合的步驟可以滿足這些需求？（選擇兩個。）
選項(中):
A. 將網頁層遷移到 Amazon EC2 執行個體的 Auto Scaling 群組後面，並使用 Application Load Balancer。
B. 將數據庫遷移到 Amazon EC2 執行個體的 Auto Scaling 群組後面，並使用 Network Load Balancer。
C. 將數據庫遷移到 Amazon RDS 多可用區域部署。
D. 將網頁層遷移到 AWS Lambda 函數。
E. 將數據庫遷移到 Amazon DynamoDB 表格。
解析(中): 為了滿足公司的需求，需要選擇合適的組合來遷移應用程式。選項 C 和 E 是正確答案。選項 C 將數據庫遷移到 Amazon RDS 多可用區域部署，可以提高數據庫的容錯能力和可用性，同時也可以盡量減少對應用程式的修改。因為 Amazon RDS 支援 MySQL 引擎，可以直接遷移現有的 MySQL 數據庫。選項 E 將數據庫遷移到 Amazon DynamoDB 表格，也可以提高數據庫的容錯能力和可用性，同時也可以減少對應用程式的修改。因為 Amazon DynamoDB 是一個 NoSQL 數據庫，可以支援高流量和高可用性的應用程式。其他選項不正確，因為選項 A 和 B 需要對網頁層和數據庫進行修改，選項 D 將網頁層遷移到 AWS Lambda 函數可能需要對應用程式進行重大修改。因此，選項 C 和 E 是最合適的組合，可以滿足公司的需求。

題目(英):
A company wants to migrate its web applications from on premises to AWS. The company is located close to the eu-central-1 Region. Because

題目(中): 一家公司想要將其網頁應用程式從內部部署遷移到 AWS。該公司位於 eu-central-1 區域附近。由於法規限制，該公司無法在 eu-central-1 區域啟動一些應用程式。該公司希望實現單位毫秒的延遲。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將應用程式部署在 eu-central-1 區域。將公司的 VPC 從 eu-central-1 區域延伸到 Amazon CloudFront 的邊緣位置。

解析(中): 根據題目描述，公司希望實現單位毫秒的延遲，但由於法規限制，無法在 eu-central-1 區域啟動一些應用程式。因此，選項 A 和 C 不合適，因為它們仍然需要在 eu-central-1 區域啟動應用程式。選項 D 也不是最佳選擇，因為 AWS Wavelength Zones 主要用於 5G 網絡和邊緣計算，可能不適合此場景。選項 B 是最佳選擇，因為 AWS 本地區域（Local Zones）可以提供單位毫秒的延遲，並且可以將公司的 VPC 從 eu-central-1 區域延伸到所選的本地區域，從而滿足公司的需求。這樣，公司可以在本地區域啟動應用程式，同時實現低延遲和遵守法規限制。

題目(英):
A company’s ecommerce website has unpredictable trac and uses AWS Lambda functions to directly access a private Amazon RDS for
PostgreSQL DB instance. The company wants to maintain predictable database performance and ensure that the Lambda invocations do not
overload the database with too many connections.

題目(中): 一家公司的電子商務網站有不可預測的流量，並使用 AWS Lambda 函數直接存取私有的 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 資料庫實例。該公司希望維持可預測的資料庫效能，並確保 Lambda 函數調用不會用太多連線過載資料庫。要滿足這些需求，解決方案架構師應該做什麼？

題目(英):
A company is creating an application. The company stores data from tests of the application in multiple on-premises locations.
The company needs to connect the on-premises locations to VPCs in an AWS Region in the AWS Cloud. The number of accounts and VPCs will
increase during the next year. The network architecture must simplify the administration of new connections and must provide the ability to
scale.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?
選項(英):
A. Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Create a VPN connection between the VPCs and the on-premises locations.
B. Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. On the instance, include VPN software that uses a VPN connection to connect all VPCs and on-
premises locations.
C. Create a transit gateway. Create VPC attachments for the VPC connections. Create VPN attachments for the on-premises connections.
D. Create an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises locations and a central VPC. Connect the central VPC to other VPCs
by using peering connections.
解析(英):
The correct answer is C. Building a Transit Gateway is the most appropriate solution because it simplifies the management of new connections and provides scalability. A transport gateway is a network service that allows you to connect multiple VPCs and on-premises data centers to a single gateway, simplifying the management of your network infrastructure. By establishing VPC attach and VPN attach connections, companies can easily connect new VPCs and on-premises data centers to transport gateways without the need to establish multiple VPN connections or peering connections.

Choice A is incorrect because establishing peering connections between VPCs may complicate the network architecture, especially as the number of VPCs increases. 題目(英):

Therefore, option A of "create A record with delay policy" is the best choice and can provide the best high-performance experience.

選項 B 的地理位置策略是根據用戶的位置將流量引導到特定的區域，但它不一定能夠提供最低的延遲。選項 C 的故障轉移策略是用於在一個區域故障時將流量轉移到另一個區域，但它不適用於提供高性能體驗。選項 D 的地理鄰近策略是根據用戶的位置將流量引導到鄰近的區域，但它不一定能夠提供最低的延遲。

因此，選項 A 的「建立具有延遲策略的 A 記錄」是最好的選擇，可以提供最好的高性能體驗。

題目(英):
A company has a web application that includes an embedded NoSQL database. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an
Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone.
A recent increase in trac requires the application to be highly available and for the database to be eventually consistent.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Maintain the embedded NoSQL database with its replication service on the EC2
instances.
B. Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Migrate the embedded NoSQL database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database
Migration Service (AWS DMS).
C. Modify the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. Maintain the embedded NoSQL database with its
replication service on the EC2 instances.
D. Modify the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. Migrate the embedded NoSQL database to Amazon
DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).
解析(英):
The correct answer is D. This is because Option D meets the needs of high availability and eventual consistency with minimal operational burden. You can ensure high availability of your application by modifying the auto-scaling group to use EC2 instances across three availability zones. At the same time, migrating embedded NoSQL databases to Amazon DynamoDB enables eventual consistency because DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database service with built-in replication and failover mechanisms. This solution minimizes operational burden because DynamoDB automatically handles database expansion and maintenance.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Simply replacing ALB and maintaining an embedded NoSQL database cannot meet the requirements of high availability and eventual consistency.
B. Simply replacing ALB and migrating to DynamoDB does not meet high availability requirements because the EC2 instances are still in a single availability zone.
C. Simply modifying the auto-scaling group and maintaining the embedded NoSQL database cannot meet the requirements for eventual consistency, because the embedded NoSQL database may not provide adequate replication and failover mechanisms.
題目(中): 一家公司有一個包含嵌入式NoSQL數據庫的Web應用程式。該應用程式在Amazon EC2實例後面的應用程式負載平衡器（ALB）上運行。實例運行在單個可用區域的Amazon EC2自動擴展群組中。最近的流量增加需要應用程式具有高可用性和數據庫最終一致性。哪種解決方案可以滿足這些需求並具有最少的運營負擔？
選項(中):
A. 將ALB替換為網路負載平衡器。維護嵌入式NoSQL數據庫及其在EC2實例上的複製服務。
B. 將ALB替換為網路負載平衡器。使用AWS數據庫遷移服務（AWS DMS）將嵌入式NoSQL數據庫遷移到Amazon DynamoDB。
C. 修改自動擴展群組以使用跨三個可用區域的EC2實例。維護嵌入式NoSQL數據庫及其在EC2實例上的複製服務。
D. 修改自動擴展群組以使用跨三個可用區域的EC2實例。使用AWS數據庫遷移服務（AWS DMS）將嵌入式NoSQL數據庫遷移到Amazon DynamoDB。
解析(中):
正確答案是D。這是因為選項D滿足了高可用性和最終一致性的需求，並且具有最少的運營負擔。通過修改自動擴展群組以使用跨三個可用區域的EC2實例，可以確保應用程式的高可用性。同時，將嵌入式NoSQL數據庫遷移到Amazon DynamoDB可以實現最終一致性，因為DynamoDB是一種完全受管理的NoSQL數據庫服務，具有內建的複製和故障轉移機制。這種解決方案可以最小化運營負擔，因為DynamoDB可以自動處理數據庫的擴展和維護。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. 只替換ALB和維護嵌入式NoSQL數據庫不能滿足高可用性和最終一致性的需求。
B. 只替換ALB和遷移到DynamoDB不能滿足高可用性需求，因為EC2實例仍然在單個可用區域中。
C. 只修改自動擴展群組和維護嵌入式NoSQL數據庫不能滿足最終一致性的需求，因為嵌入式NoSQL數據庫可能無法提供足夠的複製和故障轉移機制。

題目(英):

What should a solutions architect do to ensure that the shopping cart data is preserved at all times?

By configuring Amazon ElastiCache for Redis, solutions architects can ensure that shopping cart data is preserved at all times, even if users disconnect and reconnect. Additionally, Amazon ElastiCache for Redis can help reduce requests to Amazon DynamoDB, thereby reducing latency and improving application performance.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. The sticky session feature (session affinity) is mainly used to ensure that user session data is consistent across load balancers, but it does not guarantee the preservation of shopping cart data.
C. Amazon OpenSearch Service is primarily used for searching and analyzing data, not for caching shopping cart data.
D. Configuring Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon EBS storage can provide a solution for storing shopping cart data, but it does not provide low latency and high availability guarantees, and requires more maintenance and management efforts. In contrast, Amazon ElastiCache for Redis provides a simple, low-latency, and highly available solution.
題目(中): 一家公司正在使用 AWS 建立一個購物應用程式。該應用程式提供一個每月更新一次的目錄，並需要根據流量進行擴展。公司希望從應用程式獲得最低的延遲。每個使用者的購物車資料需要具有高可用性。使用者會話資料必須在使用者斷線並重新連接時仍可用。解決方案架構師應該如何確保購物車資料在任何時候都得到保存？
選項(中):
A. 配置應用程式負載平衡器，以啟用粘性會話功能（會話親和性），以存取 Amazon Aurora 中的目錄。
B. 配置 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis，以緩存從 Amazon DynamoDB 載入的目錄資料和從使用者會話中載入的購物車資料。
C. 配置 Amazon OpenSearch Service，以緩存從 Amazon DynamoDB 載入的目錄資料和從使用者會話中載入的購物車資料。
D. 配置 Amazon EC2 實例，使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 儲存，來儲存目錄和購物車資料。配置自動快照。
解析(中):
正確答案是 B，因為 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 是一個高效且低延遲的緩存解決方案，非常適合存儲購物車資料和目錄資料。通過配置 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis，解決方案架構師可以確保購物車資料在任何時候都得到保存，即使使用者斷線並重新連接。另外，Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 還可以幫助減少對 Amazon DynamoDB 的請求，從而降低延遲和提高應用程式的性能。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. 粘性會話功能（會話親和性）主要用於確保使用者會話資料在負載平衡器之間保持一致，但它不能保證購物車資料的保存。
C. Amazon OpenSearch Service 主要用於搜索和分析資料，而不是用於緩存購物車資料。
D. 配置 Amazon EC2 實例和 Amazon EBS 儲存可以提供儲存購物車資料的解決方案，但它不能提供低延遲和高可用性的保證，而且需要更多的維護和管理工作。相比之下，Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 提供了一個簡單、低延遲和高可用的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is building a microservices-based application that will be deployed on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The
microservices will interact with each other. The company wants to ensure that the application is observable to identify performance issues in
the future.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Congure the application to use Amazon ElastiCache to reduce the number of requests that are sent to the microservices.
B. Congure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights to collect metrics from the EKS clusters. Congure AWS X-Ray to trace the requests
between the microservices.
C. Congure AWS CloudTrail to review the API calls. Build an Amazon QuickSight dashboard to observe the microservice interactions.
D. Use AWS Trusted Advisor to understand the performance of the application.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B because Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights collects metrics for EKS clusters, providing deep insights into application performance and health. At the same time, AWS X-Ray can track requests between microservices, helping companies identify performance bottlenecks and issues. The combination of these two services provides a comprehensive observability solution that meets a company's needs.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Amazon ElastiCache can be used for caching and reducing the number of requests, but it does not provide application observability.
C. AWS CloudTrail can be used to audit API calls, but it does not provide deep insights into application performance and health. Amazon QuickSight can be used to build dashboards, but it does not provide real-time observability data.

題目(中): 一家公司正在建造一個基於微服務的應用程式，該應用程式將部署在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上。這些微服務將彼此之間進行交互。公司希望確保應用程式是可觀察的，以便在未來識別性能問題。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？

B. 設定 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights 來收集 EKS 叢集的指標。設定 AWS X-Ray 來追蹤微服務之間的請求。

D. AWS Trusted Advisor 可以提供最佳實踐和建議，但它不能提供實時的可觀察性數據和性能見解。因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company needs to provide customers with secure access to its data. The company processes customer data and stores the results in an
Amazon S3 bucket.
All the data is subject to strong regulations and security requirements. The data must be encrypted at rest. Each customer must be able to
access only their data from their AWS account. Company employees must not be able to access the data.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Provision an AWS Certicate Manager (ACM) certicate for each customer. Encrypt the data client-side. In the private certicate policy,
deny access to the certicate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
B. Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In the S3 bucket
policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
C. Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In each KMS key
policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
D. Provision an AWS Certicate Manager (ACM) certicate for each customer. Encrypt the data client-side. In the public certicate policy,
deny access to the certicate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
解析(英):
The correct answer is C. This is because Option C meets all safety requirements. First, configuring a separate AWS KMS key for each customer ensures that each customer's data is encrypted using a different key, so that data isolation can be achieved. Secondly, server-side encryption of data ensures that data is protected during transmission and storage. Finally, in each KMS key policy, denying all subjects decryption of data except those with IAM roles provided by the customer ensures that only authorized customers can access their own data, and that neither company employees nor other unauthorized subjects can access the data.

Choices A and D are incorrect because using ACM credentials is not appropriate for encrypting material and is primarily used for SSL/TLS encryption and authentication. In addition, client-side encryption of data may also cause the data to be attacked during transmission.

Choice B is incorrect because denying all principals in the S3 bucket policy to decrypt data except those with customer-provided IAM roles may result in company employees and other unauthorized principals still being able to access the data. Only by denying all subjects decryption of data in each KMS key policy can data isolation and security be truly achieved.
題目(中): 一家公司需要為客戶提供安全存取其資料的方式。該公司處理客戶資料並將結果存儲在 Amazon S3 儲存桶中。所有資料都受到嚴格的法規和安全要求的約束。資料必須在靜止時加密。每個客戶只能從其 AWS 帳戶存取其自己的資料。公司員工不得存取資料。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些要求？
選項(中):
A. 為每個客戶配置 AWS 憑證管理器 (ACM) 憑證。客戶端加密資料。在私有憑證政策中，拒絕所有主體（principals）存取憑證，除非是客戶提供的 IAM 角色。
B. 為每個客戶配置單獨的 AWS 金鑰管理服務 (AWS KMS) 金鑰。伺服器端加密資料。在 S3 儲存桶政策中，拒絕所有主體解密資料，除非是客戶提供的 IAM 角色。
C. 為每個客戶配置單獨的 AWS 金鑰管理服務 (AWS KMS) 金鑰。伺服器端加密資料。在每個 KMS 金鑰政策中，拒絕所有主體解密資料，除非是客戶提供的 IAM 角色。
D. 為每個客戶配置 AWS 憑證管理器 (ACM) 憑證。客戶端加密資料。在公有憑證政策中，拒絕所有主體存取憑證，除非是客戶提供的 IAM 角色。
解析(中):
正確答案是 C。這是因為選項 C 能夠滿足所有的安全要求。首先，為每個客戶配置單獨的 AWS KMS 金鑰，可以確保每個客戶的資料都使用不同的金鑰進行加密，這樣就可以實現資料的隔離。其次，伺服器端加密資料可以確保資料在傳輸和存儲過程中都受到保護。最後，在每個 KMS 金鑰政策中，拒絕所有主體解密資料，除非是客戶提供的 IAM 角色，可以確保只有授權的客戶才能存取其自己的資料，公司員工和其他未授權的主體都無法存取資料。

選項 A 和 D 不正確，因為使用 ACM 憑證並不適合用於加密資料，ACM 憑證主要用於 SSL/TLS 加密和身份驗證。另外，客戶端加密資料也可能導致資料在傳輸過程中受到攻擊。

選項 B 不正確，因為在 S3 儲存桶政策中拒絕所有主體解密資料，除非是客戶提供的 IAM 角色，可能會導致公司員工和其他未授權的主體仍然可以存取資料。只有在每個 KMS 金鑰政策中拒絕所有主體解密資料，才能真正實現資料的隔離和安全。

題目(英):
A solutions architect creates a VPC that includes two public subnets and two private subnets. A corporate security mandate requires the
solutions architect to launch all Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet. However, when the solutions architect launches an EC2 instance
that runs a web server on ports 80 and 443 in a private subnet, no external internet trac can connect to the server.
What should the solutions architect do to resolve this issue?
選項(英):
A. Attach the EC2 instance to an Auto Scaling group in a private subnet. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the Auto
Scaling group identier.
B. Provision an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a public subnet. Add the EC2 instance to the target group that is
associated with the ALEnsure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the ALB.
C. Launch a NAT gateway in a private subnet. Update the route table for the private subnets to add a default route to the NAT gateway.
Attach a public Elastic IP address to the NAT gateway.
D. Ensure that the security group that is attached to the EC2 instance allows HTTP trac on port 80 and HTTPS trac on port 443. Ensure
that the DNS record for the website resolves to the public IP address of the EC2 instance.
解析(英):
The problem the solutions architect encountered was that because the company's security regulations required that all EC2 instances be launched in a private subnet, these instances were unable to directly receive external internet traffic. The correct solution is option B: deploy an Internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) on the public subnet, then add the EC2 instances to the target group associated with the ALB, and finally ensure that the website's DNS records resolve to the ALB. This allows external traffic to enter the public subnet through the ALB, which then forwards the traffic to the EC2 instances in the private subnet.

Choice A is incorrect because autoscaling groups do not directly resolve the problem of external traffic being unable to connect to EC2 instances in private subnets.

Choice C is incorrect because a NAT gateway is primarily designed to allow instances in a private subnet to connect to the external internet, not to allow external internet traffic to connect to instances in a private subnet.

Choice D is incorrect because even though the security group allows HTTP and HTTPS traffic, EC2 instances in the private subnet cannot receive external internet traffic directly. Additionally, attaching a public Elastic IP address directly to an EC2 instance does not comply with corporate security regulations.
題目(中): 一位解決方案架構師創建了一個虛擬私有雲（VPC），其中包括兩個公有子網路和兩個私有子網路。公司的安全性規範要求解決方案架構師在私有子網路中啟動所有 Amazon EC2 實例。然而，當解決方案架構師在私有子網路中啟動一個運行網頁伺服器的 EC2 實例（使用 80 和 443 端口）時，外部網際網路流量無法連接到伺服器。解決方案架構師應該採取什麼措施來解決這個問題？
選項(中):
A. 將 EC2 實例附加到私有子網路中的自動擴展群組。確保網站的 DNS 紀錄解析到自動擴展群組的識別碼。
B. 在公有子網路中佈建面向網際網路的應用程式負載平衡器（ALB）。將 EC2 實例添加到與 ALB 相關聯的目標群組。確保網站的 DNS 紀錄解析到 ALB。
C. 在私有子網路中啟動 NAT 閘道。更新私有子網路的路由表以添加預設路由到 NAT 閘道。將公有彈性 IP 位址附加到 NAT 閘道。
D. 確保附加到 EC2 實例的安全群組允許 HTTP 流量在 80 端口和 HTTPS 流量在 443 端口。確保網站的 DNS 紀錄解析到 EC2 實例的公有 IP 位址。
解析(中):
解決方案架構師遇到的問題是，由於公司的安全性規範要求所有 EC2 實例必須在私有子網路中啟動，但這些實例無法直接接收外部網際網路流量。正確的解決方案是選項 B：在公有子網路中佈建面向網際網路的應用程式負載平衡器（ALB），然後將 EC2 實例添加到與 ALB 相關聯的目標群組，最後確保網站的 DNS 紀錄解析到 ALB。這樣，外部流量可以透過 ALB 進入公有子網路，然後 ALB 將流量轉發到私有子網路中的 EC2 實例。

選項 A 不正確，因為自動擴展群組無法直接解決外部流量無法連接到私有子網路中的 EC2 實例的問題。

選項 C 不正確，因為 NAT 閘道主要用於允許私有子網路中的實例連接到外部網際網路，而不是允許外部網際網路流量連接到私有子網路中的實例。

選項 D 不正確，因為即使安全群組允許 HTTP 和 HTTPS 流量，私有子網路中的 EC2 實例仍然無法直接接收外部網際網路流量。另外，將公有彈性 IP 位址直接附加到 EC2 實例上並不符合公司的安全性規範。

題目(英):
A company is deploying a new application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with an AWS Fargate cluster. The application
needs a storage solution for data persistence. The solution must be highly available and fault tolerant. The solution also must be shared
between multiple application containers.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Create Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed. Register
the volumes in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use EBS Multi-Attach to share the data between containers.
B. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) le system. Register the le system in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster.
Use the same le system for all containers.
C. Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Register the volume in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use the
same volume for all containers.
D. Create Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) le systems in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed.
Register the le systems in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Create an AWS Lambda function to synchronize the data between le
systems.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B. Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) is a fully managed file system that provides high availability and fault tolerance while supporting data sharing among multiple containers. By registering the Amazon EFS file system in the StorageClass object on the EKS cluster, all containers can access the same file system, meeting data persistence and sharing requirements. This solution has minimal operational burden because Amazon EFS is a fully managed service that requires no user maintenance and management.

The other options are incorrect for the following reasons:
A. Using multiple additional functions of EBS requires additional setup and management, and data consistency issues may arise.
C. Using a single EBS volume for all containers may cause data contention and consistency issues.
