題目(中): 一家公司正在將新應用程式部署到 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上，使用 AWS Fargate 集群。該應用程式需要一個儲存解決方案來實現資料持續性。解決方案必須具有高可用性和容錯能力，同時必須在多個應用程式容器之間共享。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求，並且具有最少的運營負擔？
選項(中):
A. 在 EKS 工作節點所在的相同可用區域中建立 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。將卷在 EKS 集群上的 StorageClass 物件中註冊。使用 EBS 多重附加功能在容器之間共享資料。
B. 建立 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 檔案系統。將檔案系統在 EKS 集群上的 StorageClass 物件中註冊。使用相同的檔案系統供所有容器使用。
C. 建立 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。將卷在 EKS 集群上的 StorageClass 物件中註冊。使用相同的卷供所有容器使用。
D. 在 EKS 工作節點所在的相同可用區域中建立 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 檔案系統。將檔案系統在 EKS 集群上的 StorageClass 物件中註冊。建立 AWS Lambda 函數以在檔案系統之間同步資料。
解析(中):
正確答案是 B。Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 是一個完全受管的檔案系統，能夠提供高可用性和容錯能力，同時支持多個容器之間共享資料。通過在 EKS 集群上的 StorageClass 物件中註冊 Amazon EFS 檔案系統，所有容器都可以存取相同的檔案系統，滿足資料持續性和共享的需求。這個解決方案具有最少的運營負擔，因為 Amazon EFS 是一個完全受管的服務，無需用戶進行維護和管理。

其他選項不正確的原因如下：
A. 使用 EBS 多重附加功能需要額外的設定和管理，同時可能會出現資料一致性問題。
C. 使用單一 EBS 卷供所有容器使用可能會導致資料競爭和一致性問題。
D. 建立多個 Amazon EFS 檔案系統和使用 AWS Lambda 函數同步資料會增加運營負擔和複雜性，同時可能會出現資料一致性問題。因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has an application that uses Docker containers in its local data center. The application runs on a container host that stores
persistent data in a volume on the host. The container instances use the stored persistent data.
The company wants to move the application to a fully managed service because the company does not want to manage any servers or
storage infrastructure.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with self-managed nodes. Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
volume attached to an Amazon EC2 instance. Use the EBS volume as a persistent volume mounted in the containers.
B. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon
EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers.
C. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Map the S3 bucket
as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers.
D. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an Amazon EC2 launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon
EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers.
解析(英): According to the problem description, the company wants to move the application to a fully managed service and does not want to manage any servers or storage infrastructure. Therefore, options A and D are not suitable as they require self-managing nodes or EC2 instances. Option C is also not suitable because the Amazon S3 bucket is not suitable as a persistent storage volume for the container. Option B is the most appropriate solution because Amazon ECS with the AWS Fargate launch type provides fully managed container services and Amazon EFS volumes provide persistent storage. This allows companies to move applications to the AWS cloud without having to manage any servers or storage infrastructure. Therefore, the answer is B.
題目(中): 一家公司有一個應用程式，該應用程式使用Docker容器在其本地資料中心。該應用程式在一個容器主機上運行，該主機在主機上的一個卷中儲存持久性資料。容器實例使用儲存的持久性資料。公司希望將應用程式移至一個完全受管理的服務，因為公司不想管理任何伺服器或儲存基礎設施。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 搭配自我管理節點。建立一個Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷並附加到Amazon EC2 實例。使用EBS 卷作為容器中掛載的持久性卷。
B. 使用Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 搭配AWS Fargate 啟動類型。建立一個Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷。將EFS 卷作為容器中掛載的持久性儲存卷。
C. 使用Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 搭配AWS Fargate 啟動類型。建立一個Amazon S3 儲存桶。將S3 儲存桶映射為容器中掛載的持久性儲存卷。
D. 使用Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 搭配Amazon EC2 啟動類型。建立一個Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷。將EFS 卷作為容器中掛載的持久性儲存卷。
解析(中): 根據題目描述，公司希望將應用程式移至一個完全受管理的服務，且不想管理任何伺服器或儲存基礎設施。因此，選項A和D不合適，因為它們需要自我管理節點或EC2實例。選項C也不合適，因為Amazon S3儲存桶不適合作為容器的持久性儲存卷。選項B是最合適的解決方案，因為Amazon ECS搭配AWS Fargate啟動類型可以提供完全受管理的容器服務，且Amazon EFS卷可以提供持久性儲存。這樣，公司就可以將應用程式移至AWS雲端，且不需要管理任何伺服器或儲存基礎設施。因此，答案是B。

題目(英):
A gaming company wants to launch a new internet-facing application in multiple AWS Regions. The application will use the TCP and UDP
protocols for communication. The company needs to provide high availability and minimum latency for global users.
Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Create internal Network Load Balancers in front of the application in each Region.
B. Create external Application Load Balancers in front of the application in each Region.
C. Create an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator to route trac to the load balancers in each Region.
D. Congure Amazon Route 53 to use a geolocation routing policy to distribute the trac.
E. Congure Amazon CloudFront to handle the trac and route requests to the application in each Region
解析(英):
To meet the needs of gaming companies, solutions that provide high availability and minimal latency are required. Options B and C are the correct answers. Option B creates an external application load balancer that provides high availability and load balancing capabilities to ensure application availability and performance. Option C establishes an AWS Global Accelerator that routes traffic to load balancers in each region, providing minimum latency and high availability.

Choice A is incorrect because an internal network load balancer is not suitable for Internet-facing applications. Option D is incorrect because the geolocation routing policy can only route based on the user's geographic location and cannot provide the lowest latency and high availability features. Option E is incorrect because Amazon CloudFront is primarily used for distribution and acceleration of static content and cannot provide load balancing and routing capabilities for dynamic applications. Therefore, options B and C are the most suitable solutions.
題目(中): 一家遊戲公司想要在多個 AWS 區域發佈一個新的面向網際網路的應用程式。該應用程式將使用 TCP 和 UDP 通訊協定進行通訊。公司需要為全球用戶提供高可用性和最低延遲。
選項(中):
A. 在每個區域的應用程式前面建立內部網路負載平衡器。
B. 在每個區域的應用程式前面建立外部應用程式負載平衡器。
C. 建立一個 AWS Global Accelerator 加速器，以將流量路由到每個區域的負載平衡器。
D. 設定 Amazon Route 53 使用地理位置路由策略來分配流量。
E. 設定 Amazon CloudFront 處理流量並將請求路由到每個區域的應用程式。
解析(中):
為了滿足遊戲公司的需求，需要提供高可用性和最低延遲的解決方案。選項 B 和 C 是正確的答案。選項 B 建立外部應用程式負載平衡器，可以提供高可用性和負載平衡的功能，以確保應用程式的可用性和效能。選項 C 建立 AWS Global Accelerator 加速器，可以將流量路由到每個區域的負載平衡器，從而提供最低延遲和高可用性的功能。

選項 A 不正確，因為內部網路負載平衡器不適合面向網際網路的應用程式。選項 D 不正確，因為地理位置路由策略只能根據用戶的地理位置進行路由，不能提供最低延遲和高可用性的功能。選項 E 不正確，因為 Amazon CloudFront 主要用於靜態內容的分發和加速，不能提供動態應用程式的負載平衡和路由功能。因此，選項 B 和 C 是最適合的解決方案。

題目(英):
A city has deployed a web application running on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application's users
have reported sporadic performance, which appears to be related to DDoS attacks originating from random IP addresses. The city needs a
solution that requires minimal conguration changes and provides an audit trail for the DDoS sources.
Which solution meets these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the ALB, and congure rules to block trac from unknown sources.
B. Subscribe to Amazon Inspector. Engage the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service.
C. Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Engage the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service.
D. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the application, and set the ALB as the origin. Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the
distribution, and congure rules to block trac from unknown sources
解析(英): The correct answer is C because AWS Shield Advanced provides advanced protection and mitigation capabilities against DDoS attacks and can be integrated with the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to provide a more comprehensive security solution. This option requires minimal configuration changes and can provide an audit trail of the DDoS source. Option A requires settings changes and may not provide adequate protection. Option B is incorrect because Amazon Inspector is primarily used for security assessment and compliance, not DDoS protection. Option D requires additional setup and resources, and may not provide the same level of protection as AWS Shield Advanced. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一個城市部署了一個在 Amazon EC2 實例後面的應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB) 上運行的網頁應用程式。應用程式的使用者報告了間歇性的性能問題，似乎與來自隨機 IP 地址的 DDoS 攻擊有關。這個城市需要一個解決方案，需要最少的設定變更，並為 DDoS 來源提供審計追蹤。
選項(中):
A. 啟用 ALB 上的 AWS WAF 網頁 ACL，並設定規則以阻止來自未知來源的流量。
B. 訂閱 Amazon Inspector。啟用 AWS DDoS 響應團隊 (DRT) 將緩解控制整合到服務中。
C. 訂閱 AWS Shield Advanced。啟用 AWS DDoS 響應團隊 (DRT) 將緩解控制整合到服務中。
D. 為應用程式建立 Amazon CloudFront 分佈，並將 ALB 設為原始來源。啟用分佈上的 AWS WAF 網頁 ACL，並設定規則以阻止來自未知來源的流量。
解析(中): 正確答案是 C，原因是 AWS Shield Advanced 提供了針對 DDoS 攻擊的進階防護和緩解能力，並且可以與 AWS DDoS 響應團隊 (DRT) 整合，以提供更全面的安全解決方案。這個選項需要最少的設定變更，並可以提供 DDoS 來源的審計追蹤。選項 A 需要設定變更，並且可能無法提供足夠的防護。選項 B 不正確，因為 Amazon Inspector 主要用於安全評估和合規性，而不是 DDoS 防護。選項 D 需要額外的設定和資源，並且可能無法提供與 AWS Shield Advanced 相同的防護水平。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company copies 200 TB of data from a recent ocean survey onto AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. The company has a high
performance computing (HPC) cluster that is hosted on AWS to look for oil and gas deposits. A solutions architect must provide the cluster
with consistent sub-millisecond latency and high-throughput access to the data on the Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. The
company is sending the devices back to AWS.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Congure an AWS Storage Gateway le gateway to use the S3 bucket.
Access the le gateway from the HPC cluster instances.
B. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Congure an Amazon FSx for Lustre le system, and integrate it with
the S3 bucket. Access the FSx for Lustre le system from the HPC cluster instances.
C. Create an Amazon S3 bucket and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) le system. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Copy the
data from the S3 bucket to the EFS le system. Access the EFS le system from the HPC cluster instances.
D. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre le system. Import the data directly into the FSx for Lustre le system. Access the FSx for Lustre le

解析(英): To meet the needs of sub-millisecond latency and high throughput, you need to choose a storage solution that can provide low latency and high performance. 題目(中): 一家公司將最近的海洋調查中 200 TB 的數據複製到 AWS Snowball Edge 儲存優化設備上。該公司在 AWS 上有一個高性能計算 (HPC) 叢集，用于尋找油和天然氣儲備。一個解決方案架構師必須為叢集提供一致的亞毫秒延遲和高吞吐量的數據存取權限，以便存取 Snowball Edge 儲存優化設備上的數據。該公司正在將設備送回 AWS。哪種解決方案可以滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 創建一個 Amazon S3 儲存桶。將數據導入 S3 儲存桶。配置一個 AWS Storage Gateway 文件網關，以使用 S3 儲存桶。從 HPC 叢集實例存取文件網關。
B. 創建一個 Amazon S3 儲存桶。將數據導入 S3 儲存桶。配置一個 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系統，並將其與 S3 儲存桶集成。從 HPC 叢集實例存取 FSx for Lustre 文件系統。
C. 創建一個 Amazon S3 儲存桶和一個 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系統。將數據導入 S3 儲存桶。從 S3 儲存桶複製數據到 EFS 文件系統。從 HPC 叢集實例存取 EFS 文件系統。
D. 創建一個 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系統。直接將數據導入 FSx for Lustre 文件系統。從 HPC 叢集實例存取 FSx for Lustre 文件系統。
解析(中): 為了滿足亞毫秒延遲和高吞吐量的需求，需要選擇一個能夠提供低延遲和高性能的儲存解決方案。Amazon FSx for Lustre 是一個高性能的文件系統，能夠提供低延遲和高吞吐量的存取權限，非常適合高性能計算 (HPC) 的需求。選項 D 直接將數據導入 FSx for Lustre 文件系統，可以避免數據複製和轉移的過程，從而減少延遲和提高性能。其他選項需要將數據導入 S3 儲存桶，然後再複製或轉移數據到其他儲存系統，會增加延遲和降低性能。因此，選項 D 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has NFS servers in an on-premises data center that need to periodically back up small amounts of data to Amazon S3.
Which solution meets these requirements and is MOST cost-effective?
選項(英):
A. Set up AWS Glue to copy the data from the on-premises servers to Amazon S3.
B. Set up an AWS DataSync agent on the on-premises servers, and sync the data to Amazon S3.
C. Set up an SFTP sync using AWS Transfer for SFTP to sync data from on premises to Amazon S3.
D. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises data center and a VPC, and copy the data to Amazon S3.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B. Set up the AWS DataSync agent on the local server to synchronize data to Amazon S3. This is because AWS DataSync is a service designed for large-scale data transfers, but it can also handle small-scale data transfers and provides a simple and efficient way to synchronize data from local servers to Amazon S3. In addition, AWS DataSync can also automatically handle the optimization of data transmission, such as data compression, data verification, etc., thereby reducing the time and cost of data transmission.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. AWS Glue is mainly used for data integration and data processing, not data transmission. While it can be used for data transfer, it is not the most cost-effective option.
C. AWS Transfer for SFTP is mainly used for secure file transfer, rather than large-scale data transfer. It requires setting up an SFTP server and client, and may require additional security configuration and maintenance.
D. AWS Direct Connect is a service that connects local data centers and AWS, but it requires large initial investment and maintenance costs, and may not be suitable for small-scale data transfer. In addition, AWS Direct Connect is mainly used for large-scale data transmission and low-latency applications, rather than small-scale data backup. Therefore, option B is the most cost-effective option.
題目(中): 一家公司在本地資料中心有NFS伺服器，需要定期將少量資料備份到Amazon S3。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求且最具成本效益？
選項(中):
A. 設置AWS Glue將資料從本地伺服器複製到Amazon S3。
B. 設置AWS DataSync代理程式在本地伺服器上，將資料同步到Amazon S3。
C. 設置SFTP同步，使用AWS Transfer for SFTP將資料從本地同步到Amazon S3。
D. 設置AWS Direct Connect連線，連接本地資料中心和VPC，然後將資料複製到Amazon S3。
解析(中):
正確答案是B，設置AWS DataSync代理程式在本地伺服器上，將資料同步到Amazon S3。這是因為AWS DataSync是一個設計用於大規模資料傳輸的服務，但它也能夠處理小規模的資料傳輸，並且提供了一個簡單且高效的方式來將資料從本地伺服器同步到Amazon S3。另外，AWS DataSync還能夠自動處理資料傳輸的最佳化，例如資料壓縮、資料校驗等，從而減少資料傳輸的時間和成本。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. AWS Glue主要用於資料整合和資料處理，而不是資料傳輸。雖然它可以用於資料傳輸，但它並不是最具成本效益的選擇。
C. AWS Transfer for SFTP主要用於安全的檔案傳輸，而不是大規模的資料傳輸。它需要設定SFTP伺服器和客戶端，且可能需要額外的安全設定和維護。
D. AWS Direct Connect是一個連接本地資料中心和AWS的服務，但它需要大量的初始投資和維護成本，且可能不適合小規模的資料傳輸。另外，AWS Direct Connect主要用於大規模的資料傳輸和低延遲的應用，而不是小規模的資料備份。因此，選項B是最具成本效益的選擇。

題目(英):
An online video game company must maintain ultra-low latency for its game servers. The game servers run on Amazon EC2 instances. The
company needs a solution that can handle millions of UDP internet trac requests each second.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
選項(英):
A. Congure an Application Load Balancer with the required protocol and ports for the internet trac. Specify the EC2 instances as the
targets.
B. Congure a Gateway Load Balancer for the internet trac. Specify the EC2 instances as the targets.
C. Congure a Network Load Balancer with the required protocol and ports for the internet trac. Specify the EC2 instances as the
targets.
D. Launch an identical set of game servers on EC2 instances in separate AWS Regions. Route internet trac to both sets of EC2 instances.
解析(英):
To meet the needs of an online gaming company, a solution was needed that could handle high volumes of UDP Internet traffic requests while maintaining ultra-low latency. Option C, configuring a Network Load Balancer with the required protocols and ports, is the most cost-effective solution. Network load balancers can handle large amounts of UDP traffic and provide ultra-low latency performance, which is ideal for online gaming needs.

Option A, configuring an Application Load Balancer, is not suitable for handling large amounts of UDP traffic because it is primarily designed to handle HTTP and HTTPS traffic. Option B, configure a Gateway Load Balancer, which is mainly designed for traffic in a virtual private network (VPC) and is not suitable for handling Internet traffic. Option D, launching a set of identical game servers on EC2 instances in different AWS regions, although it can improve availability, does not solve the need for ultra-low latency and large amounts of UDP traffic.

Therefore, option C, configuring a network load balancer with the required protocols and ports, is the most cost-effective solution to meet the needs of an online gaming company.
題目(中): 一家線上遊戲公司必須為其遊戲伺服器維持超低延遲。遊戲伺服器運行在 Amazon EC2 實例上。該公司需要一個可以處理每秒數百萬個 UDP 網際網路流量請求的解決方案。哪個解決方案能夠以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 配置一個具有所需協定和埠的應用程式負載平衡器，以處理網際網路流量。指定 EC2 實例為目標。
B. 配置一個網關負載平衡器，以處理網際網路流量。指定 EC2 實例為目標。
C. 配置一個具有所需協定和埠的網路負載平衡器，以處理網際網路流量。指定 EC2 實例為目標。
D. 在不同 AWS 區域的 EC2 實例上啟動一組相同的遊戲伺服器。將網際網路流量路由到兩組 EC2 實例。
解析(中):
為了滿足線上遊戲公司的需求，需要一個能夠處理大量 UDP 網際網路流量請求的解決方案，並且需要維持超低延遲。選項 C，配置一個具有所需協定和埠的網路負載平衡器（Network Load Balancer），是最具成本效益的解決方案。網路負載平衡器可以處理大量的 UDP 流量，並且提供超低延遲的性能，非常適合線上遊戲的需求。

選項 A，配置一個應用程式負載平衡器（Application Load Balancer），不適合處理大量 UDP 流量，因為它主要設計用於處理 HTTP 和 HTTPS 流量。選項 B，配置一個網關負載平衡器（Gateway Load Balancer），主要設計用於虛擬私有網路（VPC）中的流量，不適合處理網際網路流量。選項 D，啟動一組相同的遊戲伺服器在不同 AWS 區域的 EC2 實例上，雖然可以提高可用性，但並不能解決超低延遲和大量 UDP 流量的需求。

因此，選項 C，配置一個具有所需協定和埠的網路負載平衡器，是最具成本效益的解決方案，可以滿足線上遊戲公司的需求。

題目(英):
A company runs a three-tier application in a VPC. The database tier uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance.
The company plans to migrate the RDS for MySQL DB instance to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. The company needs a solution
that replicates the data changes that happen during the migration to the new database.
Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to transform the database objects.
B. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to create an Aurora PostgreSQL read replica on the RDS for
MySQL DB instance.
C. Congure an Aurora MySQL read replica for the RDS for MySQL DB instance.
D. Dene an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) task with change data capture (CDC) to migrate the data.

解析(英): To meet the company's needs, AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) was used to replicate data changes and migrate RDS for MySQL DB instances to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB clusters. Options A and E are the correct combination. Option A uses AWS DMS schema transformation to convert the database objects, ensuring that the structure of the new database is compatible with the old database. Option E is to promote the Aurora PostgreSQL read-only replication to an independent Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster after the migration is completed to complete the migration process. 題目(中): 一家公司在 VPC 中運行三層應用程序，數據庫層使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 實例。該公司計劃將 RDS for MySQL DB 實例遷移到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB 叢集。該公司需要一個解決方案，可以在遷移過程中複製新數據庫的數據變化。

A. 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 結構轉換來轉換數據庫物件。
B. 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 結構轉換在 RDS for MySQL DB 實例上建立 Aurora PostgreSQL唯讀複製。

解析(中): 為了滿足公司的需求，需要使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 來複製數據變化，並將 RDS for MySQL DB 實例遷移到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB 叢集。選項 A 和 E 是正確的組合。選項 A 使用 AWS DMS 結構轉換來轉換數據庫物件，確保新數據庫的結構與舊數據庫相容。選項 E 則是在遷移完成後，將 Aurora PostgreSQL唯讀複製提升為獨立的 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 叢集，從而完成遷移過程。其他選項不正確，因為選項 B 和 C 不是正確的遷移方法，選項 D 只定義了遷移工作，但沒有提到複製數據變化的具體步驟。因此，正確答案是 AE。

題目(英):
A company hosts a database that runs on an Amazon RDS instance that is deployed to multiple Availability Zones. The company periodically
runs a script against the database to report new entries that are added to the database. The script that runs against the database negatively
affects the performance of a critical application. The company needs to improve application performance with minimal costs.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Add functionality to the script to identify the instance that has the fewest active connections. Congure the script to read from that
instance to report the total new entries.
B. Create a read replica of the database. Congure the script to query only the read replica to report the total new entries.
C. Instruct the development team to manually export the new entries for the day in the database at the end of each day.
D. Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache the common queries that the script runs against the database.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B. This is because creating a read-only replica of a database can improve the performance of critical applications by offloading query load from the primary database instance to the read-only replica. This approach has the lowest operational burden because it does not require modifications to existing scripts or application code. Read-only replicas can automatically synchronize data from the primary database instance to ensure that the data queried by the script is up to date.

Option A is incorrect because it requires modifying the script to identify the least wired instances, which may increase the complexity and operational burden of the script. Additionally, the instance with the fewest connections may not be the best instance for a query.

Option C is incorrect because it requires manual intervention to export the newly added items, which can lead to human error and increased operational burden. Additionally, this approach may not provide instant query results.

Choice D is incorrect because using Amazon ElastiCache requires modifying existing application code to use the cache and may not completely resolve query performance issues. In addition, caching may cause data inconsistency. Therefore, creating read-only replicas is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在多個可用區域部署了 Amazon RDS 實例，該實例運行著一套資料庫。該公司定期運行腳本對資料庫進行查詢，以報告新增的資料庫項目。然而，運行於資料庫的腳本對關鍵應用程式的效能產生了負面影響。公司需要在最小化成本的情況下改善應用程式的效能。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求，並且具有最低的運營負擔？
選項(中):
A. 對腳本添加功能以識別連線最少的實例。設定腳本從該實例讀取以報告新增的項目總數。
B. 創建資料庫的唯讀複製品。設定腳本僅查詢唯讀複製品以報告新增的項目總數。
C. 指示開發團隊在每天結束時手動從資料庫導出當天的新增項目。
D. 使用 Amazon ElastiCache 將腳本運行的資料庫常見查詢進行緩存。
解析(中):
正確答案是 B。這是因為創建資料庫的唯讀複製品（Read Replica）可以將查詢負載從主要資料庫實例轉移到唯讀複製品上，從而改善關鍵應用程式的效能。這種方法具有最低的運營負擔，因為它不需要修改現有的腳本或應用程式代碼。唯讀複製品可以自動從主要資料庫實例同步資料，確保腳本查詢的資料是最新的。

選項 A 不正確，因為它需要修改腳本以識別連線最少的實例，這可能會增加腳本的複雜度和運營負擔。另外，連線最少的實例可能不是最適合查詢的實例。

選項 C 不正確，因為它需要人工干預以導出新增的項目，這可能會導致人為錯誤和增加運營負擔。另外，這種方法可能無法提供即時的查詢結果。

選項 D 不正確，因為使用 Amazon ElastiCache 需要修改現有的應用程式代碼以使用緩存，並且可能無法完全解決查詢效能問題。另外，緩存可能會導致資料不一致的問題。因此，創建唯讀複製品是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):

patterns across the application. A solutions architect needs to improve visibility into the infrastructure to help the company understand these

題目(中): 一家公司使用應用程式負載平衡器（Application Load Balancer, ALB）將其應用程式呈現給網際網路。公司發現應用程式中有異常的流量存取模式。解決方案架構師需要提高基礎設施的可視性，以幫助公司更好地了解這些異常。什麼是最具操作效率的解決方案，以滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在 Amazon Athena 中為 AWS CloudTrail 日誌創建表格。創建相關資訊的查詢。

題目(英):
A company wants to use NAT gateways in its AWS environment. The company's Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets must be able to
connect to the public internet through the NAT gateways.

選項(英):
A. Create public NAT gateways in the same private subnets as the EC2 instances.

解析(英): To enable Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet to connect to the public Internet through a NAT gateway, you need to create a public NAT gateway and place it in the public subnet. This allows EC2 instances in the private subnet to direct traffic through the route table to the public NAT gateway, which then forwards it to the public Internet. Option C is correct because it correctly describes the architecture: Create public NAT gateways in public subnets that are in the same VPC as the EC2 instances in the private subnets. Choices A and B are incorrect because NAT gateways should not be placed on private subnets. Choice D is incorrect because a private NAT gateway is not a valid option; NAT gateways are usually public to enable connection to the public Internet. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司想要在其 AWS 環境中使用 NAT 閘道。該公司在私有子網路中的 Amazon EC2 實例必須能夠通過 NAT 閘道連接到公眾網際網路。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在與 EC2 實例相同的私有子網路中創建公用 NAT 閘道。
B. 在與 EC2 實例相同的私有子網路中創建私有 NAT 閘道。
C. 在與 EC2 實例相同的 VPC 中的公用子網路中創建公用 NAT 閘道。
D. 在與 EC2 實例相同的 VPC 中的公用子網路中創建私有 NAT 閘道。
解析(中): 要讓 Amazon EC2 實例在私有子網路中能夠通過 NAT 閘道連接到公眾網際網路，需要創建公用 NAT 閘道，並將其放在公用子網路中。這樣，私有子網路中的 EC2 實例就可以通過路由表將流量導向公用 NAT 閘道，然後再由 NAT 閘道轉發到公眾網際網路。選項 C 是正確的，因為它正確地描述了這種架構：創建公用 NAT 閘道在公用子網路中，並且這些公用子網路與私有子網路中的 EC2 實例位於相同的 VPC 中。選項 A 和 B 不正確，因為 NAT 閘道不應該放在私有子網路中。選項 D 不正確，因為私有 NAT 閘道不是一個有效的選擇，NAT 閘道通常是公用的，以便能夠連接到公眾網際網路。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has an organization in AWS Organizations. The company runs Amazon EC2 instances across four AWS accounts in the root
organizational unit (OU). There are three nonproduction accounts and one production account. The company wants to prohibit users from
launching EC2 instances of a certain size in the nonproduction accounts. The company has created a service control policy (SCP) to deny
access to launch instances that use the prohibited types.
Which solutions to deploy the SCP will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Attach the SCP to the root OU for the organization.
B. Attach the SCP to the three nonproduction Organizations member accounts.
C. Attach the SCP to the Organizations management account.
D. Create an OU for the production account. Attach the SCP to the OU. Move the production member account into the new OU.
E. Create an OU for the required accounts. Attach the SCP to the OU. Move the nonproduction member accounts into the new OU.
解析(英):
To meet your company's needs, you need to ensure that users in non-production accounts cannot launch EC2 instances of certain sizes. The correct answer is DE. Option E is correct because it attaches the SCP to the OU that contains the non-production account, which restricts users in the non-production account from launching EC2 instances of certain sizes. Option D is also correct because it moves the production account to a new OU and attaches the SCP to the OU that contains the non-production account, thus ensuring that the production account is not restricted by the SCP.

Option A is incorrect because attaching the SCP to the root OU will apply the restriction to all accounts, including the production account. Choice B is incorrect because attaching SCPs to individual non-production accounts may cause administrative complexity and inconsistency. Choice C is incorrect because attaching an SCP to an organization's administrative account does not affect users in member accounts. Therefore, the correct answer is DE.
題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中有一個組織。該公司在根組織單位 (OU) 中的四個 AWS 帳戶中運行 Amazon EC2 實例。其中有三個非生產帳戶和一個生產帳戶。該公司希望禁止用戶在非生產帳戶中啟動某些大小的 EC2 實例。該公司已經建立了一個服務控制政策 (SCP) 以拒絕存取啟動使用禁止類型的實例。哪些解決方案可以部署 SCP 以滿足這些需求？ (選擇兩個。)
選項(中):
A. 將 SCP 附加到組織的根 OU。
B. 將 SCP 附加到三個非生產組織成員帳戶。
C. 將 SCP 附加到組織管理帳戶。
D. 為生產帳戶建立一個 OU。將 SCP 附加到 OU。將生產成員帳戶移到新 OU 中。
E. 為所需帳戶建立一個 OU。將 SCP 附加到 OU。將非生產成員帳戶移到新 OU 中。
解析(中):
要滿足公司的需求，需要確保非生產帳戶中的用戶無法啟動某些大小的 EC2 實例。正確的答案是 DE。選項 E 是正確的，因為它將 SCP 附加到包含非生產帳戶的 OU 中，這樣就可以限制非生產帳戶中的用戶啟動某些大小的 EC2 實例。選項 D 也是正確的，因為它將生產帳戶移到一個新的 OU 中，並將 SCP 附加到包含非生產帳戶的 OU 中，這樣就可以確保生產帳戶不受 SCP 的限制。

選項 A 不正確，因為將 SCP 附加到根 OU 中會將限制應用到所有帳戶，包括生產帳戶。選項 B 不正確，因為將 SCP 附加到個別的非生產帳戶中可能會導致管理複雜性和不一致性。選項 C 不正確，因為將 SCP 附加到組織管理帳戶中不會影響到成員帳戶中的用戶。因此，正確的答案是 DE。

題目(英):
A company’s website hosted on Amazon EC2 instances processes classied data stored in Amazon S3. Due to security concerns, the company
requires a private and secure connection between its EC2 resources and Amazon S3.
Which solution meets these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Set up S3 bucket policies to allow access from a VPC endpoint.
B. Set up an IAM policy to grant read-write access to the S3 bucket.
C. Set up a NAT gateway to access resources outside the private subnet.
D. Set up an access key ID and a secret access key to access the S3 bucket.
解析(英):
The answer is A because setting the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the VPC endpoint is the most secure solution. A VPC endpoint is a private and secure connection that allows EC2 instances to directly access S3 buckets without going through the public network. This solution meets the company's security needs while ensuring data privacy and integrity.

The other options are incorrect because:
B. Setting an IAM policy only grants access to the S3 bucket, but does not guarantee the privacy and security of the connection.
C. Setting up a NAT gateway is used to access resources outside the private subnet, but does not meet the company's security needs.
D. Set the access key ID and key. The access key is used to access the S3 bucket, but this method is not safe because the access key may be stolen or leaked.

Therefore, setting the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the VPC endpoint is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司的網站托管在 Amazon EC2 實例上，處理儲存在 Amazon S3 中的機密數據。由於安全問題，公司需要在其 EC2 資源和 Amazon S3 之間建立私密和安全的連接。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 設置 S3 存儲桶策略，以允許從 VPC 端點訪問。
B. 設置 IAM 策略，以授予對 S3 存儲桶的讀寫訪問權限。
C. 設置 NAT 閘道，以訪問私有子網路以外的資源。
D. 設置存取金鑰 ID 和密鑰存取金鑰，以訪問 S3 存儲桶。
解析(中):
答案是 A，因為設置 S3 存儲桶策略，以允許從 VPC 端點訪問，是最安全的解決方案。VPC 端點是一個私密和安全的連接，允許 EC2 實例直接訪問 S3 存儲桶，而無需通過公網。這種解決方案滿足了公司的安全需求，同時也能夠確保數據的私密性和完整性。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
B. 設置 IAM 策略只能授予對 S3 存儲桶的訪問權限，但不能保證連接的私密性和安全性。
C. 設置 NAT 閘道是用於訪問私有子網路以外的資源，但不能滿足公司的安全需求。
D. 設置存取金鑰 ID 和密鑰存取金鑰是用於訪問 S3 存儲桶，但這種方法不安全，因為存取金鑰可能會被竊取或泄露。

因此，設置 S3 存儲桶策略，以允許從 VPC 端點訪問，是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
An ecommerce company runs its application on AWS. The application uses an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL cluster in Multi-AZ mode for the
underlying database. During a recent promotional campaign, the application experienced heavy read load and write load. Users experienced
timeout issues when they attempted to access the application.
A solutions architect needs to make the application architecture more scalable and highly available.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST downtime?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has the Aurora cluster as a source. Create an AWS Lambda function to log the state change
events of the Aurora cluster. Add the Lambda function as a target for the EventBridge rule. Add additional reader nodes to fail over to.
B. Modify the Aurora cluster and activate the zero-downtime restart (ZDR) feature. Use Database Activity Streams on the cluster to track
the cluster status.
C. Add additional reader instances to the Aurora cluster. Create an Amazon RDS Proxy target group for the Aurora cluster.
D. Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cache. Replicate data from the Aurora cluster to Redis by using AWS Database Migration
Service (AWS DMS) with a write-around approach.
解析(英): The correct answer is C, because adding additional read instances to the Aurora cluster can increase read capabilities, reduce the impact of read load on the main instance, and can perform load distribution and connection management through Amazon RDS Proxy target groups, thereby improving the scalability and high availability of the application. This solution can be implemented with minimal downtime since adding read instances and setting up RDS Proxy does not require downtime. The other options are incorrect because: option A requires the creation of EventBridge rules and Lambda functions, but this does not directly address read and write workloads; option B enables zero downtime restart (ZDR) functionality, but this does not directly increase read capacity; option D uses ElastiCache for Redis cache and AWS DMS to replicate the data, but this requires additional setup and maintenance and may cause data consistency issues. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家電子商務公司在 AWS 上運行其應用程式，該應用程式使用 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 叢集在多可用區模式下作為底層資料庫。在最近的促銷活動期間，應用程式遇到了大量的讀取和寫入負載，使用者在嘗試存取應用程式時遇到了逾時問題。一個解決方案架構師需要使應用程式架構更加可擴展和高可用。哪種解決方案可以在最少的停機時間下滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立一個 Amazon EventBridge 規則，其源為 Aurora 叢集。建立一個 AWS Lambda 函數來記錄 Aurora 叢集的狀態變更事件。將 Lambda 函數作為 EventBridge 規則的目標。新增額外的讀取節點以進行故障轉移。
B. 修改 Aurora 叢集並啟用零停機時間重啟 (ZDR) 功能。使用叢集上的資料庫活動串流 (Database Activity Streams) 來追蹤叢集狀態。
C. 將額外的讀取實例新增到 Aurora 叢集。建立一個 Amazon RDS Proxy 目標群組給 Aurora 叢集。
D. 建立一個 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 快取。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 和寫入周圍 (write-around) 方法將資料從 Aurora 叢集複製到 Redis。
解析(中): 正確答案是 C，因為新增額外的讀取實例到 Aurora 叢集可以增加讀取能力，減少讀取負載對主實例的影響，並且可以透過 Amazon RDS Proxy 目標群組來進行負載分配和連線管理，從而提高應用程式的可擴展性和高可用性。這個解決方案可以在最少的停機時間下實現，因為新增讀取實例和設定 RDS Proxy 不需要停機。其他選項不正確，因為：A 選項需要建立 EventBridge 規則和 Lambda 函數，但這不直接解決讀取和寫入負載的問題；B 選項啟用零停機時間重啟 (ZDR) 功能，但這不直接增加讀取能力；D 選項使用 ElastiCache for Redis 快取和 AWS DMS 複製資料，但這需要額外的設定和維護，並且可能導致資料一致性問題。因此，選項 C 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is designing a web application on AWS. The application will use a VPN connection between the company’s existing data centers
and the company's VPCs.
The company uses Amazon Route 53 as its DNS service. The application must use private DNS records to communicate with the on-premises
services from a VPC.
Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure manner?
選項(英):
A. Create a Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoint. Create a resolver rule. Associate the resolver rule with the VPC.
B. Create a Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint. Create a resolver rule. Associate the resolver rule with the VPC.
C. Create a Route 53 private hosted zone. Associate the private hosted zone with the VPC.
D. Create a Route 53 public hosted zone. Create a record for each service to allow service communication
解析(英):
To meet the company's needs, private DNS records are required to communicate with internal services. Route 53 Resolver's outbound endpoint enables applications in a VPC to resolve private DNS records for internal services. Establish resolution rules to specify which DNS queries need to be forwarded to internal services. Associating resolution rules with a VPC ensures that only applications in the VPC can access the internal service's private DNS records. Therefore, option A is the safest solution.

Choice B is incorrect because the inbound endpoint is used to allow internal services to resolve private DNS records in the VPC, not the other way around. Choice C is incorrect because creating a private host zone only allows applications in the VPC to resolve private DNS records, but not internal services. Choice D is incorrect because establishing a public host zone would expose private DNS records to the Internet, thereby increasing security risks.
題目(中): 一家公司正在設計一個在 AWS 上的網頁應用程式。該應用程式將使用公司現有的資料中心和公司的 VPC 之間的 VPN 連接。公司使用 Amazon Route 53 作為其 DNS 服務。該應用程式必須使用私人 DNS 記錄來與 VPC 中的內部服務進行通訊。哪種解決方案能夠以最安全的方式滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立 Route 53 Resolver 的出站端點。建立解析規則。將解析規則與 VPC 相關聯。
B. 建立 Route 53 Resolver 的入站端點。建立解析規則。將解析規則與 VPC 相關聯。
C. 建立 Route 53 私人主機區域。將私人主機區域與 VPC 相關聯。
D. 建立 Route 53 公共主機區域。為每個服務建立記錄以允許服務通訊
解析(中):
為了滿足公司的需求，需要使用私人 DNS 記錄來與內部服務進行通訊。Route 53 Resolver 的出站端點可以讓 VPC 中的應用程式解析內部服務的私人 DNS 記錄。建立解析規則可以指定哪些 DNS 查詢需要被轉發到內部服務。將解析規則與 VPC 相關聯可以確保只有 VPC 中的應用程式可以存取內部服務的私人 DNS 記錄。因此，選項 A 是最安全的解決方案。

選項 B 不正確，因為入站端點是用於允許內部服務解析 VPC 中的私人 DNS 記錄，而不是相反。選項 C 不正確，因為建立私人主機區域只能允許 VPC 中的應用程式解析私人 DNS 記錄，但不能允許內部服務解析 VPC 中的私人 DNS 記錄。選項 D 不正確，因為建立公共主機區域會將私人 DNS 記錄公開到網際網路，從而增加安全風險。

題目(英):
A company is running a photo hosting service in the us-east-1 Region. The service enables users across multiple countries to upload and view
photos. Some photos are heavily viewed for months, and others are viewed for less than a week. The application allows uploads of up to 20
MB for each photo. The service uses the photo metadata to determine which photos to display to each user.
Which solution provides the appropriate user access MOST cost-effectively?
選項(英):
A. Store the photos in Amazon DynamoDB. Turn on DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache frequently viewed items.
B. Store the photos in the Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Store the photo metadata and its S3 location in DynamoDB.
C. Store the photos in the Amazon S3 Standard storage class. Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to move photos older than 30 days to the S3
Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class. Use the object tags to keep track of metadata.
D. Store the photos in the Amazon S3 Glacier storage class. Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to move photos older than 30 days to the S3
Glacier Deep Archive storage class. Store the photo metadata and its S3 location in Amazon OpenSearch Service.
解析(英):
Answer B is correct because it provides appropriate user access in the most cost-effective manner. Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage tiering automatically adjusts storage tiers based on how often photos are accessed, reducing storage costs. At the same time, the photo metadata and its S3 location are stored in DynamoDB, so photos can be quickly queried and accessed, thereby improving user experience. 
Choice A is incorrect because DynamoDB is not suitable for storing large binary files such as photos. Choice C is incorrect because the S3 Standard-IA storage class has higher access fees and requires manual setting of Lifecycle policies. Choice D is incorrect because the S3 Glacier and S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage classes have higher access fees and require manual setting of Lifecycle policies, and Amazon OpenSearch Service is not suitable for storing photo metadata. 
Therefore, answer B is the most cost-effective solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在 us-east-1 區域運行一個照片主機服務，該服務允許來自多個國家的用戶上傳和查看照片。有些照片會被大量瀏覽數月，而其他照片則只被瀏覽不到一周。該應用程式允許每張照片上傳大小最多為 20 MB。該服務使用照片的中繼資料來確定顯示給每個用戶的照片。哪種解決方案能夠以最具成本效益的方式提供適當的用戶存取權？
選項(中):
A. 將照片存儲在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。啟用 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 來緩存經常瀏覽的項目。
B. 將照片存儲在 Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering 儲存等級中。將照片中繼資料和其 S3 位置存儲在 DynamoDB 中。
C. 將照片存儲在 Amazon S3 Standard 儲存等級中。設定 S3 Lifecycle 政策將 30 天以上的照片移至 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 儲存等級中。使用物件標籤來跟蹤中繼資料。
D. 將照片存儲在 Amazon S3 Glacier 儲存等級中。設定 S3 Lifecycle 政策將 30 天以上的照片移至 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 儲存等級中。將照片中繼資料和其 S3 位置存儲在 Amazon OpenSearch Service 中。
解析(中):
答案 B 是正確的，因為它能夠以最具成本效益的方式提供適當的用戶存取權。Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering 儲存等級可以根據照片的存取頻率自動調整儲存等級，從而降低儲存成本。同時，將照片中繼資料和其 S3 位置存儲在 DynamoDB 中，可以快速地查詢和存取照片，從而提高用戶體驗。 
選項 A 不正確，因為 DynamoDB 不適合存儲大型二進制文件，如照片。選項 C 不正確，因為 S3 Standard-IA 儲存等級的存取費用較高，且需要手動設定 Lifecycle 政策。選項 D 不正確，因為 S3 Glacier 和 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 儲存等級的存取費用較高，且需要手動設定 Lifecycle 政策，同時 Amazon OpenSearch Service 不適合存儲照片中繼資料。 
因此，答案 B 是最具成本效益的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company runs a highly available web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The company uses
Amazon CloudWatch metrics.
As the trac to the web application increases, some EC2 instances become overloaded with many outstanding requests. The CloudWatch
metrics show that the number of requests processed and the time to receive the responses from some EC2 instances are both higher
compared to other EC2 instances. The company does not want new requests to be forwarded to the EC2 instances that are already
overloaded.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use the round robin routing algorithm based on the RequestCountPerTarget and ActiveConnectionCount CloudWatch metrics.
B. Use the least outstanding requests algorithm based on the RequestCountPerTarget and ActiveConnectionCount CloudWatch metrics.
C. Use the round robin routing algorithm based on the RequestCount and TargetResponseTime CloudWatch metrics.
D. Use the least outstanding requests algorithm based on the RequestCount and TargetResponseTime CloudWatch metrics.
解析(英): The correct answer is B because using the least outstanding requests algorithm based on the RequestCountPerTarget and ActiveConnectionCount CloudWatch metrics ensures that new requests are forwarded to the EC2 instance handling the fewest outstanding requests. This prevents an already overloaded EC2 instance from receiving more requests, thereby improving overall system availability and response time. Option A uses a round-robin routing algorithm that cannot ensure that new requests are forwarded to the idlest EC2 instance. Options C and D use metrics that are not comprehensive enough to accurately assess the load of the EC2 instance. Therefore, option B is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司運行一個高可用性的網頁應用程式在 Amazon EC2 實例後面有一個應用程式負載平衡器。公司使用 Amazon CloudWatch metrics。隨著網頁應用程式的流量增加，一些 EC2 實例變得過載，處理許多未完成的請求。CloudWatch metrics 顯示，某些 EC2 實例處理的請求數量和響應時間都比其他 EC2 實例高。公司不希望新的請求被轉發到已經過載的 EC2 實例。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用基於 RequestCountPerTarget 和 ActiveConnectionCount CloudWatch metrics 的循環路由演算法。
B. 使用基於 RequestCountPerTarget 和 ActiveConnectionCount CloudWatch metrics 的最少未完成請求演算法。
C. 使用基於 RequestCount 和 TargetResponseTime CloudWatch metrics 的循環路由演算法。
D. 使用基於 RequestCount 和 TargetResponseTime CloudWatch metrics 的最少未完成請求演算法。
解析(中): 正確答案是 B，因為使用基於 RequestCountPerTarget 和 ActiveConnectionCount CloudWatch metrics 的最少未完成請求演算法可以確保新的請求被轉發到處理未完成請求最少的 EC2 實例。這樣可以避免已經過載的 EC2 實例接收到更多的請求，進而提高整體系統的可用性和響應時間。選項 A 使用循環路由演算法無法確保新的請求被轉發到最空閒的 EC2 實例，選項 C 和 D 使用的 metrics 不夠全面，無法準確評估 EC2 實例的負載情況。因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company uses Amazon EC2, AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda to run multiple workloads in the company's AWS account. The company wants to

選項(英):
A. Create a daily budget for the Savings Plans by using AWS Budgets. Congure the budget with a coverage threshold to send notications

email the report to the appropriate email message recipients.
C. Create an AWS Budgets report for the Savings Plans budget. Set the frequency to daily.

The other options are incorrect because: Option B requires creating a Lambda function and Amazon SES to send notifications, adding complexity and cost. 題目(中): 一家公司使用 Amazon EC2、AWS Fargate 和 AWS Lambda 在其 AWS 帳戶中運行多個工作負載。該公司希望充分利用其計算節省計劃（Compute Savings Plans）。該公司希望在計算節省計劃的覆蓋率下降時收到通知。哪個解決方案能夠以最大的運營效率滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 AWS Budgets 創建計算節省計劃的每日預算。配置預算以設定覆蓋率閾值並向適當的電子郵件收件人發送通知。
B. 創建一個 Lambda 函數，運行計算節省計劃的覆蓋率報告。使用 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) 將報告通過電子郵件發送給適當的電子郵件收件人。
C. 創建計算節省計劃預算的 AWS Budgets 報告。將頻率設為每日。
D. 創建計算節省計劃的警報訂閱。啟用所有通知選項。輸入電子郵件地址以接收通知。
解析(中): 對於這個問題，正確答案是 A。因為使用 AWS Budgets 創建計算節省計劃的每日預算，可以設定覆蓋率閾值，當覆蓋率下降時，會自動向指定的電子郵件收件人發送通知。這個解決方案具有最大的運營效率，因為它可以自動化通知流程，不需要手動干預。其他選項不正確的原因是：選項 B 需要創建一個 Lambda 函數和 Amazon SES 來發送通知，增加了複雜性和成本。選項 C 創建的報告不會自動發送通知。選項 D 沒有提供設定覆蓋率閾值的功能，無法滿足公司的需求。因此，選項 A 是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company runs a real-time data ingestion solution on AWS. The solution consists of the most recent version of Amazon Managed Streaming
for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK). The solution is deployed in a VPC in private subnets across three Availability Zones.
A solutions architect needs to redesign the data ingestion solution to be publicly available over the internet. The data in transit must also be
encrypted.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational eciency?
選項(英):
A. Congure public subnets in the existing VPC. Deploy an MSK cluster in the public subnets. Update the MSK cluster security settings to
enable mutual TLS authentication.
B. Create a new VPC that has public subnets. Deploy an MSK cluster in the public subnets. Update the MSK cluster security settings to
enable mutual TLS authentication.
C. Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that uses private subnets. Congure an ALB security group inbound rule to allow inbound
trac from the VPC CIDR block for HTTPS protocol.
D. Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) that uses private subnets. Congure an NLB listener for HTTPS communication over the
internet.
解析(英): The answer is A because it meets the demand and has the highest operational efficiency. The existing VPC has been configured with private subnets and MSK clusters. Reconfiguring the public subnet and updating the MSK cluster security settings can quickly meet the needs. This approach eliminates the need to create a new VPC or deploy a new load balancer, reducing complexity and cost. Additionally, enabling mutual TLS verification ensures secure data transmission. The other options are incorrect because option B requires the creation of a new VPC, and options C and D require the deployment of a new load balancer, adding complexity and cost. Options C and D also require additional configuration and management, reducing operational efficiency. Therefore, option A is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在 AWS 上運行了一個實時數據攝取解決方案。該解決方案由 Apache Kafka 的最新版本（Amazon MSK）組成。該解決方案部署在三個可用區域的私有子網中。解決方案架構師需要重新設計數據攝取解決方案，以便在網際網路上公開可用。傳輸中的數據也必須加密。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求，並具有最高的運營效率？
選項(中):
A. 在現有的 VPC 中配置公有子網。將 MSK 叢集部署在公有子網中。更新 MSK 叢集安全設定以啟用相互 TLS 驗證。
B. 創建一個具有公有子網的新 VPC。將 MSK 叢集部署在公有子網中。更新 MSK 叢集安全設定以啟用相互 TLS 驗證。
C. 部署一個使用私有子網的應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB)。配置 ALB 安全群組入站規則以允許從 VPC CIDR 區塊的 HTTPS 通訊協定傳入流量。
D. 部署一個使用私有子網的網路負載平衡器 (NLB)。配置 NLB 監聽器以進行 HTTPS 通訊。
解析(中): 答案是 A，因為它能夠滿足需求並具有最高的運營效率。現有的 VPC 已經配置好了私有子網和 MSK 叢集，重新配置公有子網並更新 MSK 叢集安全設定可以快速滿足需求。這種方法不需要創建新的 VPC 或部署新的負載平衡器，從而減少了複雜性和成本。另外，啟用相互 TLS 驗證可以確保數據傳輸的安全。其他選項不正確，因為選項 B 需要創建新的 VPC，選項 C 和 D 需要部署新的負載平衡器，增加了複雜性和成本。選項 C 和 D 還需要額外的配置和管理，降低了運營效率。因此，選項 A 是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company wants to migrate an on-premises legacy application to AWS. The application ingests customer order les from an on-premises
enterprise resource planning (ERP) system. The application then uploads the les to an SFTP server. The application uses a scheduled job
that checks for order les every hour.
The company already has an AWS account that has connectivity to the on-premises network. The new application on AWS must support
integration with the existing ERP system. The new application must be secure and resilient and must use the SFTP protocol to process orders
from the ERP system immediately.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP internet-facing server in two Availability Zones. Use Amazon S3 storage. Create an AWS Lambda
function to process order les. Use S3 Event Notications to send s3:ObjectCreated:* events to the Lambda function.

解析(英): The answer is D because it meets all the requirements. The other options are incorrect because Option A creates servers facing the Internet, which may increase security risks; Option B only creates servers in one availability zone, which may affect high availability; Option C uses Amazon EFS storage and Step Functions state machines, which may increase complexity and cost. 題目(中): 一家公司想要將一個內部部署的傳統應用程式遷移到 AWS。該應用程式會從內部部署的企業資源規劃（ERP）系統中讀取客戶訂單檔案，然後上傳檔案到 SFTP 伺服器。該應用程式使用一個排程工作，每小時檢查一次訂單檔案。公司已經有一個具有連接內部部署網路的 AWS 帳戶，新的 AWS 應用程式必須支援與現有的 ERP 系統整合，同時必須是安全且容錯的，並使用 SFTP 通訊協定立即處理來自 ERP 系統的訂單。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在兩個可用區域中建立一個面向網際網路的 AWS Transfer Family SFTP 伺服器，使用 Amazon S3 儲存。建立一個 AWS Lambda 函數來處理訂單檔案，使用 S3 事件通知將 s3:ObjectCreated:* 事件發送到 Lambda 函數。
B. 在一個可用區域中建立一個面向網際網路的 AWS Transfer Family SFTP 伺服器，使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 儲存。建立一個 AWS Lambda 函數來處理訂單檔案，使用 Transfer Family 管理工作流程來調用 Lambda 函數。
C. 在兩個可用區域中建立一個內部的 AWS Transfer Family SFTP 伺服器，使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 儲存。建立一個 AWS Step Functions 狀態機器來處理訂單檔案，使用 Amazon EventBridge Scheduler 來調用狀態機器定期檢查 Amazon EFS 中的訂單檔案。
D. 在兩個可用區域中建立一個內部的 AWS Transfer Family SFTP 伺服器，使用 Amazon S3 儲存。建立一個 AWS Lambda 函數來處理訂單檔案，使用 Transfer Family 管理工作流程來調用 Lambda 函數。
解析(中): 答案是 D，因為它滿足了所有的需求。首先，建立一個內部的 AWS Transfer Family SFTP 伺服器可以確保只有公司內部的網路可以存取，提高了安全性。其次，在兩個可用區域中建立伺服器可以確保高可用性和容錯性。使用 Amazon S3 儲存可以提供高可用性和耐用性的檔案儲存。最後，使用 Transfer Family 管理工作流程來調用 Lambda 函數可以自動化訂單檔案的處理。其他選項不正確，因為選項 A 建立的是面向網際網路的伺服器，可能會增加安全風險；選項 B 只在一個可用區域中建立伺服器，可能會影響高可用性；選項 C 使用 Amazon EFS 儲存和 Step Functions 狀態機器，可能會增加複雜性和成本。因此，選項 D 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company’s applications use Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark to process data on premises. The existing infrastructure is not scalable and
is complex to manage.
A solutions architect must design a scalable solution that reduces operational complexity. The solution must keep the data processing on
premises.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN to access the on-premises Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) data and application. Use an Amazon EMR
cluster to process the data.
B. Use AWS DataSync to connect to the on-premises Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) cluster. Create an Amazon EMR cluster to
process the data.
C. Migrate the Apache Hadoop application and the Apache Spark application to Amazon EMR clusters on AWS Outposts. Use the EMR
clusters to process the data.
D. Use an AWS Snowball device to migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an Amazon EMR cluster to process the data.
解析(英):
The correct answer is C. This is because the question requires that the solution must keep data processing in-house, and AWS Outposts is a solution that can bring AWS services in-house. By migrating your Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark applications to an Amazon EMR cluster on AWS Outposts, you can keep data processing in-house and use the Amazon EMR cluster for data processing. This solution reduces operational complexity and provides scalability.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Using AWS site-to-site VPN to access on-premises HDFS data and applications requires transferring data to the AWS cloud, violating the requirement to keep data processing on-premises.
B. Using AWS DataSync to connect to an on-premises HDFS cluster also requires transferring data to the AWS cloud, again violating the requirement to keep data processing on-premises.
D. Using an AWS Snowball device to migrate data to an Amazon S3 bucket clearly violates the requirement to keep data processing on-premises because the data will be moved to the AWS cloud.
題目(中): 一家公司的應用程式使用 Apache Hadoop 和 Apache Spark 進行資料處理，且資料處理是在內部進行的。現有的基礎設施無法擴展且管理複雜。解決方案架構師必須設計一個可擴展的解決方案，以降低操作複雜性。解決方案必須保持資料處理在內部進行。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？

A. 使用 AWS 站點對站點 VPN 存取內部 Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) 資料和應用程式。使用 Amazon EMR 叢集進行資料處理。

解析(中):
正確答案是 C。這是因為題目要求解決方案必須保持資料處理在內部進行，而 AWS Outposts 是一個可以將 AWS 服務帶到內部的解決方案。通過將 Apache Hadoop 和 Apache Spark 應用程式遷移到 AWS Outposts 上的 Amazon EMR 叢集，可以保持資料處理在內部進行，並且可以使用 Amazon EMR 叢集進行資料處理。這個解決方案可以降低操作複雜性並且提供可擴展的能力。

其他選項不正確的原因是：

題目(中): 一家公司正在將大量數據從內部儲存遷移到 AWS。同一 AWS 區域中的 Windows、Mac 和 Linux 基礎的 Amazon EC2 實例將使用 SMB 和 NFS 儲存協定存取數據。公司將定期存取部分數據，間歇性存取其餘數據。公司需要設計一個解決方案來存放數據。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求，並且具有最少的運營負擔？

題目(英):
A manufacturing company runs its report generation application on AWS. The application generates each report in about 20 minutes. The
application is built as a monolith that runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance. The application requires frequent updates to its tightly coupled
modules. The application becomes complex to maintain as the company adds new features.
Each time the company patches a software module, the application experiences downtime. Report generation must restart from the beginning
after any interruptions. The company wants to redesign the application so that the application can be exible, scalable, and gradually
improved. The company wants to minimize application downtime.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Run the application on AWS Lambda as a single function with maximum provisioned concurrency.
B. Run the application on Amazon EC2 Spot Instances as microservices with a Spot Fleet default allocation strategy.
C. Run the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) as microservices with service auto scaling.
D. Run the application on AWS Elastic Beanstalk as a single application environment with an all-at-once deployment strategy.
解析(英):
The answer is C, because Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) provides a powerful container orchestration platform that allows companies to split their applications into microservices. This allows companies to update and expand each service independently without affecting other services. The service automatic expansion function can dynamically adjust the number of service instances according to demand, ensuring that the application is elastic and scalable. In addition, Amazon ECS supports containerized applications, which can reduce downtime and improve maintenance efficiency.

Option A is incorrect because AWS Lambda, as a serverless computing service, may not be suitable for long-running tasks such as report generation. In addition, the maximum configured concurrency for a single function may not meet the company's needs.

Choice B is incorrect because Amazon EC2 Spot Instances are an on-demand pricing instance type that may not provide adequate reliability and availability. Spot Fleet preset configuration strategies may not meet your company's needs, especially where rapid expansion and contraction are required.

Choice D is incorrect because AWS Elastic Beanstalk is a service that manages environments and may not be suitable for complex microservices architectures. An all-at-once deployment strategy can lead to downtime and inefficient maintenance.
題目(中): 一家製造公司在 AWS 上運行其報表生成應用程式。該應用程式大約需要 20 分鐘來生成每個報表。該應用程式被設計為一個單體式應用程式，運行在單個 Amazon EC2 實例上。該應用程式需要對其緊密耦合的模組進行頻繁更新。隨著公司添加新功能，應用程式變得越來越複雜且難以維護。每當公司修補軟體模組時，應用程式都會經歷停機時間。報表生成必須在任何中斷後從頭開始。公司希望重新設計應用程式，以使其具有彈性、可擴展性和逐漸改進的能力。公司希望盡量減少應用程式的停機時間。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些要求？
選項(中):
A. 將應用程式作為單個函數運行在 AWS Lambda 上，具有最大配置的並發數。
B. 將應用程式作為微服務運行在 Amazon EC2 Spot Instances 上，具有 Spot Fleet 預設配置策略。
C. 將應用程式作為微服務運行在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上，具有服務自動擴展。
D. 將應用程式作為單個應用程式環境運行在 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 上，具有全部一次性部署策略。
解析(中):
答案是 C，因為 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 提供了一個強大的容器編排平台，允許公司將其應用程式拆分為微服務。這使得公司可以獨立更新和擴展每個服務，而不會影響其他服務。服務自動擴展功能可以根據需求動態調整服務的實例數量，確保應用程式具有彈性和可擴展性。另外，Amazon ECS 支持容器化應用程式，可以減少停機時間和提高維護效率。

選項 A 不正確，因為 AWS Lambda 作為無伺服器的計算服務，可能不適合長時間運行的任務，如報表生成。另外，單個函數的最大配置並發數可能無法滿足公司的需求。

選項 B 不正確，因為 Amazon EC2 Spot Instances 是一種按需定價的實例類型，可能無法提供足夠的可靠性和可用性。Spot Fleet 預設配置策略可能無法滿足公司的需求，尤其是在需要快速擴展和收縮的場合。

選項 D 不正確，因為 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 是一個管理環境的服務，可能不適合複雜的微服務架構。全部一次性部署策略可能會導致停機時間和維護效率低下。

題目(中): 一家公司想要將一個大型網頁應用程式重新架構為無伺服器微服務架構。該應用程式使用 Amazon EC2 執行個體，並以 Python 編寫。公司選擇了一個網頁應用程式的組件來測試作為微服務。該組件每秒支持數百個請求。公司想要在支援 Python 的 AWS 解決方案上創建和測試微服務。該解決方案必須自動擴展，並需要最少的基礎設施和最少的運營支持。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？

題目(英):
A company has an AWS Direct Connect connection from its on-premises location to an AWS account. The AWS account has 30 different VPCs
in the same AWS Region. The VPCs use private virtual interfaces (VIFs). Each VPC has a CIDR block that does not overlap with other networks
under the company's control.
The company wants to centrally manage the networking architecture while still allowing each VPC to communicate with all other VPCs and on-
premises networks.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Create a transit gateway, and associate the Direct Connect connection with a new transit VIF. Turn on the transit gateway's route
propagation feature.
B. Create a Direct Connect gateway. Recreate the private VIFs to use the new gateway. Associate each VPC by creating new virtual private
gateways.
C. Create a transit VPConnect the Direct Connect connection to the transit VPCreate a peering connection between all other VPCs in the
Region. Update the route tables.
D. Create AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections from on premises to each VPC. Ensure that both VPN tunnels are UP for each connection. Turn
on the route propagation feature.
解析(英): The correct answer is A, because establishing a transit gateway is the most effective way to centrally manage the network architecture and allow communication between VPCs. Forwarding gateways can connect multiple VPCs and on-premises networks, providing a single entry point to manage routing and connectivity. By enabling route propagation, the forwarding gateway can automatically propagate routes to all connected VPCs and on-premises networks, reducing operational burden. Other options require more setup and maintenance work, such as recreating private VIFs, establishing new virtual private gateways or VPN connections, etc. Therefore, option A is the most appropriate solution. Option B requires re-establishing private VIFs and virtual private gateways, adding complexity and operational burden. Option C requires establishing multiple peer connections and updating routing tables, which also increases the operational burden. Option D requires establishing multiple VPN connections and maintaining VPN tunnels, adding complexity and operational burden. Therefore, option A is the best choice.
題目(中): 一家公司已經在其內部部署位置和AWS帳戶之間建立了AWS Direct Connect連接。該AWS帳戶在同一AWS區域中有30個不同的VPC。這些VPC使用私有虛擬介面（VIFs）。每個VPC都有一個CIDR區塊，且不與公司控制下的其他網絡重疊。公司希望在保持每個VPC之間以及與內部部署網絡之間的通訊能力的情況下，集中管理網絡架構。哪種解決方案能夠以最少的運營負擔滿足這些需求？
