C. 建立一個轉發VPConnect。將Direct Connect連接連接到轉發VPConnect。建立所有其他VPC在區域中的對等連接。更新路由表。
D. 從內部部署位置建立AWS站點到站點VPN連接到每個VPC。確保每個連接的兩個VPN隧道都啟用。啟用路由傳播功能。
解析(中): 正確答案是A，因為建立一個轉發閘道（transit gateway）是集中管理網絡架構和允許VPC之間通訊的最有效方法。轉發閘道可以連接多個VPC和內部部署網絡，提供一個單一的入口點來管理路由和連接。通過啟用路由傳播功能，轉發閘道可以自動將路由傳播到所有連接的VPC和內部部署網絡，減少了運營負擔。其他選項需要更多的設定和維護工作，例如重新建立私有VIFs、建立新的虛擬私有閘道或VPN連接等。因此，選項A是最合適的解決方案。選項B需要重新建立私有VIFs和虛擬私有閘道，增加了複雜性和運營負擔。選項C需要建立多個對等連接和更新路由表，同樣增加了運營負擔。選項D需要建立多個VPN連接和維護VPN隧道，增加了複雜性和運營負擔。因此，選項A是最好的選擇。

題目(英):
A company has applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances connect to Amazon RDS databases by using an IAM role
that has associated policies. The company wants to use AWS Systems Manager to patch the EC2 instances without disrupting the running
applications.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create a new IAM role. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy to the new IAM role. Attach the new IAM role to the EC2
instances and the existing IAM role.
B. Create an IAM user. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy to the IAM user. Congure Systems Manager to use the IAM
user to manage the EC2 instances.
C. Enable Default Host Conguration Management in Systems Manager to manage the EC2 instances.
D. Remove the existing policies from the existing IAM role. Add the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy to the existing IAM role.
解析(英): The answer is C, because enabling Default Host Configuration Management is a feature in AWS Systems Manager that allows you to manage settings and patch updates for EC2 instances without manually attaching IAM roles or policies. This feature can automatically manage the settings and patch updates of EC2 instances to meet the needs of the company. The other options are incorrect because the steps of creating a new IAM role or consumer, attaching policies, configuring Systems Manager to use an IAM consumer, etc. are unnecessary and may add complexity and security risks. Option D is also incorrect because removing the existing policy may cause the EC2 instance to lose necessary permissions, affecting the operation of the application. Therefore, enabling default hosting configuration management is the simplest and most secure solution.
題目(中): 一家公司有應用程式運行在 Amazon EC2 實例上。這些 EC2 實例使用 IAM 角色連接到 Amazon RDS 數據庫，該角色已經關聯了相關的政策。公司希望使用 AWS Systems Manager 將 EC2 實例進行補丁更新，而不中斷正在運行的應用程式。哪種解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 創建新的 IAM 角色，將 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 政策附加到新的 IAM 角色，然後將新的 IAM 角色附加到 EC2 實例和現有的 IAM 角色。
B. 創建 IAM 使用者，將 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 政策附加到 IAM 使用者，配置 Systems Manager 使用 IAM 使用者來管理 EC2 實例。
C. 啟用 Systems Manager 中的預設主機設定管理，以管理 EC2 實例。
D. 從現有的 IAM 角色中移除現有的政策，將 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 政策添加到現有的 IAM 角色。
解析(中): 答案是 C，因為啟用預設主機設定管理（Default Host Configuration Management）是 AWS Systems Manager 中的一個功能，允許您管理 EC2 實例的設定和補丁更新，而不需要手動附加 IAM 角色或政策。這個功能可以自動管理 EC2 實例的設定和補丁更新，滿足公司的需求。其他選項不正確，因為創建新的 IAM 角色或使用者、附加政策、配置 Systems Manager 使用 IAM 使用者等步驟都不是必要的，且可能會增加複雜性和安全風險。選項 D 也不是正確的，因為移除現有的政策可能會導致 EC2 實例失去必要的權限，從而影響應用程式的運行。因此，啟用預設主機設定管理是最簡單和最安全的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company runs container applications by using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) and the Kubernetes Horizontal Pod
Autoscaler. The workload is not consistent throughout the day. A solutions architect notices that the number of nodes does not automatically
scale out when the existing nodes have reached maximum capacity in the cluster, which causes performance issues.
Which solution will resolve this issue with the LEAST administrative overhead?
選項(英):
A. Scale out the nodes by tracking the memory usage.
B. Use the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler to manage the number of nodes in the cluster.
C. Use an AWS Lambda function to resize the EKS cluster automatically.
D. Use an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to distribute the workload.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B because the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler is a built-in Kubernetes component that automatically adjusts the number of nodes in a cluster to meet the needs of the workload. It can automatically add or remove nodes based on resource usage and workload changes in the cluster to ensure that the cluster has sufficient resources to execute the workload. This solution has minimal administrative burden because it is part of Kubernetes and requires no additional setup or maintenance.

The other options are incorrect because:
A. Merely tracking memory usage may not be enough to ensure that the cluster has sufficient resources because the workload may require other resources such as CPU or storage space.
C. Using an AWS Lambda function to resize an EKS cluster requires additional setup and maintenance, and may incur additional costs.
D. Using Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups to distribute workloads may require additional setup and maintenance, may incur additional costs, and may not be flexible enough to automatically adjust the number of nodes as workloads change.
題目(中): 一家公司使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 和 Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler 執行容器應用程式。工作負載在一天中並不一致。解決方案架構師注意到，當現有的節點達到叢集的最大容量時，節點數量並不會自動擴展，從而導致性能問題。哪種解決方案可以以最少的管理負擔解決此問題？
選項(中):
A. 通过追蹤記憶體使用情況來擴展節點。
B. 使用 Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler 來管理叢集中的節點數量。
C. 使用 AWS Lambda 函數自動重新調整 EKS 叢集的大小。
D. 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 群組來分配工作負載。
解析(中):
正確答案是 B，因為 Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler 是一個內建的 Kubernetes 元件，能夠自動調整叢集中的節點數量，以滿足工作負載的需求。它可以根據叢集中的資源使用情況和工作負載的變化，自動新增或刪除節點，以確保叢集有足夠的資源來執行工作負載。這個解決方案的管理負擔最小，因為它是 Kubernetes 的一部分，不需要額外的設定或維護。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
A. 只追蹤記憶體使用情況可能不足以確保叢集有足夠的資源，因為工作負載可能需要其他資源，如 CPU 或儲存空間。
C. 使用 AWS Lambda 函數來重新調整 EKS 叢集的大小需要額外的設定和維護，而且可能需要額外的成本。
D. 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 群組來分配工作負載可能需要額外的設定和維護，而且可能需要額外的成本，而且可能不夠靈活，無法根據工作負載的變化自動調整節點數量。

題目(英):
A company maintains about 300 TB in Amazon S3 Standard storage month after month. The S3 objects are each typically around 50 GB in size
and are frequently replaced with multipart uploads by their global application. The number and size of S3 objects remain constant, but the
company's S3 storage costs are increasing each month.
How should a solutions architect reduce costs in this situation?
選項(英):
A. Switch from multipart uploads to Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration.
B. Enable an S3 Lifecycle policy that deletes incomplete multipart uploads.
C. Congure S3 inventory to prevent objects from being archived too quickly.
D. Congure Amazon CloudFront to reduce the number of objects stored in Amazon S3.
解析(英): The answer is B, because enabling S3 lifecycle policies to remove incomplete multipart uploads can effectively reduce storage costs. In this case, the company's S3 object size and number remain the same, but storage costs continue to increase. This may be due to an incomplete multipart upload taking up storage space. By enabling S3 lifecycle policies, solutions architects can set up automatic deletion of incomplete multipart uploads, thereby reducing storage costs. The other options are incorrect because: Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration in option A is mainly used to speed up data transfer, rather than reducing storage costs; S3 inventory in option C is mainly used to track and manage S3 objects, rather than reducing storage costs; Amazon CloudFront in option D is mainly used to speed up data transfer and distribution, rather than reducing storage costs. Therefore, option B is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在 Amazon S3 標準儲存中維護約 300 TB 的資料，每個月都保持不變。S3 物件通常約為 50 GB 大小，並由其全球應用程式頻繁使用多部分上傳來替換。S3 物件的數量和大小保持不變，但公司的 S3 儲存成本每個月都在增加。解決方案架構師應如何在這種情況下降低成本？
選項(中):
A. 從多部分上傳切換到 Amazon S3 傳輸加速。
B. 啟用 S3 生命週期政策以刪除不完整的多部分上傳。
C. 設定 S3 清單以防止物件太快被歸檔。
D. 設定 Amazon CloudFront 以減少儲存在 Amazon S3 中的物件數量。
解析(中): 答案是 B，因為啟用 S3 生命週期政策以刪除不完整的多部分上傳可以有效地降低儲存成本。在這種情況下，公司的 S3 物件大小和數量保持不變，但儲存成本仍在增加。這可能是因為不完整的多部分上傳佔用了儲存空間。通過啟用 S3 生命週期政策，解決方案架構師可以設定自動刪除不完整的多部分上傳，從而降低儲存成本。其他選項不正確，因為：A 選項中的 Amazon S3 傳輸加速主要用於加速資料傳輸，而不是降低儲存成本；C 選項中的 S3 清單主要用於追蹤和管理 S3 物件，而不是降低儲存成本；D 選項中的 Amazon CloudFront 主要用於加速資料傳輸和分發，而不是降低儲存成本。因此，B 選項是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has deployed a multiplayer game for mobile devices. The game requires live location tracking of players based on latitude and
longitude. The data store for the game must support rapid updates and retrieval of locations.
The game uses an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance with read replicas to store the location data. During peak usage periods, the
database is unable to maintain the performance that is needed for reading and writing updates. The game's user base is increasing rapidly.
What should a solutions architect do to improve the performance of the data tier?
選項(英):
A. Take a snapshot of the existing DB instance. Restore the snapshot with Multi-AZ enabled.
B. Migrate from Amazon RDS to Amazon OpenSearch Service with OpenSearch Dashboards.
C. Deploy Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) in front of the existing DB instance. Modify the game to use DAX.
D. Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster in front of the existing DB instance. Modify the game to use Redis.
解析(英): The correct answer is D because Amazon ElastiCache for Redis provides a high-performance caching layer that reduces the read and write load on the database. The game's location data can be stored in Redis, allowing the game to quickly update and query its location. This improves the performance of the data layer, especially during peak usage periods. The reasons why the other options are incorrect are: Option A enabling snapshot restore across multiple availability zones can only increase database availability but not performance; Option B Amazon OpenSearch Service is primarily used for search and analysis, not real-time location tracking; Option C DAX is primarily used to accelerate Amazon DynamoDB, not PostgreSQL. Therefore, choosing option D is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司已經部署了一款手機多人遊戲，該遊戲需要根據緯度和經度進行玩家的實時位置追蹤。遊戲的資料存儲必須支持快速更新和查詢位置。遊戲使用 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB 實例和讀取複製來儲存位置資料。在高峰使用期間，資料庫無法維持所需的讀取和寫入更新效能。遊戲的用戶基數正在迅速增加。解決方案架構師應該做什麼來改善資料層的效能？
選項(中):
A. 將現有的 DB 實例快照。啟用多可用區域的快照還原。
B. 從 Amazon RDS 遷移到 Amazon OpenSearch Service，搭配 OpenSearch Dashboards。
C. 在現有的 DB 實例前部署 Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)。修改遊戲以使用 DAX。
D. 在現有的 DB 實例前部署 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 叢集。修改遊戲以使用 Redis。
解析(中): 正確答案是 D，因為 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 可以提供高效能的緩存層，減少資料庫的讀取和寫入負載。遊戲的位置資料可以儲存於 Redis 中，讓遊戲快速地更新和查詢位置。這樣可以改善資料層的效能，特別是在高峰使用期間。其他選項不正確的原因是：A 選項啟用多可用區域的快照還原只能提高資料庫的可用性，但不能改善效能；B 選項 Amazon OpenSearch Service 主要用於搜尋和分析，而不是用於實時位置追蹤；C 選項 DAX 主要用於 Amazon DynamoDB 的加速，而不是用於 PostgreSQL。因此，選擇 D 選項是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company stores critical data in Amazon DynamoDB tables in the company's AWS account. An IT administrator accidentally deleted a
DynamoDB table. The deletion caused a signicant loss of data and disrupted the company's operations. The company wants to prevent this
type of disruption in the future.
Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Congure a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule for delete actions. Create an AWS Lambda function to
automatically restore deleted DynamoDB tables.
B. Create a backup and restore plan for the DynamoDB tables. Recover the DynamoDB tables manually.
C. Congure deletion protection on the DynamoDB tables.
D. Enable point-in-time recovery on the DynamoDB tables.
解析(英):
The answer is C, because configuring deletion protection is the most direct and effective way to prevent accidental deletion of DynamoDB tables. This feature can be enabled on DynamoDB tables and will automatically block the deletion when someone attempts to delete the table, thus preventing data loss and disruption. This method has the lowest operating costs because it requires no additional resources or complex setup.

Option A requires configuring AWS CloudTrail, Amazon EventBridge, and AWS Lambda functions, which is a complex process that requires additional resources and maintenance. Option B requires manual recovery of the table, which may take a long time and may not fully recover all data. Option D: Enable point-in-time recovery to restore tables to a certain point in time, but this feature may not completely prevent accidental deletion. Therefore, option C is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在其AWS帳戶中的Amazon DynamoDB表格中存儲了重要數據。一個IT管理員不小心刪除了DynamoDB表格。刪除導致了大量數據丟失，破壞了公司的運營。公司希望在未來防止這種中斷。
選項(中):
A. 配置AWS CloudTrail中的跟蹤記錄。為刪除動作創建Amazon EventBridge規則。創建AWS Lambda函數以自動恢復刪除的DynamoDB表格。
B. 創建DynamoDB表格的備份和恢復計劃。手動恢復DynamoDB表格。
C. 對DynamoDB表格配置刪除保護。
D. 啟用DynamoDB表格的點時恢復。
解析(中):
答案是 C，因為配置刪除保護（Deletion Protection）是防止意外刪除DynamoDB表格的最直接和有效的方法。這個功能可以在DynamoDB表格上啟用，當有人嘗試刪除表格時，會自動阻止刪除動作，從而防止數據丟失和中斷。這個方法的運營成本最低，因為它不需要額外的資源或複雜的設定。

選項 A 需要配置 AWS CloudTrail、Amazon EventBridge 和 AWS Lambda 函數，這個過程比較複雜，需要額外的資源和維護。選項 B 需要手動恢復表格，這個過程可能需要較長的時間，且可能無法完全恢復所有數據。選項 D 啟用點時恢復（Point-in-Time Recovery）可以恢復表格到某個時間點，但這個功能可能無法完全防止意外刪除。因此，選項 C 是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has an on-premises data center that is running out of storage capacity. The company wants to migrate its storage infrastructure to
AWS while minimizing bandwidth costs. The solution must allow for immediate retrieval of data at no additional cost.
How can these requirements be met?
選項(英):
A. Deploy Amazon S3 Glacier Vault and enable expedited retrieval. Enable provisioned retrieval capacity for the workload.
B. Deploy AWS Storage Gateway using cached volumes. Use Storage Gateway to store data in Amazon S3 while retaining copies of
frequently accessed data subsets locally.
C. Deploy AWS Storage Gateway using stored volumes to store data locally. Use Storage Gateway to asynchronously back up point-in-time
snapshots of the data to Amazon S3.
D. Deploy AWS Direct Connect to connect with the on-premises data center. Congure AWS Storage Gateway to store data locally. Use
Storage Gateway to asynchronously back up point-in-time snapshots of the data to Amazon S3.
解析(英): The correct answer is B because AWS Storage Gateway using cache volumes can store data in Amazon S3 while retaining local storage copies of frequently accessed subsets of the data. This enables immediate retrieval of data at no additional cost and minimizes bandwidth costs. Choice A is incorrect because accelerated retrieval from Amazon S3 Glacier Vault requires an additional charge and does not qualify as no additional cost. Options C and D are incorrect because they use an asynchronous backup mechanism, which may result in delayed data retrieval rather than immediate retrieval. Additionally, Option D requires additional AWS Direct Connect connection costs. Therefore, option B is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司有一個內部資料中心，儲存容量即將用盡。該公司希望將其儲存基礎設施遷移到 AWS，同时盡量減少頻寬成本。解決方案必須允許立即無額外成本地检索數據。如何滿足這些要求？
選項(中):
A. 部署 Amazon S3 Glacier Vault 並啟用加速检索。啟用預先配置的检索容量以滿足工作負載需求。
B. 部署使用快取卷的 AWS Storage Gateway。使用 Storage Gateway 將數據儲存在 Amazon S3，同时保留本地存儲頻繁存取的數據子集的副本。
C. 部署使用儲存卷的 AWS Storage Gateway，以本地存儲數據。使用 Storage Gateway 將數據的時間點快照異步備份到 Amazon S3。
D. 部署 AWS Direct Connect 連接內部資料中心。配置 AWS Storage Gateway 以本地存儲數據。使用 Storage Gateway 將數據的時間點快照異步備份到 Amazon S3。
解析(中): 正確答案是 B，因為使用快取卷的 AWS Storage Gateway 可以將數據儲存在 Amazon S3，同时保留本地存儲頻繁存取的數據子集的副本。這樣可以實現立即检索數據而無需額外成本，並且可以盡量減少頻寬成本。選項 A 不正確，因為 Amazon S3 Glacier Vault 的加速检索需要額外付費，而不符合無額外成本的要求。選項 C 和 D 不正確，因為它們使用異步備份機制，可能導致數據检索延遲，而不符合立即检索的要求。另外，選項 D 還需要額外的 AWS Direct Connect 連接成本。因此，選項 B 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company runs a three-tier web application in a VPC across multiple Availability Zones. Amazon EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group
for the application tier.
The company needs to make an automated scaling plan that will analyze each resource's daily and weekly historical workload trends. The
conguration must scale resources appropriately according to both the forecast and live changes in utilization.
Which scaling strategy should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Implement dynamic scaling with step scaling based on average CPU utilization from the EC2 instances.
B. Enable predictive scaling to forecast and scale. Congure dynamic scaling with target tracking
C. Create an automated scheduled scaling action based on the trac patterns of the web application.
D. Set up a simple scaling policy. Increase the cooldown period based on the EC2 instance startup time.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B because Predictive Scaling is a feature in Amazon Auto Scaling that predicts future demand based on historical workload trends and automatically adjusts resources to meet predicted demand. This capability predicts future demand based on daily and weekly historical workload trends and scales resources appropriately based on forecasts and real-time usage changes. Dynamic Scaling and Target Tracking can adjust resources according to real-time usage changes to ensure that resource usage remains within the target range. Therefore, option B is the most appropriate answer.

Choice A is incorrect because step scaling scales resources based on specific thresholds, not based on forecasted demand. Choice C is incorrect because automatically scheduled scaling actions scale resources based on a fixed schedule rather than based on forecasted demand. Option D is incorrect because Simple Scaling scales resources based on specific thresholds rather than forecasted demand, and adding a Cooldown Period does not address forecasted and real-time usage changes.
題目(中): 一家公司在多個可用區域中的 VPC 中運行三層 Web 應用程式，應用程式層的 Amazon EC2 實例運行在 Auto Scaling 群組中。該公司需要建立一個自動化的擴展計畫，以分析每個資源的每日和每周的歷史工作負載趨勢，並根據預測和實時的使用率變化來適當擴展資源。哪種擴展策略是解決方案架構師應該推薦以滿足這些需求的？
選項(中):
A. 實施基於 EC2 實例平均 CPU 使用率的動態擴展和階段擴展。
B. 啟用預測擴展以預測和擴展，並配置目標追蹤的動態擴展。
C. 基於 Web 應用程式的流量模式建立自動排程擴展動作。
D. 設置簡單擴展策略，並根據 EC2 實例啟動時間增加冷卻期。
解析(中):
正確答案是 B，因為預測擴展（Predictive Scaling）是 Amazon Auto Scaling 中的一項功能，可以根據歷史工作負載趨勢預測未來的需求，並自動調整資源以滿足預測的需求。這項功能可以根據每日和每周的歷史工作負載趨勢來預測未來的需求，並根據預測和實時的使用率變化來適當擴展資源。動態擴展（Dynamic Scaling）與目標追蹤（Target Tracking）可以根據實時的使用率變化來調整資源，以確保資源的使用率保持在目標範圍內。因此，選項 B 是最適合的答案。

選項 A 不正確，因為階段擴展（Step Scaling）是根據特定的閾值來擴展資源，而不是根據預測的需求。選項 C 不正確，因為自動排程擴展動作是根據固定的時間表來擴展資源，而不是根據預測的需求。選項 D 不正確，因為簡單擴展策略（Simple Scaling）是根據特定的閾值來擴展資源，而不是根據預測的需求，而且增加冷卻期（Cooldown Period）不會解決預測和實時的使用率變化問題。

題目(英):
A package delivery company has an application that uses Amazon EC2 instances and an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster. As the application
becomes more popular, EC2 instance usage increases only slightly. DB cluster usage increases at a much faster rate.
The company adds a read replica, which reduces the DB cluster usage for a short period of time. However, the load continues to increase. The
operations that cause the increase in DB cluster usage are all repeated read statements that are related to delivery details. The company
needs to alleviate the effect of repeated reads on the DB cluster.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
選項(英):
A. Implement an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster between the application and the DB cluster.
B. Add an additional read replica to the DB cluster.
C. Congure Aurora Auto Scaling for the Aurora read replicas.
D. Modify the DB cluster to have multiple writer instances.
解析(英): According to the title description, the company's application uses Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon Aurora MySQL DB clusters. The increase in DB cluster usage is mainly caused by repeated read statements. To mitigate the impact of these repeated reads on the DB cluster, a solution is needed that can cache data efficiently. Option A, implementing an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster, is the most cost-effective solution. Because Amazon ElastiCache for Redis can provide efficient data caching and reduce read requests to the DB cluster, thereby reducing the usage and cost of the DB cluster. Other options are not as cost-effective as option A. Option B. Adding new read replicas may temporarily reduce the usage of the DB cluster, but will not solve the underlying problem. Option C. Setting up Aurora autoscaling may increase costs. Option D. Modifying the DB cluster to have multiple write instances will not directly solve the duplicate read problem. Therefore, option A is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家包裹遞送公司有一個應用程式，使用 Amazon EC2 實例和 Amazon Aurora MySQL DB 叢集。隨著應用程式的受歡迎程度增加，EC2 實例的使用量只略微增加，而 DB 叢集的使用量則以更快的速度增加。公司新增了一個讀取複製品，暫時減少了 DB 叢集的使用量，但負載仍然持續增加。導致 DB 叢集使用量增加的操作都是與遞送詳細資料相關的重複讀取語句。公司需要減輕重複讀取對 DB 叢集的影響。哪個解決方案能夠最具成本效益地滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在應用程式和 DB 叢集之間實現 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 叢集。
B. 對 DB 叢集新增另一個讀取複製品。
C. 設定 Aurora 自動擴展功能，適用於 Aurora 讀取複製品。
D. 修改 DB 叢集以具有多個寫入實例。
解析(中): 根據題目描述，公司的應用程式使用 Amazon EC2 實例和 Amazon Aurora MySQL DB 叢集，DB 叢集的使用量增加主要是由於重複的讀取語句引起的。為了減輕這些重複讀取對 DB 叢集的影響，需要一個能夠有效緩存資料的解決方案。選項 A，實現 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 叢集，是最具成本效益的解決方案。因為 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 能夠提供高效的資料緩存，減少對 DB 叢集的讀取請求，從而降低 DB 叢集的使用量和成本。其他選項不如選項 A 具有成本效益，選項 B 新增讀取複製品可能會暫時減少 DB 叢集的使用量，但不會解決根本問題；選項 C 設定 Aurora 自動擴展功能可能會增加成本；選項 D 修改 DB 叢集以具有多個寫入實例不會直接解決重複讀取問題。因此，選項 A 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table for storage. A solutions architect discovers that many requests to the
table are not returning the latest data. The company's users have not reported any other issues with database performance. Latency is in an
acceptable range.
Which design change should the solutions architect recommend?
選項(英):
A. Add read replicas to the table.
B. Use a global secondary index (GSI).
C. Request strongly consistent reads for the table.
D. Request eventually consistent reads for the table.
解析(英): According to the title description, the problem is that many requests to the DynamoDB table do not return the latest data, which means that there is a problem with the read consistency of the data. Since users did not report other issues related to database performance, and the latency was within an acceptable range, the problem here is mainly one of data consistency. Option C, requesting strongly consistent reads, is the correct answer because this ensures that the data read is the latest and solves the problem of data inconsistency. Option A, add read replicas (read replicas), is mainly used to improve read performance and cannot directly solve the problem of data consistency. Option B, using the global secondary index (GSI), is mainly used for query and indexing, and it also cannot directly solve the problem of data consistency. Option D, requesting eventually consistent reads, is actually the default behavior of DynamoDB, which may cause the data read to not be the latest, so this is not a correct solution. Therefore, option C is the most appropriate design change.
題目(中):
一家公司有一個應用程式使用 Amazon DynamoDB 表格進行儲存。一個解決方案架構師發現，許多請求到表格中都沒有返回最新的資料。公司的使用者沒有報告其他與資料庫效能相關的問題。延遲時間在可接受的範圍內。
哪種設計變更，解決方案架構師應該推薦？
選項(中):
A. 對表格添加讀取複製。
B. 使用全域次要索引 (GSI)。
C. 請求表格的強一致性讀取。
D. 請求表格的最終一致性讀取。
解析(中): 根據題目描述，問題出在於許多請求到 DynamoDB 表格中都沒有返回最新的資料，這意味著資料的讀取一致性出了問題。由於使用者沒有報告其他與資料庫效能相關的問題，延遲時間也在可接受的範圍內，因此這裡的問題主要是資料一致性的問題。選項 C，請求強一致性讀取（strongly consistent reads），是正確的答案，因為這能夠保證讀取的資料是最新的，解決了資料不一致的問題。選項 A，添加讀取複製（read replicas），主要用於改善讀取效能，不能直接解決資料一致性的問題。選項 B，使用全域次要索引（GSI），主要用於查詢和索引，同樣不能直接解決資料一致性的問題。選項 D，請求最終一致性讀取（eventually consistent reads），其實是 DynamoDB 的預設行為，可能導致讀取的資料不是最新的，因此這不是一個正確的解決方案。因此，選項 C 是最適合的設計變更。

題目(英):
A company has deployed its application on Amazon EC2 instances with an Amazon RDS database. The company used the principle of least
privilege to congure the database access credentials. The company's security team wants to protect the application and the database from
SQL injection and other web-based attacks.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Use security groups and network ACLs to secure the database and application servers.
B. Use AWS WAF to protect the application. Use RDS parameter groups to congure the security settings.
C. Use AWS Network Firewall to protect the application and the database.
D. Use different database accounts in the application code for different functions. Avoid granting excessive privileges to the database
users.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B because using AWS WAF to protect your application effectively prevents SQL injection and other web-based attacks. At the same time, using RDS parameter groups to configure security settings can simplify database security management. The operational burden of this solution is relatively low because both AWS WAF and RDS parameter groups are fully managed services, requiring no additional infrastructure and maintenance efforts.
Choice A is incorrect because using security groups and network ACLs only protects network access to databases and application servers, but does not protect against SQL injection and other web-based attacks.
Choice C is incorrect because using an AWS network firewall can protect applications and databases, but requires additional configuration and maintenance work and has a relatively high operational burden.
Choice D is incorrect because using different database accounts and avoiding granting excessive permissions can increase database security but does not protect against SQL injection and other web-based attacks and requires additional application code modification and maintenance work.
題目(中):
一家公司將其應用程式部署在 Amazon EC2 實例上，並使用 Amazon RDS 數據庫。該公司使用最小權限原則配置數據庫存取憑證。公司的安全團隊希望保護應用程式和數據庫免受 SQL 注入和其他基於 Web 的攻擊。
哪種解決方案可以在最少的運營負擔下滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用安全群組和網路 ACL 來保護數據庫和應用程式伺服器。
B. 使用 AWS WAF 來保護應用程式，並使用 RDS 參數群組來配置安全設定。
C. 使用 AWS 網路防火牆來保護應用程式和數據庫。
D. 在應用程式代碼中為不同的功能使用不同的數據庫帳戶，避免授予數據庫使用者過多的權限。
解析(中):
正確答案是 B，因為使用 AWS WAF 來保護應用程式可以有效地防止 SQL 注入和其他基於 Web 的攻擊。同時，使用 RDS 參數群組來配置安全設定可以簡化數據庫的安全管理。這種解決方案的運營負擔相對較低，因為 AWS WAF 和 RDS 參數群組都是完全托管的服務，無需額外的基礎設施和維護工作。
選項 A 不正確，因為使用安全群組和網路 ACL 只能保護數據庫和應用程式伺服器的網路存取，但不能防止 SQL 注入和其他基於 Web 的攻擊。
選項 C 不正確，因為使用 AWS 網路防火牆可以保護應用程式和數據庫，但需要額外的配置和維護工作，運營負擔相對較高。
選項 D 不正確，因為使用不同的數據庫帳戶和避免授予過多的權限可以提高數據庫的安全性，但不能防止 SQL 注入和其他基於 Web 的攻擊，且需要額外的應用程式代碼修改和維護工作。

題目(英):
An ecommerce company runs applications in AWS accounts that are part of an organization in AWS Organizations. The applications run on
Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL databases across all the accounts. The company needs to prevent malicious activity and must identify abnormal
failed and incomplete login attempts to the databases.
Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally ecient way?
選項(英):
A. Attach service control policies (SCPs) to the root of the organization to identity the failed login attempts.
B. Enable the Amazon RDS Protection feature in Amazon GuardDuty for the member accounts of the organization.
C. Publish the Aurora general logs to a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Export the log data to a central Amazon S3 bucket.
D. Publish all the Aurora PostgreSQL database events in AWS CloudTrail to a central Amazon S3 bucket.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B, because enabling the Amazon RDS Protection feature, Amazon GuardDuty for an organization's member accounts, can effectively identify and prevent malicious activity on the database, including abnormal failures and incomplete login attempts. This solution is the most operationally efficient as it automatically monitors and analyzes database security and provides instant alerts and recommendations.

Option A is incorrect because Service Control Policies (SCPs) are mainly used to control access permissions and behavior of AWS accounts, but they cannot directly identify abnormal login attempts to the database.

Choice C is incorrect because although publishing Aurora general logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs can provide log data for the database, this requires additional analysis and processing to identify anomalous login attempts, and may require more operations and maintenance.

Option D is incorrect because AWS CloudTrail is primarily used to log API calls and activities for AWS accounts, but it cannot directly identify anomalous login attempts to the database. Moreover, publishing all Aurora PostgreSQL database events to AWS CloudTrail may generate a large amount of log data, requiring additional analysis and processing. Therefore, option B is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家電子商務公司在AWS組織中的AWS帳戶中運行應用程式。這些應用程式在所有帳戶中運行於Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL資料庫上。該公司需要防止惡意活動，並必須識別資料庫的異常失敗和不完整的登入嘗試。哪種解決方案能夠以最具操作效率的方式滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將服務控制政策（SCPs）附加到組織的根目錄以識別失敗的登入嘗試。
B. 啟用Amazon RDS Protection功能，適用於組織的成員帳戶中的Amazon GuardDuty。
C. 將Aurora一般日誌發佈到Amazon CloudWatch Logs的日誌群組中。將日誌資料匯出到中央Amazon S3儲存桶。
D. 將所有Aurora PostgreSQL資料庫事件發佈到AWS CloudTrail的中央Amazon S3儲存桶。
解析(中):
正確答案是B，因為啟用Amazon RDS Protection功能，適用於組織的成員帳戶中的Amazon GuardDuty，可以有效地識別和防止資料庫的惡意活動，包括異常失敗和不完整的登入嘗試。這個解決方案是最具操作效率的，因為它可以自動化地監控和分析資料庫的安全性，並提供即時的警報和建議。

選項A不正確，因為服務控制政策（SCPs）主要用於控制AWS帳戶的存取權限和行為，但它們不能直接識別資料庫的異常登入嘗試。

選項C不正確，因為雖然發佈Aurora一般日誌到Amazon CloudWatch Logs可以提供資料庫的日誌資料，但這需要額外的分析和處理來識別異常登入嘗試，且可能需要更多的操作和維護。

選項D不正確，因為AWS CloudTrail主要用於記錄AWS帳戶的API呼叫和活動，但它不能直接識別資料庫的異常登入嘗試。況且，將所有Aurora PostgreSQL資料庫事件發佈到AWS CloudTrail可能會產生大量的日誌資料，需要額外的分析和處理。因此，選項B是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has an AWS Direct Connect connection from its corporate data center to its VPC in the us-east-1 Region. The company recently
acquired a corporation that has several VPCs and a Direct Connect connection between its on-premises data center and the eu-west-2 Region.
The CIDR blocks for the VPCs of the company and the corporation do not overlap. The company requires connectivity between two Regions
and the data centers. The company needs a solution that is scalable while reducing operational overhead.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Set up inter-Region VPC peering between the VPC in us-east-1 and the VPCs in eu-west-2.
B. Create private virtual interfaces from the Direct Connect connection in us-east-1 to the VPCs in eu-west-2.
C. Establish VPN appliances in a fully meshed VPN network hosted by Amazon EC2. Use AWS VPN CloudHub to send and receive data
between the data centers and each VPC.
D. Connect the existing Direct Connect connection to a Direct Connect gateway. Route trac from the virtual private gateways of the VPCs
in each Region to the Direct Connect gateway.
解析(英): The answer is D, because Direct Connect gateways allow companies to establish connections between VPCs in different regions without having to set up complex VPN networks or inter-region VPC peering. This solution reduces operational burden and provides scalable connectivity. Choice A is incorrect because inter-region VPC peering requires peering between each VPC, adding complexity and operational burden. Choice B is incorrect because private virtual interfaces can only be used to connect to VPCs in the same region. Choice C is incorrect because VPN appliances and fully meshed VPN networks add complexity and operational burden and are not as scalable as solutions with Direct Connect gateways. Therefore, option D is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在其企業資料中心和 us-east-1 區域的 VPC 之間建立了 AWS Direct Connect 連接。該公司最近收購了一家公司，該公司有多個 VPC 和一個連接其本地資料中心和 eu-west-2 區域的 Direct Connect 連接。公司和收購公司的 VPC 的 CIDR 區塊不重疊。公司需要在兩個區域和資料中心之間建立連接。公司需要一個可擴展的解決方案，以減少運營負擔。解決方案架構師應該做什麼來滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在 us-east-1 區域的 VPC 和 eu-west-2 區域的 VPC 之間設定區域間 VPC 對等連接。
B. 從 us-east-1 區域的 Direct Connect 連接建立私人虛擬介面到 eu-west-2 區域的 VPC。
C. 在 Amazon EC2 主機的完全網狀 VPN 網路中建立 VPN 設備。使用 AWS VPN CloudHub 在資料中心和每個 VPC 之間發送和接收數據。
D. 將現有的 Direct Connect 連接連接到 Direct Connect 閘道。從每個區域的 VPC 虛擬私人閘道路由追蹤到 Direct Connect 閘道。
解析(中): 答案是 D，因為 Direct Connect 閘道可以讓公司在不同區域的 VPC 之間建立連接，而無需設定複雜的 VPN 網路或區域間 VPC 對等連接。這個解決方案可以減少運營負擔，並提供可擴展的連接。選項 A 不正確，因為區域間 VPC 對等連接需要每個 VPC 之間都建立對等連接，增加了複雜性和運營負擔。選項 B 不正確，因為私人虛擬介面只能用於連接同一區域的 VPC。選項 C 不正確，因為 VPN 設備和完全網狀 VPN 網路增加了複雜性和運營負擔，且不如 Direct Connect 閘道的解決方案那樣可擴展。因此，選項 D 是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is developing a mobile game that streams score updates to a backend processor and then posts results on a leaderboard. A
solutions architect needs to design a solution that can handle large trac spikes, process the mobile game updates in order of receipt, and
store the processed updates in a highly available database. The company also wants to minimize the management overhead required to
maintain the solution.
What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Push score updates to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Process the updates in Kinesis Data Streams with AWS Lambda. Store the
processed updates in Amazon DynamoDB.
B. Push score updates to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Process the updates with a eet of Amazon EC2 instances set up for Auto
Scaling. Store the processed updates in Amazon Redshift.
C. Push score updates to an Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe an AWS Lambda function to the SNS topic
to process the updates. Store the processed updates in a SQL database running on Amazon EC2.
D. Push score updates to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use a eet of Amazon EC2 instances with Auto Scaling
to process the updates in the SQS queue. Store the processed updates in an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance.
解析(英):
The answer is A because Amazon Kinesis Data Streams can handle large traffic spikes, AWS Lambda can process mobile game updates in the order they are received, and Amazon DynamoDB is a high-availability database that can store processed updates. This solution also minimizes management burden because AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB are fully managed services that require no server management.

The other options are incorrect because:
Option B uses Amazon EC2 instances to handle updates, which requires server management and increases the management burden. Amazon Redshift is not suitable for storing processed updates because it is a data warehousing service primarily used for data analysis.
Option C uses an Amazon SNS topic and an AWS Lambda function to handle updates, but Amazon SNS topics are not suitable for handling large traffic spikes. Running SQL database on Amazon EC2 requires server management, which increases the management burden.
Option D uses Amazon SQS queues and Amazon EC2 instances to handle updates, which requires server management and increases the management burden. Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instances can provide high availability, but require database management, which increases the management burden.
題目(中): 一家公司正在開發一款移動遊戲，該遊戲將比分更新串流到後端處理器，然後將結果發佈在排行榜上。解決方案架構師需要設計一個可以處理大量流量尖峰、按照接收順序處理移動遊戲更新、並將已處理的更新存儲在高可用性數據庫中的解決方案。該公司還希望盡量減少維護解決方案所需的管理負擔。
選項(中):
A. 將比分更新推送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams。使用 AWS Lambda 處理 Kinesis Data Streams 中的更新。將已處理的更新存儲在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。
B. 將比分更新推送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams。使用一組設置為 Auto Scaling 的 Amazon EC2 實例處理更新。將已處理的更新存儲在 Amazon Redshift 中。
C. 將比分更新推送到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題。訂閱 AWS Lambda 函數到 SNS 主題以處理更新。將已處理的更新存儲在 Amazon EC2 上運行的 SQL 數據庫中。
D. 將比分更新推送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列。使用一組具有 Auto Scaling 的 Amazon EC2 實例處理 SQS 佇列中的更新。將已處理的更新存儲在 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB 實例中。
解析(中):
答案是 A，因為 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 可以處理大量流量尖峰，AWS Lambda 可以按照接收順序處理移動遊戲更新，Amazon DynamoDB 是一種高可用性數據庫，可以存儲已處理的更新。這個解決方案也可以盡量減少管理負擔，因為 AWS Lambda 和 Amazon DynamoDB 都是完全管理的服務，不需要進行伺服器管理。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
B 選項使用 Amazon EC2 實例處理更新，需要進行伺服器管理，增加了管理負擔。Amazon Redshift 不適合存儲已處理的更新，因為它是一種數據倉儲服務，主要用於數據分析。
C 選項使用 Amazon SNS 主題和 AWS Lambda 函數處理更新，但是 Amazon SNS 主題不適合處理大量流量尖峰。SQL 數據庫在 Amazon EC2 上運行需要進行伺服器管理，增加了管理負擔。
D 選項使用 Amazon SQS 佇列和 Amazon EC2 實例處理更新，需要進行伺服器管理，增加了管理負擔。Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB 實例可以提供高可用性，但是需要進行數據庫管理，增加了管理負擔。

題目(英):
A company has multiple AWS accounts with applications deployed in the us-west-2 Region. Application logs are stored within Amazon S3
buckets in each account. The company wants to build a centralized log analysis solution that uses a single S3 bucket. Logs must not leave us-
west-2, and the company wants to incur minimal operational overhead.
Which solution meets these requirements and is MOST cost-effective?
選項(英):
A. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy that copies the objects from one of the application S3 buckets to the centralized S3 bucket.
B. Use S3 Same-Region Replication to replicate logs from the S3 buckets to another S3 bucket in us-west-2. Use this S3 bucket for log
analysis.
C. Write a script that uses the PutObject API operation every day to copy the entire contents of the buckets to another S3 bucket in us-
west-2. Use this S3 bucket for log analysis.
D. Write AWS Lambda functions in these accounts that are triggered every time logs are delivered to the S3 buckets (s3:ObjectCreated:*
event). Copy the logs to another S3 bucket in us-west-2. Use this S3 bucket for log analysis.
解析(英): The correct answer is B because S3 intra-region replication automatically copies log files from the original S3 bucket to the centralized S3 bucket without leaving the us-west-2 region. This solution is the most cost-effective as it requires no additional computing resources or manual intervention. Option A requires manually setting the lifecycle policy, option C requires writing a script and executing it every day, and option D requires writing an AWS Lambda function and setting trigger events. All of these options will increase computing resources and labor costs. In comparison, S3 in-region replication is a simple, automated, and low-cost solution.
題目(中): 一家公司在 us-west-2 區域有多個 AWS 帳戶，各個帳戶都有部署應用程式，應用程式的記錄檔儲存在每個帳戶的 Amazon S3 儲存桶中。公司希望建立一個集中式的記錄檔分析解決方案，使用單一的 S3 儲存桶。記錄檔不得離開 us-west-2 區域，且公司希望最小化操作負擔。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求且最具成本效益？
選項(中):
A. 建立 S3 生命週期政策，將其中一個應用程式 S3 儲存桶的物件複製到集中式 S3 儲存桶。
B. 使用 S3 同區域複製功能，將記錄檔從 S3 儲存桶複製到 us-west-2 區域的另一個 S3 儲存桶。使用這個 S3 儲存桶進行記錄檔分析。
C. 撰寫腳本，每天使用 PutObject API 作業將儲存桶的全部內容複製到 us-west-2 區域的另一個 S3 儲存桶。使用這個 S3 儲存桶進行記錄檔分析。
D. 在這些帳戶中撰寫 AWS Lambda 函數，每次記錄檔傳送到 S3 儲存桶時觸發 (s3:ObjectCreated:* 事件)。將記錄檔複製到 us-west-2 區域的另一個 S3 儲存桶。使用這個 S3 儲存桶進行記錄檔分析。
解析(中): 正確答案是 B，因為 S3 同區域複製功能可以自動將記錄檔從原始 S3 儲存桶複製到集中式 S3 儲存桶，且不會離開 us-west-2 區域。這個解決方案最具成本效益，因為它不需要額外的運算資源或人工介入。選項 A 需要手動設定生命週期政策，選項 C 需要撰寫腳本並每天執行，選項 D 需要撰寫 AWS Lambda 函數並設定觸發事件，所有這些選項都會增加運算資源和人工成本。相比之下，S3 同區域複製功能是一個簡單、自動化且低成本的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company has an application that delivers on-demand training videos to students around the world. The application also allows authorized
content developers to upload videos. The data is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket in the us-east-2 Region.
The company has created an S3 bucket in the eu-west-2 Region and an S3 bucket in the ap-southeast-1 Region. The company wants to
replicate the data to the new S3 buckets. The company needs to minimize latency for developers who upload videos and students who stream
videos near eu-west-2 and ap-southeast-1.
Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the application? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Congure one-way replication from the us-east-2 S3 bucket to the eu-west-2 S3 bucket. Congure one-way replication from the us-east-2
S3 bucket to the ap-southeast-1 S3 bucket.
B. Congure one-way replication from the us-east-2 S3 bucket to the eu-west-2 S3 bucket. Congure one-way replication from the eu-west-
2 S3 bucket to the ap-southeast-1 S3 bucket.
C. Congure two-way (bidirectional) replication among the S3 buckets that are in all three Regions.
D. Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point. Modify the application to use the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Multi-Region Access
Point for video streaming. Do not modify the application for video uploads.

Point for video streaming and uploads.
解析(英): To meet the company's needs, data needs to be copied from an S3 bucket in the us-east-2 region to S3 buckets in the eu-west-2 and ap-southeast-1 regions, and latency for developers uploading videos and students streaming videos needs to be minimized. Options A and B are correct because they configure one-way replication from the us-east-2 S3 bucket to the eu-west-2 and ap-southeast-1 S3 buckets, which ensures data is synchronized across the three regions and minimizes latency. Options D and E are incorrect because creating an S3 multi-region access point requires modifying the application to use the multi-region access point's ARN for video streaming and uploading, which results in more modifications to the application, while options A and B only require configuring one-way replication and do not require modifications to the application. 題目(中): 一家公司有一個應用程式，提供即時的培訓視頻給全球的學生。該應用程式也允許授權的內容開發人員上傳視頻。數據存儲在 us-east-2 區域的 Amazon S3 儲存桶中。公司已在 eu-west-2 區域和 ap-southeast-1 區域創建了新的 S3 儲存桶。公司希望將數據複製到新的 S3 儲存桶中，並且需要最小化開發人員上傳視頻和學生在 eu-west-2 和 ap-southeast-1 附近串流視頻的延遲。哪種組合的步驟可以滿足這些需求，並且對應用程式進行最少的修改？（選擇兩個。）
選項(中):
A. 從 us-east-2 S3 儲存桶配置單向複製到 eu-west-2 S3 儲存桶。從 us-east-2 S3 儲存桶配置單向複製到 ap-southeast-1 S3 儲存桶。
B. 從 us-east-2 S3 儲存桶配置單向複製到 eu-west-2 S3 儲存桶。從 eu-west-2 S3 儲存桶配置單向複製到 ap-southeast-1 S3 儲存桶。
C. 在所有三個區域的 S3 儲存桶之間配置雙向（雙向）複製。
D. 創建 S3 多區域存取點。修改應用程式使用多區域存取點的 Amazon Resource Name (ARN) 進行視頻串流。不要修改應用程式進行視頻上傳。
E. 創建 S3 多區域存取點。修改應用程式使用多區域存取點的 Amazon Resource Name (ARN) 進行視頻串流和上傳。
解析(中): 為了滿足公司的需求，需要將數據從 us-east-2 區域的 S3 儲存桶複製到 eu-west-2 和 ap-southeast-1 區域的 S3 儲存桶中，並且需要最小化開發人員上傳視頻和學生串流視頻的延遲。選項 A 和 B 是正確的，因為它們配置了單向複製從 us-east-2 S3 儲存桶到 eu-west-2 和 ap-southeast-1 S3 儲存桶，這樣可以確保數據在這三個區域之間同步，並且可以最小化延遲。選項 C 不正確，因為雙向複製會導致數據在三個區域之間不斷同步，增加延遲和複製成本。選項 D 和 E 不正確，因為創建 S3 多區域存取點需要修改應用程式使用多區域存取點的 ARN 進行視頻串流和上傳，這會導致應用程式進行更多的修改，而選項 A 和 B 只需要配置單向複製，不需要修改應用程式。因此，選項 A 和 B 是正確的答案。

題目(英):
A company has a new mobile app. Anywhere in the world, users can see local news on topics they choose. Users also can post photos and
videos from inside the app.
Users access content often in the rst minutes after the content is posted. New content quickly replaces older content, and then the older
content disappears. The local nature of the news means that users consume 90% of the content within the AWS Region where it is uploaded.
Which solution will optimize the user experience by providing the LOWEST latency for content uploads?
選項(英):
A. Upload and store content in Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront for the uploads.
B. Upload and store content in Amazon S3. Use S3 Transfer Acceleration for the uploads.
C. Upload content to Amazon EC2 instances in the Region that is closest to the user. Copy the data to Amazon S3.
D. Upload and store content in Amazon S3 in the Region that is closest to the user. Use multiple distributions of Amazon CloudFront.
解析(英): According to the title description, users usually access content within the first minute after it is uploaded, and 90% of the content is consumed in the AWS region where it was uploaded. Therefore, the key to optimizing user experience is to reduce the delay in content uploading. Option B uses S3 Transfer Acceleration to upload, which can greatly reduce cross-region upload delays. S3 Transfer Acceleration accelerates uploads through Amazon's global network of edge locations and reduces latency, especially when uploading across regions. The other options are less effective at reducing latency than option B. Option A uses Amazon CloudFront for uploading, but CloudFront is primarily used to distribute content rather than accelerate uploads. Option C requires uploading the content to an EC2 instance and then copying to S3, adding extra steps and delays. Option D uses multiple CloudFront distributions, but this also doesn't effectively reduce upload latency. Therefore, option B is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司有一個新的行動應用程式，使用者可以在世界任何地方查看本地新聞，內容包括使用者選擇的主題。使用者也可以從應用程式內部上傳照片和視頻。使用者通常在內容上傳後的第一分鐘內存取內容，新內容迅速取代舊內容，然後舊內容消失。由於新聞的本地性質，使用者在上傳內容的 AWS 區域內消耗了 90% 的內容。哪種解決方案可以通過提供最低延遲的內容上傳來優化使用者體驗？
選項(中):
A. 將內容上傳和儲存到 Amazon S3，使用 Amazon CloudFront 進行上傳。
B. 將內容上傳和儲存到 Amazon S3，使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 進行上傳。
C. 將內容上傳到距離使用者最近的 AWS 區域中的 Amazon EC2 實例，然後將資料複製到 Amazon S3。
D. 將內容上傳和儲存到距離使用者最近的 AWS 區域中的 Amazon S3，使用多個 Amazon CloudFront 分發。
解析(中): 根據題目描述，使用者通常在內容上傳後的第一分鐘內存取內容，且 90% 的內容是在上傳的 AWS 區域內被消耗。因此，優化使用者體驗的關鍵是減少內容上傳的延遲。選項 B 使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 進行上傳，可以大大減少跨區域的上傳延遲。S3 Transfer Acceleration 通過 Amazon 的全球邊緣位置網路加速上傳速度，減少延遲，特別是在跨區域上傳時。其他選項不如選項 B 能夠有效地減少延遲。選項 A 使用 Amazon CloudFront 進行上傳，但 CloudFront 主要用於分發內容，而不是加速上傳。選項 C 需要將內容上傳到 EC2 實例，然後複製到 S3，增加了額外的步驟和延遲。選項 D 使用多個 CloudFront 分發，但這也不能有效地減少上傳延遲。因此，選項 B 是最好的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is building a new application that uses serverless architecture. The architecture will consist of an Amazon API Gateway REST API
and AWS Lambda functions to manage incoming requests.
The company wants to add a service that can send messages received from the API Gateway REST API to multiple target Lambda functions for
processing. The service must offer message ltering that gives the target Lambda functions the ability to receive only the messages the
functions need.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to an Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe Amazon
Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues to the SNS topic. Congure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues.
B. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon EventBridge. Congure EventBridge to invoke the target Lambda
functions.
C. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK). Congure Amazon
MSK to publish the messages to the target Lambda functions.
D. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Congure the
target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues.
解析(英): The answer is A because Amazon SNS provides a simple and flexible way to send messages to multiple target Lambda functions. By using SNS topics and SQS queues, target Lambda functions can receive only the messages they need, enabling message filtering. Additionally, the integration of SNS and SQS provides high availability and durability, ensuring messages are not lost. The reasons why the other options are incorrect are: in option B, EventBridge can call the target Lambda function, but it does not provide message filtering; in option C, Amazon MSK requires more setup and management and does not provide direct integration with Lambda functions; in option D, directly sending requests to multiple SQS queues will increase operational burden and complexity. Therefore, option A is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司正在建造一個新的應用程式，使用無伺服器架構。該架構將由 Amazon API Gateway REST API 和 AWS Lambda 函數組成，負責管理傳入的請求。該公司希望添加一項服務，可以將從 API Gateway REST API 收到的消息發送到多個目標 Lambda 函數進行處理。該服務必須提供消息篩選功能，讓目標 Lambda 函數只能接收到它們需要的消息。哪種解決方案可以滿足這些需求，並且具有最少的運營負擔？
選項(中):
A. 將 API Gateway REST API 的請求發送到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題。將 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列訂閱到 SNS 主題。設定目標 Lambda 函數從不同的 SQS 队列中輪詢。
B. 將 API Gateway REST API 的請求發送到 Amazon EventBridge。設定 EventBridge 來呼叫目標 Lambda 函數。
C. 將 API Gateway REST API 的請求發送到 Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)。設定 Amazon MSK 將消息發佈到目標 Lambda 函數。
D. 將 API Gateway REST API 的請求發送到多個 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。設定目標 Lambda 函數從不同的 SQS 队列中輪詢。
解析(中): 答案是 A，因為 Amazon SNS 提供了一種簡單且靈活的方式來發送消息到多個目標 Lambda 函數。通過使用 SNS 主題和 SQS 队列，目標 Lambda 函數可以只接收到它們需要的消息，從而實現消息篩選功能。此外，SNS 和 SQS 的整合可以提供高可用性和耐用性，確保消息不會丟失。其他選項不正確的原因是：B 選項中，EventBridge 可以呼叫目標 Lambda 函數，但它不提供消息篩選功能；C 選項中，Amazon MSK 需要更多的設定和管理，且不提供與 Lambda 函數的直接整合；D 選項中，直接將請求發送到多個 SQS 队列會增加運營負擔和複雜性。因此，選項 A 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company migrated millions of archival les to Amazon S3. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution that will encrypt all the
archival data by using a customer-provided key. The solution must encrypt existing unencrypted objects and future objects.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create a list of unencrypted objects by ltering an Amazon S3 Inventory report. Congure an S3 Batch Operations job to encrypt the
objects from the list with a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C). Congure the S3 default encryption feature to
use a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C).
B. Use S3 Storage Lens metrics to identify unencrypted S3 buckets. Congure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side
encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
C. Create a list of unencrypted objects by ltering the AWS usage report for Amazon S3. Congure an AWS Batch job to encrypt the objects
from the list with a server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Congure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side
encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
D. Create a list of unencrypted objects by ltering the AWS usage report for Amazon S3. Congure the S3 default encryption feature to use
a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C).
解析(英): The answer is A because it meets all the requirements in the question. First, it is necessary to create a list of unencrypted objects to ensure that all existing unencrypted objects can be encrypted. Amazon S3 Inventory Report is a suitable tool for this task. Next, configure the S3 batch job to use a customer-provided key (SSE-C) for server-side encryption to ensure that all unencrypted objects are encrypted. Finally, setting S3's default encryption to use a customer-provided key (SSE-C) ensures that all future uploads will be encrypted. The other options are incorrect because they do not meet all of the requirements in the question. Option B uses an AWS KMS key instead of a customer-provided key. Option C uses an AWS KMS key and an AWS batch job instead of an S3 batch job. Option D does not provide a way to encrypt existing unencrypted objects. Therefore, option A is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 一家公司將數百萬份檔案遷移到 Amazon S3。一個解決方案架構師需要實施一個解決方案，以使用客戶提供的金鑰來加密所有檔案資料。該解決方案必須加密現有的未加密物件和未來的物件。哪個解決方案能夠滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 創建一個未加密物件的清單，方法是過濾 Amazon S3 清單報告。設定 S3 批次作業來使用客戶提供的金鑰 (SSE-C) 進行伺服器端加密來加密清單中的物件。設定 S3 預設加密功能以使用客戶提供的金鑰 (SSE-C)。
B. 使用 S3 儲存鏡頭指標來識別未加密的 S3 儲存桶。設定 S3 預設加密功能以使用 AWS KMS 金鑰 (SSE-KMS)。
C. 創建一個未加密物件的清單，方法是過濾 AWS 使用報告中的 Amazon S3。設定 AWS 批次作業來使用 AWS KMS 金鑰 (SSE-KMS) 進行伺服器端加密來加密清單中的物件。設定 S3 預設加密功能以使用 AWS KMS 金鑰 (SSE-KMS)。
D. 創建一個未加密物件的清單，方法是過濾 AWS 使用報告中的 Amazon S3。設定 S3 預設加密功能以使用客戶提供的金鑰 (SSE-C)。
解析(中): 答案是 A，因為它滿足了題目中的所有需求。首先，創建一個未加密物件的清單是必要的，以確保所有現有的未加密物件都能夠被加密。Amazon S3 清單報告是一個合適的工具來完成這項任務。接下來，設定 S3 批次作業來使用客戶提供的金鑰 (SSE-C) 進行伺服器端加密，可以確保所有未加密物件都能夠被加密。最後，設定 S3 預設加密功能以使用客戶提供的金鑰 (SSE-C)，可以確保所有未來上傳的物件都會被加密。其他選項不正確，因為它們沒有滿足題目中的所有需求。選項 B 使用了 AWS KMS 金鑰，而不是客戶提供的金鑰。選項 C 使用了 AWS KMS 金鑰和 AWS 批次作業，而不是 S3 批次作業。選項 D 沒有提供加密現有的未加密物件的方法。因此，選項 A 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
The DNS provider that hosts a company's domain name records is experiencing outages that cause service disruption for a website running on
AWS. The company needs to migrate to a more resilient managed DNS service and wants the service to run on AWS.
What should a solutions architect do to rapidly migrate the DNS hosting service?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon Route 53 public hosted zone for the domain name. Import the zone le containing the domain records hosted by the
previous provider.
B. Create an Amazon Route 53 private hosted zone for the domain name. Import the zone le containing the domain records hosted by the
previous provider.
C. Create a Simple AD directory in AWS. Enable zone transfer between the DNS provider and AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active
Directory for the domain records.
D. Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint in the VPC. Specify the IP addresses that the provider's DNS will forward DNS
queries to. Congure the provider's DNS to forward DNS queries for the domain to the IP addresses that are specied in the inbound
endpoint.
解析(英):
Answer A is correct because Amazon Route 53 public host zones are a managed DNS service provided by AWS that allow users to create and manage their own DNS zones. You can quickly migrate your DNS hosting services by creating a public hosting zone and importing a zone archive containing domain records hosted by your former provider. This option is the most straightforward and efficient way to ensure that your website's DNS records are properly configured and managed on AWS.

Choice B is incorrect because private host zones are used to manage DNS records within a VPC, not public DNS records.

Choice C is incorrect because Simple AD Directory and AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory are used to manage directory services and authentication, not to manage DNS records.

Choice D is incorrect because the Amazon Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint is used to manage the forwarding of DNS queries, not the DNS host service. This option requires configuring complex settings between the DNS provider and AWS and is not as straightforward and efficient as Option A.
題目(中): 一家公司的域名記錄由 DNS 提供商托管，但該提供商正經歷中斷，導致在 AWS 上運行的網站服務中斷。該公司需要遷移到更具韌性的管理 DNS 服務，並希望該服務在 AWS 上運行。解決方案架構師應該如何快速遷移 DNS 主機服務？
選項(中):
A. 為域名創建 Amazon Route 53 公共主機區域，並導入包含由前提供商托管的域記錄的區域檔。
B. 為域名創建 Amazon Route 53 私有主機區域，並導入包含由前提供商托管的域記錄的區域檔。
C. 在 AWS 中創建 Simple AD 目錄，啟用 DNS 提供商和 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 之間的區域傳輸，以便傳輸域記錄。
D. 在 VPC 中創建 Amazon Route 53 Resolver 入站端點，指定 DNS 提供商將轉發 DNS 查詢的 IP 地址，然後配置 DNS 提供商將域的 DNS 查詢轉發到入站端點中指定的 IP 地址。
解析(中):
答案 A 是正確的，因為 Amazon Route 53 公共主機區域是 AWS 提供的管理 DNS 服務，允許用戶創建和管理自己的 DNS 區域。通過創建公共主機區域並導入包含由前提供商托管的域記錄的區域檔，可以快速遷移 DNS 主機服務。這個選項是最直接和有效的方法，可以確保網站的 DNS 記錄在 AWS 上得到正確配置和管理。

選項 B 不正確，因為私有主機區域是用於管理 VPC 內的 DNS 記錄，而不是用於管理公共 DNS 記錄。

選項 C 不正確，因為 Simple AD 目錄和 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 是用於管理目錄服務和身份驗證，而不是用於管理 DNS 記錄。

選項 D 不正確，因為 Amazon Route 53 Resolver 入站端點是用於管理 DNS 查詢的轉發，而不是用於管理 DNS 主機服務。這個選項需要配置 DNS 提供商和 AWS 之間的複雜設定，且不如選項 A 那樣直接和有效。

題目(英):

conguration and to securely store and retrieve credentials for the database and other services.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

B. Use AWS Lambda to store and manage the application conguration. Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to store and retrieve
the credentials.

The correct answer is A because using AWS AppConfg and AWS Secrets Manager meets the company's needs with minimal administrative burden. C. 使用加密的應用程式設定檔案。將檔案存儲在 Amazon S3 中以管理應用程式設定。創建另一個 S3 檔案來存儲和检索憑證。

正確答案是 A，因為使用 AWS AppConfg 和 AWS Secrets Manager 能夠以最少的管理負擔滿足公司的需求。AWS AppConfg 是一個應用程式設定管理服務，能夠讓您輕鬆地管理應用程式的設定和版本。AWS Secrets Manager 是一個密碼和憑證管理服務，能夠安全地存儲和检索您的憑證和密碼。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
- 選項 B 使用 AWS Lambda 來存儲和管理應用程式設定，但 AWS Lambda 主要是用於無伺服器計算，而不是設定管理。
- 選項 C 使用加密的應用程式設定檔案和 Amazon S3 來存儲和检索憑證，但這種方法需要更多的管理負擔和自行開發程式碼來實現安全存儲和检索。
- 選項 D 使用 Amazon RDS 來存儲和检索憑證，但 Amazon RDS 主要是用於關係式數據庫管理，而不是密碼和憑證管理。

題目(英):
To meet security requirements, a company needs to encrypt all of its application data in transit while communicating with an Amazon RDS
MySQL DB instance. A recent security audit revealed that encryption at rest is enabled using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS), but
data in transit is not enabled.
What should a solutions architect do to satisfy the security requirements?
選項(英):
A. Enable IAM database authentication on the database.
B. Provide self-signed certicates. Use the certicates in all connections to the RDS instance.
C. Take a snapshot of the RDS instance. Restore the snapshot to a new instance with encryption enabled.
D. Download AWS-provided root certicates. Provide the certicates in all connections to the RDS instance.
解析(英):
To meet security requirements, solutions architects need to ensure that all application data is encrypted during transmission. Now that encryption is enabled at rest, the focus now is on encryption in transit. Option D is the correct answer because downloading the AWS-provided root credentials and providing the credentials during all connections to the RDS instance ensures that the data is cryptographically protected in transit. This is because the root credentials provided by AWS can be used to authenticate the RDS instance and establish a secure connection.

The other options are incorrect for the following reasons:
A. Enabling IAM repository authentication improves the security of your repository, but it does not directly solve the issue of encryption in transit.
B. Self-signed credentials can lead to security risks because they may not be trusted or verified.
C. Snapshotting and restoring the RDS instance to a new instance and enabling encryption can solve the problem of encryption at rest, but it does not directly solve the problem of encryption in transit. Therefore, option D is the most appropriate solution.
題目(中): 為了滿足安全性需求，一家公司需要加密所有應用程式資料在傳輸過程中，而這些資料是與 Amazon RDS MySQL DB 實例進行通訊的。最近的安全性審查顯示，使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 已經啟用了靜止加密，但傳輸中的資料尚未啟用加密。解決方案架構師應該採取什麼行動來滿足安全性需求？
選項(中):
A. 啟用資料庫的 IAM 身分驗證。
B. 提供自簽憑證，使用憑證連接到 RDS 實例。
C. 將 RDS 實例快照化，恢復快照到新實例並啟用加密。
D. 下載 AWS 提供的根憑證，提供憑證連接到 RDS 實例。
解析(中):
為了滿足安全性需求，解決方案架構師需要確保所有應用程式資料在傳輸過程中都受到加密保護。由於靜止加密已經啟用，現在需要關注的是傳輸中的加密。選項 D 是正確答案，因為下載 AWS 提供的根憑證並在所有連接到 RDS 實例的過程中提供憑證，可以確保資料在傳輸過程中受到加密保護。這是因為 AWS 提供的根憑證可以用於驗證 RDS 實例的身份，並建立安全的連接。

其他選項不正確的原因如下：
A. 啟用 IAM 資料庫身份驗證可以提高資料庫的安全性，但它並不能直接解決傳輸中的加密問題。
B. 自簽憑證可能會導致安全性風險，因為它們可能不被信任或驗證。
C. 將 RDS 實例快照化並恢復到新實例並啟用加密，可以解決靜止加密的問題，但它並不能直接解決傳輸中的加密問題。因此，選項 D 是最合適的解決方案。

題目(英):
A company is designing a new web service that will run on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) load balancer.
However, many of the web service clients can only reach IP addresses authorized on their rewalls.
What should a solutions architect recommend to meet the clients’ needs?
選項(英):
A. A Network Load Balancer with an associated Elastic IP address.
B. An Application Load Balancer with an associated Elastic IP address.

D. An EC2 instance with a public IP address running as a proxy in front of the load balancer.
解析(英):
The answer is A because Network Load Balancers support association with Elastic IP addresses, which allows clients to access a load balancer with a fixed IP address. This is because Network Load Balancer can distribute traffic to multiple targets, including EC2 instances and IP addresses. A Network Load Balancer associated with an Elastic IP address can provide a fixed IP address for client access to meet their firewall authorization needs.

The other options are incorrect because:
- Application Load Balancer in option B does not support association with Elastic IP addresses.
The A record in the -C option can point to an Elastic IP address, but this requires additional DNS configuration and management and does not directly solve the problem of client access to the load balancer.
The EC2 instance in the -D option can provide a public IP address as a proxy server, but this requires additional servers and configuration and is not as simple and efficient as using a Network Load Balancer.
題目(中): 一家公司正在設計一個新的網路服務，該服務將在 Amazon EC2 執行個體後面的 Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) 負載平衡器上運行。然而，許多網路服務的用戶端只能存取在其防火牆上授權的 IP 位址。解決方案架構師應該推薦什麼來滿足用戶端的需求？

題目(英):
A company has established a new AWS account. The account is newly provisioned and no changes have been made to the default settings.
The company is concerned about the security of the AWS account root user.
What should be done to secure the root user?
選項(英):
A. Create IAM users for daily administrative tasks. Disable the root user.
B. Create IAM users for daily administrative tasks. Enable multi-factor authentication on the root user.

D. Provide the root user credentials to the most senior solutions architect. Have the solutions architect use the root user for daily
administration tasks.
解析(英): According to AWS security best practices, to ensure the security of the root consumer, you should establish an IAM consumer for daily management tasks and enable multi-factor authentication for the root consumer. Option B is the correct answer because it meets the need for both using IAM consumers for day-to-day management and enabling multi-factor authentication. 題目(中): 一家公司建立了一個新的 AWS 帳戶。該帳戶是新建立的，且沒有對預設設定進行任何修改。公司對 AWS 帳戶根使用者的安全性感到擔憂。為了確保根使用者的安全，應該採取什麼措施？

A. 為日常管理任務建立 IAM 使用者。停用根使用者。

題目(英):
A nancial services company wants to shut down two data centers and migrate more than 100 TB of data to AWS. The data has an intricate
directory structure with millions of small les stored in deep hierarchies of subfolders. Most of the data is unstructured, and the company’s
le storage consists of SMB-based storage types from multiple vendors. The company does not want to change its applications to access the
data after migration.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

B. Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon FSx for Lustre.

題目(中): 一家金融服務公司想要關閉兩個資料中心，並將超過 100 TB 的資料遷移到 AWS。這些資料具有複雜的目錄結構，包含數百萬個小檔案，儲存在多層次的子資料夾中。絕大多數的資料是非結構化的，公司的檔案儲存是由多個供應商提供的 SMB 型儲存。公司不希望在遷移後修改應用程式來存取資料。作為解決方案架構師，應該如何滿足這些需求，並且具有最低的運營負擔？

選項 C，使用 AWS DataSync 將資料遷移到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server，是最合適的選擇。Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 提供了一個完全受控的 Windows 文件伺服器環境，支援 SMB 通訊協定和 NTFS 檔案系統。這使得公司可以將現有的檔案系統直接遷移到 AWS，無需修改應用程式或更改存取方式。AWS DataSync 是一種快速、安全、可靠的資料遷移工具，可以幫助公司將大量資料遷移到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。

其他選項不正確的原因是：

- 選項 B：使用 AWS DataSync 將資料遷移到 Amazon FSx for Lustre，Lustre 檔案系統主要設計用於高性能計算和大規模儲存，可能不適合公司的 SMB 型儲存需求。

題目(英):
A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage AWS accounts that contain applications. The company sets up a dedicated
monitoring member account in the organization. The company wants to query and visualize observability data across the accounts by using
Amazon CloudWatch.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Enable CloudWatch cross-account observability for the monitoring account. Deploy an AWS CloudFormation template provided by the
monitoring account in each AWS account to share the data with the monitoring account.
B. Set up service control policies (SCPs) to provide access to CloudWatch in the monitoring account under the Organizations root
organizational unit (OU).
C. Congure a new IAM user in the monitoring account. In each AWS account, congure an IAM policy to have access to query and
visualize the CloudWatch data in the account. Attach the new IAM policy to the new IAM user.
D. Create a new IAM user in the monitoring account. Create cross-account IAM policies in each AWS account. Attach the IAM policies to
the new IAM user.
解析(英):
Answer A is correct because enabling CloudWatch cross-account observability allows monitoring accounts to access CloudWatch data from other accounts. Deploying an AWS CloudFormation template automates the process of sharing data, allowing monitoring accounts to query and visualize observability data across accounts. This solution meets the needs of companies, allowing monitoring accounts to centrally manage and analyze CloudWatch data across accounts.

The other options are incorrect because:
- Option B Setting up Service Control Policies (SCPs) can only control access to CloudWatch, but not data sharing.
- Option C Setting up a new IAM user and IAM policy provides access to CloudWatch, but requires manual configuration and maintenance, and each account needs to be set up and updated.
- Option D Creating a new IAM user and cross-account IAM policy can provide access to CloudWatch, but also requires manual configuration and maintenance, and each account needs to be set up and updated.

Therefore, Option A is the most appropriate solution because it automates the process of sharing data and allows monitoring accounts to centrally manage and analyze CloudWatch data across accounts.
題目(中): 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 中的組織來管理包含應用程式的 AWS 帳戶。該公司在組織中設定了一個專用的監控成員帳戶。該公司希望使用 Amazon CloudWatch 來查詢和視覺化跨帳戶的可觀察性資料。哪種解決方案可以滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 啟用監控帳戶的 CloudWatch 跨帳戶可觀察性。部署監控帳戶提供的 AWS CloudFormation 範本到每個 AWS 帳戶中，以與監控帳戶共享資料。
B. 設定服務控制政策 (SCPs) 以在組織根組織單位 (OU) 下的監控帳戶中提供 CloudWatch 的存取權。
C. 在監控帳戶中設定新的 IAM 使用者。在每個 AWS 帳戶中，設定 IAM 政策以存取查詢和視覺化 CloudWatch 資料。將新的 IAM 政策附加到新的 IAM 使用者。
D. 在監控帳戶中創建新的 IAM 使用者。在每個 AWS 帳戶中創建跨帳戶 IAM 政策。將 IAM 政策附加到新的 IAM 使用者。
解析(中):
答案 A 是正確的，因為啟用 CloudWatch 跨帳戶可觀察性可以讓監控帳戶存取其他帳戶的 CloudWatch 資料。部署 AWS CloudFormation 範本可以自動化共享資料的過程，讓監控帳戶可以查詢和視覺化跨帳戶的可觀察性資料。這個解決方案可以滿足公司的需求，讓監控帳戶可以集中管理和分析跨帳戶的 CloudWatch 資料。

其他選項不正確的原因是：
- 選項 B 設定服務控制政策 (SCPs) 只能控制存取 CloudWatch 的權限，但不能共享資料。
- 選項 C 設定新的 IAM 使用者和 IAM 政策可以提供存取 CloudWatch 的權限，但需要手動配置和維護，每個帳戶都需要設定和更新。
- 選項 D 創建新的 IAM 使用者和跨帳戶 IAM 政策可以提供存取 CloudWatch 的權限，但也需要手動配置和維護，每個帳戶都需要設定和更新。

因此，選項 A 是最合適的解決方案，因為它可以自動化共享資料的過程，讓監控帳戶可以集中管理和分析跨帳戶的 CloudWatch 資料。

題目(英):
A company’s website is used to sell products to the public. The site runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an
Application Load Balancer (ALB). There is also an Amazon CloudFront distribution, and AWS WAF is being used to protect against SQL
injection attacks. The ALB is the origin for the CloudFront distribution. A recent review of security logs revealed an external malicious IP that
needs to be blocked from accessing the website.
What should a solutions architect do to protect the application?
選項(英):
A. Modify the network ACL on the CloudFront distribution to add a deny rule for the malicious IP address.
B. Modify the conguration of AWS WAF to add an IP match condition to block the malicious IP address.
C. Modify the network ACL for the EC2 instances in the target groups behind the ALB to deny the malicious IP address.
D. Modify the security groups for the EC2 instances in the target groups behind the ALB to deny the malicious IP address.
解析(英): To protect applications, solutions architects should modify AWS WAF settings to add IP matching criteria to block malicious IP addresses. This is because AWS WAF is a web application firewall that protects websites from SQL injection attacks and other types of attacks. By adding IP matching criteria in AWS WAF, you can effectively block malicious IP addresses from accessing your website. The other options are incorrect because modifying the CloudFront distribution's network ACL or the EC2 instance's network ACL and security group will not effectively prevent malicious IP addresses from accessing the website. Option A is incorrect because the CloudFront distribution's network ACLs do not directly block malicious IP addresses, and options C and D are incorrect because the EC2 instance's network ACLs and security groups do not directly block malicious IP addresses from accessing the website, especially when using ALB and CloudFront. Therefore, the correct answer is B.
題目(中): 一家公司的網站用於向公眾銷售產品。該網站在Application Load Balancer (ALB) 後面的 Auto Scaling 群組中的 Amazon EC2 實例上運行。還有一個 Amazon CloudFront 分佈，並使用 AWS WAF 來保護免受 SQL 注入攻擊。ALB 是 CloudFront 分佈的源頭。最近的安全日誌審查顯示了一個外部惡意 IP 地址需要被阻止訪問網站。

C. 修改 ALB 後面目標群組中的 EC2 實例的網路 ACL 以拒絕惡意 IP 地址。
D. 修改 ALB 後面目標群組中的 EC2 實例的安全群組以拒絕惡意 IP 地址。
解析(中): 為了保護應用程式，解決方案架構師應該修改 AWS WAF 的設定以添加 IP 匹配條件來阻止惡意 IP 地址。這是因為 AWS WAF 是一種網路應用程式防火牆，能夠保護網站免受 SQL 注入攻擊和其他類型的攻擊。通過在 AWS WAF 中添加 IP 匹配條件，可以有效地阻止惡意 IP 地址訪問網站。其他選項不正確，因為修改 CloudFront 分佈的網路 ACL 或 EC2 實例的網路 ACL 和安全群組不能夠有效地阻止惡意 IP 地址訪問網站。選項 A 不正確是因為 CloudFront 分佈的網路 ACL 不能夠直接阻止惡意 IP 地址，選項 C 和 D 不正確是因為 EC2 實例的網路 ACL 和安全群組不能夠直接阻止惡意 IP 地址訪問網站，尤其是在使用 ALB 和 CloudFront 的情況下。因此，正確的答案是 B。

題目(英):
A company sets up an organization in AWS Organizations that contains 10 AWS accounts. A solutions architect must design a solution to
provide access to the accounts for several thousand employees. The company has an existing identity provider (IdP). The company wants to
use the existing IdP for authentication to AWS.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create IAM users for the employees in the required AWS accounts. Connect IAM users to the existing IdP. Congure federated
authentication for the IAM users.
B. Set up AWS account root users with user email addresses and passwords that are synchronized from the existing IdP.
C. Congure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). Connect IAM Identity Center to the existing IdP. Provision users and groups
from the existing IdP.

解析(英):
The answer is C because AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) is a centralized authentication and authorization solution that allows companies to use their existing IdP for authentication and authorization. By setting up IAM Identity Center and connecting it to an existing IdP, companies can grant employees access to AWS accounts without creating separate IAM users for each account. The solution can also automate user and group authorization, reducing administrative burden.

The other options are incorrect because:

D. AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) is used to share access to AWS resources, but it does not provide authentication and authorization functions. It doesn't meet the needs of companies using their existing IdP for authentication.

題目(英):
A company has a multi-tier payment processing application that is based on virtual machines (VMs). The communication between the tiers
occurs asynchronously through a third-party middleware solution that guarantees exactly-once delivery.
The company needs a solution that requires the least amount of infrastructure management. The solution must guarantee exactly-once
delivery for application messaging.
Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Use AWS Lambda for the compute layers in the architecture.
B. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the compute layers in the architecture.
C. Use Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) as the messaging component between the compute layers.
D. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues as the messaging component between the compute layers.
E. Use containers that are based on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) for the compute layers in the architecture.
解析(英): According to the problem description, the company needed a solution that required minimal infrastructure management and must guarantee exactly-once delivery of application messages. 題目(英):
A company has a nightly batch processing routine that analyzes report les that an on-premises le system receives daily through SFTP. The
company wants to move the solution to the AWS Cloud. The solution must be highly available and resilient. The solution also must minimize
operational effort.
Which solution meets these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) le system for storage. Use an Amazon EC2 instance in
an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to run the batch operation.
B. Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance that runs Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume for
storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with the minimum number of instances and desired number of instances set to 1.
C. Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance that runs Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) le system for
storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with the minimum number of instances and desired number of instances set to 1.
D. Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. Modify the application to pull the batch les from Amazon S3 to an
Amazon EC2 instance for processing. Use an EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to run the batch
operation.
解析(英):
The answer is A because this option meets all of the company's needs. First, AWS Transfer for SFTP provides a secure and reliable way to receive and process SFTP archive transfers. Finally, using Auto Scaling groups and scheduled scaling principles can ensure that batch operations are executed within a specified time, and the number of instances can be automatically increased or decreased as needed to minimize operation work.

The other options are incorrect because:
In options B and C, using a single EC2 instance and setting the minimum number of instances to 1 cannot provide high availability and resilience.
In option D, using an Amazon S3 bucket for storage requires modifying the application to pull batch files, which may require additional development work. Additionally, using Amazon S3 buckets and EC2 instances for batch operations can add operational effort and complexity. Therefore, option A is the best solution.
題目(中): 一家公司有每晚批次處理程序，分析從SFTP接收的報表檔案，這些檔案每天儲存在內部檔案系統中。公司希望將這個解決方案移至AWS雲端，且必須具有高可用性和韌性。此外，解決方案還必須最小化操作工作。

題目(英):
