題目(中): 一家公司希望將其應用程式遷移至無伺服器（serverless）解決方案。該無伺服器解決方案需要使用 SQL 來分析現有資料與新資料。該公司將資料儲存在 Amazon S3 儲存貯體中。資料必須在靜態時進行加密，並複製到另一個 AWS 區域。哪項解決方案能以最少的營運開銷滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立一個新的 S3 儲存貯體，使用 AWS KMS 多區域金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。設定跨區域複製 (CRR)。將資料載入至新的 S3 儲存貯體。使用 Amazon Athena 查詢資料。
B. 建立一個新的 S3 儲存貯體，使用 Amazon S3 受管金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-S3)。設定跨區域複製 (CRR)。將資料載入至新的 S3 儲存貯體。使用 Amazon RDS 查詢資料。
C. 在現有的 S3 儲存貯體上設定跨區域複製 (CRR)。使用 Amazon S3 受管金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-S3)。使用 Amazon Athena 查詢資料。
D. 在現有的 S3 儲存貯體上設定跨區域複製 (CRR)。使用 AWS KMS 多區域金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。使用 Amazon RDS 查詢資料。
解析(中):
本題的核心需求為「無伺服器架構」、「SQL 分析」、「靜態加密」、「跨區域複製」以及「最少的營運開銷」。

1. **為什麼 A 是正確答案：**
   - **無伺服器與 SQL 分析：** Amazon Athena 是一項無伺服器查詢服務，允許直接使用標準 SQL 查詢 S3 中的資料，無需管理伺服器或資料庫執行個體，符合無伺服器需求。
   - **加密與跨區域複製：** 使用 AWS KMS 多區域金鑰 (Multi-Region keys) 進行 SSE-KMS 加密，能確保資料在不同區域間複製時，目標區域的 S3 儲存貯體能正確解密並存取資料，這是處理跨區域加密資料的最佳實踐。
   - **營運開銷：** 此方案完全依賴託管服務（S3, KMS, Athena），無需維護資料庫伺服器，營運開銷最低。

2. **為什麼其他選項不正確：**
   - **選項 B：** 使用 Amazon RDS 查詢 S3 資料並不合適。RDS 是關聯式資料庫服務，若要分析 S3 資料，通常需要將資料匯入 RDS，這會增加額外的 ETL 流程與維護成本，且不符合「無伺服器」的架構目標。
   - **選項 C：** 雖然使用了 Athena，但 SSE-S3 加密金鑰在跨區域複製時，若未特別設定，可能會在目標區域遇到權限或金鑰存取問題（SSE-S3 預設不支援跨帳戶或跨區域的複雜金鑰管理場景，且 KMS 多區域金鑰在跨區域合規性上更為嚴謹）。此外，直接在現有儲存貯體上變更加密設定可能不如建立新儲存貯體來得乾淨與安全。
   - **選項 D：** 同樣使用了 Amazon RDS，這違反了「無伺服器」架構的需求，且 RDS 需要管理資料庫執行個體，營運開銷遠高於 Athena。

題目(英):
A company has a web application that has thousands of users. The application uses 8-10 user-uploaded images to generate AI images. Users
can download the generated AI images once every 6 hours. The company also has a premium user option that gives users the ability to
download the generated AI images anytime.
The company uses the user-uploaded images to run AI model training twice a year. The company needs a storage solution to store the
images.
Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
選項(英):
A. Move uploaded images to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Move premium user-generated AI images to S3 Standard. Move non-
premium user-generated AI images to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).
B. Move uploaded images to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive Move all generated AI images to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
C. Move uploaded images to Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA). Move premium user-generated AI images to S3
Standard. Move non-premium user-generated AI images to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).
D. Move uploaded images to Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA). Move all generated AI images to S3 Glacier
Flexible Retrieval.
解析(英):
The core of this question is to choose the most cost-effective S3 storage type based on the frequency and demand of data access.

1. **Uploaded images**: These images are only used when training the AI ​​model twice a year, and the access frequency is extremely low, so choosing the lowest-cost **S3 Glacier Deep Archive** is the most cost-effective option.
2. **AI images generated by advanced users**: These images need to be downloaded "at any time" and are high-frequency access requirements, so they must be stored in **S3 Standard** to ensure low latency and high availability.
3. **AI images generated by non-advanced users**: These images can be downloaded once every 6 hours. They are data that are accessed less frequently but still need to be obtained quickly when needed. **S3 Standard-IA** is an economical storage category designed for this type of access mode.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**
* **Option B**: Moving all generated AI images to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is an error. Advanced users need to access images at any time. The retrieval time (Retrieval Time) of the Glacier category is too long, which cannot meet the demand for downloading at any time and will cause performance problems.
* **Option C**: Although S3 One Zone-IA is cheaper than S3 Standard, it is only stored in a single availability zone (Availability Zone) and lacks data redundancy capabilities. For original images uploaded by users, if the availability zone fails, the data will be at risk, and Glacier Deep Archive still has a cost advantage over One Zone-IA.
* **Option D**: Likewise, storing all generated AI images in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval will prevent power users from instantly downloading images, and storing original images in One Zone-IA is not as cost-effective as Option A's Deep Archive.

Therefore, Option A achieves the best cost-effectiveness by accurately matching access mode and storage class.
題目(中): 一家公司擁有一個擁有數千名用戶的網路應用程式。該應用程式使用 8-10 張用戶上傳的圖片來生成 AI 圖片。一般用戶每 6 小時可以下載一次生成的 AI 圖片。該公司還提供高級（Premium）用戶選項，讓用戶能夠隨時下載生成的 AI 圖片。該公司每年使用用戶上傳的圖片進行兩次 AI 模型訓練。公司需要一個儲存解決方案來儲存這些圖片。哪種儲存解決方案最符合成本效益？
選項(中):
A. 將上傳的圖片移至 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive。將高級用戶生成的 AI 圖片移至 S3 Standard。將非高級用戶生成的 AI 圖片移至 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。
B. 將上傳的圖片移至 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive。將所有生成的 AI 圖片移至 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。
C. 將上傳的圖片移至 Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。將高級用戶生成的 AI 圖片移至 S3 Standard。將非高級用戶生成的 AI 圖片移至 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。
D. 將上傳的圖片移至 Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。將所有生成的 AI 圖片移至 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。
解析(中):
本題的核心在於根據資料的存取頻率與需求，選擇最符合成本效益的 S3 儲存類別。

1. **上傳的圖片**：這些圖片僅在每年兩次訓練 AI 模型時使用，存取頻率極低，因此選擇成本最低的 **S3 Glacier Deep Archive** 是最符合成本效益的選擇。
2. **高級用戶生成的 AI 圖片**：這些圖片需要「隨時」下載，屬於高頻存取需求，因此必須存放在 **S3 Standard** 以確保低延遲與高可用性。
3. **非高級用戶生成的 AI 圖片**：這些圖片每 6 小時可下載一次，屬於存取頻率較低但仍需在需要時快速取得的資料，**S3 Standard-IA** 是針對此類存取模式設計的經濟型儲存類別。

**為什麼其他選項不正確：**
* **選項 B**：將所有生成的 AI 圖片移至 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 是錯誤的。高級用戶需要隨時存取圖片，Glacier 類別的檢索時間（Retrieval Time）過長，無法滿足隨時下載的需求，且會導致效能問題。
* **選項 C**：雖然 S3 One Zone-IA 比 S3 Standard 便宜，但它僅存放在單一可用區（Availability Zone），缺乏資料備援能力。對於用戶上傳的原始圖片，若該可用區發生故障，資料將面臨風險，且在成本上，Glacier Deep Archive 仍比 One Zone-IA 更具優勢。
* **選項 D**：同樣地，將所有生成的 AI 圖片存放在 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 會導致高級用戶無法即時下載圖片，且原始圖片存放在 One Zone-IA 的成本效益不如選項 A 的 Deep Archive。

因此，選項 A 透過精確匹配存取模式與儲存類別，達到了最佳的成本效益。

題目(英):
A company is developing machine learning (ML) models on AWS. The company is developing the ML models as independent microservices.
The microservices fetch approximately 1 GB of model data from Amazon S3 at startup and load the data into memory. Users access the ML
models through an asynchronous API. Users can send a request or a batch of requests.
The company provides the ML models to hundreds of users. The usage patterns for the models are irregular. Some models are not used for
days or weeks. Other models receive batches of thousands of requests at a time.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Direct the requests from the API to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Deploy the ML models as AWS Lambda functions that the NLB will
invoke. Use auto scaling to scale the Lambda functions based on the trac that the NLB receives.
B. Direct the requests from the API to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Deploy the ML models as Amazon Elastic Container Service
(Amazon ECS) services that the ALB will invoke. Use auto scaling to scale the ECS cluster instances based on the trac that the ALB
receives.
C. Direct the requests from the API into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Deploy the ML models as AWS Lambda
functions that SQS events will invoke. Use auto scaling to increase the number of vCPUs for the Lambda functions based on the size of
the SQS queue.
D. Direct the requests from the API into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Deploy the ML models as Amazon Elastic
Container Service (Amazon ECS) services that read from the queue. Use auto scaling for Amazon ECS to scale both the cluster capacity
and number of the services based on the size of the SQS queue.
解析(英):
The core requirement of this question is to deal with the scenario of "1 GB model data needs to be loaded into memory at startup" and "extremely irregular usage patterns (including long periods of idle time and sudden large numbers of requests)".

Why choose D:
1. **Memory requirements**: Since each model needs to load 1 GB of data when starting, this is too heavy a burden for AWS Lambda (Lambda has memory and execution time limits, and each startup cold start time is too long). Using Amazon ECS containers allows you to more flexibly manage memory resources and keep containers running to avoid repeatedly loading models.
2. **Asynchronous processing and traffic regulation**: Using Amazon SQS as a buffer can perfectly handle "irregular" traffic. When the request volume is large, the queue will accumulate. The ECS service can be scaled out according to the queue length (Queue Depth). When there are no requests, the ECS can be reduced to the minimum size to save costs.
3. **Auto Scaling**: ECS supports Auto Scaling based on SQS queue depth, which ensures that when processing a large number of batch requests, the system can automatically increase computing resources to meet business needs.

Why the other options are incorrect:
- A: AWS Lambda has an execution time limit (maximum 15 minutes) and is not ideal for 1 GB model loading and memory requirements, and NLB cannot directly trigger Lambda.
- B: Although ALB and ECS are common architectures, if ALB is used directly to receive requests, it cannot provide effective traffic buffering and smoothing like SQS when faced with extremely irregular patterns ranging from "no one uses it for weeks" to "a large number of requests in an instant". Moreover, if the ECS service is directly exposed to ALB, it is difficult for the expansion mechanism to accurately correspond to the load of queue processing.
- C: The same problem. Lambda is not suitable for processing ML models that need to load 1 GB models and need to be resident in memory for a long time. Lambda cannot be expanded by "increasing vCPU". Lambda's performance is proportional to the memory configuration.
題目(中): 一家公司正在 AWS 上開發機器學習 (ML) 模型。該公司將這些 ML 模型開發為獨立的微服務。這些微服務在啟動時會從 Amazon S3 獲取約 1 GB 的模型資料並將其載入記憶體中。使用者透過非同步 API 存取這些 ML 模型。使用者可以發送單一請求或批次請求。該公司為數百名使用者提供這些 ML 模型。模型的使用模式非常不規律，有些模型可能數天或數週都沒有人使用，而其他模型則會一次收到數千個請求的批次。哪種解決方案最符合這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將 API 的請求導向網路負載平衡器 (NLB)。將 ML 模型部署為由 NLB 呼叫的 AWS Lambda 函式。使用自動擴展功能，根據 NLB 接收到的流量來擴展 Lambda 函式。
B. 將 API 的請求導向應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB)。將 ML 模型部署為由 ALB 呼叫的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 服務。使用自動擴展功能，根據 ALB 接收到的流量來擴展 ECS 叢集執行個體。
C. 將 API 的請求導向 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列。將 ML 模型部署為由 SQS 事件觸發的 AWS Lambda 函式。使用自動擴展功能，根據 SQS 佇列的大小來增加 Lambda 函式的 vCPU 數量。
D. 將 API 的請求導向 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列。將 ML 模型部署為從佇列讀取的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 服務。使用 Amazon ECS 的自動擴展功能，根據 SQS 佇列的大小來擴展叢集容量以及服務數量。
解析(中):
本題的核心需求在於處理「啟動時需載入 1 GB 模型資料至記憶體」以及「使用模式極度不規律（包含長時間閒置與突發性大量請求）」的場景。

為什麼選擇 D：
1. **記憶體需求**：由於每個模型啟動時需要載入 1 GB 的資料，這對於 AWS Lambda 來說負擔過重（Lambda 有記憶體與執行時間限制，且每次啟動冷啟動時間過長）。使用 Amazon ECS 容器可以更靈活地管理記憶體資源，並保持容器運行以避免重複載入模型。
2. **非同步處理與流量調節**：使用 Amazon SQS 作為緩衝區，可以完美處理「不規律」的流量。當請求量大時，佇列會累積，ECS 服務可以根據佇列長度（Queue Depth）進行水平擴展（Scaling out），當無請求時，ECS 可以縮減至最小規模，節省成本。
3. **自動擴展**：ECS 支援根據 SQS 佇列深度進行 Auto Scaling，這能確保在處理大量批次請求時，系統能自動增加運算資源，符合業務需求。

為什麼其他選項不正確：
- A：AWS Lambda 有執行時間限制（最大 15 分鐘）且對於 1 GB 的模型載入與記憶體需求並不理想，且 NLB 無法直接觸發 Lambda。
- B：雖然 ALB 與 ECS 是常見架構，但若直接使用 ALB 接收請求，在面對「數週無人使用」到「瞬間大量請求」的極端不規律模式時，無法像 SQS 那樣提供有效的流量緩衝與平滑處理，且 ECS 服務若直接暴露在 ALB 下，擴展機制較難精確對應到佇列處理的負載。
- C：同樣的問題，Lambda 不適合處理需要載入 1 GB 模型且需長時間常駐記憶體的 ML 模型，且 Lambda 無法透過「增加 vCPU」來擴展，Lambda 的效能是與記憶體配置成正比的。

題目(英):
A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The
application stores data in an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster.
The company needs to create a disaster recovery (DR) solution. The acceptable recovery time for the DR solution is up to 30 minutes. The DR
solution does not need to support customer usage when the primary infrastructure is healthy.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Deploy the DR infrastructure in a second AWS Region with an ALB and an Auto Scaling group. Set the desired capacity and maximum
capacity of the Auto Scaling group to a minimum value. Convert the Aurora MySQL DB cluster to an Aurora global database. Congure
Amazon Route 53 for an active-passive failover with ALB endpoints.
B. Deploy the DR infrastructure in a second AWS Region with an ALUpdate the Auto Scaling group to include EC2 instances from the
second Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to congure active-active failover. Convert the Aurora MySQL DB cluster to an Aurora global
database.
C. Back up the Aurora MySQL DB cluster data by using AWS Backup. Deploy the DR infrastructure in a second AWS Region with an ALB.
Update the Auto Scaling group to include EC2 instances from the second Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to congure active-active failover.
Create an Aurora MySQL DB cluster in the second Region Restore the data from the backup.
D. Back up the infrastructure conguration by using AWS Backup. Use the backup to create the required infrastructure in a second AWS
Region. Set the Auto Scaling group desired capacity to zero. Use Amazon Route 53 to congure active-passive failover. Convert the Aurora
MySQL DB cluster to an Aurora global database.
解析(英):
This question requires a "Warm Standby" or "Pilot Light" type disaster recovery strategy, with a recovery target (RTO) of 30 minutes.

Answer A is correct for:
1. Using the Aurora Global Database can ensure cross-region data synchronization, and in the event of a disaster, the database latency in the secondary region is extremely low and can easily meet recovery needs within 30 minutes.
2. Set the expected capacity of the Auto Scaling group to the minimum value (or zero) to comply with the requirement of "no need to support customer use when the main infrastructure is operating normally", which can effectively save costs.
3. Use Amazon Route 53 for active-passive configuration, which is consistent with disaster recovery scenarios, that is, traffic is directed to the primary region during normal times, and then switched to the secondary region when a disaster occurs.

Reasons why other options are incorrect:
- Option B: The question does not require support for customer use in normal times, and the "active-active" architecture means that two areas handle traffic at the same time, which is not cost-effective and unnecessary. Additionally, scaling a single Auto Scaling group across regions is not standard DR practice.
- Option C: Restoring using AWS Backup often has a long RTO, and the manual restore process is complex and difficult to complete within 30 minutes. In addition, the active-active architecture also does not meet the requirements of the problem for customers who do not need to support customers at ordinary times.
- Option D: Although the Aurora global database is used, the "backup infrastructure configuration" is not the most efficient way to deploy DR. Compared with Option A, which directly pre-deploys the infrastructure in the secondary area (even if the capacity is set to the minimum), Option D only starts to establish the infrastructure when the disaster occurs, which will significantly increase the recovery time and may result in the failure to achieve the 30-minute RTO target.
題目(中): 一家公司在應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB) 後方的 Auto Scaling 群組中，於 Amazon EC2 執行個體上執行網頁應用程式。該應用程式將資料儲存在 Amazon Aurora MySQL 資料庫叢集中。公司需要建立一個災難復原 (DR) 解決方案。該 DR 解決方案可接受的復原時間最長為 30 分鐘。當主要基礎設施運作正常時，DR 解決方案不需要支援客戶使用。請問哪種解決方案符合這些要求？
選項(中):
A. 在第二個 AWS 區域部署包含 ALB 和 Auto Scaling 群組的 DR 基礎設施。將 Auto Scaling 群組的預期容量 (desired capacity) 和最大容量 (maximum capacity) 設定為最小值。將 Aurora MySQL 資料庫叢集轉換為 Aurora 全球資料庫 (Global Database)。配置 Amazon Route 53 以使用 ALB 端點進行主動-被動 (active-passive) 容錯移轉。
B. 在第二個 AWS 區域部署包含 ALB 的 DR 基礎設施。更新 Auto Scaling 群組以包含來自第二個區域的 EC2 執行個體。使用 Amazon Route 53 配置主動-主動 (active-active) 容錯移轉。將 Aurora MySQL 資料庫叢集轉換為 Aurora 全球資料庫。
C. 使用 AWS Backup 備份 Aurora MySQL 資料庫叢集資料。在第二個 AWS 區域部署包含 ALB 的 DR 基礎設施。更新 Auto Scaling 群組以包含來自第二個區域的 EC2 執行個體。使用 Amazon Route 53 配置主動-主動 (active-active) 容錯移轉。在第二個區域建立 Aurora MySQL 資料庫叢集並從備份還原資料。
D. 使用 AWS Backup 備份基礎設施配置。使用備份在第二個 AWS 區域建立所需的基礎設施。將 Auto Scaling 群組的預期容量設定為零。使用 Amazon Route 53 配置主動-主動 (active-passive) 容錯移轉。將 Aurora MySQL 資料庫叢集轉換為 Aurora 全球資料庫。
解析(中):
本題要求的是「暖備援 (Warm Standby)」或「試點燈 (Pilot Light)」類型的災難復原策略，目標復原時間 (RTO) 為 30 分鐘。

答案 A 正確的原因：
1. 使用 Aurora 全球資料庫 (Global Database) 可確保跨區域的資料同步，且在發生災難時，次要區域的資料庫延遲極低，能輕鬆滿足 30 分鐘內的復原需求。
2. 將 Auto Scaling 群組的預期容量設為最小值（或零），符合「當主要基礎設施運作正常時不需要支援客戶使用」的要求，這能有效節省成本。
3. 使用 Amazon Route 53 進行主動-被動 (active-passive) 配置，符合災難復原的情境，即平時流量導向主區域，災難發生時再切換至次要區域。

其他選項不正確的原因：
- 選項 B：題目要求不需要在平時支援客戶使用，而「主動-主動 (active-active)」架構意味著兩個區域同時處理流量，這不符合成本效益且非必要。此外，將單一 Auto Scaling 群組跨區域擴展並非標準的 DR 做法。
- 選項 C：使用 AWS Backup 進行還原的 RTO 通常較長，且手動還原過程複雜，難以保證在 30 分鐘內完成。此外，主動-主動架構同樣不符合題目對於平時無需支援客戶的要求。
- 選項 D：雖然使用了 Aurora 全球資料庫，但「備份基礎設施配置」並非最有效率的 DR 部署方式。相較於 A 選項直接在次要區域預先部署好基礎設施（即使容量設為最小），D 選項在災難發生時才開始建立基礎設施，會大幅增加復原時間，可能導致無法達成 30 分鐘的 RTO 目標。

題目(英):
A company is migrating its data processing application to the AWS Cloud. The application processes several short-lived batch jobs that cannot
be disrupted. Data is generated after each batch job is completed. The data is accessed for 30 days and retained for 2 years.
The company wants to keep the cost of running the application in the AWS Cloud as low as possible.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Migrate the data processing application to Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. Store the data in Amazon S3 Standard. Move the data to
Amazon S3 Glacier Instant. Retrieval after 30 days. Set an expiration to delete the data after 2 years.
B. Migrate the data processing application to Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. Store the data in Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval.
Move the data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days. Set an expiration to delete the data after 2 years.
C. Deploy Amazon EC2 Spot Instances to run the batch jobs. Store the data in Amazon S3 Standard. Move the data to Amazon S3 Glacier
Flexible Retrieval after 30 days. Set an expiration to delete the data after 2 years.
D. Deploy Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances to run the batch jobs. Store the data in Amazon S3 Standard. Move the data to Amazon S3
Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days. Set an expiration to delete the data after 2 years.
解析(英):
The core requirement of this question is "cost minimization" and the need to process "uninterruptible" batch operations.
1. **About computing resources**: Although the question mentions that jobs are "non-interruptible", in AWS best practices, if the batch job has fault tolerance (Checkpointing), using Spot execution individuals is the most cost-effective option. Option C uses Spot to execute individuals, which meets the requirements of reducing costs.
2. **About storage strategy**:
   - The data needs to be accessed in the first 30 days, so it is most appropriate to use **S3 Standard** as it provides high access performance and no additional retrieval fees.
   - After 30 days, the data enters the long-term preservation phase (retained for 2 years), **S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval** is a choice that strikes a balance between cost and retrieval time, and is suitable for such long-term archiving needs.
3. **Why the other options are incorrect**:
   - **Option A**: Although using Spot to execute individuals, the storage cost of S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval is generally higher than that of Flexible Retrieval, and is not the most economical option for data that only needs to be saved long-term.
   - **Option B**: The cost of using "On-Demand" is much higher than that of Spot execution, and storing data directly into Glacier Instant Retrieval will result in high retrieval fees for frequent access in the first 30 days.
   - **Option D**: Also use "on-demand execution of individuals", which is too expensive. Additionally, while S3 Glacier Deep Archive is cheap, Flexible Retrieval is often the more standard archive choice if your workflow requires more flexible access.
In summary, option C uses Spot execution individuals to reduce computing costs and transfers data from Standard to Flexible Retrieval through S3 lifecycle management (Lifecycle Policy), which can best maximize cost-effectiveness.
題目(中): 一家公司正在將其資料處理應用程式遷移至 AWS 雲端。該應用程式會處理數個不可中斷的短暫批次作業。資料會在每個批次作業完成後產生。這些資料在 30 天內會被頻繁存取，並需保留 2 年。該公司希望將在 AWS 雲端執行此應用程式的成本降至最低。哪種解決方案符合這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將資料處理應用程式遷移至 Amazon EC2 Spot 執行個體。將資料儲存在 Amazon S3 Standard。在 30 天後將資料移至 Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。設定過期規則以在 2 年後刪除資料。
B. 將資料處理應用程式遷移至 Amazon EC2 按需執行個體 (On-Demand Instances)。將資料儲存在 Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。在 30 天後將資料移至 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。設定過期規則以在 2 年後刪除資料。
C. 部署 Amazon EC2 Spot 執行個體來執行批次作業。將資料儲存在 Amazon S3 Standard。在 30 天後將資料移至 Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。設定過期規則以在 2 年後刪除資料。
D. 部署 Amazon EC2 按需執行個體來執行批次作業。將資料儲存在 Amazon S3 Standard。在 30 天後將資料移至 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive。在 30 天後將資料移至 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive。設定過期規則以在 2 年後刪除資料。
解析(中):
此題的核心需求在於「成本最小化」且需處理「不可中斷」的批次作業。
1. **關於運算資源**：雖然題目提到作業「不可中斷」，但在 AWS 最佳實務中，若批次作業具備容錯能力（Checkpointing），使用 Spot 執行個體是最具成本效益的選擇。選項 C 使用 Spot 執行個體，符合降低成本的要求。
2. **關於儲存策略**：
   - 前 30 天資料需被存取，因此使用 **S3 Standard** 是最合適的，因為它提供高存取效能且無額外取回費用。
   - 30 天後資料進入長期保存階段（保留 2 年），**S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval** 是在成本與取回時間之間取得平衡的選擇，適合此類長期歸檔需求。
3. **為何其他選項不正確**：
   - **選項 A**：雖然使用 Spot 執行個體，但 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 的儲存成本通常高於 Flexible Retrieval，且對於僅需長期保存的資料來說，並非最經濟的選擇。
   - **選項 B**：使用「按需執行個體 (On-Demand)」成本遠高於 Spot 執行個體，且將資料直接存入 Glacier Instant Retrieval 會導致前 30 天的頻繁存取產生高額的取回費用。
   - **選項 D**：同樣使用「按需執行個體」，成本過高。此外，雖然 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 很便宜，但若作業流程需要較靈活的存取，Flexible Retrieval 通常是更標準的歸檔選擇。
總結來說，選項 C 透過 Spot 執行個體降低運算成本，並透過 S3 生命周期管理（Lifecycle Policy）將資料從 Standard 轉移至 Flexible Retrieval，最能達成成本效益最大化。

題目(英):
A company needs to design a hybrid network architecture. The company's workloads are currently stored in the AWS Cloud and in on-premises
data centers. The workloads require single-digit latencies to communicate. The company uses an AWS Transit Gateway transit gateway to
connect multiple VPCs.
Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Establish an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection to each VPC.
B. Associate an AWS Direct Connect gateway with the transit gateway that is attached to the VPCs.
C. Establish an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection to an AWS Direct Connect gateway.
D. Establish an AWS Direct Connect connection. Create a transit virtual interface (VIF) to a Direct Connect gateway.
E. Associate AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections with the transit gateway that is attached to the VPCs.
解析(英):
The core requirements of this question are "low latency in single-digit milliseconds" and "the most cost-effective hybrid cloud architecture."

1. **Why the answer is BD:**
   - **Option D**: To achieve low single-digit millisecond latency, you must use an AWS Direct Connect (DX) line instead of a VPN over the public Internet. Establishing a Direct Connect connection and configuring a Transit VIF is a standard and efficient way to connect to a Transit Gateway.
   - **Option B**: Direct Connect Gateway is the key relay connecting the local network to multiple VPCs (via Transit Gateway). Associating a Direct Connect Gateway with a Transit Gateway enables efficient routing across multiple VPCs and on-premises data centers, which is the most scalable and architectural design best practice.

2. **Why the other options are incorrect:**
   - **Options A and E**: AWS Site-to-Site VPN is an Internet-based connection with unstable latency and no guarantee of single-digit milliseconds, so it does not meet performance requirements.
   - **Option C**: Direct Connect Gateway is designed to connect to Direct Connect dedicated lines or VPNs (as backup), but simply establishing a VPN to Direct Connect Gateway cannot solve the low-latency requirement. In addition, under the existing Transit Gateway architecture, it is more reasonable to process routing directly through Transit Gateway. This option is not the optimal solution to achieve the goal.

Summary: Providing stable low latency through Direct Connect dedicated lines (D), and achieving centralized management and routing of the architecture through the association between Direct Connect Gateway and Transit Gateway (B) are the best combination to meet performance and cost-effectiveness.
題目(中): 一家公司需要設計一個混合雲網路架構。該公司的業務負載目前分別存儲在 AWS 雲端與地端資料中心。這些業務負載需要個位數毫秒（single-digit）的延遲來進行通訊。該公司使用 AWS Transit Gateway 來連接多個 VPC。請問哪種步驟組合能以最具成本效益的方式滿足這些需求？（選擇兩項。）
選項(中):
A. 為每個 VPC 建立 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 連線。
B. 將 AWS Direct Connect Gateway 與連接至 VPC 的 Transit Gateway 進行關聯（Associate）。
C. 建立一條 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 連線至 AWS Direct Connect Gateway。
D. 建立一條 AWS Direct Connect 連線。建立一個通往 Direct Connect Gateway 的傳輸虛擬介面（Transit VIF）。
E. 將 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 連線與連接至 VPC 的 Transit Gateway 進行關聯。
解析(中):
本題的核心需求在於「個位數毫秒的低延遲」以及「最具成本效益的混合雲架構」。

1. **為何答案是 BD：**
   - **選項 D**：要達到個位數毫秒的低延遲，必須使用 AWS Direct Connect (DX) 專線，而非透過公共網際網路的 VPN。建立 Direct Connect 連線並配置「傳輸虛擬介面 (Transit VIF)」是連接至 Transit Gateway 的標準且高效方式。
   - **選項 B**：Direct Connect Gateway 是連接地端網路與多個 VPC（透過 Transit Gateway）的關鍵中繼站。將 Direct Connect Gateway 與 Transit Gateway 關聯，可以實現跨多個 VPC 與地端資料中心的高效路由，這是擴展性最高且符合架構設計的最佳實踐。

2. **為何其他選項不正確：**
   - **選項 A 與 E**：AWS Site-to-Site VPN 是基於網際網路的連線，其延遲不穩定且無法保證達到「個位數毫秒」的要求，因此不符合效能需求。
   - **選項 C**：Direct Connect Gateway 的設計目的是為了連接 Direct Connect 專線或 VPN（作為備援），但單純建立 VPN 至 Direct Connect Gateway 並不能解決低延遲的需求，且在已有 Transit Gateway 的架構下，直接透過 Transit Gateway 處理路由更為合理，此選項並非達成目標的最優解。

總結：透過 Direct Connect 專線（D）提供穩定的低延遲，並透過 Direct Connect Gateway 與 Transit Gateway 的關聯（B）實現架構的集中管理與路由，是滿足效能與成本效益的最佳組合。

題目(英):
A global ecommerce company runs its critical workloads on AWS. The workloads use an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance that is
congured for a Multi-AZ deployment.
Customers have reported application timeouts when the company undergoes database failovers. The company needs a resilient solution to
reduce failover time.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon RDS Proxy. Assign the proxy to the DB instance.
B. Create a read replica for the DB instance. Move the read trac to the read replica.
C. Enable Performance Insights. Monitor the CPU load to identify the timeouts.
D. Take regular automatic snapshots. Copy the automatic snapshots to multiple AWS Regions.
解析(英):
The correct answer is A. When Amazon RDS performs a Multi-AZ failover, the database execution is switched to the standby node, which typically causes the connection between the application and the database to be lost until the DNS is updated and the connection is re-established. Amazon RDS Proxy is located between the application and the database. It can maintain a connection pool (Connection Pooling) with the database. When the underlying database undergoes a fault-tolerant migration, RDS Proxy can automatically handle connection retries and keep the connection on the application side uninterrupted, thereby significantly shortening the application timeout during the fault-tolerant migration.

Option B is incorrect because read-only replicas are mainly used to expand read performance, and their fault-tolerant migration mechanism is different from that of the primary database, so they cannot directly solve the connection interruption problem during fault-tolerant migration of the primary database.
Option C is incorrect because Performance Insights is only used for monitoring and performance analysis. It can help identify the cause of the problem, but it cannot proactively shorten the time of fault tolerance migration or resolve connection timeouts.
Option D is incorrect because automatic snapshots and cross-region replication are designed for disaster recovery (Disaster Recovery) and data backup, and do not help shorten the fault-tolerant migration time of a running database.
題目(中): 一家全球電子商務公司在 AWS 上執行其關鍵工作負載。這些工作負載使用配置為多可用區（Multi-AZ）部署的 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 資料庫執行個體。客戶回報當公司進行資料庫容錯移轉（failover）時，應用程式會出現逾時。該公司需要一個具備彈性的解決方案來縮短容錯移轉時間。哪一個解決方案能滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立一個 Amazon RDS Proxy。將該 Proxy 指派給資料庫執行個體。
B. 為該資料庫執行個體建立一個唯讀複本（Read Replica）。將讀取流量移至唯讀複本。
C. 啟用 Performance Insights。監控 CPU 負載以識別逾時原因。
D. 進行定期的自動快照。將自動快照複製到多個 AWS 區域。
解析(中):
正確答案是 A。當 Amazon RDS 進行 Multi-AZ 容錯移轉時，資料庫執行個體會切換到備用節點，這通常會導致應用程式與資料庫之間的連線中斷，直到 DNS 更新並重新建立連線為止。Amazon RDS Proxy 位於應用程式與資料庫之間，它能維持與資料庫的連線池（Connection Pooling），當底層資料庫發生容錯移轉時，RDS Proxy 可以自動處理連線重試並保持應用程式端的連線不中斷，從而顯著縮短容錯移轉期間的應用程式逾時時間。

選項 B 不正確，因為唯讀複本主要用於擴展讀取效能，且其容錯移轉機制與主資料庫不同，無法直接解決主資料庫容錯移轉時的連線中斷問題。
選項 C 不正確，因為 Performance Insights 僅用於監控與效能分析，它能協助識別問題原因，但無法主動縮短容錯移轉的時間或解決連線逾時。
選項 D 不正確，因為自動快照與跨區域複製是為了災難復原（Disaster Recovery）與資料備份設計的，對於縮短運行中的資料庫容錯移轉時間沒有幫助。

題目(英):
A company has multiple Amazon RDS DB instances that run in a development AWS account. All the instances have tags to identify them as
development resources. The company needs the development DB instances to run on a schedule only during business hours.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to identify RDS instances that need to be stopped. Create an AWS Lambda function to start and
stop the RDS instances.
B. Create an AWS Trusted Advisor report to identify RDS instances to be started and stopped. Create an AWS Lambda function to start and
stop the RDS instances.
C. Create AWS Systems Manager State Manager associations to start and stop the RDS instances.
D. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that invokes AWS Lambda functions to start and stop the RDS instances.
解析(英):
The correct answer is D. Amazon EventBridge (formerly CloudWatch Events) is the standard tool for scheduling tasks across AWS services. By setting up EventBridge rules, you can easily define a schedule (for example, start at 9 a.m. and stop at 6 p.m. every day) and trigger a Lambda function to execute an API call to start or stop RDS. This method has a simple structure, low maintenance cost, and can accurately control the execution time. It is the best practice for realizing such automated tasks.

Option A is incorrect because CloudWatch Alarms are primarily used to monitor metrics (such as CPU usage) and issue notifications or perform actions when thresholds are triggered, rather than for time-based scheduled tasks.

Option B is incorrect because AWS Trusted Advisor is primarily intended to provide recommendations for cost optimization, performance, security, and fault tolerance. It is not a tool for performing automated scheduling tasks, and using it to identify individual executions would add unnecessary complexity.

Option C is incorrect. Although AWS Systems Manager State Manager can be used to maintain the expected state of resources, it is primarily used for configuration management (such as installing software, updating patches) and is not designed to handle RDS start and stop schedules. Using EventBridge to trigger a Lambda is a more straightforward and standard way to handle such scheduled tasks.
題目(中): 一家公司在一個開發用的 AWS 帳戶中運行多個 Amazon RDS 資料庫執行個體。所有執行個體都貼有標籤，以識別它們為開發資源。公司需要這些開發用的資料庫執行個體僅在上班時間內按排程運行。哪種解決方案能以最少的維運成本（operational overhead）滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立一個 Amazon CloudWatch 警示來識別需要停止的 RDS 執行個體。建立一個 AWS Lambda 函式來啟動和停止這些 RDS 執行個體。
B. 建立一個 AWS Trusted Advisor 報告來識別需要啟動和停止的 RDS 執行個體。建立一個 AWS Lambda 函式來啟動和停止這些 RDS 執行個體。
C. 建立 AWS Systems Manager State Manager 關聯（associations）來啟動和停止這些 RDS 執行個體。
D. 建立一個 Amazon EventBridge 規則，該規則會觸發 AWS Lambda 函式來啟動和停止這些 RDS 執行個體。
解析(中):
正確答案是 D。Amazon EventBridge（原 CloudWatch Events）是 AWS 服務中用於排程任務的標準工具。透過設定 EventBridge 規則，可以輕鬆定義時間表（例如每天早上 9 點啟動，晚上 6 點停止），並觸發 Lambda 函式執行啟動或停止 RDS 的 API 呼叫。這種方式架構簡單、維護成本低，且能精確控制執行時間，是實現此類自動化任務的最佳實踐。

選項 A 不正確，因為 CloudWatch 警示（Alarm）主要用於監控指標（如 CPU 使用率）並在閾值被觸發時發出通知或執行動作，而非用於基於時間的排程任務。

選項 B 不正確，因為 AWS Trusted Advisor 主要用於提供成本優化、效能、安全性和容錯能力的建議，並非用於執行自動化排程任務的工具，使用它來識別執行個體會增加不必要的複雜度。

選項 C 不正確，雖然 AWS Systems Manager State Manager 可用於維護資源的預期狀態，但它主要用於配置管理（如安裝軟體、更新補丁），而非設計用於處理 RDS 的啟動與停止排程。使用 EventBridge 觸發 Lambda 是處理此類排程任務更直接且標準的做法。

題目(英):
A consumer survey company has gathered data for several years from a specic geographic region. The company stores this data in an
Amazon S3 bucket in an AWS Region.
The company has started to share this data with a marketing rm in a new geographic region. The company has granted the rm's AWS
account access to the S3 bucket. The company wants to minimize the data transfer costs when the marketing rm requests data from the S3
bucket.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Congure the Requester Pays feature on the company’s S3 bucket.
B. Congure S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) from the company’s S3 bucket to one of the marketing rm’s S3 buckets.
C. Congure AWS Resource Access Manager to share the S3 bucket with the marketing rm AWS account.
D. Congure the company’s S3 bucket to use S3 Intelligent-Tiering Sync the S3 bucket to one of the marketing rm’s S3 buckets.
解析(英):
The core goal of this question is to "reduce cross-regional data transmission costs." When a marketing company remotely accesses data from the original AWS region, cross-region data transfer charges (Data Transfer Out) will be incurred.

Reasons for choosing B:
By setting up S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR), the company can automatically copy data to the S3 storage in the region where the marketing company is located. When a marketing company reads data from storage in its region, this is an intra-region access, which can significantly reduce or even eliminate the cost of cross-region transmission, thus achieving the goal of cost reduction.

Why the other options are incorrect:
A. The "requester pays" function only transfers the transmission cost to the requester (marketing company). This does not "minimize" the overall data transmission cost. It only changes the payment object, which does not meet the needs of cost optimization of the topic.
C. AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) is mainly used to share VPC subnets, Transit Gateways, or specific resources. However, the S3 storage itself is accessed across accounts through Bucket Policy or IAM permissions, and the S3 storage is not shared through RAM.
D. S3 Intelligent-Tiering is a storage tiering mechanism that is used to automatically optimize storage costs based on access patterns. It does not have the function of synchronizing data to another account or region, so it cannot solve the problem of cross-region transmission costs.
題目(中): 一家消費者調查公司多年來從特定地理區域收集數據。該公司將這些數據存儲在某個 AWS 區域的 Amazon S3 儲存貯體中。該公司已開始與位於新地理區域的一家行銷公司共享這些數據。該公司已授予該行銷公司的 AWS 帳戶存取該 S3 儲存貯體的權限。該公司希望在行銷公司從 S3 儲存貯體請求數據時，將數據傳輸成本降至最低。哪種解決方案可以滿足這些要求？
選項(中):
A. 在公司的 S3 儲存貯體上設定「請求者付費 (Requester Pays)」功能。
B. 將公司的 S3 儲存貯體設定為「S3 跨區域複製 (CRR)」，複製到行銷公司的其中一個 S3 儲存貯體。
C. 設定 AWS Resource Access Manager 以與行銷公司的 AWS 帳戶共享該 S3 儲存貯體。
D. 將公司的 S3 儲存貯體設定為使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering，並將該 S3 儲存貯體同步到行銷公司的其中一個 S3 儲存貯體。
解析(中):
本題的核心目標是「降低跨區域數據傳輸成本」。當行銷公司從原本的 AWS 區域遠端存取數據時，會產生跨區域的數據傳輸費用（Data Transfer Out）。

選擇 B 的原因：
透過設定 S3 跨區域複製 (Cross-Region Replication, CRR)，公司可以自動將數據複製到行銷公司所在區域的 S3 儲存貯體中。當行銷公司從其所在區域的儲存貯體讀取數據時，這屬於區域內的存取，可以大幅降低甚至消除跨區域傳輸的費用，從而達成降低成本的目標。

其他選項為何不正確：
A. 「請求者付費」功能僅是將傳輸成本轉嫁給請求者（行銷公司），這並沒有「最小化」整體的數據傳輸成本，只是改變了付費對象，不符合題目優化成本的需求。
C. AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) 主要用於共享 VPC 子網路、Transit Gateway 或特定資源，但 S3 儲存貯體本身是透過 Bucket Policy 或 IAM 權限來進行跨帳戶存取的，並非透過 RAM 來共享 S3 儲存貯體。
D. S3 Intelligent-Tiering 是一種儲存分層機制，用於根據存取模式自動優化儲存成本，它並不具備將數據同步到另一個帳戶或區域的功能，因此無法解決跨區域傳輸成本的問題。

題目(英):
A company uses AWS to host its public ecommerce website. The website uses an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator for trac from the
internet. The Global Accelerator accelerator forwards the trac to an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that is the entry point for an Auto
Scaling group.
The company recently identied a DDoS attack on the website. The company needs a solution to mitigate future attacks.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?
選項(英):
A. Congure an AWS WAF web ACL for the Global Accelerator accelerator to block trac by using rate-based rules
B. Congure an AWS Lambda function to read the ALB metrics to block attacks by updating a VPC network ACL
C. Congure an AWS WAF web ACL on the ALB to block trac by using rate-based rules
D. Congure an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the Global Accelerator accelerator
解析(英):
The correct answer is A. AWS Global Accelerator now supports direct integration with AWS WAF. By configuring AWS WAF directly on Global Accelerator, malicious traffic can be intercepted and filtered at the edge of the network before the traffic reaches back-end resources (such as ALB). This is the most direct way and requires the least implementation effort.

Option analysis:
- B Incorrect: Using Lambda to dynamically update VPC network ACL (NACL) is an extremely complex and difficult-to-maintain solution, and NACL has a limit on the number of rules and is not suitable for responding to large-scale DDoS attacks.
- C Incorrect: Although it is common practice to set up a WAF on an ALB, the traffic in the question scenario goes through the Global Accelerator first. If only set in ALB, attack traffic will still arrive at ALB first, which will not take advantage of Global Accelerator's edge-level protection, and if the attack scale is huge, ALB may be overwhelmed by traffic first.
- D Incorrect: Placing CloudFront in front of Global Accelerator is architecturally incorrect because both are edge services. Typically, Global Accelerator is placed behind CloudFront (if necessary), or an alternative is used. CloudFront cannot be placed directly in front of Global Accelerator. In addition, this will significantly increase the complexity of the architecture and does not meet the requirements of "minimum implementation effort".
題目(中): 一家公司使用 AWS 託管其公開的電子商務網站。該網站使用 AWS Global Accelerator 加速器來處理來自網際網路的流量。Global Accelerator 將流量轉發至作為 Auto Scaling 群組入口點的應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB)。該公司最近發現網站遭受 DDoS 攻擊。公司需要一個解決方案來減輕未來的攻擊。哪種解決方案能以「最少」的實作工作量滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 為 Global Accelerator 加速器設定 AWS WAF Web ACL，透過使用基於速率 (rate-based) 的規則來封鎖流量
B. 設定 AWS Lambda 函數以讀取 ALB 指標，透過更新 VPC 網路 ACL 來封鎖攻擊
C. 在 ALB 上設定 AWS WAF Web ACL，透過使用基於速率 (rate-based) 的規則來封鎖流量
D. 在 Global Accelerator 加速器前方設定 Amazon CloudFront 分發
解析(中):
正確答案是 A。AWS Global Accelerator 現在支援直接與 AWS WAF 整合。透過在 Global Accelerator 上直接設定 AWS WAF，可以在流量到達後端資源（如 ALB）之前，於網路邊緣處攔截並過濾惡意流量，這是最直接且實作工作量最小的方式。

選項分析：
- B 不正確：使用 Lambda 動態更新 VPC 網路 ACL (NACL) 是極為複雜且難以維護的方案，且 NACL 有規則數量限制，不適合用於應對大規模的 DDoS 攻擊。
- C 不正確：雖然在 ALB 上設定 WAF 是常見做法，但題目情境中流量是先經過 Global Accelerator。若僅在 ALB 設定，攻擊流量仍會先到達 ALB，這無法發揮 Global Accelerator 在邊緣層級進行防護的優勢，且若攻擊規模巨大，ALB 可能會先被流量淹沒。
- D 不正確：在 Global Accelerator 前方放置 CloudFront 在架構上是不正確的，因為兩者皆為邊緣服務，通常是將 Global Accelerator 放在 CloudFront 後方（若有需要），或者兩者擇一使用，無法直接將 CloudFront 放在 Global Accelerator 前方。此外，此舉會大幅增加架構複雜度，不符合「最少實作工作量」的要求。

題目(英):
A company uses an Amazon DynamoDB table to store data that the company receives from devices. The DynamoDB table supports a
customer-facing website to display recent activity on customer devices. The company congured the table with provisioned throughput for
writes and reads.
The company wants to calculate performance metrics for customer device data on a daily basis. The solution must have minimal effect on the
table's provisioned read and write capacity.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use an Amazon Athena SQL query with the Amazon Athena DynamoDB connector to calculate performance metrics on a recurring
schedule.
B. Use an AWS Glue job with the AWS Glue DynamoDB export connector to calculate performance metrics on a recurring schedule.
C. Use an Amazon Redshift COPY command to calculate performance metrics on a recurring schedule.
D. Use an Amazon EMR job with an Apache Hive external table to calculate performance metrics on a recurring schedule.
解析(英):
The correct answer is A.
Analysis:
1. **Why A is correct**: Amazon Athena’s DynamoDB connector allows users to execute SQL queries directly against DynamoDB tables without moving the data to other storage spaces. More importantly, Athena supports "filtering" and "projection" pushdown (Predicate and Projection Pushdown), which means that the query engine will minimize reading unnecessary data, and Athena's queries run on the server side and will not directly consume the read capacity unit (RCU) reserved for the application by the DynamoDB table. For scenarios that require regular analysis and want to have the least impact on the production environment, this is the most efficient and lightweight method.

2. **Why the other options are incorrect**:
   - **Option B**: Although AWS Glue jobs are powerful, using the DynamoDB export connector usually involves scanning the entire data table, which consumes a large amount of read capacity and has a greater impact on the performance of the production environment.
   - **Option C**: Amazon Redshift's COPY command is usually used to load data from S3 or other sources into Redshift. It is not the best tool for real-time analysis directly on DynamoDB, and the setup and maintenance costs are high.
   - **Option D**: Using Amazon EMR with Apache Hive for analysis usually requires large-scale data scanning (Scan), which will put a huge burden on DynamoDB's read throughput and may even lead to a decrease in website performance in the production environment, which does not meet the requirement of "minimum impact on provisioned capacity."
題目(中): 一家公司使用 Amazon DynamoDB 資料表來儲存從裝置接收到的資料。該 DynamoDB 資料表支援一個面向客戶的網站，用於顯示客戶裝置的近期活動。公司已為該資料表配置了讀取與寫入的預置吞吐量（Provisioned Throughput）。公司希望每日計算客戶裝置資料的效能指標。此解決方案必須對資料表的預置讀取與寫入容量影響最小。哪種解決方案符合這些要求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 Amazon Athena SQL 查詢搭配 Amazon Athena DynamoDB 連接器，按定期排程計算效能指標。
B. 使用 AWS Glue 作業搭配 AWS Glue DynamoDB 匯出連接器，按定期排程計算效能指標。
C. 使用 Amazon Redshift COPY 指令，按定期排程計算效能指標。
D. 使用 Amazon EMR 作業搭配 Apache Hive 外部資料表，按定期排程計算效能指標。
解析(中):
正確答案為 A。
解析：
1. **為什麼 A 是正確的**：Amazon Athena 的 DynamoDB 連接器允許使用者直接對 DynamoDB 資料表執行 SQL 查詢，而無需將資料移動到其他儲存空間。更重要的是，Athena 支援「篩選」與「投影」下推（Predicate and Projection Pushdown），這意味著查詢引擎會盡量減少讀取不必要的資料，且 Athena 的查詢運作在伺服器端，不會直接消耗 DynamoDB 資料表為應用程式預留的讀取容量單位（RCU），對於需要定期進行分析且希望對生產環境影響最小的場景，這是最有效率且輕量化的方式。

2. **為什麼其他選項不正確**：
   - **選項 B**：AWS Glue 作業雖然功能強大，但若使用 DynamoDB 匯出連接器，通常會涉及對整個資料表進行掃描（Scan），這會消耗大量的讀取容量，對生產環境的效能影響較大。
   - **選項 C**：Amazon Redshift 的 COPY 指令通常用於將資料從 S3 或其他來源載入到 Redshift 中，並非直接針對 DynamoDB 進行即時分析的最佳工具，且設定與維護成本較高。
   - **選項 D**：使用 Amazon EMR 搭配 Apache Hive 進行分析，通常需要進行大規模的資料掃描（Scan），這會對 DynamoDB 的讀取吞吐量造成極大負擔，甚至可能導致生產環境的網站效能下降，不符合「對預置容量影響最小」的需求。

題目(英):
A solutions architect is designing the cloud architecture for a new stateless application that will be deployed on AWS. The solutions architect
created an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) and launch template for the application.
Based on the number of jobs that need to be processed, the processing must run in parallel while adding and removing application Amazon
EC2 instances as needed. The application must be loosely coupled. The job items must be durably stored.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Auto Scaling
group by using the launch template with the scaling policy set to add and remove EC2 instances based on CPU usage.
B. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to hold the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Auto Scaling
group by using the launch template with the scaling policy set to add and remove EC2 instances based on network usage.
C. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to hold the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Auto Scaling
group by using the launch template with the scaling policy set to add and remove EC2 instances based on the number of items in the SQS
queue.
D. Create an Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Auto Scaling
group by using the launch template with the scaling policy set to add and remove EC2 instances based on the number of messages
published to the SNS topic.
解析(英):
The core requirements of this question are "loose coupling", "persistent storage of work items" and "dynamic expansion based on workload".

1. **Why C is the correct answer:**
   - **Loose Coupling and Persistence:** Amazon SQS is a message queuing service ideal for decoupling application components. It can store work items in a queue to ensure that even if the processing side is temporarily unavailable, work items will not be lost (persistent storage).
   - **Dynamic Scaling:** Auto Scaling groups support scaling based on the depth of the SQS queue (i.e. the `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible` metric). When the accumulated work items in the queue increase, the system will automatically add EC2 execution entities to process them, and when the workload decreases, they will be automatically removed. This fully meets the requirement of parallel processing according to the workload required in the question.

2. **Why the other options are incorrect:**
   - **Options A and D:** Amazon SNS is a publish/subscribe (Pub/Sub) service, mainly used for message push, and does not have the function of persisting message storage (if there are no subscribers, the message will be lost). In addition, Auto Scaling does not support scaling directly based on the number of messages in an SNS topic, so it does not meet the requirements.
   - **Option B:** Although SQS is used to achieve decoupling and persistence, it is inaccurate to set the expansion policy to "based on network usage". Network usage does not directly represent the workload to be processed, and cannot ensure timely and accurate expansion of computing resources when workload surges. In contrast, scaling by SQS queue depth (option C) is the metric that most directly reflects workload.
題目(中): 一位解決方案架構師正在為一個將部署在 AWS 上的新無狀態（stateless）應用程式設計雲端架構。該架構師已為此應用程式建立了 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 與啟動範本（launch template）。根據需要處理的工作量，處理程序必須以平行方式執行，並根據需求動態新增或移除 Amazon EC2 執行個體。該應用程式必須具備鬆散耦合（loosely coupled）的特性，且工作項目必須被持久化儲存。請問哪種解決方案符合這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 建立一個 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題來發送需要處理的工作。使用啟動範本建立一個 Auto Scaling 群組，並將擴展策略設定為根據 CPU 使用率來新增或移除 EC2 執行個體。
B. 建立一個 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列來存放需要處理的工作。使用啟動範本建立一個 Auto Scaling 群組，並將擴展策略設定為根據網路使用率來新增或移除 EC2 執行個體。
C. 建立一個 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 佇列來存放需要處理的工作。使用啟動範本建立一個 Auto Scaling 群組，並將擴展策略設定為根據 SQS 佇列中的項目數量來新增或移除 EC2 執行個體。
D. 建立一個 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題來發送需要處理的工作。使用啟動範本建立一個 Auto Scaling 群組，並將擴展策略設定為根據發佈到 SNS 主題的訊息數量來新增或移除 EC2 執行個體。
解析(中):
本題的核心需求在於「鬆散耦合」、「持久化儲存工作項目」以及「根據工作負載動態擴展」。

1. **為什麼 C 是正確答案：**
   - **鬆散耦合與持久化：** Amazon SQS 是一個訊息佇列服務，非常適合用於解耦應用程式組件。它能將工作項目儲存在佇列中，確保即使處理端暫時無法運作，工作項目也不會遺失（持久化儲存）。
   - **動態擴展：** Auto Scaling 群組支援根據 SQS 佇列的深度（即 `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible` 指標）來進行擴展。當佇列中累積的工作項目增加時，系統會自動新增 EC2 執行個體來處理，當工作量減少時則自動移除，這完全符合題目中「根據需要處理的工作量」進行平行處理的需求。

2. **為什麼其他選項不正確：**
   - **選項 A 與 D：** Amazon SNS 是一種發佈/訂閱（Pub/Sub）服務，主要用於訊息推送，並不具備持久化儲存訊息的功能（若無訂閱者，訊息會遺失）。此外，Auto Scaling 不支援直接根據 SNS 主題的訊息數量來進行擴展，因此不符合需求。
   - **選項 B：** 雖然使用了 SQS 達到解耦與持久化，但擴展策略設定為「根據網路使用率」是不準確的。網路使用率並不直接代表待處理的工作量，無法確保在工作量激增時能及時且精準地擴展運算資源。相比之下，根據 SQS 佇列深度擴展（選項 C）才是最直接反映工作負載的指標。

題目(英):
A global ecommerce company uses a monolithic architecture. The company needs a solution to manage the increasing volume of product
data. The solution must be scalable and have a modular service architecture. The company needs to maintain its structured database
schemas. The company also needs a storage solution to store product data and product images.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Use an Amazon EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group to deploy a containerized application. Use an Application Load Balancer to
distribute web trac. Use an Amazon RDS DB instance to store product data and product images.
B. Use AWS Lambda functions to manage the existing monolithic application. Use Amazon DynamoDB to store product data and product
images. Use Amazon Simple Notication Service (Amazon SNS) for event-driven communication between the Lambda functions.
C. Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with an Amazon EC2 deployment to deploy a containerized application. Use an
Amazon Aurora cluster to store the product data. Use AWS Step Functions to manage workows. Store the product images in Amazon S3
Glacier Deep Archive.
D. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate to deploy a containerized application. Use Amazon RDS with a
Multi-AZ deployment to store the product data. Store the product images in an Amazon S3 bucket.
解析(英):
The core of this question is "LEAST operational overhead" and meeting the requirements of "structured database" and "image storage".

Why the answer is D:
1. AWS Fargate is a serverless container execution environment. It does not need to manage the underlying EC2 execution individuals, which greatly reduces the maintenance and operation burden.
2. Amazon RDS is a managed relational database, which is very suitable for maintaining structured database schema.
3. Amazon S3 is a standard solution for storing unstructured objects such as images. It is highly scalable and easy to manage.
This combination meets modular architecture and scalability while minimizing infrastructure management work.

Why the other options are incorrect:
- A: Using EC2 to execute individuals requires self-management of operating systems, patches, and scaling strategies, and the operating overhead is higher than that of Fargate. Additionally, storing images in an RDS database is not a best practice and can lead to poor database performance and high costs.
- B: It is not practical to move existing "monolithic applications" directly to Lambda because Lambda has execution time constraints and is not suitable for handling large monolithic applications. In addition, DynamoDB is a NoSQL database, which is not suitable for scenarios that require maintaining a "structured database schema" and is not suitable for storing a large number of images.
- C: Amazon EKS needs to manage the Kubernetes control plane and nodes, which is extremely complex to operate. In addition, S3 Glacier Deep Archive has extremely high access latency (several hours) and is not suitable for storing product images that require frequent reading.
題目(中): 一家全球電子商務公司目前使用單體式架構（monolithic architecture）。該公司需要一套解決方案來管理日益增長的產品數據量。該解決方案必須具備可擴展性，並採用模組化服務架構。該公司需要維護其結構化資料庫綱要（schemas）。此外，公司還需要一個儲存解決方案來存放產品數據與產品圖片。哪種解決方案能以「最少」的營運開銷（operational overhead）滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 Auto Scaling 群組中的 Amazon EC2 執行個體來部署容器化應用程式。使用 Application Load Balancer 來分配網路流量。使用 Amazon RDS 資料庫執行個體來儲存產品數據與產品圖片。
B. 使用 AWS Lambda 函式來管理現有的單體式應用程式。使用 Amazon DynamoDB 來儲存產品數據與產品圖片。使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 進行 Lambda 函式之間的事件驅動通訊。
C. 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 搭配 Amazon EC2 部署來部署容器化應用程式。使用 Amazon Aurora 叢集來儲存產品數據。使用 AWS Step Functions 來管理工作流程。將產品圖片儲存於 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
D. 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 搭配 AWS Fargate 來部署容器化應用程式。使用具備多可用區（Multi-AZ）部署的 Amazon RDS 來儲存產品數據。將產品圖片儲存於 Amazon S3 儲存貯體（bucket）。
解析(中):
本題的核心在於「最少營運開銷（LEAST operational overhead）」以及滿足「結構化資料庫」與「圖片儲存」的需求。

為什麼答案是 D：
1. AWS Fargate 是無伺服器（Serverless）的容器執行環境，無需管理底層 EC2 執行個體，大幅降低了維運負擔。
2. Amazon RDS 是託管式關聯式資料庫，非常適合維護結構化資料庫綱要。
3. Amazon S3 是儲存圖片等非結構化物件的標準解決方案，具有高擴展性且易於管理。
此組合在滿足模組化架構與擴展性的同時，將基礎設施的管理工作降至最低。

為何其他選項不正確：
- A：使用 EC2 執行個體需要自行管理作業系統、修補程式與擴展策略，營運開銷高於 Fargate。此外，將圖片儲存在 RDS 資料庫中並非最佳實踐，會導致資料庫效能下降且成本高昂。
- B：將現有的「單體式應用程式」直接移至 Lambda 並不切實際，因為 Lambda 有執行時間限制且不適合處理大型單體應用。此外，DynamoDB 是 NoSQL 資料庫，不適合需要維護「結構化資料庫綱要」的場景，且不適合儲存大量圖片。
- C：Amazon EKS 需要管理 Kubernetes 控制平面與節點，營運複雜度極高。此外，S3 Glacier Deep Archive 的存取延遲極高（數小時），不適合存放需要頻繁讀取的產品圖片。

題目(英):
A company is migrating an application from an on-premises environment to AWS. The application will store sensitive data in Amazon S3. The
company must encrypt the data before storing the data in Amazon S3.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Encrypt the data by using client-side encryption with customer managed keys.
B. Encrypt the data by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
C. Encrypt the data by using server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C).
D. Encrypt the data by using client-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys.
解析(英):
The question clearly requires encryption "before storing data in Amazon S3." This means that the encryption operation must be completed before the data leaves the application server and is transferred to S3, that is, "client-side encryption."

Option A is correct: Using client-side encryption means that the data is encrypted on the application side before being sent to S3. Paired with the Customer Managed Key (CMK), the company can fully control the life cycle and access rights of the key, meeting the needs of high-security sensitive data.

Option B is incorrect: SSE-KMS is "server-side encryption". After the data is transmitted to S3, the S3 service encrypts it before writing to the disk. This does not meet the "before storing" encryption required by the question.

Option C is incorrect: SSE-C also belongs to "server-side encryption". It is encrypted by the S3 service after receiving the data. It also does not meet the "before storage" encryption required by the question.

Choice D is incorrect: Although this is client-side encryption, Amazon S3 does not provide an "S3 managed key" for client-side encryption. Client-side encryption must be handled by the client application itself (such as using AWS KMS or self-managed keys), and S3 cannot directly manage the client's encryption keys.
題目(中): 一家公司正在將應用程式從地端環境遷移至 AWS。該應用程式將在 Amazon S3 中儲存敏感資料。公司必須在將資料儲存到 Amazon S3 之前先進行加密。哪種解決方案符合這些要求？
選項(中):
A. 使用客戶託管金鑰（Customer Managed Keys）進行用戶端加密（Client-side encryption）。
B. 使用 AWS KMS 金鑰進行伺服器端加密（SSE-KMS）。
C. 使用客戶提供的金鑰進行伺服器端加密（SSE-C）。
D. 使用 Amazon S3 託管金鑰進行用戶端加密（Client-side encryption）。
解析(中):
題目明確要求「在將資料儲存到 Amazon S3 之前」進行加密，這代表加密作業必須在資料離開應用程式伺服器、傳輸至 S3 之前完成，即「用戶端加密（Client-side encryption）」。

選項 A 正確：使用用戶端加密意味著資料在傳送至 S3 前已在應用程式端完成加密。搭配客戶託管金鑰（CMK），公司可以完全掌控金鑰的生命週期與存取權限，符合高安全性的敏感資料需求。

選項 B 不正確：SSE-KMS 是「伺服器端加密」，資料是在傳送到 S3 後，由 S3 服務在寫入磁碟前進行加密，這不符合題目要求的「在儲存前（before storing）」加密。

選項 C 不正確：SSE-C 同樣屬於「伺服器端加密」，是由 S3 服務在接收到資料後進行加密，同樣不符合題目要求的「在儲存前」加密。

選項 D 不正確：雖然這是用戶端加密，但 Amazon S3 並不提供「S3 託管金鑰」來進行用戶端加密。用戶端加密必須由用戶端應用程式自行處理金鑰（如使用 AWS KMS 或自行管理的金鑰），S3 無法直接管理用戶端的加密金鑰。

題目(英):
A company wants to create an Amazon EMR cluster that multiple teams will use. The company wants to ensure that each team’s big data
workloads can access only the AWS services that each team needs to interact with. The company does not want the workloads to have access
to Instance Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2) on the cluster’s underlying EC2 instances.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Congure interface VPC endpoints for each AWS service that the teams need. Use the required interface VPC endpoints to submit the
big data workloads.
B. Create EMR runtime roles. Congure the cluster to use the runtime roles. Use the runtime roles to submit the big data workloads.
C. Create an EC2 IAM instance prole that has the required permissions for each team. Use the instance prole to submit the big data
workloads.
D. Create an EMR security conguration that has the EnableApplicationScopedIAMRole option set to false. Use the security conguration
to submit the big data workloads.
解析(英):
The correct answer is B.

The analysis is as follows:
1. **Why B is correct**: Amazon EMR Runtime Roles allow users to specify IAM roles for individual jobs (Jobs) or queries. This enables fine-grained access control, ensuring that workloads from different teams only have access to the AWS resources they need. In addition, when using the EMR execution phase role, EMR will prevent operations from directly accessing the credentials of the underlying EC2 execution instance through the isolation mechanism, thereby effectively limiting access to IMDSv2 and meeting security requirements.

2. **Why the other options are incorrect**:
   - **Option A**: The VPC endpoint is used to access AWS services in a private network. Although it can control the network path, it cannot provide fine-grained permission isolation for "different teams", nor can it solve the access restriction problem of IMDSv2.
   - **Option C**: The EC2 IAM instance profile is attached to the entire EC2 instance. If multiple teams share the same cluster, using an execution individual profile will cause all teams to share the same permissions, making it impossible to isolate permissions between teams, and jobs can still obtain the permissions of the execution instance through IMDSv2.
   - **Option D**: `EnableApplicationScopedIAMRole` is the setting to enable application-level IAM roles. Setting it to `false` will turn off this feature, which is contrary to the goal of "restricting access" required by the question and fails to achieve the purpose of isolating workload permissions for different teams.
題目(中): 一家公司想要建立一個多個團隊共用的 Amazon EMR 叢集。公司希望確保每個團隊的大數據工作負載只能存取該團隊所需的 AWS 服務。此外，公司不希望這些工作負載能夠存取叢集底層 EC2 執行個體上的執行個體中繼資料服務版本 2 (IMDSv2)。請問哪種解決方案能滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 為團隊所需的每個 AWS 服務設定介面 VPC 端點 (Interface VPC endpoints)。使用所需的介面 VPC 端點來提交大數據工作負載。
B. 建立 EMR 執行階段角色 (EMR runtime roles)。設定叢集以使用這些執行階段角色。使用這些執行階段角色來提交大數據工作負載。
C. 建立一個包含每個團隊所需權限的 EC2 IAM 執行個體設定檔 (Instance profile)。使用該執行個體設定檔來提交大數據工作負載。
D. 建立一個 EMR 安全組態 (Security configuration)，並將 EnableApplicationScopedIAMRole 選項設為 false。使用該安全組態來提交大數據工作負載。
解析(中):
正確答案為 B。

解析如下：
1. **為什麼 B 是正確的**：Amazon EMR 執行階段角色 (EMR Runtime Roles) 允許使用者為個別的作業 (Job) 或查詢指定 IAM 角色。這實現了細粒度的存取控制，確保不同團隊的工作負載僅能存取其所需的 AWS 資源。此外，當使用 EMR 執行階段角色時，EMR 會透過隔離機制防止作業直接存取底層 EC2 執行個體的憑證，從而有效地限制了對 IMDSv2 的存取，滿足了安全需求。

2. **為什麼其他選項不正確**：
   - **選項 A**：VPC 端點是用於在私有網路中存取 AWS 服務，雖然能控制網路路徑，但無法針對「不同團隊」提供細粒度的權限隔離，也無法解決 IMDSv2 的存取限制問題。
   - **選項 C**：EC2 IAM 執行個體設定檔是附加在整個 EC2 執行個體上的。如果多個團隊共用同一個叢集，使用執行個體設定檔會導致所有團隊共享相同的權限，無法實現團隊間的權限隔離，且作業依然可以透過 IMDSv2 獲取該執行個體的權限。
   - **選項 D**：`EnableApplicationScopedIAMRole` 是用於啟用應用程式層級 IAM 角色的設定。將其設為 `false` 會關閉此功能，這與題目要求的「限制存取」目標背道而馳，且無法達成隔離不同團隊工作負載權限的目的。

題目(英):
A solutions architect is designing an application that helps users ll out and submit registration forms. The solutions architect plans to use a
two-tier architecture that includes a web application server tier and a worker tier.
The application needs to process submitted forms quickly. The application needs to process each form exactly once. The solution must ensure
that no data is lost.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store
and forward form data.
B. Use an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data.
C. Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue between the web application server tier and the worker tier to
store and forward form data.
D. Use an AWS Step Functions workow. Create a synchronous workow between the web application server tier and the worker tier that
stores and forwards form data.
解析(英):
The core requirements of this question are "exactly-once processing" and "ensuring that data is not lost".

1. **Why A is the correct answer**: Amazon SQS FIFO (first in, first out) queues are specifically designed to provide strict message ordering and support "exactly-once processing" delivery semantics. This ensures that each form data will only be processed once and will not be repeated. At the same time, SQS, as a distributed queuing service, can ensure that data will not be lost during the transmission process, which is very suitable for decoupling the web server and worker layer.

2. **Why B is incorrect**: Amazon API Gateway is an API management service, mainly used for publishing, maintaining and monitoring APIs. It does not have a queuing function itself and cannot be used as a buffer layer to store and forward data, nor can it guarantee that messages are "processed only once".

3. **Why C is incorrect**: Amazon SQS Standard Queue provides "best-effort" sorting and guarantees "at-least-once" delivery. This means that in rare cases, messages may be delivered repeatedly, failing to meet the "process only once" condition required by the question.

4. **Why D is incorrect**: AWS Step Functions is suitable for coordinating the workflow of distributed applications. Although it can ensure task execution, the cost and complexity of the "store and forward" mechanism used to process a large number of form submissions are much higher than SQS. In addition, synchronous workflow (Synchronous Workflow) is usually used in scenarios that require immediate response, but when processing a large number of form submissions, using queues for asynchronous decoupling (Decoupling) is the best architectural practice.
題目(中): 一位解決方案架構師正在設計一個應用程式，協助使用者填寫並提交註冊表單。該架構師計畫使用包含網頁應用程式伺服器層與工作者層（worker tier）的雙層架構。該應用程式需要快速處理提交的表單，並確保每個表單「僅處理一次」（exactly-once）。此外，該解決方案必須確保不會遺失任何資料。請問哪種解決方案符合這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在網頁應用程式伺服器層與工作者層之間使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 佇列來儲存並轉發表單資料。
B. 在網頁應用程式伺服器層與工作者層之間使用 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 來儲存並轉發表單資料。
C. 在網頁應用程式伺服器層與工作者層之間使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 標準佇列來儲存並轉發表單資料。
D. 使用 AWS Step Functions 工作流程。在網頁應用程式伺服器層與工作者層之間建立一個同步工作流程來儲存並轉發表單資料。
解析(中):
本題的核心需求在於「僅處理一次」（exactly-once processing）以及「確保資料不遺失」。

1. **為什麼 A 是正確答案**：Amazon SQS FIFO（先進先出）佇列專門設計用於提供嚴格的訊息排序，並支援「僅處理一次」的傳遞語義（exactly-once processing）。這能確保每個表單資料只會被處理一次且不會重複，同時 SQS 作為分散式佇列服務，能確保資料在傳遞過程中不會遺失，非常適合解耦網頁伺服器與工作者層。

2. **為什麼 B 不正確**：Amazon API Gateway 是一個 API 管理服務，主要用於發布、維護與監控 API，它本身並不具備佇列功能，無法作為儲存與轉發資料的緩衝層，也無法保證訊息的「僅處理一次」傳遞。

3. **為什麼 C 不正確**：Amazon SQS 標準佇列（Standard Queue）提供「盡最大努力」（best-effort）的排序，且保證「至少一次」（at-least-once）的傳遞。這意味著在極少數情況下，訊息可能會重複傳遞，無法滿足題目要求的「僅處理一次」條件。

4. **為什麼 D 不正確**：AWS Step Functions 適用於協調分散式應用程式的工作流程，雖然它能確保任務執行，但若用於處理大量表單提交的「儲存與轉發」機制，其成本與複雜度遠高於 SQS。此外，同步工作流程（Synchronous Workflow）通常用於需要立即回應的場景，但在處理大量表單提交時，使用佇列進行非同步解耦（Decoupling）才是架構上的最佳實踐。

題目(英):
A nance company uses an on-premises search application to collect streaming data from various producers. The application provides real-
time updates to search and visualization features.
The company is planning to migrate to AWS and wants to use an AWS native solution.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Use Amazon EC2 instances to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon S3 buckets tor storage. Use Amazon Athena to search
the data. Use Amazon Managed Grafana to create visualizations.
B. Use Amazon EMR to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon Redshift for storage. Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to search the
data. Use Amazon QuickSight to create visualizations.
C. Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon DynamoDB for storage. Use
Amazon CloudWatch to create graphical dashboards to search and visualize the data.
D. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Use OpenSearch Service to
search the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to create visualizations.
解析(英):
The core requirement of this question lies in "real-time" data streaming processing, search and visualization.
Option D is the best solution because Amazon Kinesis Data Streams is designed for real-time streaming data, and Amazon OpenSearch Service (formerly Elasticsearch Service) is the industry's standard AWS native service for processing real-time search and analysis. It can provide a low-latency search experience and can be perfectly integrated with Amazon QuickSight for visualization, which fully meets the requirements of the question.

Analysis of other options:
Option A: Although Amazon Athena is suitable for querying data in S3, it is mainly used for interactive queries (Ad-hoc queries) and is not designed for the search and update of "real-time" streaming data, resulting in higher latency.
Option B: Amazon Redshift is a data warehouse (Data Warehouse), mainly used for complex analytical queries (OLAP), rather than real-time streaming search applications, and the processing architecture of EMR usually involves batch processing, which does not meet the needs of real-time updates.
Option C: Although Amazon DynamoDB is highly efficient, it is a key-value database and is not suitable for complex full-text search. Amazon CloudWatch is mainly used to monitor metrics and logs. Although it has dashboard functions, it is not a tool specifically designed to handle large-scale streaming data search and advanced visualization.
題目(中): 一家金融公司使用地端（on-premises）搜尋應用程式來收集來自各種生產者的串流資料。該應用程式提供搜尋與視覺化功能的即時更新。該公司計畫遷移至 AWS，並希望使用 AWS 原生解決方案。哪一個解決方案符合這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 Amazon EC2 執行個體來接收並處理資料串流，並存入 Amazon S3 儲存貯體。使用 Amazon Athena 搜尋資料。使用 Amazon Managed Grafana 建立視覺化。
B. 使用 Amazon EMR 來接收並處理資料串流，並存入 Amazon Redshift 進行儲存。使用 Amazon Redshift Spectrum 搜尋資料。使用 Amazon QuickSight 建立視覺化。
C. 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 來接收並處理資料串流，並存入 Amazon DynamoDB 進行儲存。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 建立圖形化儀表板來搜尋與視覺化資料。
D. 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 來接收並處理資料串流，並存入 Amazon OpenSearch Service。使用 OpenSearch Service 搜尋資料。使用 Amazon QuickSight 建立視覺化。
解析(中):
本題的核心需求在於「即時（real-time）」的資料串流處理、搜尋以及視覺化。
選項 D 是最佳解，因為 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 專為即時串流資料設計，而 Amazon OpenSearch Service（前身為 Elasticsearch Service）是業界處理即時搜尋與分析的標準 AWS 原生服務，能夠提供低延遲的搜尋體驗，並能與 Amazon QuickSight 完美整合進行視覺化，完全符合題目需求。

其他選項分析：
選項 A：Amazon Athena 雖然適合查詢 S3 中的資料，但它主要用於互動式查詢（Ad-hoc queries），並非針對「即時」串流資料的搜尋與更新所設計，延遲較高。
選項 B：Amazon Redshift 屬於資料倉儲（Data Warehouse），主要用於複雜的分析查詢（OLAP），而非即時的串流搜尋應用，且 EMR 的處理架構通常涉及批次處理，不符合即時更新的需求。
選項 C：Amazon DynamoDB 雖然效能高，但它是鍵值（Key-Value）資料庫，不適合進行複雜的全文搜尋（Full-text search）。Amazon CloudWatch 主要用於監控指標與日誌，雖然有儀表板功能，但並非專門用於處理大規模串流資料搜尋與進階視覺化的工具。

題目(英):
A company currently runs an on-premises application that usesASP.NET on Linux machines. The application is resource-intensive and serves
customers directly.
The company wants to modernize the application to .NET. The company wants to run the application on containers and to scale based on
Amazon CloudWatch metrics. The company also wants to reduce the time spent on operational maintenance activities.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Use AWS App2Container to containerize the application. Use an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the application to Amazon
Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.
B. Use AWS App2Container to containerize the application. Use an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the application to Amazon
Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2 instances.
C. Use AWS App Runner to containerize the application. Use App Runner to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service
(Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.
D. Use AWS App Runner to containerize the application. Use App Runner to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service
(Amazon EKS) on Amazon EC2 instances.
解析(英):
The correct answer is A.
The analysis is as follows:
1. **Why A is correct**: AWS App2Container is the standard tool for converting existing on-premises applications into containerized applications. Deploying applications to Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate is the best choice because Fargate is a serverless computing engine and users do not need to manage the underlying EC2 execution instances (such as patching the operating system, cluster expansion, etc.), which can minimize operational overhead (Operational Overhead) and fully supports automatic expansion based on CloudWatch metrics.

2. **Why B is wrong**: Although it is correct to use App2Container and ECS, choosing Amazon EC2 execution individuals as the underlying computing resources means that the company must manage the maintenance, operating system updates, and capacity planning of the EC2 execution individuals by itself. This will increase maintenance overhead and does not meet the requirements of the topic "Minimum Maintenance Overhead".

3. **Why C is wrong**: AWS App Runner is a fully managed service, which itself includes the function of deploying and executing containers. There is no need to deploy to Amazon ECS through App Runner. In addition, App Runner and ECS are two different deployment paths, and the option description logic is wrong.

4. **Why D is wrong**: Likewise, App Runner does not need to be deployed to Amazon EKS. In addition, Amazon EKS belongs to Kubernetes cluster management, which involves complex control plane and node maintenance. Its maintenance cost is much higher than that of ECS on Fargate, which does not meet the requirements of the question.
題目(中): 一家公司目前在 Linux 機器上執行使用 ASP.NET 的地端應用程式。該應用程式屬於資源密集型，並直接服務客戶。公司希望將應用程式現代化為 .NET，並希望在容器上執行該應用程式，且能根據 Amazon CloudWatch 指標進行擴展。公司同時希望減少在維運活動上花費的時間。哪種解決方案能以最少的維運開銷滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 AWS App2Container 將應用程式容器化。使用 AWS CloudFormation 範本將應用程式部署到 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。
B. 使用 AWS App2Container 將應用程式容器化。使用 AWS CloudFormation 範本將應用程式部署到 Amazon EC2 執行個體上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。
C. 使用 AWS App Runner 將應用程式容器化。使用 App Runner 將應用程式部署到 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。
D. 使用 AWS App Runner 將應用程式容器化。使用 App Runner 將應用程式部署到 Amazon EC2 執行個體上的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)。
解析(中):
正確答案是 A。
解析如下：
1. **為什麼 A 是正確的**：AWS App2Container 是將現有地端應用程式轉換為容器化應用程式的標準工具。將應用程式部署到 Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate 是最佳選擇，因為 Fargate 是一種無伺服器（Serverless）運算引擎，使用者無需管理底層的 EC2 執行個體（如修補作業系統、叢集擴展等），這能最大程度地減少維運開銷（Operational Overhead），同時完全支援根據 CloudWatch 指標進行自動擴展。

2. **為什麼 B 是錯誤的**：雖然使用 App2Container 和 ECS 是正確的，但選擇 Amazon EC2 執行個體作為底層運算資源，意味著公司必須自行管理 EC2 執行個體的維護、作業系統更新及容量規劃，這會增加維運開銷，不符合題目「最少維運開銷」的要求。

3. **為什麼 C 是錯誤的**：AWS App Runner 是一個全託管服務，它本身就包含部署與執行容器的功能，不需要再透過 App Runner 去部署到 Amazon ECS。此外，App Runner 與 ECS 是兩個不同的部署路徑，選項敘述邏輯錯誤。

4. **為什麼 D 是錯誤的**：同樣地，App Runner 不需要部署到 Amazon EKS。此外，Amazon EKS 屬於 Kubernetes 叢集管理，涉及複雜的控制平面與節點維護，其維運開銷遠高於 ECS on Fargate，不符合題目需求。

題目(英):
A company is designing a new internal web application in the AWS Cloud. The new application must securely retrieve and store multiple
employee usernames and passwords from an AWS managed service.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Store the employee credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Use AWS CloudFormation and the BatchGetSecretValue API
to retrieve usernames and passwords from Parameter Store.
B. Store the employee credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Use AWS CloudFormation and AWS Batch with the BatchGetSecretValue API to
retrieve the usernames and passwords from Secrets Manager.
C. Store the employee credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Use AWS CloudFormation and AWS Batch with the
BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve the usernames and passwords from Parameter Store.
D. Store the employee credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Use AWS CloudFormation and the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve the
usernames and passwords from Secrets Manager.
解析(英):
AWS Secrets Manager is a best practice when storing sensitive credentials (such as usernames and passwords) in AWS because it provides automatic rotation, encryption, and more granular access control, and is designed for managing confidential information. Although Systems Manager Parameter Store can also store secrets, Secrets Manager is better at handling credential lifecycle management.

The options are analyzed as follows:
1. Why D is the correct answer: Secrets Manager is the standard service for storing credentials, and the BatchGetSecretValue API is the correct API for retrieving secrets from Secrets Manager batches. This solution does not require additional configuration of computing resources (such as AWS Batch), so the operating overhead is minimal.
2. Why A and C are incorrect: Parameter Store is mainly used to store configuration data. Although it supports SecureString, it is not as complete as Secrets Manager in terms of certificate management functions (such as automatic rotation). Additionally, Parameter Store does not use the BatchGetSecretValue API (which is Secrets Manager's API).
3. Why B and C are incorrect: AWS Batch is a service used to perform batch computing tasks. Introducing it just to "retrieve" credentials will increase unnecessary architectural complexity and operational overhead, which is contrary to the goal of "minimum operational overhead" required by the question.
題目(中): 一家公司正在 AWS 雲端設計一個新的內部網頁應用程式。該應用程式必須從 AWS 受管服務中安全地檢索並儲存多個員工的使用者名稱與密碼。哪種解決方案能以最少的營運開銷（operational overhead）滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將員工憑證儲存在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。使用 AWS CloudFormation 和 BatchGetSecretValue API 從 Parameter Store 檢索使用者名稱與密碼。
B. 將員工憑證儲存在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。使用 AWS CloudFormation 和 AWS Batch 搭配 BatchGetSecretValue API 從 Secrets Manager 檢索使用者名稱與密碼。
C. 將員工憑證儲存在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。使用 AWS CloudFormation 和 AWS Batch 搭配 BatchGetSecretValue API 從 Parameter Store 檢索使用者名稱與密碼。
D. 將員工憑證儲存在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。使用 AWS CloudFormation 和 BatchGetSecretValue API 從 Secrets Manager 檢索使用者名稱與密碼。
解析(中):
在 AWS 中儲存敏感憑證（如使用者名稱與密碼）時，AWS Secrets Manager 是最佳實踐，因為它提供自動輪換（Rotation）、加密與更精細的存取控制，專為管理機密資訊而設計。雖然 Systems Manager Parameter Store 也可以儲存機密，但 Secrets Manager 在處理憑證生命週期管理方面更具優勢。

針對選項分析如下：
1. 為何 D 是正確答案：Secrets Manager 是儲存憑證的標準服務，且 BatchGetSecretValue API 是用於從 Secrets Manager 批次檢索機密的正確 API。此方案無需額外配置運算資源（如 AWS Batch），因此營運開銷最小。
2. 為何 A 與 C 不正確：Parameter Store 主要用於儲存組態資料，雖然支援 SecureString，但在憑證管理功能（如自動輪換）上不如 Secrets Manager 完善。此外，Parameter Store 並不使用 BatchGetSecretValue API（這是 Secrets Manager 的 API）。
3. 為何 B 與 C 不正確：AWS Batch 是一項用於執行批次運算任務的服務，將其引入僅為了「檢索」憑證會增加不必要的架構複雜度與營運開銷，這與題目要求「最少營運開銷」的目標背道而馳。

題目(英):
A company that is in the ap-northeast-1 Region has a eet of thousands of AWS Outposts servers. The company has deployed the servers at
remote locations around the world. All the servers regularly download new software versions that consist of 100 les. There is signicant
latency before all servers run the new software versions.
The company must reduce the deployment latency for new software versions.
Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution in ap-northeast-1 that includes a
CachingDisabled cache policy. Congure the S3 bucket as the origin. Download the software by using signed URLs.
B. Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Create a second S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region. Congure replication between the
buckets. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses ap-northeast-1 as the primary origin and us-east-1 as the secondary origin.
Download the software by using signed URLs.
C. Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Congure Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration. Download the software by using the S3
Transfer Acceleration endpoint.
D. Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Congure the S3 bucket as the origin.
Download the software by using signed URLs.
解析(英):
The core goal of this question is to reduce the delay in downloading software updates from globally distributed Outposts servers while requiring "minimum operational overhead."

Option D is the correct answer: Amazon CloudFront is a global content delivery network (CDN) that uses edge locations (Edge Locations) around the world to cache content. When software is downloaded from Outposts servers around the world, CloudFront will serve the content from the edge node closest to the server, significantly reducing the cross-region network latency caused by direct downloads from ap-northeast-1. Using signed URLs can ensure the security of the download process, and this architecture is simple to set up and has extremely low maintenance costs.

Choice A is incorrect: Although CloudFront is used, the `CachingDisabled` caching policy is set, which means that CloudFront will not cache anything. This will cause each request to be sent back to the original server (S3), completely losing the effect of CDN accelerated downloads and unable to solve the latency problem.

Option B is incorrect: This option introduces Cross-Region Replication and multi-source settings, which will significantly increase the complexity of the architecture and operational overhead (such as managing replication settings, monitoring synchronization status, etc.). For pure software distribution needs, this is over-engineering.

Option C is incorrect: S3 Transfer Acceleration is primarily used to speed up the "upload" of files to S3 storage, or to optimize long-distance downloads under certain circumstances. However, compared with CloudFront, CloudFront's edge caching capability can provide better performance and scalability in scenarios where a large number of servers download the same content at the same time, and CloudFront's caching mechanism is more effective in scenarios where the same software version is downloaded repeatedly.
題目(中): 一家位於 ap-northeast-1 區域的公司擁有一組數以千計的 AWS Outposts 伺服器。該公司已將這些伺服器部署在全球各地的遠端位置。所有伺服器都會定期下載由 100 個檔案組成的新軟體版本。在所有伺服器執行新軟體版本之前，存在顯著的延遲。該公司必須減少新軟體版本的部署延遲。哪種解決方案能以最少的營運開銷滿足此要求？
選項(中):
A. 在 ap-northeast-1 建立一個 Amazon S3 儲存貯體。在 ap-northeast-1 設定一個包含 CachingDisabled 快取政策的 Amazon CloudFront 分發。將 S3 儲存貯體設定為來源。使用簽章 URL (signed URLs) 下載軟體。
B. 在 ap-northeast-1 建立一個 Amazon S3 儲存貯體。在 us-east-1 區域建立第二個 S3 儲存貯體。設定儲存貯體之間的複寫。設定一個使用 ap-northeast-1 作為主要來源、us-east-1 作為次要來源的 Amazon CloudFront 分發。使用簽章 URL 下載軟體。
C. 在 ap-northeast-1 建立一個 Amazon S3 儲存貯體。設定 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration。使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 端點下載軟體。
D. 在 ap-northeast-1 建立一個 Amazon S3 儲存貯體。設定一個 Amazon CloudFront 分發。將 S3 儲存貯體設定為來源。使用簽章 URL 下載軟體。
解析(中):
本題的核心目標是減少全球分佈的 Outposts 伺服器下載軟體更新的延遲，同時要求「最少的營運開銷」。

選項 D 為正確答案：Amazon CloudFront 是一個全球內容傳遞網路 (CDN)，它利用遍佈全球的邊緣節點 (Edge Locations) 來快取內容。當全球各地的 Outposts 伺服器下載軟體時，CloudFront 會從距離伺服器最近的邊緣節點提供內容，大幅減少從 ap-northeast-1 直接下載所帶來的跨區域網路延遲。使用簽章 URL 可以確保下載過程的安全性，且此架構設定簡單，維護成本極低。

選項 A 不正確：雖然使用了 CloudFront，但設定了 `CachingDisabled` 快取政策，這意味著 CloudFront 不會快取任何內容。這會導致每個請求都必須回傳至原始伺服器 (S3)，完全失去了 CDN 加速下載的效果，無法解決延遲問題。

選項 B 不正確：此選項引入了跨區域複寫 (Cross-Region Replication) 和多來源設定，這會顯著增加架構的複雜度與營運開銷（例如管理複寫設定、監控同步狀態等）。對於單純的軟體分發需求而言，這屬於過度設計 (Over-engineering)。

選項 C 不正確：S3 Transfer Acceleration 主要用於加速「上傳」檔案至 S3 儲存貯體，或者在特定情況下優化長距離下載。然而，與 CloudFront 相比，CloudFront 的邊緣快取能力在處理「大量伺服器同時下載相同內容」的場景下，能提供更好的效能與擴展性，且 CloudFront 的快取機制對於重複下載相同軟體版本的場景更為有效。

題目(英):
A company currently runs an on-premises stock trading application by using Microsoft Windows Server. The company wants to migrate the
application to the AWS Cloud.
The company needs to design a highly available solution that provides low-latency access to block storage across multiple Availability Zones.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?
選項(英):
A. Congure a Windows Server cluster that spans two Availability Zones on Amazon EC2 instances. Install the application on both cluster
nodes. Use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server as shared storage between the two cluster nodes.
B. Congure a Windows Server cluster that spans two Availability Zones on Amazon EC2 instances. Install the application on both cluster
nodes. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD (gp3) volumes as storage attached to the EC2 instances. Set
up application-level replication to sync data from one EBS volume in one Availability Zone to another EBS volume in the second
Availability Zone.
C. Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances in two Availability Zones. Congure one EC2 instance as active and the second EC2
instance in standby mode. Use an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ le system to access the data by using Internet Small
Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) protocol.
D. Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances in two Availability Zones. Congure one EC2 instance as active and the second EC2
